title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
description:
About the role 
We are looking for an ambitious and experienced Strategic Customer Success Manager. In this role, you are part of a fast-growing Customer Success team and build strong relationships with the largest global network accounts in the Accounting industry.
You take responsibility for the Customer Success strategy and the continuous growth of our existing customer portfolio. Your efforts will drive customer value and outcomes as well as uncover additional uses for our product. If you care about delivering value to customers, we would love to talk to you!
 Why DataSnipper? 
Audit and finance are still massively manual, and we’re changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.
Now, we’re taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we don’t sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence — meaning it doesn’t just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.
We’re not just applying AI, we’re redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.
 What you will do 
 Enterprise Account Planning: Develop and execute success plans specifically designed for our strategic customers. Work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to develop the Customer Success strategy and to drive customer engagement.
 Relationship Management: Cultivate and nurture multi-threaded relationships with key stakeholders across complex global customers. Understand their business goals, challenges, and technology needs.
 Revenue Expansion: Drive customer expansion by identifying opportunities for upsell, cross-sell, and additional value-added services. Collaborate closely with other GTM teams to maximize value from these high-profile accounts.
 Customer Advocacy: Establish and grow a customer advocacy program within strategic customers. Leverage success stories and testimonials to highlight the impact of DataSnipper's solutions within this prestigious customer base.
 Improve the CS organization & beyond: Create & optimize processes for the strategic accounts team and beyond.
 What you bring 
5+ years in a customer success role, with a proven track record in working with global enterprise clients
Possess a proactive mindset with a drive to innovate, develop new processes, and take on strategic initiatives aimed at achieving future-focused business outcomes
Demonstrate strong project and time management skills with the ability to self-start, own tasks, and deliver successful results for customers
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to present to executives and key decision-makers
Strong affinity with the software industry and understanding of B2B relationships
Full working proficiency in English
 What We Offer: 
Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact
Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share the company's success and growth
Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary
28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance
Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office
Daily, freshly prepared lunches by our in-house chef to keep you energized
NS business card for easy commuting to the office
Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills
Engage with a vibrant international team spread across five global offices
Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together
Access to OpenUp, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing
 Recruitment Process 
Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)
Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)
Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)
Final Interview (30 minutes, online) 
 Ready to Elevate Your Career? 
 Apply now and let’s explore how you can make an impact at DataSnipper! 🚀

title: GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst, Account Management
location: United States or San Francisco or New York City or London or Dublin or Tel Aviv or Sydney
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 
As a GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst, Account Management at Vanta, you will support the day-to-day operations and strategic execution of our global Account Management organization. You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and AM leadership to improve forecasting, pipeline generation, renewals, expansion, book management, and overall operational rigor.
Revenue Operations at Vanta aims to unlock revenue for our GTM teams by building scalable processes, delivering actionable insights, and removing operational friction. Within Account Management, this means helping our teams retain and grow customers while creating the operating infrastructure and visibility leaders need to run the business effectively.
Success in this role is determined by your ability to operate with speed and precision, turn data into actionable insights, build strong partnerships with the field, and continuously improve how our Account Management organization operates.
 What you’ll do as a GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst, Account Management at Vanta: 
Serve as a key operational partner to Account Managers and AM leadership, helping resolve day-to-day operational questions and escalations related to account ownership, Rules of Engagement, renewals, expansion, pipeline, and GTM data.
Own and support the AM operating rhythm, including recurring forecast and pipeline preparation, business reviews, scorecards, and performance reporting.
Inspect renewal, expansion, pipeline, and retention performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate those findings into clear recommendations for AM leadership.
Run recurring audits across pipeline, opportunities, account books, forecasting, and CRM hygiene to improve data quality and operating discipline.
Support book management and account movement, ensuring account ownership and territory changes are executed accurately and consistently.
Partner with AM leadership to improve pipeline generation and expansion motions, including tracking performance against targets and identifying opportunities to improve conversion and execution.
Develop and maintain source-of-truth reporting and operating metrics for Account Managers and leaders, primarily within Salesforce and other GTM systems.
Partner closely with Systems, Analytics, Finance, Deal Desk, and other Revenue Operations teams to identify and implement process and tooling improvements.
Manage competing priorities across recurring operational responsibilities and strategic projects, communicating tradeoffs and ensuring deadlines are met.
Support cross-functional initiatives from requirements gathering through rollout, documentation, enablement, and ongoing adoption.
 How to be successful in this role: 
Strong understanding of B2B SaaS post-sales and Account Management motions, including renewals, retention, expansion, forecasting, and pipeline management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify a business challenge, quantify its revenue or customer impact, and recommend a path forward.
Ability to move comfortably between day-to-day operational execution and broader process improvement.
Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted partnerships with Account Managers and AM leadership.
Excellent communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex data into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders.
Strong attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy and operational execution.
Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and comfort analyzing large datasets.
Advanced Salesforce reporting and dashboard experience.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment while maintaining clear communication around progress, risks, and tradeoffs.
A mindset of continuous improvement—you look beyond completing the task at hand to identify how we can make the underlying process more scalable and effective.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
 What you can expect as a Vanta’n: 
Industry-competitive salary and equity
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans
16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
Health & wellness stipend
Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend
Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office
Family planning benefits
Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting
Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time
11 company-paid holidays
Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney
To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials. 
#LI-remote
 At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply. 
 About Vanta 
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.
 Referral Instructions 
If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

title: Customer Success Operations Manager, EMEA
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
The Senior Manager, Customer First Operations, EMEA will play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling our rapidly growing EMEA Customer First organisation. Sitting within our EMEA GTM Operations team, working closely with the Global CX Operations team, this role acts as the primary operational partner for the EMEA VP of Customer First and other senior CX leadership. You will be responsible for establishing and implementing operations rigour and standards for the CX team, spanning Customer Success and Technical Account Management (TAM), while working closely with adjacent teams including Renewals, Support, and Professional Services.
In this role, you will design, refine, and continuously optimise our Management Systems, bridging the gap between corporate strategy and regional execution to maximise Net Revenue Retention (NRR). We are looking for an experienced, highly collaborative candidate with a growth mindset, exceptional analytical skills, and an appetite for constant improvement. You will be tasked with integrating the customer journey from sales through to customer success, ensuring that global and local standards are consistently adhered to and operate in support of our aggressive growth targets. 
 Job Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Be a trusted operational guardrail: Partner deeply with Global Operations to define and maintain strict consistency across processes, preventing regional drift or siloed operations while ensuring global standards support EMEA growth.
 Establish and govern the Operating Rhythm: Maintain and govern the "operating rhythm" of the CX organisation. Ensure critical cadences (e.g. Get Well Plans, Account Reviews, Path to Green reviews, and Leader Cadences) run effectively with 100% execution and high data quality.
 Drive Management System Optimisation: Act as the operational owner of the EMEA Customer First Management System. Working closely with the Global CX Operations team to translate strategy into predictable regional execution across three core pillars: KPIs, Standards, and Operating Cadences.
 Enable Cross-Functional Handoffs: Actively drive Customer First execution by working with operations peers to improve critical intersections. Optimise the handoffs and alignment between Sales, Renewals, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success.
 Maintain Customer Lifecycle Visibility: Keep an uncompromised view of the broader customer lifecycle through every major phase: Purchase & Plan, Learn, Deploy & Adopt, Use & Grow, Renew & Expand, and Advocate .
 Mitigate Risk via "Path to Green": Oversee the execution and accountability of regional "Get Well Plans", tracking Churn Dollars Saved against regional worst-case boundaries to proactively transition at-risk segments back to health.
 Shift to Leading Metrics: Drive the regional shift from lagging performance indicators (Renewal & Expansion rates) to leading ones (Stakeholder Expansion, Outcome Attainment, Customer Health targets >80% Green, and Lead Pass generation).
 Provide Operational Muscle for Scaling: Evaluate operational experiments (e.g. Key Account initiatives) to test new methodologies, optimise workflows, and scale the organisation efficiently.
 Deliver Executive Read-outs: Prepare and lead comprehensive Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews (MBR/QBR) for regional and global stakeholders, delivering a unified, metrics-driven narrative of EMEA performance.
 Manage Documentation Lifecycle: Own the quality, freshness, and accuracy of the internal documentation repository, including playbooks, customer asset standards (SBRs, MBRs, QBRs), and operational frameworks.
 Capacity and Coverage Planning: Drive and support the resource planning process to ensure effective and efficient coverage of top priority accounts aligning with aligned coverage strategies and priorities
 Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 
Demonstrated experience and success in GTM operations, customer success operations, or revenue operations, preferably within a SaaS and Enterprise business model.
Exceptional analytical and quantitative skills; good with numbers, highly logical in thinking, and capable of driving sound decision-making from complex data.
Deep understanding of the end-to-end customer journey, the enterprise software lifecycle, and business outcome attainment.
Strong proficiency in leveraging AI tools and applications to drive operational efficiency, process automation, and data analysis.
Outstanding collaboration and communication skills (both written and verbal), with a proven ability to partner with cross-functional teams, bridge gaps, and gain buy-in.
A strong growth mindset with an appetite for constant improvement, change management, and navigating high-growth, performance-focused environments.
Extreme attention to detail, specifically regarding data hygiene, governance, and operational rigour.
Deep experience with CRM and CS platforms (e.g. Salesforce.com, Gainsight) and data visualisation/reporting tools.
Proven track record of evaluating operational experiments and implementing successful learnings to optimise workflows.
True team player who is comfortable working with both global and local stakeholders to unify strategies.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who are we?
 Want to build strategic partnerships with leading financial institutions and help them protect millions of customers from fraud, scams, and emerging cyber threats? 
We help the world's leading banks stay ahead of fraudsters, scammers, and cybercriminals. Our technology protects millions of users every day by detecting fraud, malware, and emerging attack techniques before damage is done. We do this by combining 15 years of extensive research with our own smart software.
At ThreatFabric, we're not just shaping the future of cybersecurity - we're defining it. With our headquarters in the vibrant city of Amsterdam, ThreatFabric stands at the forefront of combating online fraud, mobile malware, and threat intelligence.
Your mission
Position: Full-time | 40 hours per week
Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands | Hybrid (2–3 days in the office)
Salary Range: 75.000,- / 95.000,-
Reports to: VP, Global Sales (Customer Success is part of Sales)
 About the job 
As Customer Success Manager, Strategic Accounts at ThreatFabric, you are responsible for the relationship, retention, and growth of our most strategic financial institution customers. These include leading banks and payment companies whose fraud prevention programmes depend on our platform every day.
This is a senior, revenue-accountable role in which you will act as a trusted advisor, executive partner, and internal champion for a focused portfolio of high-value accounts. You will play a key role in protecting and expanding some of our largest customer relationships.
Customer Success is part of our Global Sales organisation. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Data Science, and Solution Engineering to ensure customers achieve measurable fraud-loss reduction and a clear return on investment. You will also identify and develop expansion opportunities across new products, use cases, and business lines.
The Customer Success Manager owns the customer relationship, customer success strategy, retention planning, and identification and development of expansion opportunities. Sales remains responsible for commercial pricing, contract negotiations, and the formal closing of renewals and expansion opportunities. You will work closely together throughout this process.
 Your key responsibilities will include: 
Owning the relationship, retention strategy, and growth plan for a portfolio of strategic financial institution accounts.
Building strong, trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a strategic advisor on fraud prevention, product adoption, and business outcomes.
Developing and maintaining strategic account plans with clear objectives, actions, and success measures.
Proactively monitoring upcoming renewals, identifying risks, and coordinating retention plans with Sales.
Identifying, qualifying, and developing expansion opportunities across products, use cases, regions, and business lines.
Working with Sales during renewal and expansion processes, with Sales responsible for pricing, contract negotiations, and closing.
Demonstrating measurable customer value, including fraud-loss reduction, product adoption, and return on investment.
Conducting regular executive business reviews and clearly communicating progress, risks, and opportunities.
Working closely with Sales, Product, Data Science, Solution Engineering, and other internal teams to deliver successful customer outcomes.
Representing customer priorities internally and ensuring relevant feedback is communicated to product and executive leadership.
Monitoring customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and commercial performance.
Responding promptly and effectively to customer requests, issues, and escalations.
Contributing to the continued development and scalability of ThreatFabric's Customer Success organisation and processes.
Staying informed about evolving fraud patterns and attack methods to better understand and support customer priorities.
 What We Offer 
A 12-month employment contract with the intention to extend. Subject to mutual satisfaction, this may lead to a permanent position.
A competitive salary between 75.000,- and 95.000,- annually that reflects your skills and experience.
Commission scheme
25 holidays per year.
8% holiday allowance (included in annual salary).
A Pension Scheme.
A stimulating and supportive work environment that encourages growth and development.
An annual personal Growth and Development budget.
The opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly growing tech company.
Flexible Remote / Hybrid work-from-home options to promote work-life balance.
Flexible working hours.
Active ThreatFabric events and FitFabric bootcamps.
Active knowledge-sharing huddles.
Who are we looking for?
 Essential Experience & Skills 
Proven experience in Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, or a comparable customer-facing role.
Experience managing high-value enterprise customers and complex customer relationships.
Demonstrated responsibility for customer retention, renewals, and account growth.
Experience working with enterprise software or SaaS solutions.
Ability to translate product capabilities and customer requirements into measurable business outcomes and return on investment.
Experience building relationships with senior decision-makers and executive stakeholders.
Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify and develop expansion opportunities in collaboration with Sales.
Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Fluency in English, both spoken and written.
Willingness to travel internationally to customers.
 Preferred Experience & Knowledge 
The following experience is valuable, but candidates are not expected to meet every requirement. Industry and product-specific knowledge can be developed in the role.
Experience working with banks, payment companies, or other financial institutions.
Experience within fraud prevention, cybersecurity, fintech, financial crime, or financial services.
Experience working in an international technology company or scale-up environment.
Familiarity with behavioural biometrics, device intelligence, fraud transaction monitoring, or case management platforms.
Knowledge of evolving fraud patterns and attack methods.
Experience with solutions from companies such as NICE Actimize, Feedzai, Featurespace, or similar vendors.
A bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
 Creativity & Innovation 
Ability to develop creative and strategic solutions to complex customer challenges.
Translates customer needs and commercial opportunities into practical and implementable actions.
Identifies new use cases and opportunities to increase customer value and product adoption.
Adapts the Customer Success approach to different organisations, stakeholders, and business priorities.
 Problem Solving 
Strong analytical skills to identify, analyse, and resolve customer, product, and commercial challenges.
Able to identify risks early and develop clear mitigation and recovery plans.
Uses customer data, product insights, and commercial information to support decisions.
Able to clearly explain problem-solving approaches and recommended actions.
Prioritises effectively across multiple strategic accounts and competing stakeholder needs.
 Communication & Interpersonal Skills 
Capable of explaining complex fraud, product, and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Confident engaging with senior decision-makers and executive stakeholders.
Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
Able to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and internal teams.
Strong team player with a collaborative and commercially minded approach.
Approachable, empathetic, and a good listener with clear and positive communication skills.
Comfortable managing difficult conversations, customer concerns, and escalations.
 Continuous Improvement 
Actively seeks opportunities to improve customer outcomes, retention, growth, and operational efficiency.
Maintains a critical mindset to drive sustainable improvements in Customer Success processes and workflows.
Uses customer insights and feedback to support improvements across Product, Sales, and service delivery.
Contributes to building a scalable and repeatable enterprise Customer Success approach.
Demonstrates a strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
Keeps up to date with developments in fraud prevention, financial services, cybersecurity, and enterprise Customer Success.
What we offer
Why us?
 Protecting people, not just systems
 At ThreatFabric, your work has a direct impact on the lives of millions of people. Every day, fraudsters, scammers, and cybercriminals target individuals and financial institutions around the world. The technology we build helps stop these attacks before they cause harm, protecting not only money, but also trust, confidence, and peace of mind.
Unlike many technology companies, the problems we solve are real, complex, and constantly evolving. You'll work on challenges that make a measurable difference and see your contributions translated into solutions used by some of the world's leading financial institutions.
 Work alongside experts who love what they do
 ThreatFabric brings together security researchers, engineers, data scientists, threat intelligence specialists, and fraud experts from around the globe. We're passionate about our craft and continuously challenge each other to think differently, improve our solutions, and stay ahead of emerging threats.
Learning is part of our DNA. Whether through knowledge-sharing sessions, technical discussions, mentoring, or simply collaborating with highly experienced colleagues, you'll be surrounded by people who are eager to learn and equally eager to share their expertise.
 Why people stay
 People join ThreatFabric because they're excited by the technology and the mission. They stay because of the people. We celebrate successes together, learn from challenges together, and create an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers while enjoying the journey along the way.
Get in touch!
 Interested?
 Looking for your next challenge? We'd love to hear your story. Apply through the Personio link below and we'll be in touch shortly. Whether you're ready to make a move or simply want to explore the opportunity further, we're happy to answer your questions and help you determine if ThreatFabric is the right fit for you. We aim to fill this position in Q4 2026.
 What's next?
 So, you've hit send - what happens now? First, we'll do a screening to ensure we're a good match. If all goes well, you'll be invited for an initial chat with us. Then, there's a second interview, and we may include an assessment to better understand your skills. Ready to take the plunge?
 Please note: Pre-employment screening is part of our selection process. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies.

Success in this role will be measured by retention, expansion, NRR performance, and the ability to drive measurable customer outcomes.
You will also play a key role in shaping team standards, supporting onboarding, and contributing to the development of a high-performing Customer Success function.
This role requires ~25% travel and is suited to someone comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, with accountability for retention, expansion, and Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
Lead account strategy, identifying growth opportunities across product adoption, feature penetration, and commercial expansion
Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, aligning platform capabilities to customer business goals and KPIs
Drive value realisation, using data and insights to demonstrate ROI and influence customer decision-making
Lead executive-level engagements, including QBRs, on-sites, and strategic reviews
Identify and progress expansion opportunities, partnering closely with Sales where required
Monitor account performance, using data to proactively identify risks and opportunities
Champion the customer internally, ensuring feedback and insights inform product and business decisions
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Operations to deliver against customer and business goals
Contribute to team development, supporting onboarding, mentoring, and evolving best practices
We’re excited about you because…
You have significant experience in Customer Success or Account Management within B2B SaaS, ideally working with enterprise customers
You have a strong track record of driving retention, expansion, and commercial outcomes (e.g. NRR, upsell, cross-sell)
You are comfortable operating at a strategic level, building relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders

You have experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams
You are confident leading executive conversations, QBRs, and strategic planning sessions
You have a strong understanding of hospitality or operational workflows, or a clear interest in the space
You are proactive, structured, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment
 About DoorDash 
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. 
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.
 About SevenRooms 
In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.
With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.
In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.
As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.

title: Growth Strategy and Ops
description:
About Gigs
 At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.
Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.
Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.
If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.
 Things We Care About
 We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.
 Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
 Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
 Customer Obsession . Our customers' product is our product.
 Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
 First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.
The Role
Gigs has built a multi-market, multi-product embedded connectivity business, and we're looking for someone to own the operating system the Growth team runs on. This is a high-leverage, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution, responsible for making the Growth org faster, smarter, and more cohesive.
You will operate with high autonomy and report to the VP of Growth, while working closely with Finance, Legal, and functional leads across GTM, Customer Success, Implementation, and Marketing.
This role is for someone who thrives in complexity, communicates confidently with senior stakeholders, and uses AI as default leverage to move faster and build better.
 What you will do
 Own the operating cadence of Growth. Run planning cycles, reporting rhythms, and cross-functional coordination across GTM, Customer Success, Implementation, and Marketing, so Growth runs as one function.
 Build what lets knowledge travel. Write the playbooks, runbooks, and documentation that take what works in one region and make it work everywhere else. What you build should outlast your direct involvement.
 Own the data and reporting infrastructure. Build the systems that tell the Growth team what's working and where to focus next.
 Lead the AI and tooling stack. Make sure the team is actually using AI to multiply output.
 Drive strategic projects end-to-end. Market expansion, segmentation, GTM playbooks, from framing the problem to shipping the output.
 Keep the function moving. Unblock what needs unblocking across a multi-market, multi-product Growth team that's operating faster than its infrastructure can handle.
 What we are looking for
 4+ years in a demanding operational environment — biz ops, strategy & ops, management consulting, or growth ops at a fast-scaling company. You've operated under pressure and know what it feels like to own something that matters
 You are self-driven and relentlessly proactive. You don't need someone to hand you a problem definition. You find the problem, form a view, and start moving. We'd rather tell you to slow down than push you to speed up
 AI is part of your working stack. You use AI tools daily—for analysis, automation, building internal tooling, accelerating research. You can point to specific things you've built or automated that didn't exist before you made them.
 You can read the room and the data. You can translate a data finding into a business decision and communicate it clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.
 You're a generalist who goes deep. Comfortable moving between a data problem, a process problem, and a strategic framing problem in the same week.
 High ownership, low ego. You juggle context across multiple workstreams without dropping threads. You take pride in making complex things work reliably, not in getting credit for it. When something is yours, it gets done.
 Bonus points if
 You have experience in telecoms, fintech, or B2B SaaS - especially anything touching connectivity or payments. 
 You've built or improved internal tooling or automated workflows using AI or no-code tools.
 You've operated across multiple markets or regions and know what it takes to make something work globally, not just in one office.
Salary Range: £85,000 - £110,000
(The final offer depends on your background, skills, and how you perform through the process. We're open to considering outlier candidates, which may result in an adjustment to the scope and compensation)
Work At Gigs
At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs , as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site . Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.
What We Offer
At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

The Principal Customer Success Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for developing and managing LogicMonitor’s post-sales relationship with our most strategic, complex and high-value customers. The role is accountable for driving measurable customer outcomes, retention, expansion, executive alignment and long-term value realisation, while influencing Customer Success strategy and best practice across the wider organisation.
Through partnership and collaboration, you will coach customers to achieve their business goals and maximise value from their investment in the LogicMonitor platform. You will interact with customers daily to build relationships, drive adoption, provide awareness to all available LogicMonitor resources, ensure on-time subscription renewals, and uncover growth opportunities. The PCSM is responsible for all aspects of client account success, including training, on-boarding, adoption, retention, growth and advocacy. As an AI-forward company, LogicMonitor expects Principal Customer Success Managers to use approved AI tools confidently and responsibly as part of their day-to-day work. title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Who we are 
At OpenUp, our mission is to make mental well-being accessible to everyone. Following a ‘high tech & high touch’ approach, we support companies, their employees, and their families with proactive and practical mental health services. Through our digital platform, clients can access 1:1 check-ins, online courses, articles, videos, group sessions, mindfulness practices, and a team of committed mental well-being experts. As we believe that mental and physical well-being are deeply connected, we have also added Lifestyle Experts to our offering, focusing on nutrition, exercise, and sleep. We offer a truly holistic approach that helps people take ownership of their health. We’re proud to work with forward-thinking organizations and are committed to raising the bar on accessible care.
OpenUp was ranked in the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Startups list for 2023, 2024 & 2025 and is continuously growing. We are expanding our international teams and we are searching for like-minded talent. We are already serving 2000+ companies (e.g. Rituals, Deloitte, Decathlon, KPMG, and McDonalds), through which 600K+ employees have access to our product.
 The role 
You own the systems and processes OpenUp's commercial team relies on, from first touch to renewal: the CRM, data, forecasts, reporting for Finance and leadership, and AI tools that reduce manual work for Sales, Customer Success and Marketing. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who understands revenue operations end to end and enjoys building practical solutions.
Roughly a third of your time goes into keeping HubSpot, data quality, reporting, forecasting and quarter-end processes reliable. The other two-thirds goes into building and improving our bespoke tools using HubSpot, Apollo and LLM APIs. You work daily with the Commercial Leadership Team, AEs, BDRs, Customer Success and Finance.
 What you will own 
 Commercial systems and data 
HubSpot across Sales Hub, Service Hub and Marketing Hub: objects, lifecycle stages, lead and deal architecture, workflows, permissions, reporting and the API.
Integrations with Apollo (enrichment and outbound), our contract, calling, meeting-notes and compensation tools, and everything the team builds in-house.
Data quality: deduplication, enrichment, contact and company associations, the Do-Not-Engage list and account allocation per AE.
 Forecast, reporting and quarter-end 
The pipeline forecast in HubSpot, and the reporting on pipeline, conversion, outbound effectiveness and net revenue retention.
Quarter-end close with Finance, including the inputs for Sales and Customer Success compensation.
 Build, ship and maintain AI tooling 
Tools on top of HubSpot, Apollo and LLM APIs (Claude and OpenAI today) that remove manual work: account research and prioritisation, deal coaching on MEDDICC, signal-based outbound (job changes, LinkedIn activity, intent), list building, forecast support, renewal checks.
The full lifecycle of each tool: prototype, test with users, launch, document, monitor and improve. Retire tools when they are no longer useful.
Version control, clear documentation, monitoring, checks of model output against source data, and human review where judgement is needed. Work with our internal Data & AI team to meet OpenUp's technology, privacy and quality standards.
 Process, enablement and people 
The commercial process from lead to renewal: handoffs between Marketing, Sales and CS, pipeline hygiene standards, and the sales methodology embedded in the CRM.
Adoption: training, clear documentation, and showing AEs, BDRs and CS where AI helps and where human judgement is needed.
Decisions on what to build or buy: evaluate tools, test prototypes before purchasing, and prioritise requests based on their value to the team.
 What success looks like after six months 
Pipeline hygiene stays above 95% and forecast accuracy stays at or above 90%. Data quality is measured and maintained.
Existing tools and reports run reliably with limited manual intervention. The team uses them independently, and you have made improvements based on their feedback.
You have launched and documented at least one new tool the team uses weekly, with measurable impact on new ARR or net revenue retention.
Quarter-end close follows a fixed calendar, and Finance receives complete, checked inputs on time.
 About you 
4 - 7 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or GTM engineering at a B2B SaaS company, working closely with AEs, BDRs and CS.
You have spent the majority of your professional career as an expert on HubSpot (ideal) or another state-of-the-art CRM (such as Salesforce). You have designed objects, lifecycle stages, workflows, reporting and integrations yourself, and you have worked with the respective CRM’s API.
You have built at least one working tool or workflow using an LLM API that other people rely on. You use Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to build, and know when outputs need a human check.
You have run enrichment and outbound tooling (Apollo, FullEnrich, Lusha or similar) and know what clean, compliant prospect data looks like.
You understand SaaS metrics, including pipeline coverage, win rate, cycle length, NRR and forecast accuracy.
You document what you build and take responsibility for maintaining it.
You prioritise requests from Sales and CS alongside longer-term projects, and explain what can be done now and what needs to wait.
Fluent English. German or Dutch is a plus but not required.
 What you can expect 
Joining OpenUp means being part of a fast-growing company that's doing something meaningful. You'll work with a diverse and international team. We like to have fun together with a lot of team building activities like our weekly ‘borrels’ and after work sport classes, the yearly ski-trip and our Padel tournament. Which makes our work fun, challenging and dynamic. Apart from this, we offer:

You care about building systems that help teams move faster, make better decisions, and focus on the opportunities that matter most. If you like connecting data, processes, and people to create measurable business impact, this role is for you.

 After your first year, the process for turning product and marketing signals into sales action is faster, clearer, and trusted by the teams using it.

description:

Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.
 What's the opportunity? 
 As an Enterprise CSM, you’ll partner with our largest and most complex enterprise customers to help them succeed in the new era of AI-driven customer service. Coaching reps and sales leadership to perform better — using data to identify where deals are being lost, where process is breaking down, and where individual reps need support. Building the playbooks, qualification frameworks and enablement materials that create consistency across the team.
Owning the forecasting and pipeline management process — deal-level reviews, weekly forecasting cadence with the exec team, board pack development with Finance. Building the rigour and repeatability that gives leadership genuine confidence in the numbers.
Owning the GTM tech stack vision — you don't need to be a Salesforce admin, but you need to know what good looks like, set the direction, and be able to prototype and prove out new AI and GTM tools quickly. The current stack includes Salesforce, Clay and Gong — and there's a real opportunity to reshape it.
Driving outbound process improvement and lead engagement — getting more qualified leads into reps' pipelines, fixing the re-engagement of closed-lost contacts, and making sure no inbound or referral falls through the cracks.
Owning data quality — building always-on processes that keep commercial data clean and embedding good habits into how the sales team operates day to day.

4+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations or a closely adjacent B2B role — with real, evidenced experience of building forecasting processes, improving rep performance through data, and working with modern GTM tooling.
You're genuinely AI-literate — not just aware of the tools but actively using and experimenting with them. You've built workflows, prototyped solutions, and you're curious about what's possible. You follow what's happening in the GTM and AI space and you tinker before you're asked to.
You communicate clearly and confidently — equally comfortable coaching a sales rep through a deal and presenting pipeline analysis to the COO. You don't need to be the most senior person in the room, but you do need to be credible, direct and persuasive.
You're energised by operating as an IC — your influence comes from the quality of your thinking and the trust you build, not from headcount. You move fast, stay focused on the highest-leverage work, and don't wait for perfect before you act.
Experience in information services, SaaS, B2B intelligence or high-ACV enterprise models is a plus. Background in a commercial role — BDR, AE, AM — is also valued. Experience in a scale-up environment of 50–200 people is ideal.

 In This Role, You Will Be Responsible For

 At Borderless, we’re building a world where borders are no longer barriers — where anyone can move anywhere, seamlessly and safely.

 We are looking for a Revenue Operations Lead to build and scale the systems, data and processes that power our go-to-market teams.
You will report directly to our CEO and own RevOps end to end as our only dedicated RevOps hire. There is no inherited playbook and no committee to work through: you decide how the revenue engine gets built, then you build it, with the room to grow the function around you as we scale.

This is a high-ownership role responsible for the systems, data, processes and insights that support our Sales, Marketing and Customer Success teams.
You will own our CRM (Hubspot), GTM tech stack and revenue data, ensuring the business has clear visibility across the full customer journey - from lead generation through to customer expansion.

 🎯 Role Responsibilities
 Revenue Data & Reporting
Build and manage pipeline reporting, revenue forecasting and executive reporting.

Provide insights to leadership on pipeline trends, revenue performance and growth opportunities.

 GTM Processes

Partner with Marketing on lead scoring, segmentation and nurture flows.
 Attribution & Performance

Measure campaign performance and analyse funnel conversion to improve pipeline generation and revenue efficiency.

Identify prospect buying signals, turning them into sequenced, scored and routed plays for the SDR team to work.
Own sending infrastructure, including domains, deliverability, sequencers and reply handling.
Measure performance with the SDR team, and retire what does not convert.
 Cross-functional Enablement
Ensure GTM teams operate from a shared, trusted view of revenue data and systems.
 🎯 Your first 90 days
 We would rather tell you what good looks like than leave you to guess.
 First 30 days: learn the engine
Get under the bonnet of HubSpot and the wider GTM stack, and work out where every number comes from and where the numbers disagree with each other
Sit with the SDRs, AEs, Marketing, Partnerships and Customer Success teams, and understand how each of them actually works today
Deliver a scored audit of our CRM across data integrity, insight ability, usability and automation, with a clear view of what to fix first and why
 By 60 days: the data is trusted, and the numbers have one owner
A published HubSpot health rubric and score, so quality is measurable rather than a matter of opinion
A completed GTM data-integrity review, with the problems it surfaced remediated and no inconsistencies left in the numbers
The highest-impact lever for revenue growth identified, whether that is lead volume, MQL quality, conversion between stages or close-won rate, with new processes or assets in place to move it
Stretch: our reporting has moved off spreadsheets and into something connected to live HubSpot data
 By 90 days: the system produces decisions
An attribution model live across inbound, outbound, self-book and partnerships
Forecast accuracy tracked for the current quarter, and a forecast for the next one that leadership can plan against
The HubSpot quality score improved again on your 60-day baseline
The revenue initiatives you defined at 60 days built and delivered

3+ years experience in RevOps, Sales Ops, Marketing Ops or a similar data-driven operations role, ideally within B2B SaaS.
Experience managing Hubspot and modern RevOps tooling, including CRM platforms and marketing automation systems.
Experience building or improving GTM processes, reporting frameworks or revenue systems.
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to translate revenue data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Hands-on experience building outbound systems in Clay or equivalent, including enrichment and CRM writeback and operationalising outbound with an SDR team.
Comfortable working in high-growth environments where systems and processes are still evolving.
Highly proactive and self-directed, identifying and prioritising opportunities to improve systems, processes and performance.

title: Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
Who we are 
At illumin, we are transforming the advertising landscape. Our platform offers an integrated space for journey planning, execution, and reporting. It empowers marketers to connect with their audiences in powerful ways through real-time data and easy-to-use visual tools. By seamlessly combining media planning and buying in an intuitive interface, marketers can take complete control of their campaigns, meeting customers wherever they are in the buying journey and maximizing the impact of their ad spend through personalized insights for smarter decision-making.
We are at a pivotal moment, evolving into a product-led company with a team of over 100 skilled professionals and new leadership guiding our path forward. By harnessing the power of data, advancing our AI capabilities, and deeply investing in our people, we are preparing for a future that will redefine what’s possible in journey advertising.
Our work is guided by two beliefs: that the ability to execute is paramount to success and that we are only as good as our people. As we grow and transform, we are looking for team members (illumineers) who share our bias for speed, delivery over perfection, and an entrepreneurial mindset. Joining us now is a chance to be part of our transformation.
 Who we need 
Reporting to the COO, we are hiring a Manager, Revenue Operations to drive operational excellence across our revenue organization. You will be the strategic partner behind our sales performance, responsible for ensuring that processes, systems, reporting, forecasting, and planning activities enable sustainable growth. You will work closely with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Technology teams to create structure, visibility, and scalability across the revenue engine.
 This is a hybrid opportunity, working three days per week on-site in our downtown Toronto office. Our headquarters are located within minutes of St. Andrew and Union subway stations. 
 What's in it for you 
 Impact and visibility. This is an opportunity to play a critical role in how illumin grows and scales. You will work directly with the COO and Sales leadership to improve the systems, processes, and insights that drive revenue performance across the organization. Your recommendations will influence decisions around forecasting, territory planning, compensation, reporting, and operational strategy, giving you visibility into the business beyond a traditional Revenue Operations role.
 The opportunity to build and improve. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying opportunities, challenging the status quo, and creating better ways of working. You will have the autonomy to evaluate existing processes, uncover inefficiencies, and introduce improvements that increase visibility, adoption, and operational effectiveness. You will have the opportunity to shape how Revenue Operations evolves as the organization grows.
 Strategic exposure and growth. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, and Technology, providing broad exposure to how a growing AdTech business operates. You will partner with leaders across functions to solve complex challenges, influence decision-making, and drive initiatives from idea through execution. Whether your long-term path is senior Revenue Operations leadership, Business Operations, or broader operational leadership, this role offers the opportunity to expand your scope, strengthen your commercial acumen, and make a measurable impact across the organization.
 How you will make an impact: 
 Partner with leadership to improve revenue performance. You will work closely with the COO and Sales leaders to understand business objectives, identify operational challenges, and recommend improvements that support growth. By analyzing performance data, forecasting trends, and monitoring key metrics, you will help ensure leaders have the insights needed to make informed decisions.
 Bring structure and scalability to revenue operations. You will evaluate existing processes across the revenue lifecycle, identify opportunities to improve efficiency and adoption, and help create the frameworks that support a growing organization. Working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Technology teams, you will translate business needs into practical, scalable operational solutions.
 Own the systems, processes, and reporting that support the revenue organization. You will serve as the business owner for Salesforce and related revenue technologies, ensuring they effectively support sales processes and decision-making. While you will not be responsible for building every workflow or automation yourself, you will define requirements, recommend process improvements, and partner with technical resources to implement solutions that improve visibility, consistency, and operational effectiveness.
 Drive execution while continuously improving how the business operates. This is a hands-on role where you will balance day-to-day operational responsibilities with longer-term improvement initiatives. You will proactively identify gaps, investigate challenges, introduce best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement across the revenue organization.
 What you bring: 
 The Revenue Operations experience. You have experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a similar function within a SaaS, AdTech, MarTech, technology, or data-driven environment. You understand the systems, processes, metrics, and reporting that support revenue growth and can confidently partner with sales leaders to improve performance and drive results.
 The proactive mindset. You do not wait for problems to surface before taking action. You naturally look for trends, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities, bringing forward ideas and recommendations that improve how the business operates. You are curious, resourceful, and motivated by finding better ways to solve problems.
 The process and systems expertise. You have strong experience working with Salesforce and understand how CRM systems support forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, territory planning, and sales execution. You can translate business needs into scalable processes and workflows, defining requirements and partnering with technical resources to implement solutions that improve efficiency and adoption.
 The analytical and commercial acumen. You are comfortable working with data and know how to turn information into actionable insights. You can connect operational metrics to business outcomes, helping leaders make informed decisions around performance, productivity, and growth.
 The ownership and adaptability. You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and there is not always a predefined roadmap. You take ownership, work independently, and balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute. You enjoy building, improving, and creating structure as a business grows.
 Compensation 
At illumin, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The base salary range for this role is $130,000 - $150,000 plus bonus.
Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.
 What else should you know about us? 
We are undergoing a transformative shift. We are embracing change and the opportunities that come with it, empowering every illumineer to innovate, experiment, and bring forward new ideas. Whether accessing new technology, restructuring workflows, or expanding your team, you will have full support if you can make the business case.
We are a broad and diverse team, but we all share a passion for success, a drive to do more, and a love of creating connections. We hire for talent and commitment and provide the guidelines and guidance to elevate skills, knowledge, and abilities across all areas. This is a place where proven methods meet bold ideas, offering opportunities to grow personally and professionally.
 What you can expect from our interview process: 
A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor will discuss your interest in the role and background. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
An in-person interview with the COO focused on your experience supporting revenue organizations, improving processes, leveraging data to drive decision-making, and partnering with business leaders to improve performance. You will also have the opportunity to learn more about the team, the organization, and the priorities for the role.
A final interview with the COO and a Sales leader focused on your approach to Revenue Operations, forecasting, reporting, process improvement, Salesforce, and cross-functional partnership. The discussion will explore how you identify opportunities, solve operational challenges, and support business growth through data, systems, and process optimization.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
At Fyxer, we’re not building a traditional Customer Success team - we’re building a high-leverage, commercial motion that turns relationships into revenue and support into strategic partnership. Our CSMs don’t just react - they lead. 
This is a hands-on role for a commercially-minded operator who thrives in ambiguity and is excited to build from zero. You'll work with our largest and most complex customers - and the ones with the most potential - to drive renewals, find expansion opportunities, and turn usage into value and value into growth.
We’re looking for someone who was an Account Manager in a past life - someone who understands how to sell through success, multithread across an org, and turn commercial goals into long-term partnerships.
What's on offer:
This role is hybrid in our London office (remote work is not available) 
Salary: £70,000 - £90,000 year + bonus + equity + benefits
Violaine Yziquel, our CCO, is the hiring manager
What Success Looks Like in This Role
You’ll be at the frontline of our Customer Success motion - helping define it while actively delivering results. We don’t yet have all the tooling, playbooks, or workflows in place - you’ll help build them, while making sure our biggest customers are supported, engaged, and growing.
Success means:
Renewals are a no-brainer because value is clear and relationships are deep
Expansions happen regularly because opportunities are spotted and acted on
Customers lean on us as strategic partners - not just vendors.
Your Three Core Responsibilities
Drive Retention and Expansion Across Strategic Accounts
Own a portfolio of high-potential, high-complexity enterprise accounts
Drive the full renewal cycle
Multithread across stakeholders to ensure broad, embedded relationships
Surface commercial opportunities through value-based conversations
Build the Foundations of Customer Success at Fyxer AI
Develop scalable, repeatable playbooks for success, renewal, and expansion
Help shape our tooling and GTM tech stack - helping choose, implement, and evolve the right systems to support success at scale
Define and refine KPIs and dashboards that help us track what matters most for our customers
Be a Strategic Partner to Product, Sales, and Leadership
Translate customer insights into product feedback and roadmap influence
Collaborate closely with Sales on account planning and pre-to-post handoffs
Bring a commercial lens to everything - always thinking about how success drives revenue
What Our Ideal Candidate Looks Like
8+ years in Customer Success or Account Management, with a clear track record of owning revenue (renewals + expansion)
Enterprise experience - you’ve navigated complex orgs, long sales cycles, and strategic conversations
Commercially driven - you’re not afraid to talk numbers, push for value, and ask for the upsell
Builder mindset - you’re energized by ambiguity and excited to help define a motion from scratch
Excellent communicator - confident leading executive conversations, translating technical concepts, and managing internal stakeholders.
Tooling savvy - you know your way around modern GTM tools and can help us choose and implement what works best
Startup-ready - fast, flexible, and energized by change
The application process
Submit your CV (no need for a cover letter)
We’ll review it
An initial call with someone from the hiring team to review your experience and motivation for joining (30 mins)
Customer case study with a panel (45 minutes)
Meet more of the team (30 minutes)
 The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win 
 The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32. 
 The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps . Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.
 The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.
 Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.
This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

title: Sales Enablement Manager
description:
About the Role: 
The Sales Enablement Manager will act as a trusted enablement business partner to regional Sales Leadership, owning the strategy and end-to-end execution of enablement programs that improve seller productivity, strengthen customer conversations and accelerate revenue growth. This role will partner closely with divisional Sales Leaders, Sales Strategy, Sales Programs, Revenue Operations, Product Marketing and Global Enablement teams to identify enablement priorities, build scalable learning experiences, and ensure sales teams are equipped to execute against business priorities. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with senior stakeholders, translating sales performance data into enablement actions, facilitating engaging learning experiences, and adapting global enablement frameworks for market needs.
 Responsibilities: 
 Enablement strategy and planning 
Partner with Sales Leadership to understand business priorities, sales productivity gaps and capability needs.
Build and execute a regional sales enablement plan aligned to pipeline, revenue, product, segment and go-to-market priorities.
Conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis to identify enablement needs and tailor programs accordingly.
Align with Global Enablement teams to ensure consistency of methodology, messaging, content standards and certification approaches across regions.
Adapt global enablement content for European market realities, including regional sales motions, language needs, buyer nuances, tooling and local commercial priorities.
 Sales training and facilitation 
Design and deliver high-impact training sessions for Account Executives, Business Development teams, Sales Managers and other customer-facing roles.
Facilitate live, virtual and in-person enablement experiences that build seller capability, confidence and role-readiness.
Deliver training on sales methodology, product positioning, discovery, qualification, prospecting, negotiation, objection handling, account planning and customer value messaging.
Bring complex commercial concepts to life through practical exercises, role plays, assessments, manager coaching guides and peer learning.
 Onboarding and role readiness 
Own or support onboarding programs that help new sellers become productive faster.
Build structured learner journeys covering pre-work, live sessions, homework, coaching, certification and post-onboarding reinforcement.
Manage monthly or quarterly onboarding cohorts, including speaker briefings, learner communications, attendance tracking, logistics and progress updates.
Partner with Sales Managers to reinforce learning in the field and ensure new hires can apply skills in customer and prospect interactions.
 Content, tools and certification 
Create, curate and maintain enablement content including playbooks, talk tracks, manager guides, objection handling resources, discovery guides, competitive positioning and sales process materials.
Provide thought leadership on enablement rollout strategies, content development and certification programs..
Ensure enablement content is easy to find, practical for sellers and aligned with current go-to-market priorities.
Work with subject matter experts to deliver specialist enablement on product launches, sales plays, industry narratives and strategic initiatives.
 Program operations and measurement 
Own the operational rhythm for regional enablement programs, including planning, registration, learner tracking, communications, feedback collection and reporting.
Define and track success measures covering participation, completion, proficiency, certification, seller adoption, time to productivity, pipeline progression, conversion and revenue impact.
Use surveys, manager feedback, learner data, CRM insights and performance metrics to assess programme effectiveness and identify improvement opportunities.
Report enablement impact, insights and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
 Cross-functional collaboration 
Build trusted relationships with Sales Leadership, Sales Strategy, Sales Programs, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Product Marketing, Business Development, Customer Success and Global Enablement teams.
Coordinate enablement activity around launches, sales plays, quarterly business priorities and regional campaigns.
Work with global teams to share best practices, avoid duplication and maintain consistency across regions.
Build strong internal networks and trusted partnerships to support effective regional execution.
 Requirements: 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university
