description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.
To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.
Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will work closely with high-profile established brands to help them realize value from their investment in Braze.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Partner with Account Executives to ensure commercial alignment & drive client renewals, retention & net retention targets for your customers
Be your customers’ main point of contact and trusted advisor at Braze
Drive feature adoption by building a shared Success Plan with your customers, providing strategic guidance, enablement, and day-to-day advice to help them hit their objectives with Braze
Drive customer advocacy by building strong customer relationships and creating mutual value for your customers and Braze
Proactively analyze your customer product usage to identify opportunities and risks to account health  
Maintain ongoing contact with your customers through ad hoc communications, regular check-ins, events, and Executive Business Reviews
Advocate for your customers, soliciting and synthesizing customer product feedback to contribute to product development
Provide continuing education for customers to maximize product usage, identifying new or unused Braze features that could provide value for your customer and represent an upsell opportunity for Braze
In addition to being a dedicated contact for strategy, product training inquiries, and non-technical support, you will coordinate with other Braze teams including Technical Support, Industry Solutions, and Deliverability Services to ensure your customers receive the support they need simply and seamlessly
Work with Onboarding Managers and other Customer Success Partners to seamlessly transition clients from onboarding to ongoing activity
Act as a point of escalation for customers
Provide mentorship to junior colleagues
You will likely spend time onsite with customers and may travel [internationally]
Please note this job description cannot cover every duty you may need to undertake; your line manager may ask you to handle other reasonable responsibilities commensurate with the role. 
 WHO YOU ARE 
You are an established customer success professional who finds satisfaction in helping your customers achieve great things and in helping your colleagues grow. You have an excellent track record in customer success or a related role and are seeking to progress your career with one of the industry’s most advanced customer success teams by working with established, household-name, enterprise customers with over 1,000 employees.
You are an excellent communicator with exemplary written and verbal communication skills coupled with unparalleled follow-up skills. Clients and colleagues have the impression that you listen and understand the strategic problems they are trying to solve
You’re excited by working with medium and large technology companies who move fast, and want to build new customer experiences quickly
You’re known for being a “team player.” We just can’t emphasize this enough
You build great relationships with colleagues and customers
You have a high level of intellectual curiosity. You see opportunity and growth in learning more about what you do and how it impacts others
You have a proven track record successfully managing complex, high-value accounts or projects with sophisticated clients, multiple stakeholders, and competing priorities
You have excellent time management skills; ideally, you have significant project management experience and/or formal certifications (PMP, Agile, etc)
You have strong technical domain knowledge of two or more of the following: SaaS, Mobile, APIs, Marketing Automation, Direct Marketing, Analytics, or Programming (HTML, etc)
3-6 years relevant experience in a related area, for example, Onboarding, Customer Success, Implementations, or Project Management
 For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $76,000 and $119,000/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $90,000 and $141,000/year (including bonus or commission). Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. 
#LI-Hybrid
 WHAT WE OFFER 
 Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. 
From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we’ve got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:
Competitive compensation that may include equity
Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans
Flexible paid time off
Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave
Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend
A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation
Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 
Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze
Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work®
 ABOUT BRAZE 
 Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging.™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.
The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.
Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News & World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.
The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.
 BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER 
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you
 OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 
At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

 SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards. 
 Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards. 
 IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners 
 Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category 
 Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change 
 Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards. 
 How We Work 
Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.
We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.
Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

Support continuous improvement across go-to-market processes, planning, technology, reporting, and analytics.
Analyze Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success data to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and recurring analysis to support Revenue Operations and go-to-market leadership.
Support annual and ongoing planning activities, including capacity, coverage, territory, quota, pipeline, and forecasting analysis.
Support and optimize key stages of the sales cycle through effective use of Salesforce (SFDC), CPQ, HubSpot, and external account enrichment tools.
Monitor and improve data quality, integrity, and consistency across go-to-market systems.
Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into reporting, process, and system requirements.
Support the prioritization, testing, and implementation of system enhancements in partnership with technical teams.
Help maintain alignment across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success processes, policies, and procedures.
Analyze pipeline, forecasting, demand generation, opportunity progression, renewals, and other key go-to-market performance metrics.
Develop a strong understanding of the end-to-end customer journey and provide insights that connect performance across the GTM value chain.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate findings into clear business insights and recommendations.
Experience supporting go-to-market planning and performance management, ideally including areas such as capacity and coverage planning, territory and quota planning, pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity stage management, demand generation, and renewals.

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
About Equals 
Equals is the next-generation global money movement platform built for exceptional businesses operating across borders. We bring international payments, embedded finance, and more together into a single connection that simplifies operations and strengthens financial control. With deep expertise and integrated infrastructure, Equals turns financial complexity into reliable solutions. 
With our headquarters in London and teams around the UK and Europe, you will join a very close-knit, talented and supportive team from various backgrounds who believe that bringing different perspectives together helps us understand our customers' needs. United, by one thing, making money management straightforward and cost-effective for our customers. 
About the role 
As we enter our next phase of growth at Equals, we are looking for an exceptional Revenue Operations Lead to own the engine room behind our revenue: the data, the forecasting and the reporting that let one commercial team run on one trusted set of numbers. 
Reporting to the SVP Commercial Strategy, GTM & Revenue Operations, this role is the impartial custodian of the revenue numbers for both Sales and Finance, so the numbers the revenue side runs on are owned by someone with no deal to win. It is central to our growth ambition: a business that knows and trusts its numbers can plan, forecast and move fast. 
About you 
You are a high-calibre revenue operations professional who brings real intensity to the work. This is a step-change hire: we are looking for someone to raise the bar of everyone around them. 
You are relentless about accuracy. You chase a forecast or data discrepancy down until the single source of truth is trusted again, and you never let the numbers drift. You are equal parts tactical and strategic: you own delivery and you set direction. You build agent-first, using automation to keep data clean and surface risk so the team spends its time on analysis, not admin. You close the gap between deciding and acting in hours, not weeks, and you thrive in a fast-moving, scaling environment where the systems are still being built, iterated and deployed. 
You will work closely with the GTM team, revenue SVPs, Finance and the GTM Systems / Product team (who own and administer the CRM), as well as the wider commercial team. 
Responsibilities 
Own and maintain the single source of truth for pipeline, revenue and forecast, reconciling to the number that Finance and the Board see. 
Run the weekly forecast cadence and own the forecast-accuracy measure; surface pipeline risk weeks out, not at quarter-end. 
Own commercial data quality and pipeline hygiene: partner with the GTM Systems / Product team to define the data standards, deal-stage discipline and fields that keep the forecast honest, and hold the commercial team to them. 
Build and own commercial reporting: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales cycle, productivity per rep, and segment and vertical scorecards. 
Partner with the GTM Systems / Product team on the move onto one system, setting the reporting and forecasting requirements and driving commercial adoption of it. 
Own the definitions behind the commercial numbers: how revenue is categorised (setup fee, monthly recurring and transactional) and a single, consistent segment and vertical taxonomy. Keep these documented and applied the same way across every report and forecast, and work with the GTM Systems / Product team to reflect them in the CRM. 
Use agents and automation to keep commercial data clean and surface risk, freeing time for analysis rather than admin. 
Partner with Finance so the commercial number and the finance number never diverge. 
Set the KPIs for your remit with the SVP and identify the projects that most move the revenue number. 
Accountabilities 
Forecast accuracy against target, reviewed every week. 
The integrity of the single source of truth for pipeline, revenue and forecast. 
Commercial data quality and pipeline hygiene (the CRM is built and administered by the GTM Systems / Product team). 
Reporting that triggers action with a named owner, not reports that die on a slide. 
Essential Skills 
A proven, evidenced track record in revenue, sales or commercial operations in a B2B business. 
Evidence of owning the number in a high-growth or post-merger environment where the data was broken and you fixed it. 
A confident CRM power-user (ideally HubSpot): fluent in pipeline reporting, deal-stage logic and data governance, and able to set clear requirements for the team that builds and administers it. 
Strong data and analytical skills: advanced Excel / Google Sheets, BI and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau or Looker), and CRM and revenue-intelligence platforms. 
A bar-raiser who brings relentless intensity, owns discrepancies until they are resolved, and lifts the standard of those around them. 
Builds agent-first, embedding automation that keeps data clean and surfaces risk. 
Desirable Skills 
Experience in payments, fintech or SaaS. 
Experience owning a forecasting model or commercial data stack through a period of scale or integration. 
Degree in a numerate discipline; a commercial-finance or revenue-analytics background. 
Experience embedding AI/agent tooling into a commercial operation. 
Diversity & inclusion 
Equals is committed to building a workplace where everyone can be themselves. We actively welcome different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences, and we'll work with you to understand what you need to do your best work. We're an equal opportunities employer and proud of it. 
We offer hybrid working across our teams, balancing time in the office — for collaboration, events and the relationships that make work rewarding — with the flexibility to work remotely where roles allow.

title: Sales Operations Associate
description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 
This role sits within our global Sales Operations organisation and partners with the EMEA and LATAM LinkedIn Sales Solutions business to shape and execute go-to-market strategy. You will work with senior stakeholders both regionally and globally, across sales leadership, pricing, strategic finance, business operations and systems, to crack the strategic questions facing the region and to help design the go-to-market model that answers them. 
The role spans strategy, go-to-market design, planning and the operational rhythm that holds all of it together. On the strategy side you will lead and support projects that shape how the region sells, covering segmentation, coverage models, productivity and the structural questions that sit behind them. You will be expected to take an ambiguous business question, structure it, analyse it, and come back with a recommendation a senior leader can act on. 
Planning runs on a semi-annual cycle. Every six months we design and deliver territories and quotas to the sales teams, and you will play a hands-on part in that. Alongside it sits the operational rhythm of the business: weekly forecasting, business reviews, and the reporting infrastructure that makes the whole picture legible to the people making decisions. 
We are deliberately scoping this role with AI at its centre, and we mean building rather than simply using. Part of that is automating recurring reporting so the team spends its time on judgement instead of assembly. More of it is using AI to drive insight from a large and rich data estate, and to build tools that our go-to-market organisation adopts and relies on. We are looking for someone who has already shipped work of this kind somewhere else and wants to do more of it here. Practical, demonstrated AI capability matters more to us in this hire than a long sales operations résumé. You should be open-minded about challenging the status quo and comfortable working in a rapidly changing organisation, because a good part of this job is changing how the team itself works. 
About the Team 
You will be joining EMEA and LATAM LSS Sales Operations, a small but mighty team supporting the region's enterprise and SMB businesses. LinkedIn Sales Solutions is uniquely positioned for the wave of innovation unfolding in AI: LinkedIn sits on one of the richest professional datasets in the world, and AI draws its power from data. The growth and innovation possibilities for this business over the next few years are significant, and this team sits close to them. 
Responsibilities 
Build and ship AI-powered solutions for the go-to-market organisation, spanning automation of recurring reporting, acceleration of analysis, and tools that sales and operations partners adopt and depend on 
Surface insight from large operational, CRM and financial datasets to identify leading indicators, risks and opportunities, and turn them into decisions the business acts on 
Partner with stakeholders regionally and globally, across sales leadership, pricing, strategic finance, business operations and systems, to shape and land go-to-market decisions for the region 
Contribute to go-to-market design, including segmentation, coverage models, territory design and quota setting, and bring a point of view on how the model should evolve 
Lead and support strategic projects that shape how EMEA and LATAM sells, translating ambiguous business questions into structured analysis and clear, actionable recommendations 
Play a hands-on role in the semi-annual planning cycle, designing and delivering territories and quotas in partnership with finance and cross-functional stakeholders 
Build, strengthen and maintain the reporting infrastructure for the region, and use it to surface the trends and insights that matter to sales leadership 
Coordinate and support the weekly forecast process, and help sales leaders build a clear and honest view of the quarter 
Communicate findings clearly and confidently to a senior audience, translating a large volume of data into a small number of decisions

Basic Qualifications:
2+ years of experience in sales operations, business operations, finance, management consulting, or another analytical or operational role 
Demonstrated experience leveraging and deploying AI in a working environment, whether automating a recurring report, driving insight from a large dataset, or building a tool or workflow that colleagues went on to use 
Demonstrated working experience in SQL, Excel and PowerPoint 
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience building with AI, including hands-on work with an LLM API, prompt engineering, or agentic and automation frameworks, resulting in something colleagues went on to use 
Go-to-market experience in sales operations or a similar field-facing role, working directly alongside a sales organization 
Comfort with a developer toolchain, including GitHub or equivalent version control, VS Code or a similar editor, and Python or another scripting language 
Experience with Dynamics365/Salesforce or an equivalent CRM 
Experience with Presto, Tableau, or the Power Platform 
A track record of taking a manual process and improving or automating it end to end 
Strong business acumen, and the ability to use numbers and insight to influence sound decision making 
A 3rd level university degree, preferably in an analytically focused discipline 
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience communicating and presenting to senior stakeholders 
A strong collaborator who understands what it takes to contribute to a well-functioning team 
Experience automating workflows end to end, moving data and triggering actions across more than one system 
Comfort handling highly sensitive, confidential and non-routine information, including quota, headcount and compensation inputs 
Suggested Skills:
Analytical thinking
Building with AI
Go-to-market and commercial acumen
Stakeholder management
Communication
Problem solving
Systems thinking
Prioritisation
Data quality and governance

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
The Opportunity 
Zeta is investing in the UK as a priority growth market and is building the commercial organisation, operating model and capabilities required to scale.
We are looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to work directly with the President, UK and UK commercial leadership team to build the operating system behind that growth.
This is not a reporting role and it is not a Salesforce administration role.
We are looking for a highly commercial, analytical operator who can create one trusted view of the business, establish rigorous pipeline and forecasting disciplines, make our revenue technology work harder and turn data into decisions.
You will work across Customer Growth, Enterprise Sales, Key Account Directors (Impact Partners), Marketing, Solutions Consulting and Finance, connecting our customer, pipeline, activity and revenue data into a clear view of where we are performing, where we are at risk and where the next growth opportunities exist.
You will be expected to get into the detail, challenge assumptions and proactively bring insight to leadership. The objective is simple: give the UK team the data, systems, discipline and commercial intelligence required to make better decisions and grow faster.
 What You Will Own 
 The UK Commercial Operating System 
Work in lock step with the President, UK to build and continuously improve the commercial operating model for the UK business.
Translate UK growth objectives into measurable customer, pipeline, revenue and execution metrics.
Establish the operating cadence across weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, customer growth reviews, account planning and quarterly business reviews.
Create a consistent framework for understanding performance across our two core commercial motions: protecting and expanding strategic customers, and winning selected enterprise new logos.
Ensure leadership can quickly answer the questions that matter: Where are we winning? Where are we behind? What has changed? What is at risk? Where should we invest? What needs action now?
 Pipeline, Forecasting and Revenue Performance 
Own the operational discipline behind UK pipeline and forecasting.
Partner with the GVP, Customer Growth, GVP, Enterprise Sales and Key Account Directors (Impact Partners) to create an accurate view of expansion and new-logo opportunities.
Establish clear standards for opportunity creation, qualification, stage progression, close dates, next steps and forecast categories.
Analyse pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, ageing, slippage and forecast accuracy.
Identify pipeline gaps and forecast risk early, and work with commercial leaders to determine the actions required.
Challenge assumptions when the underlying data does not support the forecast.
Build scenario models that help leadership understand what needs to happen to achieve revenue objectives.
Maintain one trusted view of UK pipeline and forecast.
 Customer Growth Intelligence 
Build the data and operational framework required to protect and grow Zeta’s strategic UK customer base.
Create visibility across customer revenue, retention, expansion pipeline, whitespace and Zeta footprint.
Help identify where customers are underpenetrated, where additional capabilities may be relevant and where account risk requires intervention.
Partner with Customer Growth and Key Account Directors (Impact Partners) to strengthen strategic account planning and establish measurable multi-year growth plans.
Create account-level views that bring together revenue, opportunities, stakeholders, engagement and relevant commercial signals.
Help leadership prioritise the customers and opportunities where investment can create the greatest commercial impact.
 Enterprise New-Logo Intelligence 
Partner with the GVP, Enterprise Sales to build the operational discipline behind a focused enterprise new-logo strategy.
Create visibility across priority accounts, buying committees, engagement, intent, opportunities and pipeline progression.
Help determine whether we are building sufficient qualified pipeline against our targets and where intervention is required.
Analyse conversion and progression to understand where deals accelerate, stall or are lost.
Connect sales activity, marketing engagement and account intelligence to give commercial teams a more complete picture of each strategic opportunity.
Focus measurement on meaningful enterprise opportunities and revenue outcomes rather than activity volume.
 Salesforce and the Revenue Technology Stack 
Act as the UK commercial owner and expert for how Salesforce and the broader revenue technology stack support our growth strategy.
You will need strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce, including account and opportunity structures, reporting, dashboards, forecasting, workflows and data quality.
You should also understand how platforms such as Gong, 6sense and other sales, marketing and revenue-intelligence technologies can work together to improve commercial execution.
Partner with Global Revenue Operations and system owners to translate UK business requirements into effective system configuration, reporting, automation and process improvements.
Ensure account hierarchies, contacts, buying committees, opportunities and activities are structured in ways that make the data commercially useful.
Drive high standards of CRM adoption and data quality while reducing unnecessary administrative burden on sellers and account teams.
Identify opportunities to automate manual processes and improve productivity.
The objective is not technology for technology’s sake. Every system should help our teams understand customers better, prioritise more effectively, sell more intelligently or make better decisions.
 Turn Gong and Commercial Signals into Intelligence 
Help Zeta move beyond simply recording customer and prospect interactions.
Use Gong and other available data sources to identify patterns across customer conversations, opportunities and competitive engagements.
Surface recurring customer priorities, objections, competitive themes and signals of opportunity or risk.
Work with Product Marketing, Customer Growth, Enterprise Sales and leadership to turn those insights into action.
Help establish a culture where customer conversations and commercial signals inform account strategy, enablement, product feedback and leadership decisions.
 Marketing and ABM Measurement 
Partner with the VP, ABM & Customer Marketing, UK to connect account engagement to commercial outcomes.
Build visibility into engagement across strategic customers and named enterprise prospects.
Help determine which programmes are creating executive access, expanding buying-committee engagement, generating opportunities or accelerating existing opportunities.
Connect Salesforce, 6sense and relevant marketing data to provide a coherent account-level view.
Help the UK leadership team understand where marketing investment is creating commercial impact and where resources should be reallocated.
 Commercial Planning and Decision Support 
Act as a trusted analytical partner to the President, UK and UK leadership team.
Support annual and quarterly planning, translating revenue objectives into pipeline requirements, account priorities and measurable operating plans.
Provide analysis to inform account allocation, commercial capacity, resource deployment and investment decisions.
Partner with Finance and Global Revenue Operations to reconcile commercial and financial views of performance.
Build scenarios and models that allow leadership to test assumptions and understand the likely impact of different decisions.
Do not simply report what happened. Explain why it happened, what is likely to happen next and what we should do about it.
 What You Will Bring 
You will have:
Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or Commercial Operations within an enterprise B2B organisation.
Strong hands-on Salesforce capability, including reporting, dashboards, pipeline management, forecasting and commercial workflows.
Experience with Gong and familiarity with account intelligence, intent, sales engagement or revenue intelligence platforms such as 6sense.
Strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles, pipeline management, opportunity qualification and forecasting.
Experience supporting both new-logo acquisition and existing-customer expansion.
Excellent analytical capability and the ability to turn complex commercial data into clear recommendations.
Experience building executive dashboards and operating cadences used by senior commercial leadership.
Strong understanding of CRM governance, data quality and adoption.
The ability to build useful models and analyse commercial scenarios.
Experience connecting Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing and Finance data.
The ability to translate business requirements into systems, processes and automation.
Experience in SaaS, MarTech, data, customer engagement or adjacent enterprise technology would be highly valuable.
Experience with BI and data-visualisation tools is desirable, but commercial judgement is more important than expertise in any individual reporting platform.
 How You Work 
You are commercially curious. When a number moves, you want to understand why.
You do not wait to be asked for a report. You spot patterns, investigate them and bring leadership a point of view.
You are comfortable telling a senior leader that the data does not support their forecast, while working constructively with them to understand what needs to change.
You can move comfortably between the detail and the bigger picture. In the same day, you might investigate an opportunity in Salesforce, analyse a pipeline trend, improve a dashboard and sit with the President, UK to make a decision about where the organisation should focus.
You care about data quality because you understand that decisions are only as good as the information behind them.
You are technically confident but commercially driven. Salesforce, Gong, 6sense and other systems are tools. Your objective is better execution and better commercial outcomes.
You are highly collaborative, low ego and comfortable working across a complex global organisation.
Above all, you have the mindset of a business partner, not a reporting function.
 What Success Looks Like 
Success will mean that the UK leadership team has:
One trusted view of customers, pipeline, forecast and revenue performance.
Clear visibility into retention, expansion, whitespace and new-logo growth.
A rigorous commercial operating cadence that drives action and accountability.
Strong pipeline and forecasting discipline with improving forecast accuracy.
Earlier identification of customer risk, pipeline gaps and growth opportunities.
High-quality Salesforce data that commercial teams trust and use.
Effective use of Gong, 6sense and the wider revenue technology stack to improve commercial decisions.
Clear linkage between account engagement, marketing activity, opportunities and revenue.
Less manual reporting and administration through better processes and automation.
Actionable insight that helps leadership determine where to focus people, time and investment.
A scalable Revenue Operations model that can support the continued growth of the UK business.
This is a high-impact role at the centre of Zeta’s UK growth strategy. You will have direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to build the commercial operating system that helps turn strategy into measurable growth.
 PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA 
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. 
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/

https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

We’re officially Great Place To Work Certified™

See our accreditations to learn more: Great Place to Work® UK | Great Place To Work® USA
 About The Opportunity 👇 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Business Partnering & Strategy 
Act as a trusted advisor to Channel and CS leadership, helping shape partner planning, forecasting, and performance strategy.
Bring structure and clarity to ambiguous problems, translating business needs into operational solutions.
Challenge stakeholders constructively and ensure decisions are data-driven.
Partner with Sales Ops and Marketing Ops to ensure alignment on shared funnel definitions, handoff processes, and cross-functional metrics.
Help embed a culture of accountability where teams own their inputs rather than relying on ops as admin support.
Demonstrate the confidence and credibility to enforce process standards across channel and CS teams, including pushing back constructively when asked to accommodate exceptions or regional variations that would undermine consistency.
The goal is good business outcomes — not rigidity — but this person must be comfortable holding the line when it matters.
 Channel Operations 
Own partner data integrity standards in Salesforce, building reporting to monitor data quality across partner-sourced pipeline, deal registration, and revenue attribution — and holding Channel Account Managers accountable for maintaining accurate records.
Maintain and enforce deal registration hygiene — identifying duplicate, stale, or incorrectly attributed registrations and working with partner managers to resolve them.
Build and maintain channel performance reporting covering partner-sourced pipeline, deal registration conversion, win rates, average deal size, and revenue contribution by partner.
Track and report on partner attainment against targets, providing regular visibility to Channel leadership on individual partner and portfolio performance.
Support MDF ROI tracking — ensuring spend and outcomes are captured accurately in Salesforce and feeding into reporting on marketing investment through channel.
Identify trends and anomalies in channel pipeline and revenue data, proactively flagging risks and opportunities to Channel leadership.
Support channel forecasting by maintaining clean pipeline data, tracking deal progression, and helping leadership build an accurate view of partner-sourced revenue.
 Customer Success Operations (Expansion & Upsell) 
Support the CS upsell function, working closely with the CS revenue rep to ensure they have the operational tools, data, and processes needed to maximise expansion opportunities.
Maintain HubSpot sequence and workflow automation supporting upsell outreach, ensuring the CS rep has the right touchpoints and tooling in place to work expansion opportunities effectively.
Build and maintain reporting on expansion pipeline and upsell performance, giving the CS rep and CS leadership clear visibility on activity, conversion, and revenue contribution.
Ensure commission tracking for the CS rep is accurate and up to date, feeding into the broader compensation and quota management process.
 Planning, Forecasting & Performance 
Support quota setting, territory design, and capacity planning for channel and CS teams.
Own reporting and dashboards to track partner pipeline, CS expansion pipeline, conversion, and attainment.
Identify risks and opportunities in the funnel and proactively recommend actions to leadership.
Help standardise forecasting processes across channel and CS and improve predictability.
 Compensation & Quota Management 
Coordinate the distribution of commission plans for channel and CS teams, ensuring plans are issued accurately and on time at the start of each period.
Maintain a centralised log of compensation exceptions — including deal-level disputes, accelerator queries, and mid-period plan changes — and drive timely resolution in liaison with Finance and HR.
Ensure commission calculations are underpinned by clean, accurate data in Salesforce — working proactively to identify and resolve data issues before they impact payroll.
Support quota and target-setting processes for channel and CS teams, including historical performance analysis, capacity modelling, and distributing final targets into relevant systems.
Build and maintain attainment tracking for both channel and CS reps, providing regular visibility to leadership on individual and team performance against target.
Document compensation processes and exception handling procedures, and continuously improve the accuracy and efficiency of the commission cycle.
 Reporting & Insights 
Build and maintain reports and dashboards for channel and CS functions, working within the reporting infrastructure owned by the BI team to ensure accurate, timely, and actionable insights for Channel and CS leadership.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports to track KPIs including partner-sourced revenue, expansion pipeline, NRR, GRR, upsell conversion, and velocity. Experience with Tableau is highly desirable.
Go beyond reporting — interpret data and explain performance drivers, acting as the go-to person for understanding what is happening and why.
Define and continuously refine performance metrics that align to business goals and revenue targets.
Lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews for channel and CS, preparing data narratives and actionable insights that support leadership decision-making.
Proactively identify data gaps, inconsistencies, or inefficiencies in reporting and work with systems and analytics teams to resolve them.
Support leadership with analysis for QBRs, planning cycles, and strategic decisions.
 Process Design & Optimisation 
Design, document, and continuously improve GTM processes across channel and CS, including partner onboarding, deal registration, pipeline management, and CS handoffs.
Ensure processes are scalable, clearly understood, and consistently followed.
Reduce friction in the partner and expansion sales cycle and eliminate inefficiencies.
 Systems & Tooling 
Partner with Business Systems and IT to ensure Salesforce and core systems support channel and CS business needs.
Translate requirements into clearly defined tickets and work closely with system owners to drive resolution.
Identify gaps or inefficiencies in tooling and workflows, and proactively recommend improvements.
Support evaluation and rollout of tools relevant to partner management and CS operations.
Ensure tools are well understood, adopted, and delivering measurable value to the business.
 Data Quality & Governance 
Maintain high standards of CRM data quality, structure, and hygiene across channel and CS records.
Implement processes to improve data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Define and enforce governance standards for data hygiene, deal naming, partner tagging, and system usage.
Ensure all operations comply with relevant data protection regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA).
Partner with Legal, IT, and RevOps to monitor compliance risks and support audits, documentation, and vendor due diligence.
 Required Skills & Experience 
4+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, partner operations, or a similar operational role — preferably in a B2B or SaaS environment with exposure to channel or partner-led business models.
Hands-on Salesforce experience is essential, with demonstrable ability to build reports, maintain data structures, and support process automation.
Strong understanding of channel go-to-market motions, including partner-sourced pipeline, deal registration, MDF, and co-sell execution.
Experience supporting CS expansion functions, including upsell pipeline management, renewal forecasting, and NRR tracking.
Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modelling.
Strong process design and documentation skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable operational processes.
Excellent analytical skills — comfortable going beyond reporting to interpret data and explain performance drivers.
Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and present data-driven recommendations to senior leadership.
High attention to detail and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders.

title: Senior Associate, Revenue Strategy & Enablement, EMEA
description:

 Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future.  Attributes We Value
 We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster.  The Revenue Strategy & Enablement team at Airwallex sits at the heart of our commercial engine, empowering sales and commercial teams to win in a fast-paced environment. We collaborate closely with commercial leaders, product marketing, and cross-functional partners to deliver world-class enablement programs, content, and training. Our mission is to accelerate revenue growth by equipping and coaching our teams with the knowledge, tools, and processes they need to succeed – across both core and new products, and in every region we serve.
What you’ll do
Airwallex is looking for a commercially savvy operator with experience in enablement, new product launches, and market entry to help accelerate our growth across EMEA.
You’ll work at the intersection of GTM, Product, and Commercial – driving high-impact initiatives that support our frontline teams and unlock new revenue opportunities. We’re seeking someone with a strong foundation (or a strong interest) in Banking, Financial Services, Fintech, or Payments, and the ability to combine strategic thinking with operational execution and content excellence.
If you’re passionate about scaling businesses and enabling teams to win, we’d love to hear from you.
 Responsibilities
Partner with Commercial and Revenue Strategy leaders to identify the highest-leverage enablement initiatives that will drive growth across the funnel.
Translate GTM priorities into clear, actionable enablement programs that improve sales execution across both core and new products.
Develop and deliver high-impact onboarding, product training, and enablement experiences that align with commercial goals and accelerate time-to-productivity.
Lead the design and rollout of scalable content, AI tools, and systems in partnership with Revenue Operations to improve rep effectiveness and deal velocity.
Collaborate cross-functionally to strengthen the commercial operating rhythm, including SKOs, training cadences, and feedback loops.
Analyse funnel performance and sales data to surface gaps, inform enablement priorities, and guide coaching efforts.
Who you are
We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
 Minimum Qualifications
3+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement or Strategy, or a related field, ideally in Financial Services or Technology
Proven track record of collaborating with commercial leaders and driving impactful programs.
Excellent written, verbal, and in-person communication skills, with strong cross-functional management abilities.
Highly organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Self-starter mentality with a high degree of motivation to understand root causes and deliver success.
High attention to detail and a “do what it takes” attitude to own and execute high-quality outcomes.
Experience working with Salesforce (or similar CRM) and modern sales technology stacks (e.g., Gong, Outreach, Highspot, LMS platforms, AI tools).
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a high-growth fintech or technology scale-up environment.
Experience working with EMEA-based sales teams.
Experience implementing and scaling AI-enabled sales workflows and enablement programs.
Experience with data-driven enablement program measurement and iteration.
Language Skills: Fluency in English and at least one additional European language (Spanish, Dutch, German, or French) is a plus.
 Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters
 To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
 Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
 Equal opportunity

title: Principal Customer Success Manager
description:
As a Principal Customer Success Manager (Principal CSM), you will serve as a senior strategic partner to our most complex and high-value customers, while also acting as a thought leader and mentor within the Customer Success organization. This role extends beyond traditional account management—you will be responsible for driving customer value, influencing product direction, and establishing best practices.
You will collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders in Product, Sales, Support, and Marketing to ensure that our customers achieve measurable business outcomes and long-term success.
This position is well-suited for an experienced CSM who excels in strategic discussions, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and enjoys mentoring colleagues.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Strategic Customer Management 
Own executive relationships and success planning for a portfolio of strategic accounts.
Partner with customers to define success metrics, drive adoption, and ensure long-term satisfaction and retention.
Act as a trusted advisor, providing insights that align our solutions with customers’ business goals.
 Thought Leadership & Best Practices 
Lead cross-functional initiatives to scale best practices across the Customer Success organization.
Develop frameworks, playbooks, and templates to improve customer engagement and outcomes.
Represent Customer Success in product feedback loops, contributing to roadmap discussions.
 Mentorship & Leadership 
Coach and mentor other CSMs to build capabilities in strategic thinking, customer engagement, and influence.
Serve as a role model and informal leader within the team, driving a culture of excellence and collaboration.
 Qualifications 
8+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Strategic Consulting, preferably in SaaS or enterprise software.
Proven track record of managing complex, enterprise-level accounts and delivering measurable business value.
Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and executive presence skills.
Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Support, Sales, and Engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead initiatives, mentor peers, and influence at all levels of an organization.
Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, or similar customer success platforms.
Industry expertise relevant to our customer base
 The Path to Success 
 30 Day Milestones 
Upon completing SailPoint specific trainings, understanding the SailPoint products, core value, features, and use cases
Demonstrate proficiency in SailPoint’s CRM tool, and articulating the value of Success Plans in delivering customer results.

title: GTM Operations Analyst
description:
We’re Heidi. 
We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.
Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.
We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.
If you don’t choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.
 The role 
This is a commercially focused GTM Operations role supporting Heidi’s UK and European markets. You’ll report to the Head of GTM Operations and work closely with leaders across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing and Finance, as well as our central Analytics and GTM Engineering teams.
Your job is to turn commercial direction into an operating model the region can actually use. When leaders agree how we should forecast, segment accounts, organise territories or manage the customer lifecycle, you’ll build the models, processes, reporting and tooling that make it work day to day.
Doing that well means working beyond the CRM. You’ll use HubSpot, Databricks and Omni to bring together commercial and product data, pressure-test assumptions and turn what you find into better decisions and processes.
This role suits someone who enjoys both sides of GTM Operations: working through commercial problems with leaders, then doing the hands-on work to make the solution stick.
 What you’ll do 
 Turn commercial plans into working operations. Partner with the Head of GTM Operations and regional leaders to operationalise decisions on segmentation, territories, coverage, capacity, quotas and commissions. Build the models, processes and operating cadences that allow teams to execute them consistently.
 Connect the full customer lifecycle. Build and improve the processes between Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, from lead management and pipeline creation through onboarding, adoption, renewal and expansion. Make ownership and handoffs clear, and ensure each team has the information it needs from the others.
 Strengthen commercial execution. Improve how we inspect pipeline, forecast revenue and understand customer health, retention and growth. Help embed methodologies such as MEDDIC into the way managers and teams run deals—not just the fields they complete in HubSpot—and drive adoption of the changes you introduce.
 Use data to support commercial decisions. Query existing datasets in Databricks, build reporting in Omni and connect CRM, product and commercial data to understand performance. Build the recurring reporting the region needs, investigate issues in more depth when required and explain what changed, why it matters and what action it suggests.
 Keep the GTM engine running. Maintain HubSpot and the regional GTM stack, including pipelines, routing, workflows, reporting and data quality. Resolve issues quickly and partner with central teams when something needs a global fix.
 What you'll need 
 Hands-on GTM Operations experience. You’ve worked in GTM Operations, Revenue Operations or Sales Operations and have practical experience with core processes such as forecasting, territory and quota planning, lifecycle management and CRM workflows. We care more about the ownership and judgement you’ve developed than a fixed number of years.
 Strong commercial judgement. You can reason across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success, understand the drivers of acquisition, conversion, adoption, retention and expansion, and distinguish an interesting data point from something the business should act on.
 Confident with data. You can write SQL, navigate a warehouse such as Databricks and work with a BI tool such as Omni. You’re comfortable interrogating existing datasets, validating the output and turning the result into a clear recommendation. Experience building core warehouse models is not required.
 A strong, credible operator. You can take an agreed commercial approach and turn it into a workable model, process or system change. You communicate clearly, challenge assumptions with evidence, bring the right people with you and follow through until the change is adopted.
 A practical, tool-fluent systems thinker. You understand how process, data, tooling and team behaviour interact. You’re confident in HubSpot and have worked with tools such as Clay, Gong, outbound platforms, enrichment providers and CPQ/CLM systems, or can get productive in them quickly.
 How we show up 
 Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.
 Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.
 Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.
 Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.
 Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.
 Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.
 Why Heidi?

This role will also lead a step-change in the organisation's use of data and automation. Current data quality, visibility and utilisation are inconsistent; a key priority will be to establish a robust, data-driven operating model and leverage AI and automation to improve efficiency, insights, and sales productivity.
You will report to the Chief Financial & Operating Officer, working closely with Finance and with the regional Commercial teams.

 Enablement and Incentives:

Knowledge of sales forecasting and planning models

title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst, GTM Strategy
description:
Meet DeepL
 DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
 What Sets Us Apart
 What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.
 Meet the team behind this journey
 At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and drive for excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will be at the forefront of driving our growth and expanding our global reach. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that meet the needs of our clients.
 Your Responsibilities
Own territory design globally — coverage models, segmentation, and account assignments — across the annual planning cycle, working directly with sales managers and our regional Sales Strategy Business Partners.
Model and monitor. Build territory and ownership scenarios across Salesforce, Google Sheets, and Databricks, then track how territories perform once they're live: which patches are working, what's selling where, and where coverage needs rebalancing.
Build target-account strategies grounded in our product, partnering with Product, Data Analytics & Insights, and Marketing Operations to sharpen our ICP by region and focus coverage where it's most likely to convert.
Own our sales policies and Rules of Engagement — where reps can and can't sell, how ownership decisions get made, and what happens when the rules are breached. These exist today; rebuilding them properly is yours.
Automate the manual work. This role is roughly 40% operational today and we want it closer to fully strategic. You'll have our backing to use AI tools like Claude, and the partnership of our Systems and Operations teams, to get it there.
Keep the foundations clean. Be the strategy voice in Salesforce roadmap reviews so changes don't quietly break territories or reporting, and handle day-to-day account reallocation as people join, move, and leave.
 Qualities we look for
Around 3–5 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Go-to-Market Strategy, or sales planning. We care more about what you've owned than the number on your CV.
Highly analytical. You're comfortable getting into the data across Sheets, Salesforce, and Databricks to test an idea, and you land on a clear, defensible recommendation rather than a deck of options.
Confident reasoning about Salesforce — how accounts, territories, ownership, and data fit together. This is not an admin or technical role, and we have strong Systems and Operations teams behind you, but you need to hold your own in those conversations. Hands-on backend experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
Able to influence without authority. A lot of the change you'll drive sits in other teams, so you'll get there through insight, evidence, and constructive challenge.
A strong bias to automate. You already use AI tools such as Claude to remove repetitive work, or you have a genuine appetite to learn how.
Proactive. You spot the problem, work out what to do about it, and go and do it. We don't need someone who arrives with all the answers — we need someone who goes and finds them.
Comfortable with real deadlines. Planning season doesn't move and it's intense. The rest of the year is calmer and more about building for the next cycle.
Experience in tech at scale is a plus — somewhere you've seen what good looks like and can bring that standard with you.
Collaborative across regions and disciplines, with the energy and drive to work well with Sales, Product, Revenue Intelligence, and Marketing Operations.
 What We Offer
Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.
Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.
Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.
Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.
Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.
Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.
30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.
Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.
If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!
 We are an equal opportunity employer
 You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

title: International Strategy and Operations Lead
description:
About Faire
 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.
We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.
 About This Role
 We are looking for a Strategy & Operations Lead to play a pivotal role in driving informed, data-backed decisions across our international business. In this role you’ll leverage a unique combination of skills, including analytical rigor, strategic intuition, and execution, to drive growth for our business.
As a core member of our International Strategy & Operations team, you’ll have the chance to lead mission-critical projects end to end. You’ll partner cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Operations, Marketing, and Finance teams to inform the strategic roadmap by generating insights and helping translate them into action.
This is an ideal role for someone who wants to work as a high-impact individual contributor in a fast-paced, highly collaborative, and data-driven environment and have the opportunity to gain exposure to partnering with a variety of functions.
This role is based out of our London, UK office (3 days in the office)
 What You’ll Do
Break down complex and ambiguous problems to uncover actionable insights
Analyse customer, product, and business data to identify growth opportunities and shape priorities, with a key focus on Brand (supply) opportunities.
Lead large cross-functional strategic initiatives that move company metrics in partnership with Product, Sales, Finance, Operations, Marketing, etc.
Identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, execute in-depth analysis, and make recommendations to Faire’s leadership team based on your findings
Provide thought partnership to cross-functional teammates to ensure the organization is using data thoughtfully and correctly
Support the prioritisation, planning, and launch of new international markets.
You will be required to regularly demonstrate the ability to exercise independent discretion in analytical rigor, strategic intuition and execution.
 Qualifications
Must possess a bachelor's degree
5+ years of experience in strategy, analytics, finance, consulting, or business operations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear recommendations.
Strong business judgment and ability to work across Product, GTM, and operational topics.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders.

Ability to execute: adept at working across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, influencing decision-making, and shipping high-quality insights and initiatives on time.

Do you have 5+ years of experience in analytical, financial, or strategic roles?

Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

title: Customer Success Account Manager
description:
Overview 
With over 17,000 employees worldwide, the mission of the Customer Experience & Success (CE&S) organization is to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. Come join CE&S and help us build a future where customers achieve their business outcomes faster with technology that does more.
Are you the tech-savvy cloud loving person that has Cloud and IT (information technology) Service Management blood running in your veins? Do you want to be that key person that helps our commercial enterprise customers achieving the most out of the Microsoft products and services they use? Do you get your energy from making your customers succeed in making their strategic and transformational cloud projects real?
This role is aligned to supporting multiple commercial enterprise accounts with significant scale, visibility, and executive engagement.
As a CSAM, you are the primary delivery lead and a partner for our customers, empowering them to achieve more by accelerating their value realization across our Digital Cloud platforms. By leveraging your technical expertise, business acumen and industry perspectives you will be responsible for the end-to-end post sales delivery and support orchestration across the Microsoft and Partner ecosystem to align the right resources at the right time to achieve customer business outcomes. Check out the CSAM role in the Customer Success Unit at Microsoft! Be ready to make impact! This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, leverage your delivery management capabilities and deepen your cloud and industry expertise.
 Responsibilities 
 Customer Relationship Management 
Builds and coaches others on customer, partner, and internal stakeholder engagement strategy and models. Develops, maintains, and builds upon foundational relationships with key customer stakeholders and technical professionals to enable quality solution delivery and health using partnerships with other account team leaders and leads orchestration across internal/external stakeholders. Expands customer and partner relationships beyond the current Unified Support contract consumers with a focus on leading the definition of business outcomes and how to align Microsoft strategy to customer business priorities.
Identifies, navigates, communicates, and influences key customer technical, business, and executive-level stakeholders (including partners). Guides and leads conversations to facilitate the achievement of customer business objectives by leveraging their investment in Microsoft. Maps internal roles to customer priorities to action the needs of customers and provides input into customer priorities. Holds, maintains, and nurtures internal stakeholder relationships. Influences and challenges senior/executive internal stakeholders. Leads business value conversations at customer executive levels.
Initiates the gathering of information on the business and Information Technology objectives for customer organizations using partnerships with other account team leaders to identify customer priorities. Partners with Account Team to create a customer success plan and contribute to the shared customer account plan in support of customer objectives specific to the customer's business transformation programs and common to their industry.
 Customer Success Leadership 
Leads the strategic execution of program planning and customer-facing program reviews, prioritization of engagements, and management of key stakeholder and executive expectations to address agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities to deliver ongoing customer success. Leverages Microsoft delivery management methodologies, processes, and tools to manage and improve customer operational health. Proactively identifies and mitigates customer blockers by leveraging Microsoft solutions and services, and develops deliverable programs of work. Orchestrates delivery resources to facilitate value realization with a focus on driving operational health. Leads delivery program reviews with internal stakeholders to ensure alignment on customer outcomes and account priorities. Leads escalation management and communications for delivery programs in the customer account.
Engages in conversations with customers and demonstrates alignment between customer objectives and the current Microsoft portfolio of work in the customer account. Promotes the organizational and customer success strategy with customers. Aligns Microsoft technology and services with the customer's goals and objectives to form a cooperative strategy. Engages in account team planning, promoting business and technical needs for change that challenge customer thinking. Aligns with the account team to link Customer Success Plans (CSPs) with account plan priorities and develop bookable programs of work. Challenges the customer and influences their strategic decision making, driving the case for change towards improved operational health.
Proactively identifies, monitors, and mitigates actual and potential blockers to consumption through data analysis and customer feedback. Mobilizes resources to address actual and potential blockers to consumption, associated issues, and to ensure delivery on Customer Success Plans (CSPs). Holds accountability for identified consumption milestones and their completion. Partners with customers to proactively identify opportunities for growth, optimize usage, and drive adoption. Partners with customers to understand their business objectives, identify opportunities where Microsoft offerings can help achieve those objectives, and aligns Microsoft products and services to agreed-upon customer outcomes and account priorities. Leverages an understanding of the customer's needs and business objectives to identify opportunities where Microsoft can provide added value to maximize retention and minimize churn.
 Technical Relevance 
Understands, identifies, and aligns Microsoft solutions, and technical capabilities (e.g., Azure, Modern Work, Dynamics) to customer needs and priorities. Leverages broad foundational industry and technical expertise to enable customer success. Identifies complex customer scenarios (e.g., Independent Software Vendors [ISV], cross-cloud, partner) and aligns with technical specialists to identify relevant cross-cloud technology solutions. Strengthens Microsoft's position in the customers' cloud technology marketplace against competitors. Leverages understanding of the customer's technology platform and Microsoft's technology roadmap to enable customer digital transformation.
 Qualifications 
Required Qualifications
Degree in Business, Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience.
Strong Customer Success experience within complex enterprise environments , driving technology adoption and business outcomes.
Proven ability to build and influence relationships with senior customer executives.
Experience orchestrating complex technology engagements across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication, planning and analytical skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Relevant cloud technology certification.
Service, project or change management certification.
