title: CRM & Revenue Operations Manager (Hubspot)
description:
About Allica Bank 
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
 Department Description 
 Allica is building out its growth function, based around talented, empowered and autonomous individuals who will be responsible for product-based customer acquisition using a combination of channels to meet objectives set across the business. You will get an opportunity to work with different teams across the business including product squads, distribution, engineers and operations to deliver on Allica’s mission of becoming the UK’s most recommended business bank. 
We are rare amongst banks in that our senior leadership team have backgrounds at worldleading fintech's, which shows in their active engagement in both the strategic and execution elements of our rapidly scaling organisation. Because we are working on one of the last untapped fintech opportunities, in a new team it will mean that we're often working on entirely new challenges and unpicking complexity as we move along. No two days are ever the same. 
 Role Description 
We are seeking a CRM & Revenue Operations Manager to lead the optimisation and continuous improvement of HubSpot across multiple product pipelines. 
This is not a pure HubSpot administrator role. The successful candidate will combine strong CRM knowledge with analytical problem-solving, structured project delivery and confident stakeholder management. You will work closely with HubSpot administrators, Product, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Data, Risk, Compliance and Technology teams to ensure CRM processes are effective, scalable and well-controlled. 
You will be responsible for independently leading CRM projects end-to-end, managing stakeholders, improving data quality and reporting, running governance forums, challenging requirements where needed, and translating business problems into practical CRM, process, reporting, automation and data solutions. 
This role requires someone who is hands-on, analytical and delivery-focused, with the ability to move between strategy and execution. You should be comfortable working through ambiguity, bringing structure to complex problems and using data to drive better business decisions. 
 Principal Accountabilities 
 Project Delivery & Stakeholder Management 
Lead complex CRM initiatives from discovery through to implementation, adoption and postlaunch review.
Manage multiple CRM projects simultaneously across different product and stakeholder groups. 
Create and maintain project plans, delivery roadmaps, requirements documentation and status updates. 
Translate business requirements into clear CRM process, data, reporting, automation, clear documentation and configuration requirements. 
 Analytics, Reporting & Data Quality 
 Use CRM data to identify pipeline issues, process inefficiencies, adoption gaps and data quality risks. 
Define and improve key CRM metrics, including pipeline conversion, stage ageing, SLA performance, ownership, activity, adoption and data completeness. 
Work with Data and Reporting teams to improve management information and executive reporting. 
Actively propose data-driven optimisation plans that improve pipeline performance, revenue outcomes and operational efficiency. 
 HubSpot Product Ownership 
Provide product ownership for key areas of HubSpot, including objects, properties, pipelines, lifecycle stages, workflows, permissions, views, lists, reporting and integrations. 
 Work closely with HubSpot administrators to ensure configuration changes are well-designed, well-tested and aligned to the CRM operating model.
Review proposed HubSpot changes for scalability, reporting impact, data quality, user experience and compliance considerations. 
Ensure CRM documentation, field definitions, process maps and change records are kept up to date. 
 CRM operational Improvement, Automation & AI Enablement 
Identify opportunities to improve customer, colleague and operational journeys through better CRM processes. 
 Support the design of workflows, automation and handoff processes that improve efficiency while maintaining appropriate controls. 
 Use AI-enabled tools appropriately to accelerate analysis, documentation, summarisation, workflow design, knowledge management and stakeholder communication. 
 Ensure automation and AI-assisted ways of working are measurable, documented, reviewed and used in line with relevant data, security and compliance expectations. 
 Personal Attributes & Experience 
Commercially aware, with an understanding of how CRM supports growth, customer journeys and operational efficiency.
 Hands-on and proactive, with a make it happen attitude. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify patterns, root causes and opportunities from data. 
Proven experience leading CRM, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations or business transformation projects in a complex organisation. 
Strong project management capability, including the ability to manage multiple initiatives independently.
.Comfortable using HubSpot or a similar CRM platform to support workflows, reporting, pipeline management and operational processes.
Comfortable using AI tools responsibly to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, communication and operational effectiveness. 
Strong understanding of CRM data quality, reporting definitions, pipeline management and user adoption.
 Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, including the ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders. 
Able to challenge requirements constructively and manage trade-offs between different teams. 
 Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to turn complex issues into clear recommendations. 
 Comfortable working in ambiguity and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional problems.
 Working at Allica Bank 
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
Options for flexible working
Regular social activities
Pension contributions
Discretionary bonus scheme
Private health cover
Life assurance
Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave
 Don’t tick every box? 
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
 Flexible working 
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
 Diversity 
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.
hard_gaps: Demonstrated CRM/HubSpot product ownership and end-to-end project delivery

Role demands hands-on CRM configuration ownership and governance forums; Tom's CRM depth is power-user plus personal HubSpot instance.
Sponsorship not mentioned; UK Skilled Worker salary threshold must be verified against an unpublished band.

title: Customer Success, Enterprise
description:
About Airwallex 
Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.
Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.
 Attributes We Value 
We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.
 About the team 
Airwallex is revolutionising global banking, and our Embedded Finance team is building the infrastructure that enables enterprises to deliver financial products and experiences to their customers.
We work with large, complex organisations—including embedded finance customers and businesses with more than 1,000 employees—to help them launch, scale and optimise Airwallex solutions. Our work spans Payments, Business Accounts, Spend and APIs, combining deep product expertise with a highly consultative, customer-first approach.
This is an opportunity to join the founding team of our EMEA Enterprise Customer Success function . You will work closely with our existing Customer Success Manager and help shape the processes, playbooks and operating model for the team as it grows.
Our UK team is growing and currently has more than 110 employees. We operate in a hybrid environment, with three days per week required in our London office at Wells & More, Fitzrovia.
 What you’ll do 
As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will own the post-sale relationship for a portfolio of strategic customers. You will partner with customers throughout implementation, go-live and ongoing growth, ensuring they achieve measurable value from Airwallex.
You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Product, Support, Operations, Billing and Technical teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
 Responsibilities 
Act as a founding member of the EMEA Enterprise Customer Success team and help build the function from the ground up.
Manage and grow relationships with embedded finance customers and enterprise clients, typically organisations with more than 1,000 employees.
Own the customer lifecycle from implementation and go-live through adoption, expansion and renewal.
Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, technical teams and operational contacts across customer organisations.
Lead complex implementation and onboarding programmes, coordinating internal and external stakeholders to deliver against agreed timelines.
Develop customer success plans, define objectives and establish success metrics aligned to each customer’s business goals.
Serve as the primary escalation point for operational, technical and service-related issues.
Coordinate with Sales, Account Management, Support, Billing, Product and Engineering to drive timely resolution of customer issues.
Monitor product adoption, transaction volumes, service levels, failure rates and other key performance indicators.
Use data and customer insights to identify risks, recommend improvements and drive increased adoption and value.
Support customers in optimising their use of Airwallex’s APIs, Payments, Business Accounts and Spend solutions.
Project-manage the rollout of new products, features and capabilities across your accounts.
Proactively identify opportunities to improve the customer experience and prevent potential issues.
Ensure customers receive clear, timely and proactive communication throughout incidents, changes and key delivery milestones.
Develop deep expertise in Airwallex’s products and embedded finance capabilities to advise customers and resolve complex challenges.
Contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, processes and best practices for Enterprise Customer Success.
 Who you are 
You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Delivery, Operations or a related client-facing role supporting enterprise customers.
You have experience working with complex organisations, multiple stakeholders and long implementation cycles.
Experience in fintech, payments, banking, APIs or embedded finance is highly desirable.
You are an accomplished relationship builder who can establish credibility and trust with stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
You have exceptional communication and presentation skills and are comfortable engaging with both technical and non-technical audiences.
You are commercially minded and able to identify opportunities to drive customer value, adoption and growth.
You are highly organised and comfortable managing multiple complex projects and priorities simultaneously.
You are detail-oriented and understand the importance of operational accuracy when supporting enterprise customers.
You are technically minded and have experience delivering, implementing or troubleshooting SaaS, API-based or other technical solutions.
You are proactive, solutions-oriented and comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
You enjoy building from scratch and are excited by the opportunity to help shape a new Customer Success function.
You have experience working with tools such as Google Workspace, Salesforce, SQL, Looker and Zendesk.
 Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters 
 To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page. 
 Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. 
 Equal opportunity 
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Looker and SQL working experience

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Versapay 🚀 
 Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. 
 Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward. 
 Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually. 
 Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!! 
 HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT: 
 As the Revenue Operations Manager, you will drive increased pipeline visibility, forecast accuracy, and deal velocity, all while ensuring clean data and scalable workflows across the GTM motion. You will drive core operating cadences and contribute to projects that improve visibility, efficiency, and performance across our go-to-market teams. 
 Reporting to the Director of Revenue Operations, you will blend strategic vision with operational execution to build the processes that drive predictability, the insights that guide decision-making, and the scalable systems that enable our go-to-market (GTM) teams to perform at their best. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to align processes, data, and insights to drive speed and accuracy within our GTM engine. 
\n
 What You’ll Do 
 GTM Forecasting: 
 Drive core operating rhythms, including weekly forecasting and bookings updates, pipeline reviews, and monthly/quarterly business reviews. 
 Refine data models and processes to improve forecasting accuracy and predictability. 
 Enforce stage definitions, rules of engagement, and data standards in our CRM. 
 GTM Insights & Reporting: 
 Build and maintain strategic dashboards, KPI scorecards, and performance metrics to inform decisions across Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership. 
 Enhance analytics and reporting frameworks to track key sales metrics and trends. Enable sales leaders to act on data by providing actionable insights. 
 Deliver insights suitable for executive presentations, including quarterly business reviews (QBRs), board presentations, and recurring business reviews. 
 Partner with the Analytics team to maintain data accuracy, ensure consistency, and optimize self-service reporting. 
 Revenue Strategy & Planning : 
 Partner with Sales, Finance, and Marketing on bookings plan modelling, including target setting, and capacity modelling across GTM teams. 
 Facilitate quota allocation and support compensation planning and analysis. 
 Support annual goals and key strategic initiatives by working on goal design, reporting, inspection, and insights. 
 Business Partnering: 
 Drive alignment among leadership stakeholders to support seamless GTM execution. 
 Continuously streamline and improve best practices, including processes, policies, and tools. 
 Support the selection, integration, and optimization of the Sales Tech Stack (e.g., Gong, ZoomInfo), with a strong focus on leveraging AI-powered platforms to enhance productivity and insights. 
 What You'll Bring to The Team 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field. 
 5+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, sales strategy, business operations, or similar; preferably at a Fintech or SaaS company 
 Strategic thinking : Applies an outcomes-focused mindset to determine marketing effectiveness and ROI of customer engagement efforts. Sees beyond the day-to-day grind to help reach marketing and sales goals. 
 Follow-through : Thrives in a fast-scaling, high-growth environment where accuracy, trust, and speed coexist. Can work independently to bring all assigned work to completion with speed and accuracy. 
 Collaboration : Assertive with humility—able to lead change in a positive way. Excellent communicator who can bridge Finance rigour and GTM clarity. 
 Data fluency : Strong modelling skills in Excel and comfort with a leading BI/Dashboarding platform (e.g. we use Tableau). You like working with data and insights, able to synthesize data and make recommendations. Trusted to manage sensitive compensation data with precision. 
 Platform/tools expertise : Extensive experience with Salesforce and other GTM systems, such as ZoomInfo, Gong, and Calendly. 
\n
$110,000 - $130,000 a year
\n
#LI-Remote
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

 This is a rare opportunity to build something from the ground up. As Revenue Operations Manager for our Automotive & Data (A&D) business unit, you will design and own the operating system that powers A&D's global commercial organisation — with the freedom to shape it right from day one.
Working within the Global Revenue Operations function and based in our London office, you'll become the go-to operational voice of the A&D business — the person commercial leaders turn to when they need clarity, confidence, and a system that actually works. You'll form deep, trusted partnerships with A&D's sales leadership, the Commercial Operations Manager, the COO, and key stakeholders across Finance, GTM Operations, and Product.  How To Make An Impact
 A&D Operational Partnership
 This is where it begins. To support the business growth and before systems can scale, the business needs to be heard — and you'll be the person doing the listening.
Embed yourself as the primary operational partner to A&D's Commercial Operations Manager and commercial leaders, earning the credibility to become their first call when something needs to work better.
Lead the end-to-end setup of A&D in Salesforce and associated tooling — pipeline structure, opportunity stages, reporting views, forecasting cadences — standing up an operational foundation that gives the business unit full confidence from day one.
Translate the business's commercial needs into scalable system and process solutions, ensuring what gets built reflects what A&D actually needs to grow — not just what's easiest to configure.
Serve as A&D's focal point into centralised functions — Compensation, Enablement, and Analytics — making sure the business unit gets the right support, at the right time, from shared services.
Progressively transfer capability and ownership into the business as A&D matures, so your impact compounds rather than creating dependency.
 Salesforce & Systems Ownership
 The systems you own are the backbone of commercial confidence. You'll ensure they stay fit for purpose as A&D scales.
Drive and continuously improve the Salesforce CRM architecture that underpins pipeline management, forecasting, reporting, and commercial governance — working directly with the Salesforce development team to make A&D's vision a reality.
Own platform consistency and data quality standards across the business unit, ensuring Salesforce is the single source of truth that leaders can rely on — not a source of doubt.
Evaluate, onboard, and manage commercial tooling integrations, keeping the tech stack coherent, purposeful, and aligned to what the business needs to grow.
Develop and maintain executive-level reporting and dashboards that give A&D leadership genuine confidence in pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and commercial execution.
 Processes & Governance Standards
 Great operations are invisible when done well. You'll build the structures that let the business move fast without breaking things.

Enforce CRM hygiene, compliance, and adoption in ways that make sense for commercial teams — identifying gaps, understanding root causes, and partnering with the business to close them.
Build the reporting and governance infrastructure that keeps leadership aligned and accountable, creating the shared language between sales, finance, and operations that predictable growth depends on.
 Enablement & Continuous Improvement
 The best systems are ones people actually use. You'll build the capability and culture that makes that happen.
Design and deliver training and enablement programmes that equip A&D's commercial teams with best-practice system usage and operational workflows — reducing friction, not adding it.
Identify and implement automation opportunities that remove manual effort, improve data quality, and increase commercial productivity — prioritising changes with the clearest impact on business outcomes.
Partner with FP&A, Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to align on shared KPIs, forecasting methodologies, and GTM hand-offs that hold up across functions and support confident decision-making.
 About You
 You are a systems-minded, detail-oriented operations professional who takes pride in building reliable infrastructure that commercial teams depend on. You are comfortable holding the line on standards while remaining consultative and collaborative — and you understand that great operations work is often invisible when done well.
You are energised by the idea of being embedded in a high-growth business unit while also serving the wider organisation. You move naturally between the language of commercial teams and the language of technical ones — translating needs in both directions, and making sure what gets built is what the business actually needs.

Strong working knowledge of Salesforce — enough to translate commercial needs into well-scoped requirements, challenge technical decisions, and hold a development team accountable — without necessarily being the person who builds it.
Track record of designing and scaling common commercial processes and governance frameworks that improve forecast accuracy and CRM adoption across an organisation.

A growth mindset and genuine curiosity: you look for ways to make things better, document what you learn and bring others along with you.

title: Senior RevOps Manager
description:
Hi 👋 We’re Legl. 
 Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services. 
 We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting. 
 Legal work is high-stake - it’s regulated, complex, and deeply impactful - and our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences 
 We’re backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK’s top 200, launched in the UK and Australia - and entering our next phase of growth. 
 We Work Best When 
 AI is the central-operating model: not a tool or a future plan - but the way we run. 
 Decisions live with people: you're trusted to make calls and own them. 
 Think deeply, execute quickly: speed and rigour, not speed or rigour. 
 What You’ll Do 
 As Legl's Senior RevOps Manager , you own how revenue moves through the business - from a lead landing in HubSpot, through signature, launch and ramp, to a customer using the product at the level we expected when they signed. Legl gets paid for what customers use, not how many we sign, so this role covers the whole funnel: Sales & Marketing, Launch & Implementation and Customer Success. 
 Own HubSpot as our commercial system of record - l ead routing, pipeline stages, deal hygiene and the data model underneath them, so that the CRM reflects reality and sales leadership can forecast from it with confidence. 
 Connect marketing to pipeline - define with Marketing what a qualified lead is, own the handover to Sales, and build the attribution reporting that shows which channels and campaigns turn into revenue. 
 Run the sales forecast - build the process and tooling that turns pipeline data into an accurate forecast, and keep it accurate as the business scales. 
 Track ramp and forecast usage - follow every new customer from go-live against what we expected at signature, build a bottom-up usage and revenue forecast by account, and explain the gap between forecast and actual each month to CS, Sales and Finance. 
 Build the reporting leadership runs on - maintain the core commercial reporting in HubSpot and Metabase, write your own SQL when the standard reports don't answer the question, and get usage and revenue data in front of AEs and CSMs inside the CRM. 
 Find where deals slow down and fix it - analyse cycle time by stage and segment, take the findings to the sales team, and drive the changes that speed deals up. 
 Lead change across the commercial motion - when the sales or CS playbook needs to change, design the new process, document it, land it with the team, and report back on what worked and what didn't. 
 Build AI into how the commercial team works - design and deploy agentic workflows across the commercial stack, with clear judgement about where AI belongs and which data should never go near it. 
 This Role Is a Great Fit If You… 
 Are experienced in revenue operations at a B2B SaaS scaleup, and have owned HubSpot as the system of record - you've designed the pipeline and data model, not just kept it tidy. 
 Have worked in a usage-based or consumption-priced business and know first-hand that a signed deal is only the start of the revenue funnel. 
 Have built a forecast that leadership relied on, and can explain how you made it accurate. 
 Are comfortable in SQL and a BI tool such as Metabase, and would rather write the query than wait for someone else to. 
 Have worked across the whole funnel - you understand how Marketing, Sales and Customer Success hand off to each other and where revenue goes missing between them. 
 Have taken difficult findings to a sales team and got them to act - you can make the case with data and hold your ground in the room. 
 Have rolled out process change to a commercial team and made it stick, and can talk openly about the times it didn't. 
 Use AI as a matter of course in how you work, and think carefully about where it shouldn't be used. 
 This Role Is Not a Great Fit If You… 
 Want an analyst role. You'll own outcomes here, not just the reporting on them. 
 Are looking for an established RevOps function to join. You'll be building much of it. 
 Have only ever worked on new business and haven't had to think about what happens to a customer after they sign. 
 Prefer to stay in the tooling rather than have direct conversations with sales and CS leaders about pipeline, forecast and process. 
 Want a large team around you or a manager who sets the agenda. Decisions live with you. 
 Are used to a large-enterprise pace where change is slow and heavily governed.

Use modern revenue tools, no-code automation and AI-assisted workflows to remove manual work, improve decisions and scale reliable processes.

HubSpot (Marketing), Salesforce (CRM), Clay, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, PandaDoc, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Vercel, Railway, n8n, Make.com, Zapier and Gumloop.

title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
description:
Job description 
 Role: Customer Success Operations Specialist
 Scope: The scope of this role is to own and optimise the operational backbone of Customer Success by translating business goals into scalable processes, lifecycle automation, tooling and reporting, with a strong focus on AI-driven efficiency and adoption.
 Language requirement: Dutch
 Location: Ghent, with hybrid working model
 Who are we and why should you care? 
Teamleader is a SaaS scale-up born in 2012 in Ghent, Belgium, and part of the Visma Group since 2022. Our mission? To make work easier, not harder , for small and medium-sized businesses.
Here’s what we bring to the table:
 Teamleader Focus : the all-in-one tool that helps small businesses optimise CRM, projects, and invoicing.
 Teamleader One : the go-to e-invoicing software that self-employed pros can count on.
We’ve also been growing smarter through strategic acquisitions:
 Teamleader Orbit (2019): helping medium-sized agencies thrive and scale.
 Vectera (2022): powering seamless customer meetings.
 Dexxter (2024): making financial admin a breeze for freelancers.
Curious to learn more about us, our products, and why you’ll love working at Teamleader ? Check us out here . 
 We Are Looking for a Customer Success Operations Specialist to Join us 
We are not starting our AI and automation journey from scratch. We already have automation and AI initiatives in place, and are now looking for someone who can help us operationalise, scale and continuously improve what works.
Support automation already resolves a large share of our ticket volume, our digital CS motion runs at scale and we have a clear direction for where AI takes our operating model next: coaching on autopilot, next-best-action in Planhat off churn signals, a self-improving knowledge base and signal-driven retention and contraction. Some of these initiatives are already proven in pilot; others are still being developed.
Your job is to turn these initiatives into reliable, scalable day-to-day operations: translate business and CS goals into lifecycle logic, workflows, automations, tooling and reporting that work in practice. You will configure and connect the tools yourself, make sure the underlying data is reliable, and drive adoption across the teams using what you build.
We are not looking for someone who needs a fully defined roadmap or wants to work only on strategy. This is a hands-on operator role in an organisation that is currently going through significant change. Priorities will evolve, processes are still being built and you will have a real opportunity to shape how the function works.
You’ll work behind the scenes to enable and scale the CS organisation through better processes, tooling, automation and reporting. This is not a customer-facing Customer Success role.
Today the scope is Customer Success and lifecycle. As the function matures, this role is built to grow into a broader Revenue Operations remit across the commercial funnel, so we are looking for someone who can own the CS and lifecycle layer now and grow into the wider mandate.
 Key Responsibilities 
You will own the operational backbone of Customer Success: the lifecycle logic, tooling and instrumentation the team runs on. You own the operational layer; the data analysts build analysis and models on top.
You own the CS tooling stack, with Planhat as the source of truth for the CS motion, and you keep the data flowing cleanly between Planhat, Hubspot, Zendesk, Fin.ai and the other tools the team relies on.
You build with AI to automate and scale CS operations: you turn manual or reactive CS workflows into more scalable ones, and you take the team's AI and automation initiatives from pilot into daily operational reality.
You drive adoption and connect CS across the customer lifecycle. You ensure that the tooling and processes you build are adopted in practice, while creating a connected customer journey from sales and onboarding through CS and beyond.
You build and maintain operational reporting and dashboards that help CS leaders understand performance and make better decisions, working with data analysts where deeper analysis or modelling is needed.
You work closely with CS leadership and with the data, product and wider commercial teams to keep process and tooling aligned.
You help shape the future RevOps operating model. As the organisation evolves, you will contribute ideas, best practices and structure to help build a more proactive and connected RevOps function across the commercial organisation.
 Why others chose Teamleader: we're lively, not corporate 
We have the energy and boldness of a start-up and the expertise and pragmatism of a scale-up. The result: a team of both young and seasoned professionals led by supportive and approachable managers who give recognition and rewards for hard work. You’ll be working in a fast-paced tech environment with open feedback culture and room for initiatives as well as ideas. You’ll have plenty of room to apply your personality, express yourself, and impact our course of action with your insights or ideas.
 On top of that, you’ll get: 
An extensive training budget. 
A hybrid working model : a pleasant mix of office and home working.
A personal tooling budget, to make working from home as comfortable as from our offices.
Daily budget-friendly in-house prepared lunch and dinner options (only in our Ghent office), as well as Friyays and numerous sport initiatives!
 32 holidays on top of the standard public ones! (based on full-time employment).
Our long-lasting dedication to employee well-being, just take a look at our career page and Instagram to see how we keep the Team(leader) spirit going.
 We value diversity 
Our ambition is to build and sell a product that helps everyone everywhere (starting with Europe) to work smarter, so we want our team to reflect that. We believe that a diverse , inclusive working environment is crucial to realise that ambition, so we’re committed to continue to build and cherish a culture where every colleague feels welcome, appreciated and heard. 
 Job requirements 
 You’d be a great fit for this role if you have: 
Have experience in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Lifecycle Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations or a related operational role , ideally in a SaaS or other technology environment. Direct RevOps experience is not a must-have if you have strong CS operations experience and the ability to grow into a broader RevOps role. 
Can translate strategy into operations: turn a business or CS goal into processes, lifecycle logic, automations, tooling and reporting that work in practice. title: Senior Customer Success Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Mixpanel 
Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at mixpanel.com.
 About the Team 
The Revenue Strategy & Operations team at Mixpanel partners with Regional and Global Business Leaders to set and execute revenue strategy across the customer lifecycle. We build the strategy, operational processes, reporting infrastructure, and decision-making frameworks that make our GTM teams successful.
 About the Role 
As Senior Customer Strategy & Operations Manager, you’ll be the strategic advisor and operating partner to our VP of Global Customer Success. You’ll own how we understand, retain, and grow our customer base - diagnosing what drives upsell, what predicts churn, and what we need to build to scale the post-sales motion.
This isn’t a role where you inherit a clean process and tune it at the margins. You’ll get your hands dirty in customer-level data, design the systems that turn signals into action, and build AI-powered tooling. You’ll work directly with CS leadership day-to-day and feed field-level insight back into the broader Revenue Strategy team and GTM leadership.
You bring the structured thinking of a consultant and the bias for action of an operator. You’re equally comfortable in a strategy session with the VP and three layers deep in a SQL query.
 Responsibilities 
 Customer analysis at the account level. Get hands-on with the data to understand what drives expansion, what predicts churn, and where the highest-leverage interventions live. You’ll connect product usage signals, customer health, and commercial outcomes and translate the findings into decisions the CS org acts on.
 Forecasting and pipeline rigor for the post-sales motion. Build and evolve how we forecast GRR, NRR, and expansion pipeline. You’re technical enough to wire up the inputs yourself.
 The CS operating cadence. Run the rhythm - business reviews, executive deep dives, leadership offsites - and make sure the right questions get asked with the right data behind them.
 CS systems and tooling. Partner with our systems team on our CS platform and its integrations with Salesforce and our product data. You’ve deployed or deeply operated one of these before and know where the leverage is.
 AI as a force multiplier. Build skills, agents, and automations that the whole CS org can adopt.
 Strategic partnership with Global CS leadership. Act as a true business partner in the room, in the work, jointly owning the outcomes. You’ll also coordinate with peers supporting other functions to make sure the post-sales view connects to the broader GTM picture.
 We're Looking for Someone Who Has 
 5+ years operating in Revenue Strategy, Sales Strategy, CS Operations, or Business Operations at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. Ideally smaller, fast-moving environments where you own outcomes end-to-end.
 Direct experience supporting a Customer Success or Post-Sales organization. You’ve worked alongside CS leadership, understand the mechanics of retention and expansion, and have driven measurable impact on GRR, NRR, or churn.
 Hands-on with a CS platform. You’ve deployed, administered, or deeply operated a CSP. You understand health scoring, playbooks, and lifecycle workflows.
 Strong technical and analytical instincts. You write your own SQL, build your own models, and work directly with operational data. 
 Enterprise product experience. You’ve worked on a product sold to Enterprise customers. 
 Structured thinking and commercial judgment. Your work is rigorous, your priorities are clear, and you build for impact.
 Exceptional communication. You can move from a SQL query to an exec-level recommendation in the same hour.
 Genuine, daily AI fluency. You’ve built skills, agents, or automated workflows that others use.
#LI-Hybrid
 Benefits and Perks 
Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care
Mental Wellness Benefit
Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays
Enhanced Parental Leave
Volunteer Time Off
Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break
 *please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary* 
 Culture Values 
 Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.
 Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.
 One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.
 Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.
 Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.
 Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.
 Why choose Mixpanel? 
We’re a leader in analytics with over 9,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.
Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

 Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

 About The Team
 The Revenue Strategy & Enablement team at Airwallex sits at the heart of our commercial engine, empowering sales and commercial teams to win in a fast-paced environment. Our mission is to accelerate revenue growth by equipping and coaching our teams with the knowledge, tools, and processes they need to succeed – across both core and new products, and in every region we serve.

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us 
AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.
AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.
AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400+ carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.
Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.
 Your Mission: 
We succeed when our customers succeed. Customer Success is not only a critical function at AfterShip, but a core value of the organization. As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of some of AfterShip's most strategic and commercially important accounts, including some of the industry's top DTC brands. These are our highest-value relationships, and you'll be trusted to protect and grow them.
This role goes beyond adoption and support. You'll lead complex commercial conversations, drive renewal and expansion outcomes, and build durable relationships across every level of the customer organization, from day-to-day operators to the executive suite. Your ability to influence senior stakeholders, deliver compelling business reviews, and negotiate win-win commercial outcomes will directly shape AfterShip's retention and growth trajectory.
This is a high-impact position within the growing global Customer Success team. As part of a global team, there may be a need to work outside of regular office hours for meetings with Europe or APAC. Meetings outside of regular business hours are planned with advance adequate notice.
 What You’ll Do: 
Own the end-to-end success of a portfolio of AfterShip's most strategic accounts, carrying direct responsibility for Net Dollar Retention, minimize churn and expansion targets.
Lead commercial negotiations for renewals, upgrades, and multi-year agreements, partnering with Sales and leadership to structure deals that protect revenue and deepen the partnership.
Build and execute proactive renewal strategies well ahead of contract dates, identifying risk early and mobilizing internal resources to defend and grow accounts, including in competitive situations.
Develop multi-threaded stakeholder maps across your accounts, cultivating champions and building trusted relationships with economic buyers and executive sponsors.
Prepare and present executive-level business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) that connect AfterShip's impact to the customer's business outcomes, using account performance metrics, industry insights, and ROI narratives to influence decision-makers and surface incremental opportunities.
Act as the strategic voice of your customers internally, working cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and Engineering across time zones to remove blockers and shape the product roadmap.
Lead onboarding for new strategic clients in close collaboration with implementation counterparts, ensuring time-to-value is fast and measurable.
Mentor and raise the bar for the broader CSM team, sharing best practices on commercial conversations, executive engagement, and business review craft.
Be willing to travel for onsite client meetings, executive sessions, and trade events (up to 20%).
 Who We're Looking For: 
5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role in SaaS, preferably in eCommerce, with a track record of managing strategic or enterprise-tier accounts.
Proven expertise in commercial negotiations and renewals, including navigating procurement, structuring pricing conversations, and defending revenue in competitive situations.
Demonstrated ability to own a revenue number, with a history of strong retention and expansion performance against quota.
Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with experience building relationships and influencing at the VP and C-suite level.
A strong storyteller who can build and deliver business reviews that land with executives, translating data into a clear narrative about value, ROI, and opportunity.
Ability to understand and explain technical solutions in business terms to both clients and internal stakeholders.
Comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder accounts with competing priorities, and skilled at prioritization in a growth-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
 At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn’t always fit every requirement. If you’re passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply. 
 Why You Should Join Us: 
 Great Place to Work Certified: We’ve been recognized for our inclusive, values-driven culture that celebrates diversity and collaboration.
 Innovative & Inclusive Culture: Started by our software engineer-turned-CEO, AfterShip is built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We’re a passionate, global team of problem solvers who put egos aside to innovate together. We take immense pride in fostering a culture that’s inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.
 Ambitious Mission with Real Impact: Join us in transforming eCommerce by making buying and selling easier for everyone. It’s one of the most dynamic spaces in tech, with limitless opportunities to innovate and grow.
 Thrive & Grow: There’s no ceiling to what you can achieve or learn here. We’re committed to empowering your career while advancing together as a company.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
Who We’re Looking For
At ScalePad, we hire thoughtful builders who want their work to matter. Our roles are designed for people who thrive on driving impact, see ambiguity as an opportunity, and believe that raising the bar is a team sport.
We don’t bring people in to run playbooks. We hire people who want to rewrite them. And in this role, you’ll get to do that, while shaping the future of managed services for our global partners. (That’s what we call our customers.)
What is ScalePad
At ScalePad, we’re building more than software; we’re building confidence and clarity for the people who manage the technology businesses rely on every day.
Our mission: help MSPs evolve into MVPs (their clients’ most valuable partner). Our tools turn them from reactive service providers into strategic advisors through a consistent, scalable Customer Success motion.
Our product suite unifies risk insights, client planning, and service delivery so MSPs can have smarter conversations, show clients their value, and grow their revenue.
But our purpose goes beyond our software. We’re creating a workplace where curious, growth-minded people can do their best work, where ideas are valued, progress is shared, and everyone belongs. Together, we’re creating a future where MSPs don’t just keep businesses running, they help them thrive. We believe that when our partners succeed, we all do.
With offices in Vancouver, Toronto, Montreal, and Phoenix and a global-first mindset. ScalePad has grown into a category leader trusted by 12,000+ partners across 60+ countries. We’ve been recognized for our products and corporate culture by MSP Today, G2, and Great Place to Work™, to name a few.
 About The Role
 The Sales Operations Manager is a critical hire within the Revenue Operations org, sitting at the intersection of sales strategy and operational execution. This is a strategic role that requires an operator's mindset — someone who can hold a long-term view while executing in the short term, navigate ambiguity without losing momentum, and adapt quickly as the business evolves. Get ready to go beyond order-taking. Your strategic responsibilities include:
Sales Technology & AI
Own the full sales tech stack end-to-end — administration, adoption, and roadmap.
Define utilization and impact metrics for every tool; make rationalization calls and lead implementations in partnership with Revenue Systems.
Drive adoption across the sales team through enablement and change reinforcement; adoption is an outcome, not an assumption.

Operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and the ability to adapt quickly is as important as functional expertise.

4–6 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a closely related function at a SaaS company.
Deep HubSpot & Gong expertise; familiarity with adjacent tools (Sales Nav, ZoomInfo, Clay, or similar) a strong plus.

Strong analytical skills — comfortable building models, telling a story with data, and connecting operational metrics to revenue outcomes.
Experience owning a tech stack, not just administering tickets within one.
Proven ability to influence Sales leaders without relying on authority.

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Channel Programs (Hybrid)
description:
About Us:
 A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.
 How We Work:
 We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:
One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
Own it We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
Accountable to our customers We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
Excellence in execution Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
Be bold, fail fast, learn faster We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.
These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.
 The Role
 Nitro is investing in its Revenue Operations function and needs a technically strong systems builder to own the Salesforce infrastructure that powers our go-to-market motion. This role sits inside RevOps and is primarily responsible for the configuration, automation, and integrity of our Salesforce instance with an immediate focus on the systems and workflows that support our channel and partner business.
You will personally build and maintain flows, automations, and reporting across the GTM stack. While the partnerships motion is the primary domain you will support day-to-day, this role is a RevOps systems role first and will naturally extend into broader areas of the GTM system as the function grows. This is a hands-on build role. You will be in Salesforce every day building, not directing others to do it.
 What You Will Do
 Salesforce Build & Administration
Own and personally execute Salesforce configuration across the GTM stack: flows, automations, assignment rules, approval processes, page layouts, record types, and dynamic layouts
Design and build scalable workflows, maintaining clean system architecture and clear documentation throughout
Manage data quality across the instance; deduplication, enrichment standards, validation rules, and field governance
Maintain CPQ configuration as it relates to deal structures, pricing rules, and quote generation
Own Salesforce documentation: build guides, flow documentation, change logs, and admin playbooks
Support governance, release management, health checks, and security reviews for the Salesforce instance
Serve as the primary Salesforce subject matter expert for RevOps and the internal teams that depend on it
 Partnerships & Channel Systems
Apply your Salesforce expertise to the channel and partner motion, building and maintaining deal registration workflows, partner tiering logic, opportunity routing, partner attribution logic, and partner-facing CRM processes
Own day-to-day administration of the partner tech stack, Salesforce, Allbound (partner portal), and Pax8-related workflows
Operationalise partner programme components inside Salesforce: deal registration, onboarding workflows, partner tiering, incumbency protection, and partner lifecycle tracking
Build and maintain dashboards covering partner pipeline, partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, deal registration activity, and programme performance
Identify and resolve system friction that slows partner activity, causes misrouting, or reduces adoption
Use AI and automation tools to reduce manual effort across partner operations: intake, enrichment, routing, reporting, and field notifications
 What We Are Looking For
5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a closely related function in B2B SaaS
Deep, hands-on Salesforce Administration experience is required. You must be able to personally build flows, configure automations, manage data, and own the system architecture
Salesforce Admin Certification strongly preferred; CPQ experience a plus
Familiarity with how SaaS partnerships work in practice. Channel motions, partner-led pipeline, and deal registration is useful context for this role, though not a hard requirement
Experience with partner portals, channel systems, or partner programme operations a plus
Familiarity with tools such as Allbound, Pax8, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Groove, or Clari is a plus
Analytical, process-oriented, and documentation-driven. Comfortable operating across both tactical build work and cross-functional programme coordination
AI-fluent and automation-minded in practice, not just in principle
 Success in This Role Looks Like
At 30 days: Clear picture of the current Salesforce configuration, highest-priority gaps identified, hands-on remediation underway
At 90 days: Deal registration workflows, partner account management, and attribution logic are cleaner and better documented. Partnerships team has a reliable system resource.
At 6 months: Leadership has trusted reporting on channel performance. Partner onboarding is faster. Routing and attribution are reliable. Manual workarounds have been replaced with documented, automated processes.
 Why Nitro?

title: RevOps Manager
description:
Appear is building the infrastructure that helps brands get cited by AI: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini. We're early, we're growing fast, and we need someone who can sell a category that didn't exist two years ago. 
 Context 
Search is shifting. When someone asks ChatGPT which law firm, clinic, or software to use, the brands that get cited win the business, and most companies have no idea whether they're showing up. Appear fixes that. We measure AI visibility, identify the gaps, and build the content infrastructure to close them.
Tasks
Own HubSpot end-to-end: configuration, workflows, custom objects, pipelines, permissions, and data hygiene across Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, and Service Hub.
Design and maintain account and lead segmentation models that reflect our multiple GTM motions, ensuring each segment is routed and worked correctly.
Build and own lead routing logic, territory, round-robin, and rules-based that runs cleanly across concurrent motions and avoids conflicts or leakage.
Design, implement, and continuously tune lead scoring models (fit + engagement) that reflect the different buying signals across each motion.
Design and maintain lifecycle stages and scoring models that align Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success and Product-Led Growth.
Build and maintain dashboards and reports that give leadership real-time visibility into pipeline, funnel conversion, and revenue performance across all active motions.
Partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to identify process gaps and implement scalable solutions inside HubSpot.
Own integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the GTM stack (e.g. Slack, Lemlist, Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, billing/finance systems), evaluating and onboarding new tools as our needs evolve.
Use AI-powered enrichment and automation tools to keep contact, account, and pipeline data continuously updated, deduplicated, and accurate reducing manual data entry across the GTM team.
Establish and enforce data governance standards deduplication, field standardization, and enrichment processes.
Support quota and territory planning, forecasting, and compensation reporting with clean, reliable data.
Train and support end users across the GTM org on HubSpot best practices.
Requirements
3-5+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations, with deep hands-on HubSpot experience (admin-level required; HubSpot certifications a plus).
Proven experience building and maintaining HubSpot workflows, custom properties, reporting, and pipeline automation.
Hands-on experience designing segmentation, lead routing, and lead scoring models, ideally across more than one GTM motion running at once.
Comfort operating in a multi-motion environment, balancing sometimes-competing requirements from PLG, sales-led, and/or partner motions within a single system.
Strong SQL or spreadsheet skills for data analysis; experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, or similar) a plus.
Familiarity with the broader GTM tech stack (Slack, Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Zapier/Workato, or similar) and experience integrating new tools into HubSpot.
Experience using AI-powered enrichment or automation tools (e.g., Clay, ZoomInfo, Apollo, or similar) to keep CRM data fresh and accurate at scale.
A systems-thinking mindset: You can see how a single field change ripples across the whole funnel.
Excellent cross-functional communication; you can translate between technical systems and business needs.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.
Real category upside. GEO is where SEO was in 2004. You're early enough to matter.
Founders in the room. Direct access to the CEO, CRO, CMO, and GTM. No bureaucracy between you and decisions.
We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone who looks at a category that barely exists, sees the opportunity, and wants to be the person who figured out how to sell it.

title: Sales Enablement Manager

description:
WHAT IS BOX? 
Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.
 WHY BOX NEEDS YOU 
As part of the broader Go To Market (GTM) Enablement organisation, the EMEA Sales Enablement Manager owns the regional enablement strategy end to end. You will design, build, and execute a bespoke EMEA enablement roadmap that directly accelerates revenue performance across the region while acting as the primary bridge between global enablement strategy, EMEA GTM strategy, and the activation of both in market.
This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role focused on 'last mile enablement'- ensuring that global enablement is successfully translated into how reps act in the field. You will operate as a trusted business partner to EMEA Sales and broader GTM leadership, quickly absorbing business context, understanding regional priorities, and translating them into practical enablement actions that improve seller execution and business performance. You must be able to connect market conditions, regional business priorities, seller needs, and customer outcomes - and champion those priorities when partnering directly with EMEA GTM teams.
Business acumen is critical in this role; you must bring a customer-first mindset and a deep understanding of the value of Box for our customer's business, maximising the value of global programmes while building locally-driven initiatives that reflect the unique dynamics of EMEA markets and sales motions. EMEA Enablement is uniquely positioned to act as a testing ground for new processes, selling motions, and cross-functional GTM teaming initiatives. You will lead the enablement charge that translates those from strategies to high-impact field performance.
Reporting Structure: Reports directly to the Global Head of Enablement with a dotted line to EMEA
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
Regional Strategy & Roadmap: Design, own, and execute a bespoke, agile EMEA enablement roadmap aligned with regional revenue priorities, GTM strategy, and QBR planning. Integrate closely with Chief of Staff and GTM Ops as a core commercial lever.
Global-to-Local Integration: Bridge global enablement and EMEA field teams by adapting global tools, training, and content for regional market nuances, while championing EMEA-specific priorities and resource needs at the global level.
Bi-directional Feedback & Insight: Maintain a continuous feedback loop between EMEA sellers, frontline managers, and global stakeholders, surfacing field realities, seller experience insights, and performance trends in real time.
End-to-End Programme Delivery: Design, facilitate, and reinforce high-impact enablement programmes (virtual and in-person) across onboarding, product launches, sales processes, MEDDPICC adoption, and manager enablement to drive sustained behavior change.
Executive Advisory & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as a trusted advisor to the EMEA SVP, sales leadership, and cross-functional GTM teams, building consensus in a matrixed environment and proactively identifying performance gaps.
Measurement & Commercial Impact: Partner with RevOps to build and maintain performance dashboards tracking key seller metrics (ramp time, win rates, deal velocity) and directly communicate enablement’s ROI on revenue, pipeline, and retention.
 WHO YOU ARE 
 Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, sales management, or closely related commercial roles, including significant experience supporting enterprise sellers and sales leaders in EMEA markets.
 Business Partnership: Proven ability to operate as a trusted business partner to Sales and GTM leaders, using sound judgment and commercial understanding to shape priorities, influence decisions, and drive execution.
 Enterprise Sales Experience: Strong background working directly with enterprise Sales teams, including experience coaching sellers and managers across multiple EMEA markets on value-based selling, sales process excellence, and in-field execution. Deep empathy for seller experience and a practical understanding of what helps frontline teams adopt, execute, and win.
 Customer-First Mindset: A strong customer-first mindset with a deep understanding of how to articulate and position the value of Box for our customer's business.
 Tools: Proficient with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), enablement and LMS platforms, and data/analytics tools, a plus if you’ve been leveraging AI tooling to drive efficiency, scale and impact.
 Communication: Exceptional presentation and facilitation skills for executive audiences, virtual and in-person; able to influence and inspire across cultures and seniority levels.
 Analytical Skills: Ability to leverage performance dashboards; skilled at using data to identify gaps, measure ROI, and tell a compelling impact story.
 Autonomy & Drive: Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast
We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.
Box lives its values, with community and in-person collaboration being a core part of our culture. Boxers are expected to work from their assigned office a minimum of 3 days per week. Your Recruiter will share more about how we work and company culture during the hiring process.
At Box, we believe unique and diverse experiences benefit our culture, our products, our customers, our company, and our world. We aim to recruit a passionate, high-performing workforce that reflects the world we live in. If you are head-over-heels about this role but unsure if you meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply!
 BENEFITS 
Box Benefits package includes pension, medical and dental coverage. We have a robust wellness program including 25 days of vacation (plus your birthday off!) and subsidized gym membership. There is such a thing as a free lunch, you can order from a daily menu along with lots of snacks and drinks. EMEA HQ office is located in the impressive White Collar Factory on Old Street; www.whitecollarfactory.com and other European offices in Paris, Munich, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.
 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY   
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, and any other protected ground of discrimination under applicable human rights legislation.
For details on how we protect your information when you apply, please see our Personnel Privacy Notice.

Backed by General Catalyst, the same investors behind Stripe and Airbnb, we’re building something truly extraordinary.
 Our Mission
 Our mission at Goodstack is to revolutionize how the world does good 🌎.
 As a fast growth, AI-native social impact startup, we power global change through technology. We enable companies to seamlessly integrate positive impact into what they do through a unified platform while supporting nonprofits in gaining access to cutting-edge technology and finding new funding streams.
Global brands, including Google, OpenAI, TikTok, LinkedIn, HSBC, Atlassian and Twilio - as well as thousands of nonprofits, including the Red Cross, Cancer Research, and Oxfam - use Goodstack to make a difference.
In 2025 alone, we facilitated $5 billion in donations to good causes. But this is just the beginning. We're building the world’s leading platform that powers donations to nonprofits globally.
To keep our momentum and deliver consistently high value to our partners, we need incredible people to help us on our journey – we need you 🫵
 Join us as a as Revenue Operations Manager to help build the operating engine behind our growth
 You will work across Sales, Finance, Marketing, Solutions, Customer Success, and Ops to make sure the revenue engine is well run, well instrumented, and built for the next stage of growth.
We are specifically looking for someone who is deeply AI-native in how they operate.
You'll run the operational engine behind a high-velocity, transactional sales motion: short cycles, high volume, and growth that comes from experiments rather than playbooks. You'll pair that with the traditional RevOps craft the motion depends on: clean data, honest reporting, and systems that scale, alongside partnering with the enterprise-side organisation that works with some of the biggest names in the world to deliver impact to non-profits globally.
This role rewards someone who can hold two things at once: moving fast on experiments, and protecting the integrity of the data and reporting the experiments depend on. If you only enjoy one of those, this is the wrong role. If the combination is exactly what you like, it's a very good one!
 As Revenue Operations Manager, your mission will include:
Pipeline and demand generation reporting: One source of truth that leadership trusts, from channel to win. 
Capacity planning and data modelling: The models that answer "what doubling output actually takes."
ICP definition: Iterated on closed-won evidence, not opinion, feeding directly back into targeting. 
CRM and tooling ownership: HubSpot end-to-end, plus the integration layer around it. 
Automations and workflows: Built with AI where it earns its place, built without it where determinism wins. 
 After 6 months, success will look like:
Leadership quotes one number per question, because there's one source of truth for pipeline and demand generation reporting. 
An experiment cadence is running with named owners, kill criteria, and results the team acts on. 
A capacity model exists that turns growth targets into inputs: channels, volumes, and rep time. 
The ICP is truly developed, grounded in win evidence, and targeting reflects it. 
Product has been supported with evidence of what the customers' needs are to inform product direction from your insights. 
A level of growth that makes Goodstack the place where the world's best and biggest Impact teams connect and serve the world's largest pool of Non-Profits. 
 This role is a perfect match for you if you are/have:
Run growth experiments with real stakes: owned the design, called the result, killed the losers. 
Worked inside a transactional or high-velocity sales motion and understand how it differs from enterprise. 
Built automations that ran in production, with or without AI (if you've built them without, you'll pick up the AI-assisted versions fast, and we'll want to see how). 
Owned a CRM end-to-end, including the unglamorous parts: deduplication, field governance, write-path control. 
Built a capacity or forecast model that someone senior actually used to make a decision. 
A practical, high-agency mindset and excitement about using AI and automation to create leverage. 
The ability to translate messy business problems into scalable processes. 
Confidence working cross-functionally across commercial, finance, and operational teams. 
A systems and process builder with strong operational instincts and enough commercial judgement to understand what matters and why. 
 Bonus if you have knowledge or love of:
Building AI-assisted outbound or prospecting workflows. 
Partnering closely with Finance or FP&A. 
Improving deal desk or complex commercial workflows. 
Experience in high-growth B2B SaaS or operationally complex businesses. 
 How we think about AI in this role:
You use AI tools daily as part of your workflow, not as an occasional assistant. 
You proactively automate repetitive operational tasks and workflows. 
You are excited by building lightweight internal tools, automations, and workflows without needing heavy engineering support. 
You stay current with emerging AI tooling and are constantly experimenting with better ways of working. 
You think in terms of leverage, speed, and systems - not headcount. 
You help raise the AI capability of the broader GTM organisation.
