title: Head of Business Operations — Business
description:
About Us 
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fueling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation .
Here’s a little more:
 Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
 Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
 Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
 Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
 Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word
The Role
Taptap send is building a Business product, leveraging the best-in-class cross-border payment network we have built. This is a new product line we’re building from the ground up and we are looking for a hungry, hands-on generalist to build and scale the operations behind it. You will own high impact, high urgency, needle-moving goals on a new and fast growing product in an established start up.
Taptap Send Business is early and growing fast. Businesses are already using us to pay people and suppliers across emerging markets, and we are launching a wider set of products and geographies. Every launch is a new promise to a business customer whose payroll, suppliers and cash flow depend on us getting it right.
This role reports to the Director of Business Operations and owns the service our business customers get. You will be given high agency and high autonomy, working across Product, Data, Engineering and Compliance to build and run best-in-class support for a product line that is growing fast.
The outcome you will drive
 Business customer retention — build an AI native account management support that is an order of magnitude better than anything on the market.
 A service excellence our BPO partners deliver to , consistently, as volume and product complexity increase.
 Launch readiness — every new product and geography requires specific support, you build it and run it.
 Insight to build a Product businesses love — you’re the closest to what business customers actually ask, you quantify it and get it into the roadmap.
 Cost of support — own the budget for support and make it more efficient with scale.
Responsibilities
Design, build and run best-in-class support for the Business product, end to end
Identify unhappy paths, build and automate solutions and work with product to fix at scale
Design, build and maintain AI-powered workflows and automations that reduce manual effort, improve retention and scale Operations effectively
Take operational functions and processes from 0 to 1, then 1 to 100
Set the standard our BPO partners are held to — playbooks, QA, KPIs — and hold the performance bar high
Structure complex and ambiguous problems by conducting ad hoc analysis
Act as Product Ops for the Business line: turn what customers tell us into evidenced product priorities, and get them built
Work across highly technical and specialised product, engineering and data colleagues to deliver an experience business customers stay for
Own support for each new launch, from readiness through to a steady, automated state
Requirements
5-7+ years of high-performing experience in a fast pace, analytical environment
 B2B account management, customer success or business operations for a business/SME product is what we are looking for , you know what business customers expect and what it takes to deliver it
You are looking for a role where you can directly drive the impact, where you are the owner and have autonomy to make decisions and drive outcomes
You take ownership, are dependable, and do the hard things to make things work. You own the problems end-to-end and constantly ship improvements
Comfortable using SQL to drive decisions daily
Willingness to build and iterate on AI-powered workflows and automations
No task too small, willingness to dive in and sweat the details regardless of the tool or problem
Instinct to add 'just enough' process to scale without cumbersome bureaucracy
Comfortable in a regulated, 24/7 business where the stakes for the customer are real
London, office based
How we work
A BizOps role at Taptap Send is a super Individual Contributor . For your topic you are the single threaded owner, the analyst, the product manager, the engineer and the operations lead. In practice you don’t wait for others, you leverage AI to get things done and build what drives the outcome you seek.
 This is not a coordination role, and it is not a strategy-deck role. If your best work has been influencing other teams to build things, this will be a frustrating job. If you have been waiting for a role where you are simply allowed to go and fix it, this is that role.
This role is a launchpad — previous BizOps hires have gone on to lead functions and launch products.
Taptap Values 
Impact first
Team next
Accept reality
Propose solutions
Win with grit
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
Love the particular
Own it
Create positive energy
Maybe, even have fun

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
 Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About AlayaCare
 At AlayaCare, we're more than just a fast-growing SaaS company, we're a team of people passionate about transforming home healthcare. Our cloud-based platform empowers care providers around the world to deliver better outcomes for their clients.
With 550+ employees across Canada, the US, Australia, and Brazil, we're united by a shared mission and a strong culture of transparency, growth, and human connection. Whether you're early in your career or a seasoned expert, AlayaCare offers the opportunity to grow your impact, your skills, and your career.
 About The Role
 As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll help AlayaCare strengthen the systems and processes that enable teams to support providers and improve outcomes for clients and families. Reporting to the Director, Revenue Operations, you'll own the vision, architecture, and evolution of HubSpot and the broader go-to-market technology ecosystem. You'll partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and other teams to simplify revenue processes, improve handoffs, and turn business needs into sustainable system solutions. This is a hands-on builder and advisor role, combining process redesign, workflow architecture, cross-functional problem-solving, and responsible AI-enabled automation.
What You'll Do
 GTM Systems Ownership
Own the vision, architecture, and evolution of our HubSpot platform and the broader GTM systems ecosystem. 
Own and optimize the GTM technology stack, including HubSpot and supporting Revenue Operations tools. 
Design thoughtful, maintainable system architecture that minimizes operational overhead, reduces technical debt, and proactively accounts for edge cases before they become operational issues. 
 Process Redefinition & Optimization
Act as a process owner, not just a systems administrator: proactively identify where existing sales, marketing, and customer lifecycle processes are inefficient, manual, or no longer fit how the business operates today. 
Redesign core revenue processes (lead-to-opportunity, quote-to-cash, renewals, handoffs between teams) with a bias toward simplification and translate the redesigned process into the system configuration that supports it. 
Establish documentation, governance, and change-management practices so process and system changes are adopted consistently rather than living as tribal knowledge. 
 Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into scalable system and process solutions. 
Serve as a trusted advisor to cross-functional leaders, balancing immediate business needs with long-term platform health while influencing stakeholders without direct authority. 
Support enablement on new systems, workflows, and process changes as they roll out, in partnership with Revenue Enablement. 
 AI Fluency & Automation
Bring strong AI fluency to the role: identify opportunities to build AI agents and automations that remove manual work from sales and revenue processes. 
Evaluate and pilot AI-driven tools within the GTM stack (e.g., AI-assisted lead routing, data enrichment, forecasting support, agent-based workflows) and assess them for scalability and risk before wider rollout. 
What You'll Bring to the Team
Bachelor's degree in Data, Finance, Statistics, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

description:
Join us as Revenue Operations Manager, based in London!
 About the Role 
 Are you passionate about turning strategic ideas into structured execution and taking ownership of how Sales systems, enablement, and processes behind DIGITEC's commercial engine come together? 
As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll take ownership of a pivotal, greenfield remit within DIGITEC's go-to-market organisation — shaping our CRM transformation, driving GTM programmes end-to-end with strong project-management discipline, and building the operational backbone behind how we report on and scale revenue.  Your responsibilities

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
We're Heidi.
We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.
Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.
If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.
The Role
We are hiring a strategic Enterprise Customer Success Manager to serve as the senior accountable lead for our most complex NHS and private health system accounts in the UK and Ireland.
This is not a relationship management role. You will act as a strategic consultant to executive decision-makers inside NHS trusts and health networks, shaping deployment strategy, driving clinical and operational decisions, and building the internal organisational will to adopt and expand. At the same time, you will orchestrate a cross-functional delivery team of Implementation Specialists, Clinical Associates, Account Executives, and Forward Deployed Engineers, keeping internal execution aligned to what you have committed to on the ground.
You will own a portfolio of 10 to 15 large NHS trusts or strategic health organisations (250+ users each), leading the full lifecycle from pilot design through implementation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
What you'll do
Act as a strategic consultant to executive stakeholders
Lead executive-level engagements with CIOs, CMOs, COOs, and clinical directors. Shape the customer's thinking on deployment strategy, change approach, and long-term value, not just report on progress.
Build the internal organisational case for adoption by helping executives understand what good looks like, what is blocking it, and what decisions are theirs to make.
Adapt your advisory style fluently across frontline clinicians, operational managers, IT leads, and board-level executives.
Orchestrate the internal delivery team
Serve as the accountable lead for the cross-functional pod assigned to your accounts: Implementation Specialists, Clinical Associates, Account Executives, and Forward Deployed Engineers.
Translate executive commitments into clear delivery briefs. Hold the team accountable to outcomes without line authority.
Surface risk early, resolve internal ambiguity, and keep Product, Engineering, and Support properly informed so they can act when needed.
Lead multi-site NHS rollouts
Drive sophisticated, multi-wave implementations with formal governance structures, clinical change management, and cross-site coordination.
Design and oversee structured adoption programmes: training waves, competency assessments, workflow reinforcement, and coaching delivered in partnership with Clinical Associates on the ground.
Build success plans grounded in clinical and operational KPIs that are meaningful to NHS commissioners and trust leadership.
Own commercial outcomes
Lead renewal conversations with strong, evidence-based value narratives tied to clinical outcomes and usage data.
Identify and execute expansion opportunities across sites, departments, and specialties. Partner with Account Executives to close.
Contribute to NRR and portfolio growth across your account set.
Engage in pre-sales and pilots
Work alongside Account Executives to scope NHS pilots for success, shape deployment strategy, and run customer-facing sessions when needed.
Design evaluation frameworks for pilots that are grounded in clinical and operational KPIs and translatable into multi-year value narratives.
Shape how we work
Contribute to the frameworks, tools, and playbooks that turn complex NHS programmes into scalable, repeatable rollouts for the wider team.
What we're looking for
NHS or health system experience: You understand how NHS organisations work, how decisions are made, who holds influence, and what governance and compliance obligations shape procurement and deployment. This is strongly preferred, not optional.
Executive advisory presence: You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still being the person who shapes the outcome. You have changed a senior stakeholder's mind on a strategic decision, not just maintained a relationship.
Cross-functional orchestration: You have driven accountability across teams you do not own, including clinicians, engineers and commercial colleagues, through influence, clarity, and trust rather than authority.
Enterprise lifecycle ownership: 5+ years in SaaS customer success or client-facing roles, with at least 3 years managing enterprise accounts (250+ users, high-value ARR), across scoping, implementation, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
Change management: Experience leading multi-site rollouts that drive genuine behaviour change and sustained adoption in complex organisations.
Commercial acumen: Strong on expansion, complex renewals, and contributing to NRR and portfolio growth. You can hold a commercial conversation without defaulting to the Account Executive.
Data to narrative: You translate usage patterns and outcome data into clear strategic narratives, adjusted in depth and style for IT, ops, and executive audiences.
Political intelligence: You read complex organisational landscapes quickly, work around internal factions, and stay credible across competing agendas without getting captured by any one of them.
How we show up
Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.
Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.
Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.
Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.
Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.
Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.
Why Heidi?
You'll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders and designers who've felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.
Building what we're building isn't always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn't choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.
True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.
We take care of you.
We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.
We chose to open-source our benefits hub , if you care to take a peek.
Heidi's commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.
We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.
This position is for an existing vacancy.
We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Specialist to drive operational excellence, efficiency, and scalability across Roofr's Revenue organization. As a key member of the RevOps team, you'll play a hands-on role optimizing GTM processes, improving our technology ecosystem, strengthening data integrity, and building AI-ready systems that enable our Revenue teams to perform at their best.
You'll work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Enablement to identify operational challenges, develop solutions, automate manual processes, and ensure our systems and workflows support a seamless customer and revenue lifecycle.
This is a highly collaborative, execution-oriented role for someone who enjoys solving complex operational problems, working deeply in systems and data, and turning business needs into scalable and AI-forward technology solutions.
 What You'll Do: 
 Optimize Revenue Processes & Systems 
Identify operational challenges across the Revenue org and develop scalable solutions that improve efficiency, productivity, and the GTM experience.
Design, implement, and continuously optimize Revenue processes, workflows, and systems across the customer lifecycle.
Apply a structured, project-management-oriented approach to understand problems, evaluate solutions, manage implementation, and measure outcomes.
Partner with Revenue leaders and ICs to understand their needs, gather feedback, test solutions, and ensure initiatives meaningfully improve team performance.
Look for opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary manual work, and design human-in-the-loop AI workflows to improve efficiency for Revenue teams. 
 Drive Process Automation & AI Enablement 
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive and manual processes using existing technology, integrations, and automation platforms.
Build and maintain workflows, automations, routing, notifications, and other system-based solutions that improve team productivity.
Leverage connectors such as Fivetran, Zapier, or similar platforms to connect systems and improve data flow.
Continuously evaluate opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve Revenue productivity and operational scale.
 Own & Optimize the Revenue Technology Stack

Own the creation, maintenance, and optimization of pipelines, workflows, custom views, templates, playbooks, lists, and other HubSpot functionality supporting Revenue initiatives.
Manage and optimize key Revenue technologies including Aircall, Sakari, Gong, Stripe, Hippo Video, and Guru.
Ensure systems are configured effectively, adopted appropriately, and integrated into Revenue workflows.
Stay current on product capabilities and emerging features, identify opportunities to improve our technology stack, and maintain relationships with key technology vendors.
 Strengthen Data & Revenue Insights 
Maintain strong data integrity practices across the tools, processes, and automations you own.
Ensure GTM data is clean, consistently structured, and AI-ready.
Use data to identify trends, diagnose operational issues, and measure the impact of Revenue initiatives.
Support analysis related to lead scoring, customer health, pipeline performance, conversion, productivity, and other Revenue performance indicators.
Translate data and operational insights into actionable recommendations for Revenue teams.
 Partner Across Revenue 
Work closely with leaders and ICs across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Enablement to inform your roadmap and prioritize initiatives.
Partner with the Revenue Enablement Specialist to ensure new tools, processes, and AI-assisted workflows are effectively rolled out, documented, and adopted.
Engage Revenue team members as partners in testing new processes and tools, and incorporate their feedback into solutions.
 Documentation & Operational Excellence 
Create and maintain clear documentation for tools, systems, processes, workflows, and automations.
Ensure documentation is accessible and easy for Revenue teams to understand and use.
Partner with Enablement to support training and adoption of new tools and processes.
Establish repeatable processes that make it easier for teams to understand and consistently use Revenue systems.
 What You'll Bring: 
4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or Customer Success Operations.
Hands-on HubSpot administration experience across Marketing Hub and Sales Hub.
Experience owning, implementing, and optimizing Revenue technology and GTM systems such as CRM, conversation intelligence, sales engagement, communication, customer education, and payment platforms.
Strong understanding of Revenue processes and how systems, data, and workflows support the broader GTM motion.
Experience building and optimizing workflows, automations, integrations, and data flows.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify problems, inform decisions, and measure impact.
Demonstrated experience evaluating or implementing AI-powered GTM tools — not just familiarity, but hands-on work with AI-assisted workflows, automation platforms, or agentic tooling.
Strong project management skills with the ability to independently drive initiatives from concept through implementation.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile, and dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
 Who You Are: 
You're a builder and problem solver who enjoys figuring out how things work and finding better ways to make them work.
You naturally look for opportunities to simplify, automate, and scale processes and you think critically about where AI creates real leverage versus where humans still need to be in the loop.
You're highly detail-oriented and understand that clean, well-structured data is the foundation of effective RevOps.
You're comfortable getting deep into systems and technical details while keeping the broader business objective in mind.
You take ownership and don't need a playbook to get started.
You are curious about new technology, including AI and automation, and think critically about where it can create meaningful business value.
You're an effective cross-functional partner who understands that successful RevOps solutions start with understanding the people and processes they support.
You are comfortable operating in a PLG and/or PLS environment and understand how operational processes and systems need to support both self-serve and sales-assisted customer journeys.
 Bonus: 
HubSpot certifications, including HubSpot Certified Administrator, HubSpot Marketing Software, or HubSpot Sales Software.
Experience integrating GTM technologies directly as well as using Zapier or similar integration and automation platforms.
Experience working in an organization supporting both PLG/self-serve conversion and PLS/sales-assisted conversion models .
Demonstrated proficiency with tools such as Aircall, Sakari, Gong, Zendesk, Stripe, Hippovideo, Guru, and Asana.
Experience with AI-enabled Revenue Operations tools and automation.
Experience working with SaaS metrics such as pipeline conversion, velocity, retention, customer health, and productivity.
 Compensation Band: $90k-105k CAD 
Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.
 What we offer (US + Canada)

 About the Role

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner. 
Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. 
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. 
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. 
 You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. 
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. 
 In this role, you will: 
Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform

 Minimum requirements for the role:

This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence

Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills

Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution

title: Revenue Enablement Manager
description:
About AppDirect 
Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
 About PartnerStack, an AppDirect Subsidiary
PartnerStack is the leading partner ecosystem platform for B2B SaaS — purpose-built to help software companies find, activate, and scale partnerships as a primary growth channel. Through a two-sided marketplace, PartnerStack connects vendors with high-quality affiliate, referral, and reseller partners, while giving partners a single destination to discover and grow inside the programs worth their time. As part of the AppDirect family, PartnerStack sits at the center of how modern B2B companies go to market through partners — complementing AppDirect's subscription commerce infrastructure and Tackle's cloud marketplace capabilities to give customers a complete partner-led growth platform.
 About You 
You are someone who thrives on bringing revenue teams together around a shared go-to-market motion. You do your best work when complexity needs to become cohesion — when separate selling cultures, product vocabularies, and customer narratives need to come together into something a rep can actually use in the field. You understand that cross-sell doesn't happen because leadership decrees it; it happens because sellers have been given the tools, the language, and the confidence to make it real in every customer conversation. You are energized by the challenge of multi-product GTM and know how to help revenue teams move from selling what they know to confidently selling what the full portfolio can do.
 What you'll do and how you'll have an impact 
We're looking for a Revenue Enablement Manager to build and scale the programs that help our go-to-market teams — Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding and Support — ramp faster, sell smarter, and execute consistently. The immediate priority is getting our Sales team and Account Managers comfortable and confident selling across all three of our business unit product lines. Beyond that, this role owns onboarding, ongoing training, content curation, and tool adoption across the revenue org, and partners closely with RevOps, team leads, and frontline managers to translate strategy into day-to-day execution.
This is an individual contributor role today, with real potential to grow into people leadership as the enablement function scales — for example, building out a small team of enablement specialists or coordinators as programs expand across functions. You'll have run enablement programs before and ideally have some experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating others (direct reports, contractors, or a working group), even if you haven't formally managed a team. This role breaks down into a few areas of focus:
 Enable cross-BU selling. Build and deliver the curriculum that gets Sales reps and Account Managers comfortable and confident selling all three business unit product lines — positioning, use cases, and value props for each, plus how they fit together for customers.
 Design and own onboarding. Build and continuously improve ramp programs for new hires across Sales, CS, and Support, with clear milestones and time-to-productivity targets.
 Build ongoing enablement programs. Develop training on product updates, messaging, competitive positioning, and sales/CS methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, value selling, or your team's chosen framework).
 Manage content and knowledge systems. Own the enablement content library (playbooks, battle cards, call frameworks, objection handling guides) and keep it current as the product and market evolve.
 Partner cross-functionally. Work with Product Marketing, Product, and RevOps to translate roadmap and positioning changes into digestible, actionable enablement.
 Drive tool adoption. Partner with RevOps on rollout and adoption of GTM tools (CRM, conversation intelligence, CS platforms) — training, certification, and reinforcement so tools actually get used correctly.
 Measure what matters. Define and track enablement KPIs (ramp time, win rates, quota attainment, call scorecards, certification completion) and report on program impact to leadership.
 Coordinate contributors. Work with a network of subject-matter experts, cross-functional partners, and (as the function grows) potential future direct reports to deliver programs on time.
 Run the operating rhythm. Own the enablement calendar — kickoffs, ongoing training cadence, certifications, and manager-led reinforcement.
 What we're looking for 
What you’ll bring:
 5+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales enablement, or a closely related GTM role (training, sales/CS operations, or field enablement).
Some experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating others — direct reports, contractors, or cross-functional working groups — with an interest in growing into formal people leadership as the function scales.
Experience building enablement programs for both new hire onboarding and ongoing skill development .
Familiarity with a sales or CS methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Sandler) and the ability to operationalize it into training.
Comfort working with GTM systems — CRM (Salesforce), conversation intelligence (Gong or similar), LMS/enablement platforms (Highspot, Seismic, Lessonly, or similar).
Strong project management skills — you can run multiple concurrent programs without things slipping.
A data-informed approach: you tie enablement activities to business outcomes (ramp time, win rate, quota attainment) rather than just tracking completion.
Excellent written and verbal communication — you can distill complex product or process information into clear, usable training.
Experience working in a fast-moving B2B SaaS environment strongly preferred.
Nice to Have:
Experience enabling multiple functions (Sales and CS/Support) rather than a single team.
Experience through a company scaling phase, acquisition, or GTM consolidation.
Familiarity with partner or channel sales motions.
Instructional design or curriculum development background.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About AppDirect
Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
About PartnerStack, an AppDirect Subsidiary
PartnerStack is the leading partner ecosystem platform for B2B SaaS — purpose-built to help software companies find, activate, and scale partnerships as a primary growth channel. Through a two-sided marketplace, PartnerStack connects vendors with high-quality affiliate, referral, and reseller partners, while giving partners a single destination to discover and grow inside the programs worth their time. As part of the AppDirect family, PartnerStack sits at the center of how modern B2B companies go to market through partners — complementing AppDirect's subscription commerce infrastructure and Tackle's cloud marketplace capabilities to give customers a complete partner-led growth platform.
About You
You are the person leaders turn to when a decision needs numbers behind it. You enjoy turning complex questions into clear, defensible answers, and you bring rigor, curiosity, and attention to detail to every analysis. You are comfortable working across Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Finance, and you communicate your thinking clearly with stakeholders at all levels.
You thrive in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment where strong judgment, accuracy, and adaptability matter. You are resourceful, analytical, and confident building models from scratch, validating assumptions, and translating data into insights that help teams do their best work.
What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact
 Support the analysis behind our GTM reporting. Build and maintain dashboards, models, and reports that leadership relies on for pipeline/bookings reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and board updates — so decisions are grounded in clean, trusted numbers.
 Turn data requests into clear answers. Field ad-hoc data asks from Sales, CS, Marketing, and Finance, scope what’s really being asked, and deliver analysis that is accurate, well-documented, and easy to act on.
 Support the forecasting and planning rhythm. Support the development of operational models behind forecasting, pipeline coverage, capacity and quota planning, territory analysis, and scenario planning — in Google Sheets and our BI tools.
 Work fluently across our GTM systems. Use Salesforce, PlanHat, and adjacent GTM tools as a power user — building reports, pulling and validating data, and flagging integrity issues — while partnering with the systems team who build and maintain the workflows themselves.
 Track the metrics that matter. Monitor and report on the core GTM metrics — pipeline generation and conversion, win rates, bookings, churn and retention, attainment — and proactively call out what’s changing and why.
 Safeguard data quality. Investigate and flag data-quality issues during our Deal Desk process that undermine reporting and forecasting accuracy. Partner with the systems and GTM teams to get them fixed at the source
 Communicate with leadership. Translate analysis into clear, concise narratives and visuals for a senior audience — and be ready to explain your methodology and defend a recommendation.
 What we’re looking for 
3+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales/GTM operations, financial analysis, business analytics, or a closely related analytical role in B2B SaaS.
A bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, economics, finance, or a similar field.
You are a genuine power user of Google Sheets (or Excel): complex formulas, pivots, lookups, and the ability to build and maintain models from scratch, not just fill in someone else’s template.
You revel in the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative data to answer questions, generate solutions, and drive informed decisions.
Working knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC) and PlanHat as an advanced user — building reports and dashboards, pulling and validating data — with a solid understanding of how GTM data flows through the systems around it. 
Experience preparing analysis and reporting for QBRs, board decks, or forecasts.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you can present data to senior leaders, walk them through your methodology, and defend a recommendation.
Strong attention to detail and a bias for accuracy; you double-check your numbers because you know decisions ride on them.
Comfort with BI/reporting tools (Looker, Domo, or similar) beyond native CRM reporting; SQL experience to pull data from BigQuery is a strong plus.
Self-motivated and action-oriented, able to prioritize competing requests and adapt in a fast-paced environment while working independently.
Able to challenge others’ assumptions and conclusions with data, while supporting the ultimate decision even when it goes a different direction

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager II
description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
Our Strategic Customer Success Managers pick up where our Services team leaves off, working closely with Samsara’s largest Fleet customers to understand their unique challenges, advising on how to leverage Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term strategic partner. 
Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.  
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
 You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
 You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
 You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
 You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
 In this role, you will:   
Be on the front lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform 
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, and timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value 
Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision-makers and our executive leadership, where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals 
Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more.
Partners with cross-functional teams like Product, Support, Finance, etc. to drive progress on customer requests.
Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success teams
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
6+ years of work experience with most recent experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role
Experience supporting Enterprise SaaS and/or Fortune 500 companies
Strong priority management and high emotional intelligence; this is a demanding position with high internal visibility
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Proven track record of building trust, communicating effectively and driving change with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software 
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment 
Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Customer travel is expected up to 25-40%.
 An ideal candidate also has: 
Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Experience serving and supporting large-scale business solutions at Fortune 500 companies
Ability to thrive in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
 Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
Annual OTE Salary
 $111,562.50 — $168,750 USD 
 Total Rewards 
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
 Accommodations  
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
 Our Commitment to Authenticity 
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
 Fraudulent Employment Offers 
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here .

title: Senior Customer Success Manager
description:
Role Description 
 As a Senior Customer Success Manager , you will guide utilities through a deeply intentional, outcome-driven value realization journey. You will take ownership post-implementation, multithreading across each account and engaging users, program managers, and executive sponsors to build strong alignment and measurable progress. 
 You'll create shared success plans, manage change across people, process, and communications, and ensure every customer interaction is purposeful — not just time spent, but value delivered. Your goal is to ensure Klir becomes a trusted, adopted, and indispensable operational hub across every level of the utility. 
 As our Customer Success team scales and takes on larger, more complex accounts, this role has real potential to grow into ownership of one of our flagship strategic relationships. 
 Your primary success metrics include: Net Dollar Retention, Gross Dollar Retention, Time to Value, Success Plan completion, value realization milestones, customer health, customer adoption, and qualified expansion opportunities. 
 Responsibilities: 
 Post-Implementation Ownership 
 Own the customer relationship immediately following implementation 
 Build continuity, trust, and deep account knowledge beyond onboarding 
 Serve as the long-term strategic partner across multiple stakeholder levels 
 Value Realization & Success Planning 
 Build and maintain shared Success Plans with clear outcomes, timelines, and responsibilities 
 Drive customers through a structured value journey tied to measurable progress 
 Ensure utilities understand what value will be delivered, how it will be achieved, and how it will be measured 
 Communicate Klir’s Product Roadmap consistently to customers and act as a voice of the customer internally 
 Multithreading & Strategic Relationships 
 Develop strong, multidimensional relationships across each account 
 Engage users, supervisors, program managers, and executive sponsors 
 Tailor communication and engagement to each stakeholder group’s goals and perspectives 
 Structured Change Management 
 Lead customer adoption through a practical change management framework focused on: 
 Process: Understanding and aligning Klir to real-world workflows and SOPs 
 People: Delivering role-specific enablement, training, and adoption strategies 
 Communications: Ensuring clear internal messaging around: 
 Why Klir is being adopted 
 What will change 
 When teams will be impacted 
 Who is responsible 
 How to get training and support 
 Customer Enablement & Adoption 
 Deliver thoughtful, outcome-focused enablement and training 
 Identify and resolve blockers to adoption by being a Product expert 
 Use data and insights to guide engagement, usage, and behavior change 
 Renewals & Expansion 
 Lead renewal conversations with POCs and executive buyers 
 Identify value-aligned expansion opportunities and partner with Sales to pursue them 
 Risk Management 
 Monitor account health and proactively identify risk signals 
 Build and lead action plans to mitigate risk and protect long-term value 
 Intentional Customer Engagement 
 Ensure every touchpoint is purposeful and aligned to value, outcomes, or next steps 
 Move beyond check-ins toward strategic discussions that demonstrate impact 
 Continuously highlight how Klir supports efficiency, effectiveness, and workforce satisfaction 
 Requirements (Sound like you?) 
 Experience 
 5+ years in Customer Success (Strategic/Enterprise CSM, Professional Services, or Implementation) — required. You don't need to have spent all five years in a senior-level CSM role, but you should have held a senior-level role previously. 
 Experience with enterprise clients required; direct experience in highly regulated industries, government, or utilities is a strong asset. 
 Skills & Attributes 
 Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities 
 Skilled in guiding post-implementation customer journeys 
 Strong experience in change management across process, people, and communications 
 Excellent at building multithreaded relationships 
 Great communicator who brings intentionality and clarity to every conversation 
 Comfortable becoming a genuine product expert — confident demoing software and working through issues live with customers 
 Commercially minded, with a solid grasp of revenue outcomes and renewal ownership 
 Curious and creative about applying AI tools to your day-to-day work 
 High accountability, an ownership mentality, and no ego — ready to roll up your sleeves 
 Empathetic, customer-centered, and mission-driven, with genuine care for customer outcomes 
 Resourceful, action-oriented, and thrives in fast-moving environments 
 Our Commitment To You 
 Meaningful Impact 
 You’ll be helping to transform how water utilities operate and support the sustainability of a vital global resource. 
 Hybrid Flexibility 
 Working in a hybrid model with your home base in Toronto, collaborating in person while benefiting from remote flexibility. 
 High-Performance, High-Heart Culture 
 We take our mission seriously—but we believe in humor, humanity, and enjoying the work. 
 Our Values 
 Honesty. Audacity. Unity. These guide how we work with customers and with each other. 
 Commitment to Your Growth 
 You’ll work with leaders dedicated to coaching, transparency, and helping you become your best professional self. 
 Compensation & Timing & Travel 
 Salary: CAD $90,000–$110,000 plus annual bonus 
 Benefits: Canadian benefits package, unlimited vacation, MacBook Pro 
 Travel: As this role manages strategic relationships with utilities across the United States, you will be expected to travel to customer sites for key milestones, relationship-building, value reviews, and strategic planning sessions. Typical travel ranges from 10–20% annually, depending on customer needs.Timing: Immediate opening 
 About Klir 
 For too long, water utilities have had to manage operations through fragmented systems, siloed data, and workflows held together by institutional memory. As costs rise, teams shrink, and operational decisions demand real-time clarity, connected data is no longer a nice-to-have. It's essential. 
 Our mission is simple: Making Water Better. 
 Klir is the Operational Data Hub that connects water utility programs, data, and decisions into one connected operational system. It replaces fragmented tools and siloed data with a unified view of Drinking Water, Wastewater, and Industrial Pretreatment operations — giving teams the clarity, visibility, and continuity to act sooner and with more confidence. 
 Utilities choose Klir because we combine: 
 A single source of truth for operational and compliance data 
 Automated workflows that eliminate manual effort and reduce risk 
 Insights and analytics that surface trends, issues, and optimization opportunities 
 A modern, intuitive experience for frontline operators and executives alike 
 Backed by Insight Partners, Bowery Capital, and Spider Capital, Klir is one of the fastest-growing companies in the digital water space — with strong product-market fit and rapidly expanding demand across North America. 
 Location: Full-time • Toronto (Hybrid)

Maintain a revenue base by managing retaining and expanding a book of business
Build strong relationships with your assigned customer portfolio and support them as their the key contact and advocate

Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams to advocate for your customers and proactively find ways to grow our customer base

Renewals
Maintain 85% or higher renewal rate
Expansion
Grow book of business 3+% each quarter
Identify potential growth during customer engagement calls and account planning resulting in the creation of expansion opportunities
Adoption
Average purchased seat utilization 75% or higher

title: Revenue Operations Lead
description:
Revenue Operations Lead
 Global expansion is broken. Without a local company, conversion rates fall, costs rise, and compliance gets messy. Outpost fixes it. 
Selling internationally is a maze of tax, payments, and operational friction. Most brands avoid it, or expand slowly and expensively.
 Outpost is your modular back office for global commerce. 
Pick only what you need - tax, payments, treasury, or operations - and unlock new markets without the overhead. Sometimes we become liable for a merchant's taxes. Sometimes we become the legal reseller in each market and carry the payments, tax and compliance risk. Other times, we give you the tools to do it yourself.
We go live wherever a merchant needs to sell next, for digital and physical goods. That means we own the full stack - payments, tax, compliance, treasury, and merchant experience.
 Sell anything, anywhere. Without compromise. 
🧠 The Role
We're looking for our first Revenue Operations hire: the person who owns how revenue actually works at Outpost.
Your job is to build the RevOps machine. One source of truth for pipeline. One model that turns a merchant's volume, markets and product mix into a price. One set of numbers that the CEO, the board and the commercial team all agree on. And a handover from signed contract to live merchant that never drops anything.
This is a hands-on build role, not a reporting layer. You'll sit between sales, marketing, and operations, and you'll be the only person who can see the whole revenue system at once. You'll design it, instrument it, automate it, and then run it until it's good enough to hand over.
You'll work directly with the CEO, the Chief of Staff and the founding team.
🧗 What You'll Get
Yes, the work is intense . But in return you'll get scope and exposure most people wait 10 to 20 years to access .
You'll own a core function at a company solving one of the hardest problems in global commerce, you'll see every commercial decision before it happens, and you'll build a function from scratch with real budget and real backing. We won't handhold, but we'll coach you hard.
🧩 What You'll Do
 Own the revenue system 
Own the CRM (Attio) end to end: object model, stage definitions, required fields, hygiene, automation
Build the forecasting system and operationalise it with weekly pipeline review, monthly board numbers, and quarterly planning
Own the GTM stack: outbound sequencing, enrichment, routing, deduplication, attribution
Run the pipeline agentically. Build agentic system that enrich accounts, draft follow-ups, surface stalled deals and keep the CRM clean, so the team spends its time on the conversations and not the admin. You'll design the workflows, write the prompts, set the guardrails, and audit what the agents produce
 Analytics & performance insights 
Own the revenue metrics that matter: GMV, ARR, take rate, win rate, sales cycle, pipeline coverage, cost of acquisition
Build the reporting the company runs on, and the pack investors see
Build the pricing and quoting model, and the deal desk discipline around it.
 Operational execution 
Own the handover from signed contract to live merchant, with operations, tax and engineering
Instrument time-to-live and revenue ramp, then attack both
Feed commercial reality back into the roadmap. You'll know which deals we lose and why before anyone else does
 Build the function 
Write the playbooks: qualification, scoping, pricing approval, renewal, expansion
Set the standard for what good data looks like, and hold the line on it
Hire behind you once the system is running
💥 Example Projects
Rebuild the pipeline in Attio so every deal has a stage definition, an owner, a close date and a modelled value, and the weekly review takes 20 minutes instead of two hours
Build the pricing calculator that turns a merchant's volume, market mix and product mix into a price, and retire the per-deal spreadsheet
Cut time from signed contract to first live transaction by half, working across operations, tax and engineering
Build the weekly revenue pack and the monthly investor pack, and automate the data pull behind both
Design the commission plan for the first commercial hires
Score the lead universe against our ICP and rebuild outbound targeting on top of it
Instrument the full funnel from LinkedIn and outbound through to closed won, and prove which channel actually pays
Forecast GMV by market and product, and tell the founding team where the $1BN does and doesn't come from
🧱 What We're Looking For
 Ideal background: 
4 to 7 years in revenue operations, sales operations, business operations, or GTM strategy at a high-growth fintech, payments company, or B2B SaaS
Has built a revenue system from zero, not inherited a mature one
Fluent in CRM architecture and the outbound stack. We run Attio, Instantly and Apollo, but the tool matters less than knowing how to design the model underneath it
Strong analytical skills — advanced Excel or Sheets, experience with BI tools
 Signals we care about: 
Ridiculous bias for action . You solve, you don't observe
Systems thinker who still does the work. You fix the broken report, then remove the reason it broke
Analytically strong. You can quantify a process, not just describe it
Strong EQ. You'll be telling experienced commercial people their data is wrong, and they need to thank you for it
Exceptionally hard working . You see work as a core part of your purpose
Fluent in ambiguity and chaos. Startups are not neat, this will be hard
Curious and resourceful. You can figure anything out
Clear, quantified achievements on your CV, not vague descriptions
 What this role is not: 
Not a reporting or BI role where you build dashboards and hand them over
Not a sales role, and not a sales-support role that takes instructions from account executives
Not a CRM administrator job. The tool is the smallest part of it
Not for someone who needs defined processes and hierarchy to be effective
🚀 Why This Role Is Different
Most revenue operations roles inherit a system and tune it. You'll write ours.
At a company that takes on legal liability for its merchants, revenue operations is not admin. Pricing accuracy is margin. Time-to-live is retention. Forecast quality is how we decide what to build and who to hire. Get it right and the whole company moves faster, permanently.
We expect whoever is in this role to grow rapidly into leading the function, and we'll back you every step of the way.
🦾 Outpost Team
Our team were leaders at Revolut, Airwallex, Adyen and Wayflyer, and we're backed by top-tier investors who have built or backed some of the world's leading fintechs.
🧾 What We Offer
Equity and salary in a well-funded startup
Ability to own your work and move fast
World-class training from operators who've scaled globally
A global mission with real impact
Low politics, high output
Chance to grow into a senior leadership role
A culture of builders, not talkers
🧭 Working Style
We work together in person in London 5 days a week. We believe the hardest problems are solved in the room.
🌎 Reach Out
 emile@outpostnow.com 
 Learn more 
 Outpost Culture 
 Outpost founder 
Outpost is where the hard problems are. If you want to help build the engine behind global trade, we'd love to hear from you.

Build repeatable approaches for qualification, discovery, pitching, follow-up, negotiation, and re-engagement, and adapt these plays for different Creator segments, verticals, products, and opportunity types.

Partner with RevOps through implementation to ensure systems reinforce the intended journey and behaviours.
Enablement & adoption: Turn methodology into practical playbooks, templates, talk tracks, examples, and decision guides.
Partner with Partnerships leadership to embed new plays and approaches into the team, and evolve enablement based on performance, experimentation, and team feedback.
Additional
Other duties and responsibilities as required from time to time

7+ years of experience designing GTM methodology, sales plays, or customer journey logic for a two-sided business; where success depends on both a B2B partner’s engagement (creators, sellers, merchants) and D2C outcomes downstream (fans, buyers, end customers).
A track record of proving out new approaches through testing and data, then translating what works into systems, and repeatable team behaviour.
Strong storytelling instincts; you can turn business performance and data into simple, compelling narratives that a team can actually use in the field.
Experience partnering with RevOps or a systems/tooling function to translate strategy into pipelines, workflows, automation, and reporting.
Excellent cross-functional leadership skills; you can influence and drive adoption across Partnerships, RevOps, and Marketing without needing direct authority over all of them.

Experience in the creator economy, crowdfunding, or merchandise/apparel industries.
Experience building a GTM or enablement function from the ground up inside a scaling startup.
Familiarity with limited-edition, scarcity-driven, or pre-order commerce models.

title: Revenue Enablement Lead
description:
Revenue Enablement Lead
 Hi, I'm Romain - SVP Global Sales at hx. 
I joined hx six months ago because I saw a rare mix of things: a deeply talented team, a product that is genuinely changing how insurers make decisions, and the ambition to build something category-defining in one of the world's most important industries.
The commercial opportunity in front of us is huge, but it is also complex. We sell into a market where credibility matters, where our customers are actuaries, underwriters and senior insurance leaders, and where AI needs to create real business value, not just a better story.
That is why we are hiring for our first Revenue Enablement role. This person will help us build the operating rhythm, onboarding, materials and enablement programmes that make our global Revenue team sharper, more consistent and more credible in the field.
 A note on level: we're open on seniority for this hire. What matters most is finding the right person to build this function hands-on, not matching a specific title. If your experience sits closer to a Head of function than a Lead, see our companion Head of Revenue Enablement posting for a version calibrated closer to that level.
This is not a role where you inherit a finished playbook, and it doesn't come with a team to manage. It is a role for someone who wants to build the first version properly, hands-on, working closely with Revenue leadership, and help shape how hx sells as we continue to scale.
About hyperexponential (hx)
At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.
Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision, helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.
Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally, already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.
What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do, from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.
What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure, it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.
If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.
About the team
hx's commercial engine is scaling rapidly, and Revenue Enablement sits at the heart of making that scale sustainable. Today, enablement happens across pockets of the organisation, Revenue leadership, RevOps, Sales Ops, Product Marketing, and Marketing, but there's no single owner, no operating cadence, and no clear system for turning commercial strategy into repeatable field execution.
This is where you come in. You'll be building hx's first dedicated Revenue Enablement function, working in close partnership with Romain and the wider commercial leadership team. Your mission is to close the gap between intent and execution: improving how our sellers are trained, equipped, motivated, and held to a consistent operating rhythm that drives revenue.
You'll take an AI-first approach to how enablement gets built at hx. That means using AI tools directly to accelerate content creation, calibrate messaging against live deal data, and build feedback loops faster than a traditional enablement function could.
In this role, you'll treat enablement as a system, not a content library. You'll get close to the customer, the field, and the behaviours that actually move deals forward. This is a builder role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and wants hands-on ownership of how a world-class commercial team operates.
 Check out our Sales and Partnerships Candidate Hub for a behind the scenes look at the team you would be joining! 
What you'll be doing
Help build hx's Revenue enablement operating model, working with Romain to define scope, intake processes, prioritisation frameworks, and success metrics.
Contribute to the 2026 Revenue enablement roadmap, turning commercial priorities into training, content, and rhythms that improve seller effectiveness.
Design and run enablement programmes that strengthen qualification, discovery, deal progression, sales process adherence, Salesforce hygiene, and forecasting accuracy.
Build out customer insight, references, case studies, and value messaging that make sellers more credible and commercially sharp in the field.
Work closely with Marketing, Product Marketing, and ABM so sellers can confidently use messaging, launch materials, competitive positioning, and customer stories.
Build onboarding and continuous learning content with clear curriculum and measurable ramp indicators for commercial hires.
Use AI tools hands-on to build and iterate enablement assets and programmes, rather than relying solely on manual content production.
What you'll need to have done
Worked in Revenue enablement in a B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or complex commercial environment, with evidence you understand enablement is about changing seller behaviour, not just producing training content.
Built or contributed to enablement processes such as intake, content calibration, or measurement, even if not the sole owner of the full operating model.
Delivered work that measurably improved seller effectiveness, such as better discovery execution, faster ramp times, improved Salesforce adoption, or stronger commercial discipline in live deals.
Worked cross-functionally with commercial stakeholders, earning trust through pragmatic judgement and clear prioritisation rather than relying on formal authority.
Built or contributed to onboarding and learning content that shortened time-to-productivity for new hires.
Used customer insight and proof points to improve how sellers engage with prospects.
Been comfortable building hands-on, without a team, at least in the first phase of the role.
You're unlikely to thrive here if
Your experience is mainly in content production, LMS administration, or training delivery without exposure to the operating system and structure around enablement.
You need an existing playbook to follow, or see enablement as separate from sales execution, commercial strategy, customer insight, and cross-functional operating cadence.
You prefer strategy over hands-on delivery, or prefer working independently rather than collaborating closely with Revenue leadership, Marketing, RevOps, and frontline sellers.
You're looking for a role that comes with people management from day one.
If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energized, hx may not be the place where you will do your best work. We are building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.
Compensation
At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process, our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations, and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.
Equity: We offer equity across all roles at hx, making it a significant component of total compensation. Your Talent Partner will be able to share more details about this.
Benefits
£5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.
25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).
Company pension scheme via Penfold.
Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life .
Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.
Private healthcare insurance through AXA.
Income protection and Life Insurance.
Cycle to Work Scheme.
Additional perks
Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).
Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.
Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry 
Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.
Interview process
Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off.
Manager interview with our SVP of Sales.
Skills assessment: 60-minute working session where you'll present your diagnosis of the enablement opportunity at hx, a proposed 6-month enablement plan, your approach to intake and prioritisation, and one example enablement programme designed to improve seller behaviour in practice.
Values interview + Meet the CEO
We offer!
Our commitment to Diversity
hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.
Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.
If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.
Next steps
If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.
For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.
 Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, EMEA
description:

Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build.
