title: Director, Revenue Operations (B2B SaaS)
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
 WHY STOREFORCE 
StoreForce helps retailers connect decisions, execution, and performance across their stores. We work with complex, well-known retailers around the world, and we have meaningful room to grow both through new clients and within the clients that already trust us. This role will sit close to the work, have real access to leadership, and materially shape how our sales organization scales.
 OVERVIEW 
 Make the right sales behaviors repeatable, visible, and durable. 
StoreForce has strong sales leadership, meaningful opportunity inside our existing client base, and a growing set of plays for winning new business. What we need now is someone who can turn those ideas into consistent execution across the team.
Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), the Director of Revenue Operations will build the operating rhythm that makes good ideas stick. This person will bring rigor to account planning, pipeline management, forecasting, expansion, and follow-through. They will know what matters commercially, make it visible, and work with the team until it becomes how we operate every week.
This is not a traditional Salesforce administrator role nor a second sales leader. The CRO will set sales strategy, coach the team, and lead our most important pursuits. The Director of Revenue Operations will translate that direction into clear actions, useful inspection, and sustained execution so the CRO and sellers can spend more time coaching, selling, and closing.
This role is fully remote with moderate national and international travel required.
 THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR 
You are a commercially minded operator who enjoys helping a talented team become more consistent. You can move comfortably between the detail of a late account plan and the larger question of where growth is coming from. You are direct without being heavy-handed, analytical without hiding behind the data, and persistent without creating unnecessary process.
You make things happen. When a direction is agreed, you create the structure and follow-through needed to carry it all the way into the field.
You know what good enterprise SaaS selling looks like. You can distinguish a meaningful commercial signal from activity that merely looks busy.
You can hold experienced people accountable without relying on hierarchy. Your credibility comes from judgment, preparation, consistency, and a willingness to help.
You build with the team, not around it. You listen, ask plainspoken questions, and improve the system as you learn.
You are comfortable in a growing, evolving company where not every answer or process already exists.
You care about outcomes more than ownership lines and bring a low-ego, sleeves-rolled-up approach to cross-functional work.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 1. Execution and Operating Cadence 
Translate sales strategy and priorities into a manageable set of actions, owners, milestones, and measures.
Run the recurring cadence for pipeline, forecast, deal progression, and account-plan review in close partnership with the CRO.
Reinforce the agreed revenue KPIs through the weekly operating cadence, ensuring the team understands what is being measured, why it matters, and what actions are required when performance is off track. Follow through with persistence and good judgment. Help the team understand why the work matters and remove obstacles where you can. When commitments are missed repeatedly, name it plainly and hold the line. The job is durable execution, not activity that looks busy.
Spot when a play or process is not working, diagnose why, and improve it rather than adding bureaucracy.
 2. Account Planning and Expansion 
Set a practical standard for strong account plans and coach the team toward it.
Build repeatable land-and-expand plays across sister brands, regions, and StoreForce products.
Keep expansion opportunities moving from analysis to action, with clear ownership and measurable progress.
 3. Pipeline, Forecasting, and Insight 
Create a shared, fact-based view of pipeline health, deal risk, forecast, conversion, velocity, and win/loss patterns.
Own the revenue KPI framework, including the leading and lagging indicators used to measure pipeline creation, pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, conversion, deal velocity, win/loss, expansion, productivity, and attainment. Ensure definitions are clear, reporting is trusted, and metrics are used to drive action rather than simply describe performance.
Ask the next useful question when the data exposes a gap. Turn reporting into decisions and actions, not another set of dashboards.
Partner with the CRO on coverage strategy, territory design, and capacity planning to ensure resources are aligned with market opportunity and growth objectives.
Partner with Finance on quota setting, incentive design and compensation modeling that reinforces desired commercial behaviors and supports the annual go-to-market objectives.
 4. Process, Enablement, and Systems 
Document the few processes and playbooks that genuinely help the team execute, then drive their adoption.
Reinforce new sales approaches through coaching, inspection, and feedback until they become durable field behavior.
Work with our existing Salesforce and analytics resources to define what the systems need to deliver. You should be fluent enough to ask for the right things, but you will not be expected to serve as the hands-on Salesforce administrator.
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Client Success, Finance, and Product where the sales motion crosses functional lines.
 WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE 
 In the first 12 to 18 months, this leader will: 
Establish and drive adoption of AI-enabled workflows across account planning, opportunity management, prospect research, enhance deal inspection and forecasting, creating measurable productivity improvements for the sales team
Establish a simple, dependable weekly operating cadence for pipeline, deal progression, account plans, and commitments. Expectations are clear, follow-up is consistent, and agreed actions do not disappear between meetings.
Within the first 90 days, baseline the numbers that matter (forecast accuracy, deal-cycle time, win rate, and account-plan coverage), and set clear targets against them with the CRO, so that “better” has a definition both of you agree on.
Establish a clear revenue scorecard and KPI framework that leadership trusts and the sales team uses consistently to inspect performance, identify risk, and drive action.
Raise the quality of account planning across the team. Our most important clients and prospects have practical plans with clear objectives, relationships, next steps, owners, and dates.
Turn white-space analysis into an active expansion motion across brands, banners, geographies, and products. Opportunities are prioritized, assigned, progressed, and measured.
Improve confidence in the forecast by creating stronger pipeline discipline, clearer inspection, and more reliable inputs. Risks and gaps surface early enough for the team to act.
Operationalize our sales plays, including value and ROI communication, so they show up consistently from the first conversation through proof of value, QBRs, expansion, and renewal.
Build useful visibility into performance by segment and region, helping leadership decide where to focus and where different motions may be needed.
Clarify the right approach to smaller, faster-moving opportunities that sit below our traditional enterprise ICP, then help stand up the motion if the opportunity warrants it.
Create leverage for the CRO. Sales leadership spends less time chasing updates and policing process, and more time coaching the team, shaping strategy, and closing important business.
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) 
Salesforce CRM adoption and data quality/completeness rate across the sales team;
Sales process compliance: percentage of deals and activities following StoreForce-defined processes;
Timeliness and accuracy of sales forecasting;
On-time delivery of weekly, monthly, and quarterly sales performance reports to the CRO and stakeholders;
Number of identified process gaps converted into documented, implemented, and adopted processes;
Pipeline velocity, conversion rates, win/loss ratios, and average sales cycle length.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Competencies Required: 
 Accountability – Holds themselves and others to a high standard; proactively identifies issues, follows through on commitments, and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.
 Influence & Assertiveness – Comfortable driving accountability across peers and senior team members; knows how to push for results without direct authority and does so with professionalism and persistence.
 Analytical Thinking – Digests complex data from multiple sources; identifies patterns, gaps, and opportunities; translates data into clear, actionable insights for decision-makers.
 Communication – Strong oral and written communication skills; able to present complex data and recommendations clearly to both frontline team members and senior executives.
 Leadership – Demonstrated ability to coach, train, and develop others; creates clarity, sets expectations, and builds a culture of operational excellence.
 Process Orientation – Natural inclination to bring structure and repeatability to ambiguous or unstructured environments; thrives on building systems that scale.
 Agility – Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment; maintains focus and drives outcomes despite competing demands and shifting priorities.
 Entrepreneurial Drive – Takes ownership of outcomes and operates with urgency; demonstrates a belief that they personally own their results and the results of the team.
 EXPERIENCE / KNOWLEDGE 
Meaningful experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Excellence, or a comparable commercial execution role, ideally in enterprise B2B SaaS.
A track record of improving sales execution, not simply administering tools or producing reports.
Hands-on experience with account planning, complex deal inspection, forecasting, and land-and-expand motions.
Strong analytical skills and working fluency with Salesforce. Salesforce administration expertise is useful, but it is not the core of this job.
Experience influencing sellers and leaders without direct authority and creating adoption across a distributed team.
Experience in vertical SaaS, private-equity-backed companies, specialty retail, or retail technology is helpful, but strong commercial pattern recognition and the ability to learn quickly matter more.
 WHY WORK WITH US AT STOREFORCE 
StoreForce is growing quickly – it’s the kind of place you can make a real impact. We thrive on change, collaboration, and trust; And are fueled by a mutual passion for Specialty Retail. At StoreForce you’ll have the chance not only to work with some amazing people, but also with some of the world’s best retail brands.
We're remote and offer flexibility in your schedule;
Employer-paid health benefits including dental, prescription drug coverage, and a Health Spending Account;
RRSP Matching with First Time Home Buyer support*
Company paid training and professional development;
Extended Long Weekends and Religious Observance Days
Employee Referral Program
Spotlight Recognition Bonus Program
Dedicated Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
 *Speak with HR for full program details. 
StoreForce is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all individuals and to providing individuals with a work environment that is diverse and inclusive. This starts by welcoming and encouraging applications from all individuals including those with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
At StoreForce, we leverage AI tools to support a fair and efficient recruitment process. This may include AI-assisted resume screening to help identify top candidates and AI note taking during interviews. All hiring decisions are made by real people. AI is used only as a supplemental tool to enhance, not replace, human judgment.
We never accept or respond to speculative applications from third party recruiters and work only with preferred partners.

title: Technical Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Wayflyer
 Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
The challenge
RevOps at Wayflyer is a team of builders. We're not just looking for people who can spot what's broken and flag it, that skill matters and we have great people who do it well. We're looking for people who also have the technical range to build the fix themselves, independently, without waiting on someone else's roadmap.
We sit at the epicenter of an exceptionally fast-growing business running across multiple channels and partners, and it's our job to make sure the systems underneath that growth have the ability to scale. This role is for a builder who wants to see the impact of their work fast, ideally in seconds, while still thinking several steps ahead so today's quick fix doesn't turn into next year's technical debt. We want people who enjoy the instant feedback loop just as much as the long game.
What you'll actually do
Integrations & Technical Ownership: Build, maintain and improve the systems, internal automations and integrations that make our sales and CS teams faster and more effective, from the ground up.
AI-Native Systems: Build, deploy and continuously sharpen AI-native workflows and agents that augment how Sales, CS and the wider Revenue org work, not just automate around the edges.
Data, Analytics & Problem Solving: Use self-sourced data to diagnose what's actually broken, run root cause analysis, and build the fix yourself, then measure it against real KPIs and keep iterating.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Ownership: Work directly with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Finance to turn half-formed requirements into systems that actually solve the problem.
Revenue Data Hygiene: Own regular audits, deduplication, enrichment and the process fixes that keep our data usable across every system that touches it.
Driving Operational Excellence: Spot inefficiencies before anyone asks you to, prioritise ruthlessly, and build the automated solutions that let the function scale without adding headcount.
What this role could turn into
This function sits at the intersection of Revenue, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering, so you'll get exposure most people spend years angling for. People who do this well tend to move toward GTM strategy, GTM engineering, product roles, and beyond. The sky is the limit.
Who thrives here
You're an AI-native builder who thinks in scale, not one-off fixes, and gets uncomfortable when you spot a manual workaround. You're just as comfortable pairing with Engineering as you are in the room with Sales leadership, translating one for the other without losing anything in the middle. You run towards the hardest, messiest problems, you don't wait for permission, and you don't need a fully-scoped brief before you start. You're always watching what the best GTM teams are building, and you'd rather pitch a bold idea than ship another incremental tweak.
We hire for range
3+ years in RevOps, MarOps, consulting or similar, but tenure isn't the point, trajectory is. Whatever your background, you're an AI-native builder with strong business acumen and a sharp eye for the difference between a good customer experience and a bad one.
You bring fluency in Python (or Node) and SQL, hands-on experience configuring HubSpot and its developer suite, and comfort with automation platforms like Zapier, Pipedream, n8n or UiPath. You've likely configured CPQ, CLM, sales engagement or customer-success platforms before, and just as importantly, you've driven adoption of something you built, not just shipped it and walked away. Extra credit if you've built and deployed AI agents, integrated AI/LLM-based solutions into existing workflows, or built automated pipelines end to end.
Location and working policy
 📍 Dublin or London, Hybrid
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity, because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

 About the job

 What you’ll be doing 
Working within our Enterprise Customer Success team, you will be part of a global account team assuming ownership and management of the relationship of some of our largest clients, helping them to realise value and support growth.
Establish and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and end users 
Consult clients on how to solve challenges & achieve desired outcomes with GWI

Accurately forecast risk with account manager and develop a plan to mitigate
Working closely with other internal teams to help deliver custom projects and strategic workshops
Be the voice of the customer and channel feedback to relevant departments.
 About you

5+ years in a Customer Success, Strategic Account Management, or Management Consulting role, with a minimum of 3 years working exclusively with strategic accounts.
Proven, demonstrable experience building and managing executive-level relationships (VP and above) within large, matrixed organisations, this is non-negotiable.
A track record of successfully navigating complex organisations of different sizes, industry and geography: managing multiple stakeholder groups, chairing cross-functional programmes, and sustaining engagement across long sales and success cycles.
Demonstrable history of retaining and growing revenue within a large portfolio, with clear examples of upsell and expansion driven through relationship-led strategy.
Background in Martech, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, or data-driven marketing technology strongly preferred; experience as a CRM or marketing practitioner is a significant advantage.
Comfortable with 30%+ travel to customer sites, predominantly UK with some international travel required.

title: Strategic Customer Success Manager - US Public Sector
description:
Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role: 
Our Enterprise Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our top customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner. 
Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except  Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.  
 You should apply if: 
 You want to impact the Public Sector:  You’ll be working with cities, states, school districts, and universities that help run our world. You'll work with them to help them operate more efficiently, safely, and drive citizen value through their services.
 You thrive the most when solving problems:  Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
 You are a natural relationship builder:  Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
 You are the architect of your own career:  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
 You want to be with the best:  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.
 In this role, you will:  
Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform 
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value 
Orchestrate executive business reviews with our customers’ decision makers and our executive leadership where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals 
Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to get the most out of their Samsara products
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Serve as a mentor to the wider Customer Success and Support teams 
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices 
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
5+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or strategic consulting role. Enterprise SaaS experience preferred
This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence 
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem solving skills
Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering leadership, day-to-day users of our software
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment 
Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
 An ideal candidate also has: 
Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Experience serving and supporting large-scale solutions for Public Sector organizations
Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
 Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. 
Annual OTE Salary
 $111,562.50 — $150,000 USD 
 Total Rewards 
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
 Flexible Working  
 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. 
 Belonging at Samsara 
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
 Accommodations  
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
 Our Commitment to Authenticity 
We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
 Fraudulent Employment Offers 
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our  blog post here .

title: eClinical Customer Success Team Lead
description:

 OpenClinica makes clinical trials more efficient and effective with advanced technology and recruitment solutions. Our industry-leading EHR-to-EDC connectivity automates source data acquisition, reduces errors, and eliminates delays, while our precision recruitment solutions help teams enroll the right participants with ease. Trusted by the world's leading life sciences companies, academic institutions, and government agencies, OpenClinica bridges the gap between healthcare and research. 
 About the Role and Team: 
 The eClinical Customer Success Team Lead is player-coach responsible for the overall performance and operational execution of the eClinical Customer Success team. This individual will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Services, Product, and Support to drive customer retention, expansion, Services growth, and long-term customer success across the eClinical installed base. 
 This role serves as both a player-coach and operational leader — helping manage escalations, improve team execution, standardize customer success processes, and drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) performance across the business. This role supports OpenClinica’s UK and broader NHS / public-sector client base. The ideal candidate has experience working with NHS organizations, UK-based research institutions, CROs, or life sciences customers and understands the operational, regulatory, and communication nuances of supporting UK customers. While this is a US-based role, preference will be given to candidates located on the US East Coast to enable strong overlap with UK business hours and customer needs.

 Lead, coach, and develop the eClinical Customer Success team to drive strong customer outcomes and commercial performance

 Partner closely with Sales and Account Executives to identify and progress Growth opportunities within existing accounts 
 Serve as an escalation point for complex customer issues and coordinate resolution across Product, Support, Services, and Engineering 
 Monitor customer health, Salesforce pipelines, adoption trends, and account risks to proactively drive retention and expansion outcomes

 Scale revenue!

 Bachelor’s Degree required

 Experience managing enterprise customer relationships in software, technology, or clinical research environments 
 Prior experience leading or mentoring customer-facing teams 
 Familiarity with clinical trial operations, EDC platforms, or eClinical systems 
 Experience supporting NHS, UK public-sector, or UK life sciences / clinical research customers strongly preferred 
 Familiarity with UK business culture, communication norms, and healthcare or clinical research ecosystems 
 Experience working across UK and US time zones in a client-facing role 
 Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship 
 Significant level of comfort interacting with a high volume of customers over a variety of mediums (phone, email, webinars) 
 Skills

 Commercial mindset with ability to identify growth and expansion opportunities

 Data-driven, operationally minded, and comfortable working in fast-paced environments 
 Nice to Have 
 Experience working with CROs, sponsors, biotech, pharma, or academic research organizations 
 Familiarity with SaaS metrics including NRR, churn, expansion ARR, and renewal forecasting 
 Experience conducting QBRs and executive stakeholder management 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
OpenClinica is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

hard_gaps: Familiarity with clinical trial operations, EDC or eClinical systems
Prior experience leading or mentoring customer-facing teams

description:
Toronto, Canada
 Building Canada's Mortgage Ecosystem of the Future. 
 We're committed to creating a true Canadian champion.
 About Us
 Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.
Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.
Operating through our family of brands— CMLS , nesto , and Nesto Cloud —our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.
With more than 1,300 team members across Canada, we're building Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future—and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.
Learn more at: https://nestogroup.ca/
 Life at Nesto Group
 At Nesto Group, you'll be part of a collaborative organization where innovation, speed, trust, expertise, and continuous learning go hand in hand. Whether you're shaping strategy, supporting operations, building technology with best-in-class AI-driven tools, or serving customers, your work contributes to an ecosystem that's redefining the future of mortgage lending in Canada.
Discover the values that drive everything we do, every day. Join the Canadian Rocketship redefining the lending industry.

A successful Growth Operations Manager is the rare individual who masters analytical skills to identify and deliver the highest value opportunities possible, just as well as the soft skills required to wield influence to win challenging business cases and lead the change management for the changes you are implementing. Underpinned by a strong sense of ownership, your willpower is what gets challenging projects to the finish line.

Seize opportunities to deliver day to day improvements to core processes and tangibly grow business results
Evolve our user journey and user experience to provide best in class service to borrowers, brokers and capital partners

Deliver large scale projects to level up the business function from scoping, to implementation, to change management

Coordinate a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, from senior leadership to front line staff, with sometimes conflicting perspectives and priorities
Overcome complexity, ambiguity and obstacles to drive towards value and delivery

title: Senior Sales Enablement Manager
description:

Delivery of the enablement roadmap.

Embedding AI-first selling approaches.
Driving tool adoption and seller capability uplift.
Cross‑functional alignment to maintain consistent GTM messaging.
Relationships
Sales Directors & Sales Managers
Solution Sales Leads
Marketing
Services & Product Teams
IT & Sales Operations
Vendors (training, content, strategy alignment)

Drive change adoption across the sales organisation.
 What We Expect Of You

Strong data literacy and ability to link enablement to business outcomes.
Experience in a technology or solutions‑led sales organisation.
Background in consultative selling or modern digital selling.

 CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization
 We’re looking for people who bring curiosity, a learner’s mindset, and a willingness to engage with ever-evolving technology and tools. We value adopting AI as a partner, openness to experimentation, and a shared interest in learning together on AI. Our goal is to create a culture where AI enhances—not replaces—human creativity and decision-making. You don’t need to be an expert today; what matters is your readiness to explore, adapt, and grow with us as we integrate AI responsibly and effectively into our work.
Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.
 About Us
 CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, EMEA
description:

We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 
As Vanta continues its push into new markets, the EMEA Revenue Org is at the center of that growth — and this role is the dedicated enablement partner making that motion faster, sharper, and more scalable. As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager supporting our EMEA organization, you'll operate as a true strategic thought partner to Sales and Post-sales leadership, helping design and build the enablement infrastructure needed to win in complex sales environments. This is a high-autonomy role that shapes how Vanta's revenue teams learn, grow, and perform.
This role will lead the execution of both global enablement initiatives and region-specific programs. You’ll work independently, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and help EMEA leaders reinforce new skills and behaviors with their teams.
What you’ll do as a Senior Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta:
 - Partner closely with EMEA Revenue Leadership to understand business priorities, team performance, and enablement needs.
 - Build trusted relationships with sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Revenue and the broader business.
 - Diagnose gaps in industry, product, sales methodology, and role-specific skills across EMEA.

 - Measure program effectiveness, gather feedback, and refine enablement priorities as the business, product, and sales motion evolve.
 - Collaborate with other Revenue Enablement partners to maintain alignment across global programs and regional delivery.
How to be successful in this role:
 - 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, GTM enablement, or an equivalent role.
 - Experience supporting EMEA-specific sales teams and markets.
 - Experience supporting global sales organizations in a variety of roles spanning Early Stage through Upmarket segments.
 - A track record of designing and delivering sales methodology enablement.
 - Experience in SaaS; experience supporting a technical product is preferred.
 - Strong ability to diagnose capability gaps and translate them into focused enablement priorities.
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across varied audiences.
 - Strong business partnership and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 - Ability to operate independently, manage ambiguity, and build credibility with senior sales leaders.
 - Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.
 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
What you can expect as a Vanta’n:
 - Industry-competitive salary and equity
 - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage
 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents
 - Health & wellness stipend
 - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend
 - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office
 - Pension matching
 - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time
 - 8 company-paid holidays
 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!
 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.
About Vanta
We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 
Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

title: Manager, Customer Success, Strategic
description:
Description 
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Manager, Customer Success, Strategic for the Sales & Customer Experience team.
 Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team? 
At Sprout Social, our Sales and Customer Experience team is the driving force behind how today’s most innovative brands use Sprout to power the future of customer connection. We sell and support the leading social intelligence platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social data to drive strategic decisions.  Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.
In this role, you will collaborate with the brightest minds in the industry to support global giants like Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, we believe in the power of our people. You’ll find a culture that honors your ambition, encourages you to explore new horizons, and provides the framework for you to build a career that matters. If you’re ready to champion innovation and accelerate your impact, this is where you can do your best work.
 What You'll Do 
As Manager, Customer Success, Strategic, you will lead a team of tenured Strategic Customer Success Managers overseeing a high value book of business. Your focus is bringing segment strategy to life with operational rigor, ensuring repeatable team execution, and driving retention and portfolio growth.
 Lead & Develop Senior Talent: Direct and coach an experienced team of CSMs through 1:1s, call reviews, and account planning. Build individualized growth paths, clear operational roadblocks, and set clear performance expectations.
 Drive Operational Rigor & Execution: Translate segment strategy into clear priorities. Establish and refine team operating standards—including Mutual Success Plans, Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), account health scoring, and CRM discipline - to ensure consistent performance across the portfolio.
 Own Retention, Risk, & Expansion: Deliver on team retention and quota targets. Pressure-test expansion pipelines, coach opportunity qualification, establish early risk-detection mechanisms, and lead structured save plans for escalating accounts.
 Serve as an Executive Escalation Point: Directly engage with customer executives to reinforce value, support strategic renewals, and articulate social intelligence ROI for C-level audiences.
 Champion AI Innovation: Incorporate generative AI into your workflow and guide the team in using AI tools to streamline research, account prep, and communication without losing strategic oversight.
 Lead Through Change & Cross-Functional Alignment: Guide the team through evolving go-to-market motions with clarity. Partner with Sales, Renewals, Onboarding, and Product to unblock technical hurdles and advocate for customer needs internally.
 Monitor & Report Performance: Track and report key metrics across retention, growth, adoption, and health scores to diagnose portfolio trends and optimize resource allocation.
 What You'll Bring 
The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader who thrives on operational discipline and is energized by complex, high-stakes customer relationships. You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for the work—staying motivated and forward-looking through ambiguity and difficult stretches, and bringing your team with you.
 Minimum qualifications: 
 Customer Success Experience: 6+ years in Customer Success or account management, with direct experience owning a strategic or enterprise book of business.
 People Leadership: 1+ years of experience leading client-facing teams, with a track record of coaching, performance management, and developing high-tenured individual contributors serving matrixed enterprise clients.
 Commercial & Operational Track Record: Proven success driving retention and growth targets, paired with strong business acumen across renewals, negotiations, process refinement, and project management.
 Risk & Influence Skills: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence key stakeholders and maintain sound judgment under pressure.
 Generative AI Proficiency: Hands-on experience applying generative AI tools (e.g., for research, account prep, communication) to optimize personal and team productivity.
 Travel: Ability to travel for customer on-sites within the U.S. 4+ times per year.
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 SaaS & Tooling Expertise: Experience in SaaS/subscription business models, with fluency in tools like Salesforce, Gainsight, Tableau, or similar CRM/BI platforms.
 Executive Coaching: Experience coaching CSMs on C-suite presentations and value-based ROI selling.
 Sales Background: Previous experience in direct account management or sales roles.
 How you’ll grow 
Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:
Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.
Make a plan with your manager to set initial priorities, align on expectations for your role, plant goalposts for your career, and learn about Sprout’s approach to Customer Success
Meet 1:1 with your team of CSMs and begin reviewing account portfolio health, Mutual Success Plans, and current forecast projections.
Shadow current QBRs, account planning sessions, and cross-functional syncs with Sales and Renewals partners to map key stakeholder workflows.
Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:
Build connections with members from other teams through active networking and community building
Begin active strategic coaching in 1:1s—focusing on executive presentation, risk mitigation, and embedding AI-enabled workflows. 
Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:
Have your first performance conversation with your manager, where you’ll discuss your accomplishments in your role and work together to build goals for your professional growth
Consistently meet or exceed team retention targets
Build individualized career development and stretch plans tailored to senior/tenured ICs on your team. 
Synthesize customer and team feedback to influence cross-functional partners in Product, Professional Services, and GTM leadership. 
Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:
Serve as a recognized mentor and internal advocate for cross-functional collaboration and strategic account excellence. 
Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change your team in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet.
Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.
 Our Benefits Program  
We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:
 Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
 Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
About the role 
 As Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, you own the systems, data, and process that power our go-to-market engine end to end: HubSpot and the wider GTM stack, the reporting and forecasting leadership plans around, the deal desk, and the pipeline process that keeps it all clean. 
 This is a senior individual-contributor role, a builder with the judgment of a leader. You will partner with our Heads of Sales, Marketing, and Finance, translate their priorities into one coherent operation, and do the hands-on work yourself, from the CRM field to the leadership dashboard. To keep the role focused, it does not own sales compensation design, quota setting, or territory design; those sit with other teams today. 
 You will have meaningful ownership from the start and the trust to form a point of view, push back with data, and move the work forward. 
 What you'll do 
 GTM Systems & CRM (HubSpot) 
 Own HubSpot administration end to end: fields, pipelines, workflows, permissions, and user management. 
 Own the customer lifecycle in the CRM, from net-new lead through renewal and upsell, and maintain data quality and completeness across leads, contacts, companies, deals, and other core objects. 
 Manage integrations and data flow between HubSpot and the rest of the GTM stack. 
 Own the broader tech stack, including sequencing tools, dialers, call recording, and other platforms across marketing, sales, and CS, and lead evaluations, purchases, and deprecations of GTM tooling. 
 Reporting, Forecasting & GTM Analytics 
 Build a single source of truth for top-level KPIs and full-funnel reporting, and maintain dashboards leadership can self-serve. 
 Own recurring revenue and pipeline reporting for leadership meetings, including the analysis and insight, not just the data pull. 
 Own the forecast process and cadence across GTM teams, deliver one consolidated forecast to Finance on a fixed calendar, and track forecast accuracy over time. 
 Support quarterly planning: build pipeline-coverage and metrics targets by segment and channel, worked back from the company revenue plan so GTM targets and the financial plan align. 
 Pipeline, Process & Deal Desk 
 Design and maintain sales stages and exit criteria, building on work already underway, and own pipeline hygiene: stale deals, missing data, and process adherence. 
 Run the deal desk as the first point of contact for reps on pricing, discounts, and non-standard terms, enforcing the approval thresholds Finance sets. 
 Flag revenue-recognition implications before deals close, own a clean handoff from closed-won to billing, and route contracts with Finance and Legal. 
 Enablement, Automation & Documentation 
 Design the tech stack to be self-serve and scalable, with automation and templates as the default, and build foundational GTM system projects such as lead scoring, routing, and lifecycle automation. 
 Create and maintain comprehensive documentation and training for the systems you own. 
 Communicate the GTM systems roadmap and project status to the wider team for transparency and prioritization. 
 Stay current on new features and technology, especially AI, and make recommendations to the team. 
 Qualifications 
 6+ years in RevOps, Marketing Ops, or Sales Ops at a B2B SaaS company. 
 Deep, hands-on HubSpot administration across the full platform, not specialized in a single area such as marketing. You have seen it all, and prior sole-admin experience is a strong plus. 
 A track record of cleaning, building, and scaling HubSpot to meet a growing business’s needs. 
 Working knowledge of B2B SaaS KPIs and the purchase, quoting, and contracting process. 
 Direct, data-driven communication, and genuine comfort pushing back on leadership. 
 Transparency and accountability in your status updates and on the current state of the systems. 
 Experience using AI to multiply your productivity and insight (Claude preferred). 
 Hands-on email and landing-page development, mostly HTML and CSS, is a plus. 
 Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem is a plus. 
 Why Orchestry? 
 Work that matters: Join a growing, remote-first SaaS company solving real problems for organizations navigating the complexity of Microsoft 365. 
 Real ownership: Build and scale the revenue operations discipline from the ground up. 
 Flexibility with accountability: We trust people to work in the way that works best for them while staying accountable for meaningful outcomes. 
 A smart, kind, no-ego team: People show up, work across departments, and care more about getting to the right answer than being the person who had it first. 
 Competitive compensation, equity, and benefits. 
 About Orchestry 
 Orchestry is a pioneering SaaS company in the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, helping organizations simplify, govern, and get more value from their collaboration tools. Our platform empowers IT and business users alike through intelligent automation, governance, and user-friendly design. 
 We are a remote-first team of smart, kind, low-ego people who take ownership of their work and care about building something that matters. There is plenty of flexibility in how you work, but just as much accountability for what you deliver. 
 We're growing fast and scaling globally, and we're looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to own the systems, data, and process behind our go-to-market engine, and to turn multiple team priorities into one well-run revenue operation. 
 The pay range for this role is: 
130000.00 - 150000.00 CAD per year (Remote)

title: Senior Business Operations Manager - CBO Office
description:
Business Operations at Booking.com bridges strategy and execution, ensuring the organization can effectively translate priorities into outcomes. Through planning, operational governance, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination, we drive alignment, operational readiness, and execution excellence—helping Booking.com deliver on its Mission, Vision, and Strategy with the customer at the center.
The Chief Business Officer (CBO) Office is responsible for leading business planning and operations, program management and change management for Booking.com. The CBO Office reports to Booking's Chief Business Officer and works directly with the most senior leadership across the organization, including Department LT's and corporate functions (HR/People, Finance, Legal, and Global Strategy & Development), to enable Booking.com to achieve its strategic and operational goals.
The Senior Business Operations Manager serves as a strategic and hands-on operating partner to (also reporting into) the Director of Business Operations, in the CBO Office. In this high-impact role, you act as the "connective tissue" between strategy and execution for Booking.com — ensuring the company operates efficiently, scales effectively, and makes decisions grounded in data. You are responsible for shaping, building and scaling key elements of the enterprise operating system, orchestrating the translation of strategy into execution so both remain tightly aligned. The role requires strong versatility, contributing across a wide range of initiatives and adding value wherever it is most needed.
 Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:
(Quarterly) Operational Planning & Adaptive Execution: Design, operate, and continuously improve rolling quarterly planning and execution cycles at scale that translate annual direction into near-term priorities, commitments, sequencing, and decisions. Partner closely with annual planning owners to keep the two horizons connected, using execution insights to validate assumptions, surface dependencies and trade-offs, and adjust course as conditions change. Evolve quarterly planning from a periodic event into an effective operating rhythm that improves execution velocity, agility and predictability.
Strategic Portfolio, Capacity & Trade-off Management: Build and continuously improve strategic portfolio-management and capacity/resource-management practices that enable active enterprise steering. Create visibility across priorities, demand, dependencies, investment, and capacity; establish effective prioritization and decision rights; and equip leaders to make explicit trade-offs on what to start, protect, pause, re-sequence, or stop. Partner with Finance, HR and other relevant functions where needed to strengthen resource, workforce, and investment decisions.
Enterprise Operating Maturity: Shape and advance operating-model improvements across the organization in line with leadership direction and sponsorship. Translate emerging strategic direction into practical improvements to quarterly governance, leadership rhythms, decision-making, standards, and ways of working.  Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships.  The Role
 We are looking for a highly adaptable and autonomous Business Operations Associate to join our team. This is a highly dynamic role focused on solving important operational and commercial problems across the Dealer journey. You will focus strictly on the B2B/Dealer side of our marketplace, acting as a key driver for improving our post-sale experience.
You will combine strong analytical thinking with practical execution. That means identifying opportunities through data and observation, developing clear hypotheses, and then driving cross-functional initiatives that deliver measurable outcomes.
The role is intentionally broad. You will work across teams including Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and commercial functions—as well as partner third parties—to solve complex problems and implement scalable solutions. In this role, you will have consistent exposure to Leadership, including our Director of Dealer Services and our COO.
Motorway moves quickly and operates in an environment that is constantly evolving. This role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, is naturally curious, demonstrates high agency, and enjoys taking ownership of messy problems and turning them into structured solutions. Lead Cross-Functional Projects: Drive projects from idea through to implementation, partnering with teams across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, and external partners.
Data-Driven Analysis: Analyse operational, financial, and product data to diagnose problems, inform prioritisation, and uncover opportunities to improve dealer retention, CX, and efficiency.
Define Metrics & Action Plans: Develop clear business cases, success metrics, and tracking frameworks for initiatives while translating complex operational problems into actionable plans for key stakeholders.

description:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.
 Job Description
 Founded in 2001, Sportradar is a global leader in sports technology, trusted by federations, media organisations and betting operators across more than 20 countries. We sit at the intersection of sport, data and technology, and we are one of the reasons the modern sports industry works the way it does.
Every match, every moment, every data point. We capture it, structure it, and turn it into products our clients build their businesses on. When a live odds feed updates in milliseconds, when a governing body catches a corrupted match, when a brand reaches fans at the exact second a goal goes in, that is our technology.
Our portfolio spans real-time sports data, media rights products, advertising technology, integrity services and emerging prediction markets. Few commercial organisations anywhere are this broad.
That breadth is our biggest advantage. This role exists for someone hungry to sharpen how we sell it and turn it into revenue, faster and more consistently, across every region.
 Why this Role
You will own enablement across the full commercial funnel: SDRs, Sales Executives and Account Managers, in four regions 
You will work at the intersection of coaching, data and AI, using all three as core inputs rather than bolt-ons 
You will be measured on revenue impact, and you will have the mandate and the leadership backing to work that way 
 THE CHALLENGE
 This is a role for a builder.
 Our revenue organisation spans EMEA, APAC, North America and LATAM, sells across more than ten distinct product lines, and is scaling fast. Enablement here already has foundations to work from. What it needs now is someone to take it into its next chapter and match the pace the commercial organisation is moving at.
You will shape what enablement means at Sportradar: the methodology, the frameworks, and the metrics it is held to. Enablement earns its seat at the commercial table by proving incremental revenue. We want someone who can show that a sharper discovery framework lifted opportunity-to-close rates by a measurable margin, that a coaching programme moved average deal size, that a redesigned ramp brought forward first revenue by weeks.
That responsibility runs the full length of the funnel. SDRs generating first conversations, Sales Executives running complex multi-stakeholder deals, Account Managers protecting and expanding existing revenue. Each needs a different intervention, and each moves a different metric. We are looking for someone who understands where the highest leverage sits at every stage, and who can build for a first-week SDR and a fifteen-year enterprise seller in the same quarter.
We are benchmarking against the best go-to-market enablement functions in SaaS, and we want someone who knows what that standard looks like because they have worked inside it.
 What You Will Own
 Sales methodology: Own, embed and govern a common commercial language across every region and product line: qualification, discovery, value framing, multi-threading, and commercial negotiation. This includes selecting or refining the methodology itself, then building the reinforcement, certification and deal-level coaching that makes it stick.
 Data and diagnosis: Own the answer to the question: what is actually working, and what is not. Use CRM data, win and loss analysis, conversation intelligence and funnel performance to locate where deals slow down. Bring findings to sales leadership with a point of view attached and a plan ready to be actioned.
 AI native delivery: Treat AI as core infrastructure rather than a side project. Drive adoption across the commercial team and use AI to capture and interpret the data. Scale personalised coaching, compress content production from weeks to days, and put usable intelligence in front of sellers at the point of need.
 Manager partnership: Work directly with front-line managers to design curated, specialist enablement for their teams, territories and segments. Diagnose the specific gap, build the specific intervention, measure whether it moved the number.
 Onboarding and ramp: Build role-specific ramp paths for every commercial profile that get new hires productive faster and prove the improvement with evidence rather than sentiment.
 Commercial launches and change: Lead the enablement workstream for transformation, new product introduction and go-to-market shifts. Own the run of show, pull in the right internal specialists, and land the change consistently across multiple regions.
 Content and knowledge architecture: Own playbooks, battlecards, objection handling and competitive intelligence in partnership with Product Marketing, so that sellers can find the right thing at the right moment rather than hunting for it.
 Commercial rhythm: Shape the operating cadence that keeps the commercial organisation sharp: sales kick-off, quarterly reviews, manager forums and the feedback loops that connect them.
 Cross-functional partnership: Work alongside Revenue Operations, Product Marketing, Sales Development and regional commercial leadership to align enablement priorities with the wider go-to-market roadmap.
 What You Will Bring
5+ years in sales enablement, revenue enablement or a closely related commercial function, ideally in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology scale-up 
A track record in an organisation that has been through acquisition, integration or significant structural change 
Experience across a large, multi-region commercial function with more than one product line and more than one buyer type 
Strong command of at least one recognised sales methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, Challenger or equivalent) and evidence of embedding it, not just teaching it 
Fluency with sales data. You can build the analysis yourself, interrogate CRM hygiene, and separate signal from noise 
Hands-on experience with Salesforce or equivalent CRM and a modern commercial stack (conversation intelligence, sales engagement, content management, LMS) 
AI literate. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a clear view on where they belong in an enablement operating model 
Credibility with senior sales leaders and front-line managers. You have influenced without formal authority and enjoyed it 
Strong instincts for methodology and behaviour change, not just content production 
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping. Version one out the door beats version three in draft 
 Bonus points
Background in sport, media, advertising technology, data or marketplaces 
Experience standing up enablement infrastructure from the ground up: LMS, content architecture, certification 
Exposure to pricing transformation or commercial model change 
Previous experience in a frontline sales or sales management role 
 Additional Information
 At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. About Invoca: 
 Invoca is the revenue execution and platform leader that helps marketing, commerce, and contact center teams turn every conversation into revenue. Through its AI agents, Invoca engages, qualifies, and converts customers across SMS and voice, orchestrating seamless buyer journeys and measurable, profitable growth. With over 300 employees, 2,000+ customers, and $100M in revenue, the company continues to lead the category it created.  Our Revenue Operations, Strategy and Enablement organization is designed as a unified, end-to-end revenue engine — aligning Strategy, Operations, Systems, and Enablement across the full customer lifecycle.  The Revenue Operations pillar owns how our revenue engine operates day-to-day. You'll also collaborate with our AI team to identify where automation and AI-driven workflows can remove manual work and improve seller productivity. title: GTM Strategy & Ops, Senior Manager
description:
Technology is one of the biggest items in an enterprise CFO’s budget, second only to headcount. Traditional procurement is one of the most frustrating, friction-filled bottlenecks in the modern business.
Vertice is the world’s first Intelligent Procurement Platform eliminating this chaos. By combining agentic workflows, deep AI insights, and a global network of expert negotiators, we empower enterprises to buy smarter and scale at pace.
The market response has been unprecedented:
 $75bn+ in spend processed across our platform.
 20% savings consistently delivered to our customers.
 70% reduction in standard enterprise procurement cycles.
 13X revenue growth achieved over the last two years alone.
Founded by serial technology entrepreneurs Roy and Eldar Tuvey, who have successfully scaled and exited two category-defining platforms and created $600M+ in enterprise value, we are backed by over $100M in Series C funding from tier 1 global investors including Bessemer Venture Partners, 83North, Lakestar . We have also been recognized as the #2 fastest-growing company on the Sunday Times' Tech 100 and the fastest-growing startup in the UK and Ireland by the FT’s Sifted (#4 in Europe) .
With headquarters in London and hubs in New York, Brno, Sydney, and Johannesburg, we are fundamentally reshaping the global B2B economy.
 The role 
In a nutshell, this role would suit someone who holds an unforgiving bar for excellence who feels personal accountability for the execution of the sales motion.
You'll drive GTM strategy and enablement for a global sales organisation with a strong team across our US and EMEA offices. Leonard Maassen on AI use cases across GTM, Caldwell Harden who focuses on our North American expansion, Chris Davis on GTM systems and Constantin Clement on wider GTM projects.
This is a role about the motion itself: how Vertice pitches, positions, negotiates and closes, and what the team needs to do all of that better. The reporting engine behind the sales org is already in a good place, so the leverage sits in the craft rather than in RevOps. The work is global and you'll spend most of your time in the London HQ.
 You'll focus on three things in your first twelve months: 
 #01. Raise the ceiling & the floor 
Understand what it takes to win, then embed the standard throughout the sales motion, across the team. There is no prescribed way to do this.
 #02. Selling a broad product portfolio 
Vertice is selling a portfolio of products. The best reps already excel at selling the full portfolio, because they earn more from it. Your job is to accelerate that momentum, and to do it again for whatever comes next.
 #03. Programmes for scale 
There is huge headroom across newer channels, which need GTM programmes designed, shipped and measured, alongside sharpening the ICP and pushing AI use cases into a fast-growing sales org.
You'll report to Constantin Clement , who owns GTM Strategy & Ops, Business Development, Solutions, Deals Strategy and Special Projects with Roy. Both he and Roy recognise that more attention to GTM Strategy & Ops will yield far more juice from the squeeze.
For the right person, this is a rare chance to shape how a genuinely excellent sales organisation operates, at the point where it is scaling channels, geographies and products at once, with the CEO close enough to the work to back what you build.
 About you 
We're looking for an analytical generalist with operator instincts: someone who wins the confidence of senior sales leaders and pushes work all the way into execution. 
In general, we find it takes a certain type of person to thrive at Vertice: someone with a spike in their craft who is also genuinely low-ego, communicates in plain English, doesn't settle for the status quo, and gets a kick out of company building with smart people.
 In practice, it's likely you'll have most of the following: 
 #01. Hold an unforgiving bar for excellence 
You are a perfectionist about the craft, and you can tell good from great in the detail rather than in the aggregate. We think the best people feel the weight of performance on their shoulders, like the sales leaders they partner with.
 "The key here is a super high bar for excellence. Can they listen to a call and have the instincts and the bar to say this wasn't great, and this is how it should be different." - Constantin Clement, Hiring Manager 
 #02. Have commercial horsepower and gravitas 
You frame decisions around revenue impact rather than activity, you are quick and confident with numbers, and you command the respect of AEs and senior sales leaders well enough to challenge them and be believed.
 #03. Have built the enablement craft 
You have built assets that win deals, embedded excellence in how a team operates, and measured the impact in hard numbers (it's not important if you've had an Enablement title - if anything it's likely you don't). You're happy to screenshare the work.
 #04. Think from GTM strategy to execution 
You have architected and shipped GTM programmes end to end with measurable revenue impact. For example, you built and defended an ICP from first principles and know the nuance of a good target list in practice.
 #05. Are a stage-appropriate leader 
You have done high-ownership work in a comparable high-agency, high performance environment. Ideally you have managed at least one person, though formal line management is preferred rather than required.
 Interview process 
 #01. Discovery with Sam · ~60 mins · Remote 
Short form (~5 mins) on hygiene, like compensation, then a call to explore mutual fit with Sam , an recruiter embedded at Vertice. Sam has worked with Vertice for >2 years.
 #02. Discovery with Constantin · ~45–60 mins · In-person
Your hiring manager, Constantin Clement . You may also meet one other member of the team, or spend further time with Constantin before moving to panel.
 #03. Panel with Roy, Matt and Constantin · ~75-90 mins · In-person 
A working session with Roy Tuvey (CEO), Matt Barnard (CFO), Constantin and one of Vertice's sales leaders. We'll share the detail in advance.
 If you invest time at any stage 1-3, we'll give you feedback regardless of the outcome. There's also the option to meet more of the team afterwards if it's useful to you. 
 What now? 
If you're keen to keep exploring this opportunity with Vertice, let's speak.
Complete the application form and we'll be in touch if we think it's a good fit on paper.
 Final things to note 
Vertice is an equal opportunities employer, although you must be legally able to work in the specified region of the job. Any personal data you provide will be processed in accordance with Vertice's privacy policy and applicable data protection law.
We use AI-assisted tools to help us review and assess applications more efficiently. These tools support our Talent team but do not make hiring decisions autonomously. You have the right to contest any AI-assisted decision, and exercise your data subject rights by contacting us; please follow the instructions in our privacy policy. 
We like to deal directly with our candidates so no agencies please!
 If you aren’t sure this job applies to you, feel free to send your CV to careers@vertice.one, and we’ll be happy to take a look and see if you could be a good fit anywhere else in our business!

title: AI Revenue Operations Manager

01Health is at an inflection point. The platform is built, revenue is accelerating, and we are moving from a single-specialty company to a multi-vertical specialist healthcare platform - with AI as embedded clinical infrastructure. Our vision is to help all clinicians deliver the latest innovations in healthcare, improving the standard of care for millions of people. Balderton-backed Series A company

4.98★ customer rating from the dentists who use us

US expansion live

title: Sales Operations Executive
description:
Want to help build something rather than simply step into an existing role? 
Connect 4 Payments is a growing payments business helping companies across Ireland and the UK find smarter, simpler and more cost-effective ways to take payments.
We're growing — and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us .
We're hiring a commercially minded Sales Operations Executive to take ownership of the day-to-day operations behind our sales team and help us build better processes as we scale.
This isn't a role for someone who wants to be given a checklist every morning.
We're looking for a self-starter who can work independently, spot what needs to be done and get on with it. Someone who sees a problem, looks for the solution and takes ownership of making it happen.
You'll work closely with the leadership team, but you'll also be trusted to make the role your own .
And while operations is at the heart of this position, this isn't a role where you'll sit behind a CRM all day. 
You'll regularly communicate with clients, partners and our sales team, so you need to be confident picking up the phone, asking questions, chasing what's needed and getting things moving.
 We're open to different levels of experience, with salary reflecting this. The upper end of the range is available for candidates who can demonstrate strong, relevant Sales Operations or Commercial Operations experience. 
 What you'll be doing? 
You'll sit at the centre of our sales operation, helping make sure leads, applications, partners and customers move smoothly through the business.
You'll be responsible for:
Managing and improving our CRM and sales processes
Monitoring leads and ensuring opportunities don't fall through the cracks
Tracking pipeline, conversion rates and sales performance
Producing clear sales reports and identifying trends
Improving how leads are distributed, managed and followed up
Speaking directly with clients and partners by phone and email to resolve queries, obtain information and keep applications moving
Building strong working relationships with our payment partners
Identifying bottlenecks and finding practical ways to fix them
Supporting forecasting and pipeline planning
Working closely with the sales team and leadership
Improving workflows, systems and automation
Helping introduce new processes as the business grows
Taking ownership of projects without needing constant direction
Most importantly, we want your ideas . If you see something that could work better, we'll give you the freedom to help change it .
 Who are we are looking for? 
You'll ideally already have experience within Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations or a similar sales-focused operational role .
You'll understand how a sales function works behind the scenes — from CRM and pipeline management to reporting, processes and partner coordination.
We're looking for someone who is:
A genuine self-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged
Experienced within a sales-focused operational environment

A strong communicator who can build relationships and get answers when they're needed

Commercially minded and confident working with sales data

Naturally curious about how processes could work better

 Why Join Connect 4 Payments?

You won't be joining a huge corporate structure where every process has already been decided for you. You'll have the opportunity to help shape how we work, improve how we operate and build processes that grow with the business .
