title: Revenue Operations & Strategy
description:
About Traversal 
 Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise.
Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high-impact work.
Today, Traversal operates in mission-critical environments at some of the world’s largest enterprises. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’ve brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Hanabi, NFDG, and American Express Ventures.
 The Role 
As a Revenue Operations individual contributor, you will be a force multiplier across our GTM organization. This is a broad, high-ownership role: you'll move fluidly between systems administration, analytics and forecasting, process design, and support for sales compensation and territory planning. You'll use an AI forward approach while working with sales, marketing, finance, and leadership to scale our the revenue engine.
This role suits someone who wants to own problems end-to-end — from diagnosing a broken process, to redesigning it, to building the Salesforce automation or dashboard that makes it stick — without a large team around them yet.
 Responsibilities 
 Systems & Data 
Administer and continuously improve Salesforce: objects, automation, validation rules, and data quality, in partnership with the broader GTM tool stack (Claude, Clay, Apollo, Clari, Gong, Granola).
Own integration health across tools — investigating and resolving issues (e.g., sync errors, validation rule conflicts) that affect pipeline and forecast accuracy.
Maintain and improve reporting infrastructure and dashboards used by sales leadership and the executive team.
 Analytics & Forecasting 
Build and maintain pipeline and forecast models, capacity plans, and performance dashboards (e.g., cycle time by stage, pipeline coverage, conversion rates).
Partner with sales leadership to prepare board- and leadership-level pipeline and forecast materials.
Analyze funnel and rep performance data to surface trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate findings into recommendations.
 Process & GTM Strategy 
Build out the analytics layer that powers GTM decision-making, from pipeline dashboards to cohort analyses to efficiency metrics
Set the standard for how we analyze regional pipeline health, win/loss trends, and rep productivity, and determine how those insights feed back into the GTM plan
Partner with field leadership to diagnose gaps in the business and drive the structured plans to address them, covering real-time action as well as the insights that guide QBRs, pipeline reviews, etc.
Design and document processes and swim lanes that clarify handoffs across Sales, Marketing Ops, and Finance Ops.
Support go-to-market planning: territory design, account segmentation, and capacity/headcount modeling.
Design the coverage models aligned to 2-year growth projections, incorporating territory design, account segmentation, and capacity planning
Set the point of view on competitive dynamics, regional expansion priorities, and whitespace opportunities
 Sales Compensation & Planning 
Support the design and administration of sales compensation plans (quotas, commission structures, SPIFFs), ensuring plans are modeled accurately and compliant with relevant wage law.
Help resolve comp-related questions and disputes with clear, data-backed answers.
 AI-Enabled Ways of Working 
Use AI tools (Claude and similar) as a core part of the RevOps toolkit — automating recurring analysis and reporting, drafting process documentation, and prototyping solutions faster than manual approaches allow. As a company building AI-powered software, we expect our own operations to reflect that same leverage.
 Requirements 
7+ years of experience in Revenue/Sales Operations, Business Operations, or a related analytical role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
Deep hands-on Salesforce expertise (administration, automation, reporting) — you can build and troubleshoot, not just spec requirements for someone else.
Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with experience building forecast, capacity, or compensation models.
Demonstrated ability to work independently across ambiguous, cross-functional problems and drive them to resolution.
Excellent communication skills — comfortable presenting analysis and recommendations to senior leadership.
Experience with a modern GTM stack (Salesforce plus tools like Clay, Clari, Gong, Apollo, or similar).
 Nice to Have 
Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup, building RevOps processes from scratch rather than maintaining existing ones.
Exposure to enterprise/strategic sales motions and long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals.
Design and run structured experiments to test new GTM approaches: new segments, new channels, new acquisition or expansion motions
 Compensation 
We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full-time role is $175,000 - $300,000 plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.
 Why You Should Join Us 
Traversal is a place to take on hard, meaningful problems with real ownership from day one. You’ll work alongside people who challenge you to grow, learn constantly, and help define a new category of infrastructure software. We think long term, move quickly, and hold a high bar without taking ourselves too seriously.
We offer competitive salary and equity packages, health insurance, fertility benefits, a great tech setup stipend and flexible time off. Plus in-office snacks, team happy hours and outings, an annual company offsite, and plenty of built in time to collaborate across teams.

You will play a critical role in translating product decisions into GTM requirements, identifying cross-functional dependencies, coordinating operational readiness, and ensuring the end-to-end customer and seller experience works as intended. This role sits at the intersection of product and commercial execution, giving you broad exposure across the business and the opportunity to improve how we bring increasingly complex products and commercial models to market.
You will serve as a critical connection point between Product and the teams responsible for bringing product changes to market, ensuring teams are aligned and operationally ready for launch. You will also help build and scale the GTM Readiness capability, creating clearer processes, identifying dependencies earlier, reducing launch friction, and enabling teams to move faster and execute with greater confidence.
 Responsibilities
Own GTM readiness for product and commercial changesincluding new product launches, pricing and packaging changes, new SKUs, migrations, deprecations, and changes to routes to market.
Translate product decisions into commercial and operational requirements across areas such as product catalog, pricing and approvals, contracting, Salesforce/CPQ, billing and ordering, provisioning and entitlements, compensation, reporting, and customer lifecycle.
Partner with Product teams early in the development lifecycle to understand upcoming changes, identify impacted GTM motions, and establish the decisions, owners, dependencies, and lead times required for readiness.
Orchestrate cross-functional readiness across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Enablement, GTM Technology, and other impacted teams, while maintaining clear accountability with the teams that own individual decisions and deliverables.
Drive end-to-end operational validationdefining critical business scenarios and ensuring appropriate owners validate the complete customer and seller experience across quoting, ordering, provisioning, billing, reporting, renewal, support, and other applicable workflows.
Identify and manage readiness riskssurfacing unresolved decisions, dependencies, and operational gaps early and driving them toward resolution or explicit risk acceptance before launch.
Improve the GTM Readiness operating model by creating reusable processes, launch patterns, requirements frameworks, and automation that reduce manual coordination and make future launches faster and more predictable.
 Requirements
At least 8 years of overall professional experience.
5+ years of experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Business Systems, or another role supporting complex cross-functional GTM initiatives.
Demonstrated experience supporting product launches, pricing/packaging changes, commercial model changes, or other initiatives requiring coordination between Product and GTM teams.
Working knowledge of core SaaS commercial processes, including multiple areas such as opportunity-to-order, quoting/CPQ, pricing, contracting, billing, provisioning, renewals, compensation, or customer lifecycle management.
Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous product or business needs into clear operational requirements, dependencies, decisions, and execution plans.
Experience independently coordinating complex initiatives across Product, Technology, Finance, Legal, Sales, and other business functions without direct authority over participating teams.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to understand how a change in one part of the commercial lifecycle can affect downstream processes, systems, data, and customer experiences.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience documenting requirements, facilitating cross-functional decisions, communicating risks, and driving clarity among stakeholders with different priorities.
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience working in a B2B SaaS or subscription-based business with multiple products, customer segments, or routes to market.
Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, billing, commerce, provisioning, entitlement, or other systems supporting the quote-to-cash/customer lifecycle.
Experience designing or improving product launch, commercialization, or GTM readiness processes rather than solely executing within an established process.
Experience supporting products sold through multiple motions, such as self-service, direct sales, channel, reseller, or partner ecosystems.
Familiarity with automation and AI capabilities that can simplify requirements gathering, dependency management, testing, and operational readiness.
Durable Skills
 Skills
 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:
Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.
To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.
 Compensation
 The range listed above is the expected annual salary/OTE (On-Target Earnings) for this role, subject to change.
Salary/OTE is just one component of Dropbox’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for the corporate bonus program or a sales incentive (target included in OTE) as well as stock in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).
 Company Description
 Read more about our benefits here.
Dropbox isn’t just a workplace—it’s a living lab for designing a more enlightened way of working. We’re a global community of bold visionaries and resourceful doers shaping the future of Dropbox and, in turn, the future of work. Our Virtual First model combines the autonomy of a distributed workplace with the power of human connection, creating space for meaningful work and lasting relationships. With a startup mindset and enterprise-level opportunities, we expect Dropbox employees to think critically, stay curious, and use modern tools, including AI, to improve how work gets done. Here, you can be who you are and grow into who you’re meant to be. You own your impact, helping make work more intuitive, joyful, and human for yourself and hundreds of millions of people worldwide. If you’re ready to push boundaries and challenge yourself, Dropbox is ready for you.
 Team Description
 The Company Strategy & Operations team (CS&O) is part of the Office of the CEO (OCEO). We partner with Dropbox’s most senior leaders to drive the CEO’s vision forward by bringing focus and structure to the company’s most important work. Our team combines strategic thinking with strong operations — we ask the right questions, navigate ambiguity, and partner with teams to help maintain alignment. Whether we’re shaping strategy, managing operating rhythms, or driving cross-functional collaboration, we do it with clarity, humility, and impact. If you thrive in complexity and enjoy building alongside others — you’ll find your people here.
 Virtual First
 Dropbox’s Virtual First way of working is designed to help people do their best work with flexibility, autonomy, and connection. Day to day, teams work remotely with nonlinear schedules and core collaboration hours that support deep focus and individual working styles. We prioritize asynchronous communication to improve clarity, respect deep work time, and reduce unnecessary meetings. While remote work is the primary experience for our employees, we also prioritize intentional, in-person connection. We bring teams together through regular team gatherings, on-demand workspaces, and Dropbox Neighborhood events in order to strengthen team cohesion, foster creativity, and enhance momentum. Virtual First is built to provide the same access to opportunity, growth, and impact for everyone, regardless of location.
This role requires travel to offsites and various other team gatherings (approximately 5-10% of the year or 2-3 days per quarter). We provide advance notice when possible and encourage candidates to discuss any accommodation needs during the interview process.
 AI Fluency
 AI fluency is a core part of how we work and grow. It’s not about being an expert—it’s about using these tools thoughtfully and effectively to improve your work and support others.
 We Look For Four Key Behaviors In Candidates
Ownership: You use AI responsibly by protecting data, applying sound judgment, and taking accountability for the quality and accuracy of your work.
Experimentation: You explore new AI capabilities and apply them to improve workflows within approved tools and practices.
Leverage: You use AI to enhance thinking, improve efficiency, and increase your impact and your team’s.
Learning: You stay current on emerging AI tools and trends, continuously build your skills, and share what you learn with others.
Together, these behaviors help build a workforce where technology amplifies human judgment, creativity, and impact.
Dropbox supports responsible use of AI for preparation, but misrepresentation of skills or experience is not permitted. To learn more, see our approach to AI in hiring.
Dropbox is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

The ideal candidate combines business process expertise, systems thinking, and workflow automation experience to build scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, standardize operations, and enable business growth.

 Translate business requirements into automation designs that align with organizational standards and long-term scalability.

 Evaluate existing processes and identify opportunities to eliminate or reduce manual work through automation and orchestration.
 Develop future-state workflow designs that improve operational efficiency and user experience.
Business Process Improvement

 Facilitate process discovery sessions and document current-state and future-state workflows.

Solution Delivery

Governance & Standards

 Experience working in high-growth SaaS or enterprise technology organizations.

title: Senior GTM Engineer
description:
About Us 
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.
 The Role 
Perk is building a modern, AI-powered outbound and pipeline generation motion in close partnership with Sales and Marketing leadership. The Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering function sits at the centre of this transformation, designing and operating the data infrastructure, Clay-based enrichment systems, and AI-driven workflows that enable our revenue teams to execute at scale.
This is not a traditional RevOps or systems admin role. The Senior GTM Engineer is a hands-on builder: someone who constructs sophisticated Clay workflows from scratch, engineers AI-powered enrichment pipelines, and translates signal-based prospecting strategies into production-ready systems. As AI continues to reshape B2B sales, this role is responsible for staying ahead of the curve and identifying where LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent automation can replace manual effort and improve outbound precision.
The role reports to the Senior Manager, Revenue Systems, and works closely with the central GTM Engineering team, Revenue Operations, and Sales leadership. It offers a direct, visible impact on how Perk builds and scales its commercial engine.
 What You’ll Do 
 Clay Engineering & AI-Powered Outbound Infrastructure 
Own the design, build, and maintenance of Clay tables, waterfall enrichment flows, and AI column logic that power Perk's outbound engine.
Engineer multi-step Clay workflows using webhooks, HTTP API integrations, and conditional branching to automate account and contact sourcing at scale.
Build and iterate on AI prompt layers within Clay using LLM columns to generate personalised outreach snippets, research account context, and qualify leads programmatically.
Construct and maintain signal-based prospecting systems that ingest buying triggers (hiring signals, funding events, intent data) and route them into prioritised Clay tables for Sales activation.
Integrate Clay with Salesforce, Outreach, and data providers (Clearbit, Apollo, LinkedIn, PredictLeads, and others) to maintain clean, enriched, and timely GTM data.
 AI Workflow Design & Automation 
Evaluate and implement AI tooling, including LLM-based research agents, AI SDRs, and prompt-engineered enrichment flows, to scale outbound relevance without scaling headcount.
Design and maintain Outreach sequences that incorporate AI-generated personalisation, ensuring high-volume dialling and email campaigns feel 1:1 at scale.
Identify and automate repetitive GTM operations (list building, data hygiene, routing, deduplication) using Clay, Make, and custom API scripts.
Maintain a working knowledge of the AI GTM vendor landscape and bring forward well-reasoned recommendations on new tooling.
 Data Quality & Enrichment Architecture 
Own TAM sourcing and enrichment workflows, building waterfall logic that sequences providers (e.g. Clearbit -> Fullenrich -> LinkedIn) to maximise contact coverage and data completeness. This includes engineering matching logic and scoring systems to accurately identify net-new accounts against existing CRM data (using identifiers like domain, LinkedIn, and country) before routing them to Sales.
Maintain accurate account and contact data across Salesforce and connected GTM tools, with automated hygiene rules to catch decay before it reaches Sales.
Define and enforce data quality standards for ICP segmentation, territory assignment, and pipeline attribution.
 GTM Systems & Sales Productivity 
Configure and maintain the core GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Clay) to support high-volume outbound activity and ambitious pipeline targets.
Partner directly with Sales to diagnose productivity bottlenecks and build systems solutions, from routing logic to sequence architecture to dialler integrations.
Rapidly troubleshoot system and workflow failures to minimise lost selling time during core business hours.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Roadmap Execution 
Serve as the primary systems contact for Revenue Systems and GTM Engineering support, owning issue resolution end-to-end.
Execute against the Revenue Systems roadmap in partnership with the Senior Manager and central GTM Engineering team.
Share learnings, workflow templates, and Clay builds with the global GTM Engineering team to drive consistency and compound improvement across regions.
Provide ground-level feedback to inform roadmap prioritisation, surfacing patterns in what's breaking, slowing, or blocking revenue teams.
 What We’re Looking For 
 Must-Have 
6+ years in GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS environment, with a strong technical orientation.
Hands-on Clay expertise; you have built complex Clay tables, waterfall enrichment flows, webhook integrations, and AI column prompts in a production environment, not just experimented with the tool.
Direct experience applying AI to GTM workflows: prompt engineering for LLM-based enrichment, AI-powered personalisation at scale, or building/evaluating AI SDR tooling.
Salesforce proficiency: building and maintaining custom objects, flows, reports, and data integrity logic.
Familiarity with sales engagement platforms (Outreach or SalesLoft) and their integration with CRM and enrichment tooling.
Ability to work with APIs, webhooks, and lightweight automation tools (Make, Zapier, or equivalent) without requiring engineering support for every integration.
Strong data instincts: you build systems that keep data clean, catch decay early, and ensure Sales always operates from a high-quality foundation.
 Strong Advantage 
Experience building signal-based outbound systems using intent data, hiring signals, or funding triggers surfaced through Clay or similar infrastructure.
Familiarity with data providers in the GTM stack: Clearbit, Apollo, PredictLeads, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Bombora, or similar.
Exposure to Gong data and using conversation intelligence to inform outbound strategy or sequence design.
Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment.
 What We Offer 
Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk
Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex
Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva
Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen
Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence
Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus
Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party
Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones
Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave
Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes
Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year
Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards
Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years
Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support
 AI at Perk 
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.
 How We Work 
At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.
For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.
Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
 Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 
All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Customer Success based in Ireland.
 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role responsible for shaping the entire post-sale customer experience within a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment. You will own retention, expansion, and adoption outcomes while developing the strategies and systems that support sustainable customer growth. Working closely with senior leadership, you will combine strategic direction with direct involvement in key customer relationships. You will lead and develop an expanding Customer Success team while establishing scalable playbooks across onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to build the Customer Success function during an important stage of company growth. Success will be measured through meaningful business outcomes, customer value, and recurring revenue rather than activity alone.
Accountabilities
Own overall Customer Success strategy and execution, with direct accountability for retention, expansion, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and churn outcomes.
Drive customer adoption by increasing both the breadth and depth of product usage across the customer base.
Coach, enable, and actively support the Customer Success team, stepping directly into strategic accounts when intervention or additional leadership is required.
Lead, develop, and scale the Customer Success organization as the business grows, including hiring and onboarding future team members.
Build and continuously refine a scalable Customer Success playbook covering onboarding, adoption, success planning, renewal, and expansion.
Establish customer success plans, health-scoring frameworks, account-management standards, and repeatable processes tied to measurable retention and expansion outcomes.
Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to communicate customer needs, surface opportunities, and represent the voice of the customer.
Maintain accurate visibility into customer health, risks, opportunities, and performance through HubSpot or comparable CRM systems.
Proactively identify accounts at risk as well as expansion opportunities, developing practical and actionable recommendations for leadership.
Build a culture of ownership and customer value, ensuring processes and team activity remain closely connected to business outcomes.
Use customer insights and performance data to continuously improve the Customer Success operating model.
 Requirements
Proven leadership experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, including direct people-management responsibility.
Demonstrated experience owning retention and expansion metrics and coaching teams toward measurable commercial outcomes.
Hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to personally engage with strategic accounts while developing the team to operate effectively at scale.
Experience building, improving, or scaling Customer Success processes within an early-stage or high-growth company.
Strong understanding of the complete customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion, and account management.
Consultative and customer-focused mindset, with the ability to ask thoughtful questions, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.
Highly autonomous and proactive, able to identify priorities independently and take ownership without requiring extensive direction.
Strong proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.
Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
Exceptional written and spoken English.
Experience with customer health-scoring or Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Vitally, or similar tools is an advantage.
Familiarity with partner-led or channel-influenced Customer Success models is a plus.
 Benefits
Opportunity to build and lead a Customer Success organization within a rapidly growing SaaS environment.
Direct collaboration with founders and senior leadership on customer strategy and organizational development.
Significant ownership and autonomy in shaping Customer Success processes, playbooks, and team structures.
Exposure to strategic customer relationships and the opportunity to influence retention and expansion outcomes directly.
Entrepreneurial, low-ego working environment focused on ownership, execution, and measurable customer value.
Opportunity to work within an AI-native technology environment focused on modernizing partnership operations.
Remote work arrangement, with working hours aligned to the U.S. East Coast.
Opportunity for professional growth and leadership development as the organization scales.
Exposure to a broad range of B2B SaaS customer challenges and partner-focused business models.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
As our Head of Revenue Operations (RevOps), you'll bridge strategy and execution, combining strong analytical skills with commercial acumen to help leadership understand what's working, what's not, and what to do next.
Reporting to the VP Operations, you'll work with a high degree of autonomy and partner closely with the CRO (through the Chief of Staff) and the CFO. You'll lead two RevOps Managers—one focused on new business and one on expansion—and collaborate closely with the DataOps team on systems and technical implementation.
This role is built around three core strengths: business insight —turning data into meaningful recommendations; translation —connecting leadership priorities with day-to-day execution; and strategic operations —owning the metrics, cadences, and processes that drive commercial performance.
 Working closely with the Chief of Staff to the CRO , you'll provide the analytical backbone behind our commercial strategy. While they drive GTM strategy and cross-functional execution, you'll ensure decisions are backed by clear insights, robust business cases, and performance tracking that keeps the organization aligned and accountable.
 Your 12-month journey 
 First 3 months: Immerse yourself in the business. Understand the ARR snowball, funnel mechanics, key commercial levers, and the stakeholder landscape across new business and expansion. Build strong relationships with the CRO’s Chief of Staff, Finance leadership, and GTM team leads. Take ownership of the reporting cadence and QBR preparation. Start cross-checking numbers with the teams — get to a level of data confidence that doesn’t exist today.
 First 6 months: Own the full operating rhythm: weekly forecast and business reviews, monthly deep-dives, quarterly business reviews. Deliver improved pipeline health tracking and ARR analysis. Present your first strategic recommendations on territory coverage, commission impact, or forecast adjustments. Be able to produce a reforecast on the fly based on your understanding of the business.
 First 12 months: Leadership relies on your analysis to make headcount, territory, and investment decisions. You’ve built the business cases that shaped this year’s commercial strategy. If we want to grow from 15% to 20%, you’re the first person we go to for where to allocate that growth.
 What you’ll be doing 
 Business insights & analytical ownership (~50% of your time): This is your primary mandate. You are the person who is kept awake at night until the numbers are clear and understood. Own the analytical layer that drives leadership decisions: ARR dynamics, cohort analysis, pipeline velocity, conversion patterns, churn drivers, NRR, GRR, CAC ratios — per dimension, per segment. You don’t just build reports; you interpret them, cross-check them with the teams, flag anomalies, and push the organization to act. When something unexpected happens — an unusual churn spike, a self-service trend shift, an expansion initiative underperforming — you’re the one who digs in and comes back with an explanation and a recommendation.
 Operating cadence & accountability (~40% with GTM teams): Design and run the commercial operating rhythm in partnership with the Chief of Staff. Own the weekly forecast and business review cadence, monthly analysis cycles, QBRs (with the right metrics and the right view), and budget/reforecasting processes. You set the expectations, prepare the materials, track initiative efficiency (A/B testing, dashboarding), and ensure follow-through. When a reforecast is needed, you flag it and drive it.
 Translation & strategic recommendations: You are the translator between the ground and the top. You turn field-level signals into structured insights for Ops leadership and the CRO team. You translate corporate objectives and the Ops roadmap into priorities and actions for the GTM teams. You build business cases that support key commercial decisions: commission scheme design, territory adjustments, growth allocation, capacity planning.
 Team leadership: Lead and develop two RevOps Managers — one dedicated to new business, one to expansion. Ensure they operate with the same level of analytical rigor and business understanding you bring. Coach them to become strong business partners to the GTM leaders they support.
 Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with the Chief of Staff to the CRO on QBR preparation, performance intelligence, and strategic initiatives. Partner with the DataOps team for system architecture, integrations, and technical builds. Collaborate with Finance on unit economics, budget tracking, and reforecasting.
 What you bring 
 We’re looking for someone who has been the #1 RevOps / Business Operations leader in a B2B SaaS company in the €50m–€100m ARR range, or a strong #2 in a larger organization (€100m–€250m ARR). You lead with business judgment and analytical depth — not systems administration. 
 Must-haves 
Proven experience leading a RevOps or Business Operations function end-to-end in B2B SaaS, with direct ownership of business metrics and commercial cadences.
Deep understanding of recurring revenue models, ARR mechanics, and commercial finance: NRR, GRR, CAC ratios, commissions, capacity planning, unit economics.
Obsessive analytical rigor: you cross-check, you dig in, you don’t stop until the numbers tell a coherent story. You can produce a reforecast on the go.
Proven track record of producing analytical work that drives executive decisions — business cases, scenario models, strategic recommendations — not just dashboards.
Strong stakeholder management: you present to C-levels, challenge assumptions, and hold commercial leaders accountable. You do this through credibility and data, not authority.
Experience designing and running operating cadences: weekly business reviews, QBRs, forecast cycles. You know what good looks like and you enforce it.
Team management experience: you’ve built or led a small RevOps team and can develop people.
English at C2 level. Fluency in Dutch or French is a strong advantage.
 Nice-to-haves 
Experience with HubSpot, Planhat, Modjo, or Qobra.
Familiarity with BI tools (Metabase or similar) and SQL — enough to pull your own analysis autonomously.
Exposure to data engineering concepts (dbt, data warehousing) — enough to collaborate with a DataOps team.
Awareness of how AI is evolving the ops operating model.
Experience working across multiple European geographies (NL, FR, DE).
What we offer
Flexibility to work from home and from our canal side office in Amsterdam
A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe
Work in a diverse and multicultural team
€1,500 annual training budget plus internal training
Pension plan, travel reimbursement, and wellness perks
28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax
Work from anywhere for 4 weeks/year
Apple MacBook and tools
€200 home office budget
 This role can be both based in Amsterdam, The Netherlands or Paris, France. Benefits can differ based on location. 
 About Tellent 
Tellent is a Talent Management Suite that helps organizations attract, hire, manage, and grow their people. Our platform combines Applicant Tracking, HRIS, and Performance Management solutions used by 7,000+ companies across 100+ countries.
With 250+ employees across Europe, we’re building intuitive and scalable HR technology that helps companies create better employee experiences.
 AI in our recruitment process 
We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement , check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.
 If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we’re happy to help.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Ben jij een strategische gesprekspartner die kansen ziet voordat de klant ze zelf ziet? Krijg jij energie van het bouwen aan langdurige klantrelaties én het realiseren van resultaten? Dan hebben wij een mooie uitdaging voor jou!
Wij zijn namelijk op zoek naar een Customer Success Manager.
 Over Dynamic People 
Geen standaard club, geen standaard projecten. We zijn een hecht team van consultants, developers en strategen die werken met de nieuwste Microsoft-technologieën. Samen bouwen we slimme oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken.
Met onze diepgaande businesskennis en expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP & CRM), Power Platform, Azure, Data en AI, begeleiden we organisaties van strategie tot en met implementatie en beheer.
Onze cultuur? Ondernemend, gedreven en wij werken samen. Wij doen dit elke dag met veel plezier, geen onnodige bureaucratie, maar korte lijnen, veel verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. We vieren successen samen en geloven dat onze mensen het verschil maken.
 Jouw uitdaging 
Als Customer Success Manager ben jij dé schakel tussen de klanten, organisatie en onze dienstverlening. Je begrijpt de ambities van de klant, vertaalt deze naar concrete oplossingen en services en zorgt ervoor dat klanten blijvend waarde halen uit hun Dynamics 365-omgeving.
Je voert strategische gesprekken, ontwikkelt klant-roadmaps en brengt als regisseur de juiste mensen samen om kansen te realiseren. title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
description:
GTM Operations & Strategy at MongoDB is a global team of builders and innovators focused on unleashing MongoDB’s sales greatness by pairing world‑class analytics with scalable operations. Within GTM Operations, the GTM Intelligence – Applied Science team turns complex GTM data into tools, models, and insights that help our sales organization make better, faster decisions across our people, segmentation, territory design, forecasting, and account prioritization.
As a Senior Analyst on the Applied Science team, you will own high‑impact analytical workstreams end‑to‑end: from problem framing with senior GTM stakeholders, to data engineering and model design, through to productionalized workflows, dashboards, and executive‑ready narratives that drive concrete changes in the field. This role is based in Dublin, Ireland and supports a global stakeholder set across regions and GTM functions.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.
What You’ll Do
Translate GTM questions into analytical projects
Partner with GTM Ops, Sales Strategy & Planning, Sales Leadership, and Central Analytics to scope problems, define success criteria, and prioritize work across areas like segmentation, territory design, account prioritization, and pipeline/forecast health.
Structure ambiguous questions into hypotheses, analytical plans, and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders (SVPs, RVPs, functional leaders).
Design and build scalable analytics & models
Develop and maintain statistical and machine learning models (e.g., NARR prediction, deal qualification, account momentum, workload identification) that inform forecast expectations, territory assignments, and deal prioritization.
Engineer robust data pipelines and features (SQL/Python) on top of our GTM data stack (Salesforce, product usage, call transcripts, marketing signals, etc.) in partnership with data and platform teams.
Own core GTM analytics assets
Contribute to flagship programs such as Forecasting 3.0 / Atlas Forecasting Calculator, Customer 360 Revamp, GTM Metrics 3.0, and territory optimization initiatives, ensuring they are statistically sound, explainable, and operationally durable.
Build and govern self-serve analytics assets (e.g., Sigma workbooks, curated datasets) that allow GTM stakeholders to answer their own questions safely and consistently.
Turn analysis into decisions and change
Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (memos, scorecards, and QBR/MBR content) that highlight trade‑offs and explicit recommendations, not just data and charts.
Run stakeholder working sessions to align on scenarios, validate model outcomes, and embed recommendations into operating rhythms (e.g., segmentation reviews, annual planning, forecast calls).
Advance our GTM data & AI foundations
Help shape and exploit new GTM data sources such as call transcript modeling, workload inference, and account intelligence to unlock novel scoring and routing use cases.
Partner with Central Analytics and GTM Tech on best practices for testing, monitoring, documentation, and change management for GTM models and analytics products.
Coach, document, and uplevel the org
Create clear documentation, playbooks, and training to help other analysts and GTM stakeholders understand and safely use the models, tools, and datasets you own.
Contribute to a strong culture of technical rigor, peer review, and knowledge sharing within Sales Intelligence and the broader GTM Operations community.
What We’re Looking For
 Experience
~4–7+ years in analytics, sales operations, data science, or strategy/consulting roles supporting B2B or SaaS go‑to‑market teams (or equivalent high‑impact analytical experience).
Demonstrated track record owning complex analytics projects end‑to‑end (from scoping through production deployment and stakeholder adoption), ideally in forecasting, segmentation/territory design, or account/deal scoring domains.
Experience working directly with senior commercial stakeholders (e.g., Sales/GTM leaders) and turning analysis into concrete decisions and measurable business impact.
Technical Skills
Advanced SQL and strong Python (or equivalent) for data wrangling, feature engineering, and statistical / ML modeling.
Comfort working with large, messy datasets spanning CRM (Salesforce), product usage, and marketing/sales engagement tools.
Experience with at least one modern BI / analytics environment (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Tableau) and building self‑serve, governed assets for business users.
Solid grounding in statistical thinking (sampling, backtesting, lift/impact measurement) and model validation practices.
Problem‑Solving & Communication
Ability to decompose ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans, with clear assumptions, risks, and trade‑offs.
Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain complex models and data decisions in simple, GTM‑friendly language and build trust with non‑technical stakeholders.
Bias toward action and ownership: you are comfortable making recommendations under uncertainty and iterating as new data arrives.
Nice to Have
Prior experience in Sales Operations / Revenue Operations or GTM Strategy at a high‑growth SaaS company.
Experience with forecasting and timeseries models, or commercial applications of NLP / LLMs (e.g., call transcript analytics, opportunity notes analysis).
Familiarity with MongoDB’s ecosystem (Atlas, GTM motions, sales process) or similar modern cloud data platforms.
Experience contributing to cross‑functional programs such as Customer 360, self‑serve analytics initiatives, or GTM data/metrics standardization.
 About MongoDB
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Go-To-Market Lead — Working Capital Solutions
description:
Position Type
 Full time
 Type Of Hire
 Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)
At FIS, our technology and our people are moving forward. We advance the way the world pays, banks and invests. We build inclusive, diverse teams that help our colleagues, clients and communities succeed. If you are ready to make an impact in fintech and help scale a high-growth working capital business, we have one question~ Are you FIS?
 About The Role
 We are seeking a commercially minded Go-To-Market Lead to help accelerate growth across FIS’s Working Capital Solutions (Platform) proposition. The role sits at the centre of sales, marketing, product, business development and leadership, turning strategy into disciplined execution. You will define the operating rhythm, sharpen messaging, build and improve sales collateral, support seller enablement, and create measurable campaigns that increase market engagement, seller participation and pipeline coverage.
 What You Will Be Doing
Build and run the GTM operating framework for Working Capital Solutions (Platform), translating commercial priorities into clear campaigns, targets, actions, owners and cadence. 
Increase seller engagement and cross-sell penetration across the Lending sales organisation by creating clear rules of engagement, practical enablement and consistent follow-up with sellers and sales managers. 
Strengthen sales messaging and collateral by taking stock of existing material, assessing whether it is fit for purpose, identifying gaps and coordinating the creation of sharper pitch decks, use-case narratives, scripts and client-facing content. 
Drive measurable pipeline outcomes by tracking weekly activity, introductions, campaign performance, pipeline evolution and conversion, with a focus on improving corporate pipeline coverage and execution discipline. 
Develop targeted campaigns for platform clients, focused on segmentation between Tier 1 customers and the emerging opportunity with smaller to mid sized banks 
Activate partner-led channels with consulting firms and other intermediaries by developing scripts, engagement models, collateral and conversion processes that turn advisory relationships into qualified opportunities. 
Improve direct marketing and business development execution, including outbound campaign design, inbound follow-up, website and digital messaging, trade show preparation, LinkedIn activity and coordination between business development and sellers. 
Use tools, data and AI-enabled content platforms to improve targeting, campaign execution, content creation and performance measurement, including better adoption of available sales enablement platforms. 
Work closely with key stakeholders across corporate sales, Working Capital Solutions specialists, marketing, product and leadership to ensure priorities are aligned and execution remains focused on the highest-value opportunities. 
 What You Will Need
Experience in go-to-market execution, commercial strategy, sales enablement, business development or marketing within financial services, fintech, enterprise software or B2B solutions. 
A practical understanding of working capital solutions, ideally including supply chain finance, receivables finance, treasury, corporate finance or Lending-led propositions. 
Strong commercial discipline, with the ability to turn broad growth objectives into specific campaigns, activity targets, operating cadence and measurable outcomes. 
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence working across sales, marketing, product, senior management and partner organisations. 
Ability to create, review and improve sales collateral, messaging, scripts and enablement material for different audiences and use cases. 
Comfort using CRM, sales enablement, digital marketing and data tools to manage activity, monitor performance and improve execution. 
A proactive, structured and outcome-oriented style, with the confidence to bring discipline to teams, challenge current ways of working and maintain momentum. 
 Success In This Role Will Look Like
A clear, documented GTM plan with defined campaigns, target segments, actions, owners and reporting cadence. 
Materially higher seller engagement across the Lending organisation, supported by better messaging, collateral and manager involvement. 
Improved visibility of campaign performance, introductions, qualified opportunities and pipeline progression. 
A stronger and more consistent market-facing narrative for Working Capital Solutions (Platform) across corporate and partner-led channels. 
A more disciplined, repeatable approach to business development, direct marketing and cross-sell execution. 
 What We Offer You
 At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer~
Opportunities to innovate in fintech 
Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere 
Professional and personal development 
Resources to contribute to your community 
Competitive salary and benefits 
 Privacy Statement
 FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
 Sourcing Model
 Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: GTM Enablement Lead
description:
About Nscale
 Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers.
Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.
We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that will power the future.
By joining our global comms team and working closely with the global policy and Norwegian team, you will be part of a fast-scaling company that sits at the intersection of green energy and cutting-edge technology, helping us tell the story of how Nscale is powering the next generation of intelligence.
 About The Role
 You are the boots-on-the-ground, tactical coach for our GTM team. You are the crucial execution layer on designing the global curriculum and overarching strategy. You will take the V1 playbooks, field-test them in live combat, localize them for the specific dynamics of the market, and drive absolute adoption across the floor. You will sit side-by-side with Account Executives, Deal Strategists, and technical sellers to hone their pitches, dissect their pipeline, and accelerate their deal velocity. In this role, you are the vital feedback loop between the reality of what the market is demanding today and what our global enablement materials are teaching.
 Responsibilities
Content Localization & Adaptation: Take core Nscale messaging and tailor it specifically for market dynamics. You will build localized competitive intelligence profiles for competitors highly active in your region and adapt pitch decks accordingly.
Pipeline Interventions: Analyze regional CRM data to identify where deals are systematically stalling (e.g., at the technical validation stage or legal review). You will proactively build and deploy rapid-response training workshops to unblock the pipeline.
Continuous Field Education: Run regular, highly tactical "lunch and learns," rigorous role-play sessions, and micro-learning modules to ensure the team's technical knowledge and competitive edge remain razor-sharp.
Onboarding Execution: Partner closely with the field to facilitate the local execution of the onboarding bootcamp, ensuring new hires ramp quickly and hit their productivity milestones.
 You May Be a Good Fit If You Have
5+ years of experience in sales enablement, product marketing, or as a successful quota-carrying Account Executive in the enterprise tech, cloud, or infrastructure space.
Deep empathy for the immense pressures of a complex, high-stakes sales process. You know exactly how to deliver critical, corrective feedback in a way that builds psychological safety, earns trust, and elevates overall performance.
The intellectual agility to rapidly absorb complex AI infrastructure concepts—like liquid cooling efficiency and data gravity—and translate them into simple, compelling business value for sellers to articulate.
A proactive, self-starting nature. You don't wait for direction; you naturally dive into and analyze crm data, identify a weakness in the pitch, and independently build the solution to fix it.

title: GTM Systems Administrator
description:
Why Harvey
 At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
 Role Overview
 Harvey is building a best-in-class go-to-market engine, and we're looking for a GTM Systems Administrator to join the GTM Systems team and help scale the systems that power both our pipeline and our customer experience. You'll take on a variety of projects across the full GTM lifecycle, from how we source, enrich, and route leads at the top of the funnel to how we support and engage customers through Zendesk and our Customer Success platforms. This is not a traditional RevOps or Salesforce admin role: we expect this person to work AI-first, using AI tools and agents to build, automate, and maintain systems that would traditionally require engineering support or manual admin work. Reporting to the Head of GTM Systems, you'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success to translate business needs into scalable, reliable systems that directly drive revenue and retention outcomes.
 What You'll Do
Work across a variety of projects on the GTM Systems team, with some sprints focused on top-of-funnel growth and others on support and customer success tooling, flexing to where the business needs you most.
Design and improve top-of-funnel systems including lead sourcing, enrichment, scoring, and routing, building enrichment workflows in Clay and across data providers (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.) to power inbound and outbound pipeline.
Configure and optimize Zendesk as Harvey's primary support platform (ticket routing, triggers, automations, macros, SLA policies, agent workspace) and support adjacent CS platforms like Catalyst.
Contribute to Salesforce configuration across the funnel, including lead routing, scoring, lifecycle stages, and automation (Flows, validation rules, custom objects), and how data flows across Salesforce, marketing automation, support, and enrichment tools.
Use AI as a default working method: build and maintain AI agents, automations, and workflows (AI triage, copilots, agent-based enrichment, LLM-powered data quality checks) to eliminate manual admin work and extend what the systems team can ship without engineering support.
Integrate GTM and CS tools with Harvey's broader ecosystem (CRM, product data, internal tools, communication platforms) to ensure a unified view of the customer, and build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline conversion, support performance, and customer health.
Maintain high data quality and compliance through deduplication, normalization, enrichment governance, and consent/opt-out handling, and document system architecture, workflows, and processes so everything scales as the company grows.
 What You Have
4-8+ years of experience in GTM Systems, RevOps, Growth Ops, Support Ops, or similar roles.
Strong proficiency in Salesforce (data modeling, Flows, lead routing, account hierarchy, reporting) plus hands-on experience administering Zendesk (routing, automations, triggers, SLA policies), or deep expertise in one with proven ability to ramp fast on the other.
Hands-on experience with Clay and at least one major enrichment/data provider (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.), and experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).
Demonstrated AI fluency: you already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay AI, Zendesk AI, or similar) to build workflows, automate admin tasks, draft configurations, and troubleshoot, and you can point to concrete things you've shipped this way.
Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design and debug end-to-end data flows across tools, spanning both reactive support workflows and proactive growth motions.
A collaborative, team-first working style: comfortable operating in a pod, picking up varied projects, and working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Support, Customer Success, and Operations. Highly organized and documentation-oriented, with a focus on scalable, maintainable systems.
Bonus
Experience with Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, Catalyst) or Zendesk certification(s).
Experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, or iPaaS tools (Workato, Zapier, MuleSoft), or integrating GTM systems with data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).
Experience building or deploying AI agents in production (e.g., agentic prospecting, AI ticket triage, health-score automation)
Working knowledge of SQL and/or scripting (Python, JavaScript) for data workflows.
Background in high-growth or early-stage environments where systems are built from the ground up.

title: Go-to-Market Engineer
description:
Our everyday digital experiences are in the midst of a realtime revolution. Whether chatting alongside a livestreaming event, receiving realtime financial information, or working with colleagues in an online collaborative environment - consumers simply expect realtime digital experiences as standard. At Ably we’re not just witnessing this revolution, we’re powering it - at scale.
At the heart of our mission lies a commitment to putting developers first. Ably provides a suite of products to build, extend, and deliver powerful digital experiences in realtime, delivering billions of messages for millions of devices every day and supporting organizations like Harness, EA, Panasonic and HubSpot.
Working at Ably means helping to build the infrastructure and technology that will power and shape the future of the internet. The opportunity in front of us is immense. And we’d like your help.
 About this role
 As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you'll be the person who actually builds and owns the systems that make our commercial data and workflows trustworthy, not just report on where they're broken. Right now, responsibility for Ably's commercial data and workflows is split across a few people and tools, each doing good work in their own area, but nobody's holding the full picture end to end. That's what we want this person to own.
This role sits at the intersection of Sales, CS, Marketing and Data Engineering. This isn't scoped to one function: it's scoped to wherever the commercial systems gap is, whether that's a marketing lifecycle problem today or a sales automation problem tomorrow. You might build an agent that flags an ICP account the moment its usage crosses a threshold and drafts the first outreach, or a nightly job that reconciles HubSpot and Snowflake data so nobody's arguing about whose number is right.
You'll spend most of your time putting infrastructure in place: workflows, data pipelines, AI-driven enrichment and automation. The rest goes into using that infrastructure to find what's actually wrong and fix it: data quality audits, funnel and conversion analysis, and diagnosing gaps in our commercial systems wherever they show up.
This isn't a dashboards-on-request role. You won't be handed tickets and told what to build. We want someone who thinks like an owner: you see the gap before anyone else notices it, decide what's worth building, and go build it, not because something's on fire, but because you can see a better system than the one that exists today.
 Day to day, you will
 Build and own the systems, not just the outputs. The majority (~70%) of this role is building: automated workflows, data pipelines, lead scoring and routing logic, and AI-driven enrichment across our CRM, sales and marketing stack. You choose the stack and approach; we care about reliability, not which tool you picked. The other ~30% is using what you've built to run data quality audits, diagnose conversion issues and analyse performance.
 Automate where possible and fix broken or manual workflows wherever you find them. That might be Sales flagging something that isn't automated yet (prospecting, outreach, data hygiene), poor delivery, bounce or open rates on a nurture sequence, or a sales process still being done by hand. This role isn't scoped to marketing specifically, it's scoped to wherever the gap is.
 Share HubSpot's day-to-day upkeep, including Marketing Hub, as part of the team's rotation. This isn't an admin role, the job is building systems on top of HubSpot data, but routine maintenance is shared across the team.
 Run data quality audits. Validate enrichment accuracy across our vendors, spot-check that account and lead classification is actually correct, and dig into why a number's moved rather than shrugging it off.
 Own conversion and funnel tracking. Map where prospects drop off across our automated systems, from first touch through to deal, and turn that into something the business can actually act on.
 Be the connective tissue between commercial and data teams. Take requirements from stakeholders, translate them into a working system, and push back when a request is really a symptom of something else that needs fixing at the root.
 Use AI to operate at a scale one person shouldn't otherwise manage. You're comfortable building an AI-assisted enrichment or automation workflow largely unsupervised, and you instinctively reach for AI tooling to keep what you build self-sustaining rather than manually maintained.
 We'd love to talk if you have
Experience in Marketing Ops, Sales Ops, Revenue Ops or a similar cross-functional systems role, ideally with AI-driven or automated workflows already under your belt.
Comfort working across CRM platforms in general. We use HubSpot, but this role exists to build systems using HubSpot data, not to become its day-to-day maintainer. If you've worked deeply in Salesforce or another CRM, that transfers fine.
A track record of building things independently: given a data or workflow problem, you can pick an appropriate stack and build a working solution without being told how.
Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make or similar). This is a must, not a nice-to-have. You should be comfortable designing and shipping a multi-step automated workflow yourself, not just configuring templates.
You've built with LLMs beyond basic prompting: agentic workflows, custom AI tooling, MCP connections or similar. This is also a must, we want evidence you've built something an agent runs, not just used a chatbot for research.
A systems-thinking mindset and genuine analytical ability. You can look at delivery, bounce or open-rate data, or a lifecycle funnel, and diagnose why it looks the way it does, then fix the process that caused it rather than patch the symptom in front of you.
Comfort with ambiguity. You've got strong opinions and can hold your own view on what's worth fixing first, even when priorities aren't obvious or agreed.
 Bonus points if you have
Familiarity with the Claude stack specifically (Claude Code, Claude API, MCP). This is what we use internally, so prior exposure is preferred though not required.
Experience with lead lifecycle/funnel models (MQL, SAL, PQL, SQL) and how scoring and routing logic works in practice.
 What’s it like to work at Ably?
 We’re tackling planet-scale problems and our ambitions are a testament to that. You’ll join a successful, deeply motivated and collaborative team that thrives on innovation, experimentation and autonomy. To get a sense of life at Ably, visit our careers page. You can also read about the origins of Ably's core values on our blog.
We believe in fostering a culture that's built on inclusivity and mutual respect among all team members, and we recognise that each individual is different and will want to be supported in their role in different ways. We provide a range of perks and benefits to aid folks' development and wellbeing, allowing them to be their best selves and do great work.
A remote-first and flexible work environment. UK-based teams come together in person once per month in our London hub (next to Old Street) and we get together as a company twice per year. Aside from that, you’re welcome to work wherever suits best for you.
Equity. We’re a growing start-up and we want all team to members to share in the success of the company through our EMI share options programme.
Enhanced holiday allowance. Our policy provides Ablyans with 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).
Enhanced parental leave package, so that you can take the time you need to get to know your new family member, rest and recover.
Home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 p/a thereafter), so that your home office is set up to serve you well and that you have everything you need to work comfortably.
Personal learning and development budget of £1000 annually, and 5% L&D time during working hours to focus on improving your skillset.
Private healthcare with BUPA.
Medical cash plan to cover a range medical and dental costs.
Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.
Monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.
Life assurance and income protection.
Access to Tech & Cycle to Work schemes.
Weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week “Need To Know” meeting.
A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.
 Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Ably
 We believe our differences as individuals is what makes us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to creating long-term success as an organization. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to that opportunity.
 If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email; we’d be more than happy to give you some advice on your application.

title: Business Operations Manager - Marketplace
description:
About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We're the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world.
 Role Description:
 The Business Operations Manager drives processes and implements structure to ensure goal achievement, designing an effective rhythm of business and driving adoption of company-wide processes (Quarterly Operational Reviews, Strategic Portfolio Management, Planning and Budget).
In Marketplace, this means building the operating system for one of Europe's most complex technology departments — 1,500+ people across 11 Track Groups spanning Product, Engineering, Data & AI, Design, and Commercial. The decisions made through our planning cycles determine how a $15B+ company invests, prioritises, and delivers for hundreds of millions of travellers worldwide.
We are looking for a Business Operations Manager who will design and own that operating system. Not maintain an existing one — build a new one. The full cycle: quarterly planning, annual planning, performance governance, dependency management, and the portfolio trade-offs that determine where the department invests.
This is not a support role. You will architect the planning system, lead a team of 5, and operate daily at VP level — translating strategic intent into operational clarity for 11 Track Groups while holding an entire department accountable to shared timelines, quality standards, and decisions.
The decisions made through quarterly reviews, annual planning, and performance governance — what to invest in, what to stop, what to trade off — shape the trajectory of a business serving 28+ million accommodation listings and hundreds of millions of travellers. You will be at the centre of those decisions, helping a department move from reactive management to systematic, disciplined ways of working.
 Key Job Responsibilities and Duties:
 Operating System & System Design
Architect, implement, and maintain repeatable operating models that create predictability, horizontal visibility, and execution discipline across 1,500 people and 11 Track Groups.
Apply structured methodologies to implement an effective way of running business operations, making it easier for teams to achieve objectives. 
Positively and proactively contribute towards the craft, including being available to coach others, share best practices, or participate in cross-team projects.
 Process Excellence
Design and execute thoughtful, yet simple, processes to increase efficiency and productivity across the organisation, simplifying complex workflows where possible.
Drive adoption of standardised processes at scale — ensuring consistency across the department without killing speed.
 Governance & Cadence
Own the preparation, architecture, and facilitation of leadership business reviews (Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Performance Reviews, mid-year reviews) — ensuring the right decisions happen at the right time with the right information. Manage follow-up and ensure actions are tracked and delivered.
 Planning
Lead end-to-end annual, quarterly, and ad hoc planning processes for a 1,500-person department — from architecture through final CBO submission — in close collaboration with 11 Track Groups and FP&A for budget definition and resource allocation.
Manage cross-departmental dependencies with CBO, FP&A, and peer teams — operating as the single point of accountability.
Build the foundations to evolve planning into structured portfolio management — turning reviews into investment trade-off decisions.
 Performance Management
Design and implement the measurement, reporting, and analysis of performance (vs. KPIs), creating and automating reporting and performing analysis to deliver data-driven insights for executive decision-making.
 Stakeholder Management
Serve as a central point of contact and trusted partner across VPs, Directors, and cross-functional leadership — streamlining processes, fostering teamwork, and driving operational efficiency. 
Ability to influence and partner effectively up to (Senior) Director and VP level.
 Team Leadership
Lead and develop a team of 5 direct reports through sustained, high-pressure delivery cycles. People management is central to this role, not peripheral — fostering collaboration, alignment, and a high-performance, outcome-driven culture.
 Qualifications & Skills:
8–12 years of relevant business operations experience in strategic planning, program management, or operational leadership at a Tech or Marketplace company

System design thinking: you build operating models, not just run processes. You understand that at scale, velocity is a system design opportunity
VP-level stakeholder management in a matrix environment — including the ability to hold senior stakeholders accountable and make difficult conversations productive
Strong business and financial foundation — ability to leverage quantitative and qualitative data to drive executive decision-making and tell a clear story with insights
You can plan backwards from a final milestone, decomposing into workstreams, owners, and dependencies without being told how
Project management tooling at governance level — you have opinions on how tools should serve a large organisation
Executive communication: written and verbal, adapted to your audience. Ability to build lasting relationships across diverse domains
 Benefits & Perks : Global Impact, Personal Relevance

title: Strategy & GTM Lead
description:

We bring international payments, embedded finance, and more together into a single connection that simplifies operations and strengthens financial control. Measure enablement coverage and its link to win rate and productivity, feeding results into the commercial scorecard with Revenue Operations.
