The seniority and presence to lead a commercial function through transformation at pace, including leading, mentoring or building a team where the business needs it.
Desirable Skills

Content or creative fluency for producing sharp sales assets.
Experience with modern enablement tooling beyond HubSpot.

We offer hybrid working across our teams, balancing time in the office — for collaboration, events and the relationships that make work rewarding — with the flexibility to work remotely where roles allow.

title: Sales Support & Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Styx Intelligence is a fast\-growing cyber security company based in Vancouver on a mission to make the digital world safer. Our AI\-powered platform helps organizations protect what matters most \- their brand, executives, and digital assets \- by detecting and stopping threats like phishing, impersonation, data leaks, and even emerging risks fueled by generative AI. Backed by top\-tier venture investors, we’re building an all\-in\-one digital risk protection solution that brings together cutting\-edge technology, real\-time visibility, and automated takedowns.
At Styx Intelligence, we move quickly, think boldly, and work collaboratively. Joining our team means having the opportunity to shape the future of online security, solve meaningful challenges at scale, and grow alongside a company that’s just getting started.
**About the Role** 
We are looking for a highly organized, analytical, and commercially minded Sales Support \& Revenue Operations professional to help scale our SaaS revenue organization. Reporting to the CRO, the role will support this role will support and optimize the processes, systems, data, and tools that enable our sales team to operate efficiently and drive predictable growth.
This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, improving processes, and turning data into actionable insights. Working cross\-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Success, you will help build the operational foundation needed to support the company's next phase of growth.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Sales Operations \& Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day operational support to the sales organization and CRO.
* Manage and improve sales processes from lead generation through opportunity, quoting, contracting, and close.
* Ensure opportunities are properly documented and progressed through the CRM.
* Support account planning, opportunity management, proposals, presentations, and sales documentation.
* Support sales team with ARR (Net new), NRR (expansion) and GRR (renewal) initiatives to ensure continued expansion and retention of customer base.
* Coordinate sales meetings, pipeline reviews, QBRs, and revenue meetings.
* Maintain sales templates, pricing documents, proposal materials, and other sales resources.
* Partner with Sales to support customer meetings and follow\-up activities.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements to enhance sales productivity and scalability.
**Revenue Operations \& Reporting**
* Own the integrity and accuracy of revenue data across the CRM and supporting systems
* Develop and maintain standardized sales processes, operating procedures, and workflows to support scalable growth, reporting consistency, and operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics to provide visibility into pipeline performance, bookings, ARR, renewals, forecasting, and sales activity.
* Monitor key SaaS and revenue metrics, including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, win rates, average contract value, sales cycle length, forecast accuracy, and bookings performance.
* Establish consistent definitions and reporting for pipeline, qualified opportunities, forecast, bookings, ARR, and customer acquisition metrics.
* Partner with leadership to review pipeline health, identify risks, and improve forecasting accuracy.
* Support weekly, quarterly, and annual forecasting and revenue planning activities
* Support the administration, adoption, and optimization of CRM, reporting, sales engagement and other revenue technology platforms to improve user adoption, data quality, and operational effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, leverage technology, automate workflows, and reduce manual administrative effort across the revenue organization.
**Deal Desk \& Commercial Operations**
* Support the sales team through the quotation, proposal, and contracting process.
* Maintain the company's pricing structure and product/service catalog.
* Ensure approved pricing and SKUs are accurately reflected in the CRM and sales materials.
* Coordinate with Finance and Sales Leadership on pricing, discounts, contracts, and commercial approvals.
* Help identify pricing inconsistencies and margin/revenue leakage.
* Maintain standardized quote and proposal processes.
* Track closed\-won business and ensure accurate handoff to Finance, Customer Success, and Operations.
* Support renewal, expansion, and customer lifecycle processes through effective operational coordination and reporting.
**Qualifications** 
* 3\-6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Support, Business Operations, or a related SaaS environment.
* Strong understanding of SaaS sales processes, pipeline management, forecasting, and the metrics that drive revenue performance.
* Hands\-on experience working with CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce or similar, including maintaining data and supporting user adoption.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets, with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable business insights.
* Proven success developing reports, dashboards, and performance metrics that support decision\-making and provide visibility into revenue performance.
* A detail\-oriented and analytical approach, coupled with sound judgment and the ability to identify operational risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Customer Success, and Leadership teams.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment where priorities may evolve as the business scales.
* A continuous improvement mindset, with a natural curiosity for technology, process optimization, and scalable ways of working.
**Preferred Experience**
* Background in a B2B SaaS company or in a high\-growth technology environment is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with CRM administration, configuration, or optimization within Salesforce, HubSpot, or comparable platforms.
* Understanding of SaaS performance metrics such as ARR, MRR, GRR, bookings, customer retention, pipeline coverage, and forecast accuracy.
* Experience supporting executive reporting, strategic planning, or revenue review processes.
* A track record of identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enhance the effectiveness of revenue\-generating teams.
**What Success Looks Like** Within the first 6–12 months, this person will have:
* Established reliable reporting and dashboards that provide clear visibility into pipeline, bookings, forecasting, and overall revenue performance.
* Improved CRM adoption, data quality, and process consistency across the revenue organization.
* Implemented a scalable pipeline management and forecasting process that improves accuracy and supports business planning.
* Reduced administrative burden on the sales team through process improvements, automation, and operational support.
* Standardized key revenue operations processes, including deal approvals, reporting, and cross\-functional handoffs.
* Strengthened collaboration across Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success to create a more seamless customer and revenue lifecycle.
* Become a trusted operational partner to the leadership team by providing actionable insights and helping the revenue organization scale effectively.

Enablement impact demonstrated
 AI-Powered Selling

description:
About AlphaSense
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
 About The Team
 The Sales Enablement team at AlphaSense is an integrated and dynamic team that works cross-functionally to drive results for the Revenue organization. We identify skill gaps, knowledge gaps and opportunities for optimization to shape a scalable enablement strategy that improves overall efficiency and effectiveness of the revenue team. Our team is extremely passionate about continuous employee growth and helping others realize and reach their full potential while maximising output across the organisation.
 About The Role
 We're seeking a Sales Enablement Lead (Customer & Product Support, Global) who believes that customer-facing teams should always know as much about the product as the market demands — and knows how to build the programs that get them there. This role has three distinct mandates. First , you'll own the onboarding and continuous development of our Customer & Product Support teams globally, building the product fluency they need to triage, troubleshoot, and resolve complex customer questions with confidence — including technical products like APIs, Financial Data, and Connectors. Second , you'll partner with our Product Enablement lead to ready the broader Revenue organization to speak to, demo, and sell new releases — working in close partnership with PMM, Product, and Engineering to ensure that when something ships, the people facing customers are prepared to bring it to market. Third , you'll own more technical knowledge such as security, infosec, and integrations across the organization — partnering with our Security teams, App Specialists, and Technical PMM to translate our connector ecosystem / API requirements, compliance, and data security concepts into clear, accessible enablement that arms revenue-facing reps to engage confidently with IT and AI personas at scale.
 Who You Are
A technically curious problem-solver who translates complex products into practical enablement
A clear communicator who makes intricate technical concepts accessible across varied audiences - including IT, security, and AI buyer personas.
An organized program builder who can design structured onboarding paths, manage multiple training tracks, and continually refine programs based on feedback and performance metrics.
A collaborative cross-functional partner who can manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders at once without losing momentum.
A confident facilitator who energizes new hires and levels up tenured team members.
A data-driven thinker who measures impact and iterates.
A coach and mentor who thrives on helping others build deep product understanding and grow their technical troubleshooting capabilities.
 What You'll Do
Design and own end-to-end onboarding and continuous training for the Support team, with a focus on how the product works, how it integrates, and how to troubleshoot it in real customer contexts.
Define escalation paths, workflows, and troubleshooting best practices that scale that help improve client troubleshooting, escalation, and implementations
Partner with the Product Enablement lead and cross-functional teams to translate new releases into field-ready enablement for the Revenue org — bringing project management rigor to keep multiple launches on track.
Own security and infosec enablement across the organization — partnering with Security teams and Technical PMM to translate policies, compliance requirements, and data security concepts into playbooks and training that equip reps to navigate IT and AI-focused buying conversations with confidence.
Work with App Specialists and PMM to improve connector and implementation knowledge and process across the broader org to drive connector adoption and usage 
Build and maintain internal product knowledge bases, playbooks, and guides for reps
Coach reps and help them apply knowledge to real scenarios to improve the customer experience
Track knowledge through assessments and performance metrics; identify gaps, iterate, and continuously improve time-to-ramp.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
About Us 
At No Isolation we're a 65 people strong scale-up EdTech operating across Europe, on a mission to help educators ensure learning and belonging for all children globally.
Our AV1 robot is deployed across 19 countries with 5,000+ units, supporting schools to improve attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Consistently described as life-changing, it bridges the gap between the student and their peers, restoring both educational continuity and the essential sense of social belonging.
 The Opportunity - Revenue Operations (RevOps) Specialist 
We're growing fast, and we're growing global - across 19 countries so far, with ambitions well beyond that. Our commercial engine needs to scale with us, and up until now, that engine hasn’t had a dedicated owner. That changes with you.
As RevOps Specialist, you'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations, and take ownership of the tech stack, data, and processes that turn market demand into accurate pipeline, clean reporting, and decisions leadership can actually trust. You'll inherit some existing setup, but the function is still being built - you will audit what's working, clean up what isn't, and put your own stamp on how our engine scales
You'll report directly to our Chief Commercial Officer, with daily access and visibility across the entire commercial strategy - pipeline, forecasting, market intelligence, the lot. Think of yourself as the CCO's right hand from an execution standpoint: they set the direction, you make it real across every market we operate in.
This goes far beyond basic CRM maintenance . It's a build-and-own role for someone who wants real influence over commercial outcomes, not just a seat watching them happen.
 What You'll Do — Scope & Responsibilities 
 Own and automate our GTM tech stack, globally: You'll be the business owner for HubSpot and Clay across every market we operate in, evaluate new productivity and sales tools that improve team performance, and work with Operations on Odoo integration — with a focus on smooth setup and practical adoption.
 Configure the CRM to work for the business: You'll build and optimise HubSpot workflows across the full commercial funnel - lead-to-deal in Marketing, deal-to-order in Sales, renewal/upsell in Customer Success.
 Maintain data integrity: You'll manage database hygiene - companies and hierarchies, contact associations, permission-based controls - so that when leadership looks at a report, they can trust the number.
 Audit and automate the Order-to-Cash process: You'll work across Sales, Operations and Finance to find the manual bottlenecks and replace them with clean handoffs and automated workflows.
 Turn raw data into strategic insight: You'll support Total Addressable Market analysis across our markets to sharpen territory planning, design real-time dashboards to track KPIs and pipeline health, and translate what you find into actionable insights that leadership can act on.
 Automate and monitor performance incentives: You'll configure automated tracking for commission schemes and monitor performance incentives (like SPIFFs) to ensure accurate calculations and evaluate how effectively they drive target sales behaviours.
 Help shape new commercial ventures: You'll support the operational build-out of the AV1 Store - workflows, system configuration, and the data flows behind it.
 Drive adoption and behaviour change: You'll work with sales leadership to build accountability and data discipline across the team.
 What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities 
You will have a few years of hands-on RevOps experience under your belt, along with the capability and drive to take on a role like this.
The skillset and attitude which will make you it the most likely fit for No Isolation are:
 Commercial Acumen: A solid understanding of B2B solution sales processes, SaaS metrics, and what actually drives commercial growth.
 HubSpot Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of building workflows, custom properties, views, and data pipelines and integrating GTM tools like Clay.
 Process & Automation Mindset: Ability to map business processes end to end, connect data across different tools, and build reliable automations.
 Analytical Instinct: Comfortable digging into sales data and pipelines to identify trends and insights to drive decision making.
 Stakeholder Communication: Clear, effective communication skills to walk teams through new tools or workflows and influence actual adoption.
 Execution Bias: A preference for building simple, reliable solutions quickly rather than over-engineering complex systems.
 Conscientiousness: Highly organised, detail-oriented, and motivated to deliver high-quality work and accurate and reliable reporting.
 What We Offer 
 Close CCO Working: Reporting directly to our CCO (who has led Vodafone business units in Europe and Africa), and working alongside sales and marketing leaders, you’ll have complete visibility into our commercial strategy and performance - and benefit from significant 1:1 coaching and mentoring.
 Function Ownership: As our dedicated RevOps Specialist, you’ll have full hands-on autonomy to design, build, and enable our rapid commercial growth as we scale.
 International Exposure: You'll be building the systems our international growth relies on, working across every market we operate in, with occasional trips to our Oslo and Munich offices to collaborate in person.
 Flexible working around core hours (10:00-15:00) and some remote working
 27 vacation days + bank holidays
Mobile phone and Internet subscription 
Enhanced parental leave 
Option to enroll into salary sacrifice pension scheme 
Regular company socials and an annual trip away together 
 Location 
This position is based from our central London office , working closely with our Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Operations teams internationally.
 How to Apply 
Please click Apply and upload your CV.
If you’d like, you can also include a short video as part of your application – this is optional, but it gives us a chance to see a bit more of who you are beyond your CV. Let your personality and passion shine!
If you get genuine satisfaction from turning a messy process into a clean automated system, and you want that system to power something that actually matters, we'd love to hear from you.
We welcome all qualified applicants. Due to current visa/work-permit processes, we can only progress candidates with no need for additional work permit sponsorship . (This note is about work authorization only; no sensitive personal data is required.)

The role will work across Revenue Enablement, Practices/Service Lines, Industries, Business Units and Regional teams to develop actionable enablement plans and drive their execution with seller populations globally. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of sales in an IT services or technology services environment, combined with the ability to operate effectively in a complex, global organization.
Success will depend on the ability to align stakeholders, create accountability, remove execution barriers, and drive adoption and measurable business outcomes.
 Key Responsibilities
 Revenue Enablement Planning & Execution
Translate Revenue Enablement strategy and priorities into structured, actionable enablement plans focused on APAC
Develop execution plans covering target seller populations, interventions, timelines, milestones, stakeholder responsibilities, and expected outcomes.
Drive execution of global enablement initiatives across regions (focused on APAC) in partnership with regional teams.
Establish execution cadence to maintain momentum against agreed priorities and establish transparency.
Identify execution gaps, dependencies and barriers and work proactively with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
 Seller Capability & Sales Enablement

Build strong working relationships across Practices, Industries, Business Units, and regional teams.
Bring together multiple stakeholders around common enablement objectives, plans, and measures of success.
Facilitate sharing of effective approaches and lessons learned across regions.
 Drive Adoption & Execution Through Influence

Identify areas where execution is behind plan and proactively intervene with regional and global stakeholders.
Challenge constructively, resolve execution bottlenecks and escalate critical issues when required.

 Measurement & Business Impact
Establish appropriate measures and tracking mechanisms for enablement initiatives.
Track seller participation, adoption, readiness, and execution against agreed plans.

 Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to accelerate research, synthesis, reporting, and workflow automation

description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
 Join Our Team at Cliniconex 
 Position: RevOps Specialist (Sales and Marketing Operations)
 Location: Kanata (Hybrid)
 Reporting to : Angela Hunt 
 Meet Cliniconex 
At Cliniconex, our focus is our customers, our community and our culture. As a small company, we understand the importance of having a team that connects effectively. Whether it’s day-to-day operations or an emergency, teams need to be on the same page, and that’s why we make healthcare communication and collaboration solutions that are as easy as 1,2,3. Easy to implement, easy to use and easy to scale. 
Our solution reaches audiences via voice, text or email, strengthens teams with a record of all conversations, and unites a family-centered community through timely, transparent outreach. The result? More time to care. 
 What You'll Be Doing: 
As a Sales and Marketing Operations Specialist at Cliniconex, you’ll own the systems, data and process that generate demand and move deals forward. You’ll run prospect pipeline management, marketing automation, forecasting and budget tracking — turning scattered activity into insight the Sales and Marketing teams can actually act on. This is a build role as much as a run role: our revenue engine is growing quickly, and you’ll have the latitude to design process rather than inherit it. You’ll partner closely with our Customer Success Operations Specialist so the full revenue lifecycle, from first touch through to renewal, runs on clean data and consistent process.
 Your Responsibilities: 
Own prospect pipeline management and hygiene in our CRM — stage definitions, exit criteria, deal aging, next-step discipline and close date accuracy.
Build and maintain pipeline and funnel reporting, covering stage conversion, sales velocity, win rate and pipeline coverage against target.
Own marketing automation in ActiveCampaign, including campaign build, nurture flows, segmentation, list hygiene, suppression rules and deliverability.
Manage the lead lifecycle end to end — capture, scoring, routing, qualification definitions, follow-up service levels, and closed-loop attribution from campaign through to closed-won.
Administer and integrate the sales and marketing technology stack, including Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, Calendly and Zapier — field management, flows, validation rules and integration troubleshooting.
Run the forecasting cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, forecast roll-ups, variance against plan, and scenario modelling to support decisions at the executive level.
Manage the Sales and Marketing budget — committed versus actual spend, campaign and event budgets, vendor renewals, and reporting on cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
Produce the demand generation and pipeline reporting that feeds quarterly business reviews and board reporting.
Support territory, quota and target setting, and maintain the underlying data for commission and incentive calculations.
Partner with Channel Partnerships to track and report on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline.
Document process and enable the team through playbooks, field definitions and training, so new process actually gets adopted.
Uphold data quality standards across lead and prospect records, including enrichment, deduplication and ongoing cleanup.
 What We're Looking For: 
We're on the lookout for a passionate and driven individual who has the following:
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance, Data Analytics or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Three or more years in sales operations, marketing operations or revenue operations.
Hands-on CRM administration experience — reports, dashboards, custom fields, flows and data management. You have configured it, not just used it.
Demonstrated ownership of a marketing automation platform such as ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Marketo or Pardot, including campaign build and nurture logic.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to build a forecast model and clearly explain the assumptions behind it.
Advanced spreadsheet skills in Google Sheets or Excel, including pivot tables and lookup logic.
Comfort with budget tracking and core commercial metrics such as variance, cost per lead and customer acquisition cost.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a track record of working effectively across Sales, Marketing and Finance.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several projects at once.
 Compensation: $70,000- $80,000 CAD
 Bonus Points for: 
Experience with Zapier or comparable no-code integration and automation tools.
Healthcare technology or other regulated-industry B2B SaaS experience.
Experience with sales intelligence and data enrichment tools such as ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Dun and Bradstreet.
Practical experience applying AI tooling to revenue operations work — automating reporting, research or repetitive workflow.
Exposure to a channel or reseller motion, and the reporting it requires.
Familiarity with common sales methodologies and demand generation strategy.
 Perks of Joining Our Team: 
✨ Make a Real Impact: Join a mission-driven team that's transforming patient care across North America. Your work will directly contribute to better health outcomes and meaningful change. 
 Flexible Hybrid Work Model: We believe in balance. Enjoy the best of both worlds with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration. 
 30 Days of Paid Time Off: Work hard, rest well. We offer a generous PTO policy to support your work-life balance - right from the start.
 Health & Wellness Budget: Invest in your well-being with an annual budget to support your physical, mental or emotional health.
 Internet Budget: We provide a budget for home internet expenses so you can stay connected and productive while working from home.
 ️‍ Collaborative Culture: Be part of a supportive, dynamic team where every voice is heard, and innovation thrives.
 Growth & Development: We're committed to your success and encourage you to learn and grow your skills
 Day-One Benefits & Flexibility: Enjoy comprehensive benefits on your first day!
 Ready to Make an Impact? 
If you're ready to make a difference and be a part of our dynamic team, we want to hear from you! To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter. Looking forward to learning more about you!
 About This Posting: 
This posting is not for an existing vacancy. We are accepting applications for anticipated future opportunities and to build our talent pipeline, and we'll be in touch as roles become available.
 Equal Opportunity and Accommodations: 
Cliniconex is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, including those from underrepresented communities.
Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process. Please contact careers@cliniconex.com for any accommodation requirements.

title: Senior Digital Customer Success Manager - Americas
description:
About the Job: 
The Digital Led Customer Success Manager reports directly to the regional CS leader and represents LaunchDarkly as the direct point-of-contact with our customers post-sales. They are LaunchDarkly subject-matter experts, guiding our new and existing customers through implementation and adoption with a heavy focus on 1:many outreach tactics and leveraging data to engage with the right customers at the right time. Responsibilities:
 Customer Onboarding: Leverage customer journey data to understand which customers need additional support through onboarding. Drive them to 1:many marketing engagements or work with them 1:1 to ensure all customers in your portfolio are onboarded and activated correctly.

About You:
 Entrepreneurial and Self-Motivated: You are driven and proactive, taking ownership of your role and responsibilities. You operate with a high level of urgency at all times. You thrive in a highly ambiguous, start up environment. This is a new team at LaunchDarkly and you will be helping to build the organization while executing within it!
 Passion for Learning and Growth: You are enthusiastic about continuous learning and personal development at LaunchDarkly. You view feedback as a necessity for growth so consistently seek it out and give it.
 Highly Data Driven: You enjoy identifying trends in data and have a proven track record of leveraging data to make informed decision making on behalf of your customers

 Organized & Autonomous: You are capable of efficiently managing your workload and have a process for time management. You are able to prioritize a large customer portfolio to engage with the right customers at any given time. You do not require a lot of external direction to organize and manage your workload.
 Strong Sales Acumen: You have a high level of sales acumen, strong negotiation skills and are eager to own a number. This is a commercially focused CS organization.
 Natural Problem Solver: You have strong critical thinking skills and enjoy the process of solving complex customer problems. You are able to escalate issues when necessary in a clear, effective manner.
 Team Player: You collaborate well with others, know when to pull specialists or leaders in and keep others informed proactively. Win as a team!

Located in the Continental US
5+ years in a customer-facing role, ideally in scaled/1:many/tech touch onboarding/implementation, account management, customer/partner success, or customer support, with a track record of exceeding targets.
Proven success in a 1:many/tech touch/tech-led Customer Success organization.
Highly data-driven with experience using product telemetry and growth/risk signals to target the right customers at the right time.

Exceptional time management and organizational skills.

Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

title: Director of Revenue Operations (m/f/x)
description:
**About Eye Security**
Eye Security is providing cybersecurity with embedded cyber insurance solutions for organizations in Europe. Headquartered in the Netherlands, we are already over 170 FTEs and continue to grow internationally.
We combine cutting\-edge technology with hands\-on expertise to detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats in real time. Our team brings together talent from intelligence, military, tech, and consulting backgrounds, all united by a shared mission: to make enterprise\-grade cybersecurity accessible to every business, not just the big players.
At Eye, you will work on projects with an international footprint, solving real\-world challenges and helping to build a safer digital future for our clients.
**About this role**
We are seeking an experienced Director of Revenue Operations to own and scale a critical function across Europe. While systems exist, there is no dedicated leader. You will drive end\-to\-end revenue infrastructure and reporting directly to the CBO. You'll have budget flexibility for tools and resources, and the autonomy to shape how the function evolves.
**What you will do**
* **Map our growth strategy.** Design segmentation by customer size and vertical, and define territory models for BENELUX, DACH, and new markets.
* **Plan for scale.** Lead quarterly planning cycles: set regional quotas, define sales capacity targets, and align capacity models to pipeline and ARR goals.
* **Own one source of truth.** Establish consistent revenue data definitions, build forecasting models, and create reporting cadence for Sales and Channel teams.
* **Build the operating system.** Optimize our GTM technology, design end\-to\-end revenue processes, and govern AI tools with proper GDPR compliance and partner attribution.
* **Enable the teams.** Create onboarding and training programs for Sales, Channel, and CS using AI\-powered insights to sharpen skills and execution.
* **Drive decisions with data.** Analyze customer cohorts, win/loss patterns, and sales cycles to uncover expansion opportunities and retention strategies.
**What you will need**
* **8\+ years in B2B SaaS**, with 3\+ years building Revenue Operations or Sales Operations functions at Director level.
* **Multi\-region GTM architect.** You've run go\-to\-market strategies across EMEA or globally, and you've cracked at least one partner model (VAR, MSP, or similar).
* **Systems builder.** You're fluent in CRM platforms, revenue analytics, and forecasting and you translate complex strategy into frameworks your teams execute.
* **Data\-driven decision maker.** You move fast, lead with numbers, and aren't afraid to challenge the room when the data doesn't support the consensus.
* **Bonus points:** Cybersecurity or regulated industry experience. GDPR and EU data residency expertise. Track record building RevOps teams from early\-stage to enterprise.
* **Language skills:** English fluency required; Dutch or German is a plus.
**What we offer**
* You will become part of one of the fastest growing cybersecurity scale\-ups in Europe.
* You will evolve alongside the industry \- as a rapidly growing scale\-up, we provide an environment where your professional development is driven by the dynamic nature of our work and the complexity of the problems we solve.
* You will enjoy a flexible work setup that supports our distributed team in Europe.
* An attractive remuneration package and “floating holidays” for additional time off.
* Choose your own device: MacBook or Windows Laptop.
* Strong support for your personal and professional development.
* Regular company\-wide get\-togethers, giving you the opportunity to collaborate in person and build strong team connections.

title: Director of Revenue Operations
description:
Hello, we’re ScreenCloud! 
Founded in 2015 and with 10,000+ customers around the globe, ScreenCloud is a cloud-based SaaS company, employing over 100 people in our Bangkok, Belfast, LA, Charlotte and London hubs.
At ScreenCloud, we’re hard at work helping businesses to make stronger connections at scale, and with those who are most important to them; their employees & their customers. By using the screens on their walls & the content in their systems, we enable the sales, productivity & engagement that keep our customers’ businesses thriving.
We believe AI is reshaping how we work. The playbook is still being written, and we find that exciting. We're building a company where AI empowers every team member to have outsized impact and we're looking for people who share that vision.
We’re very proud of our product and we’re also incredibly proud of our people. It’s our ‘ScreenClouders’ and the culture they nurture that will take us where other companies just can’t go. So if you’re someone looking to join a team of talented individuals, apply below!
 The Role: 
Revenue Operations is how ScreenCloud's commercial strategy becomes execution — and how execution becomes the intelligence on which our GTM leaders, exec, and the board make decisions. The Director, Revenue Operations owns the function: architecting the commercial operating model, building the analytical foundations decisions rest on, and making RevOps the strategic voice in the room — forward-looking and guiding, not reactive and implementing.
This is not a role that inherits a function and keeps it running. You are being hired to rebuild RevOps from a clean base as an AI-first function: one where the system does the work and the people do the judgment.
You'll be the senior commercial partner to the executive team, and the architect of how
Marketing, Sales and CS operate as one revenue engine. You'll inherit a small team and a mandate to make it a leverage engine, not a headcount one. Reports to the CMO; operates as a peer to the leaders of Sales, CS and Finance, with a direct line to the CEO and board on the numbers.
 What "AI-first" means here — and what we're not asking for 
We don't mean someone who uses AI to do their existing job a bit faster. We mean someone who assumes AI capability as the baseline and designs the function around it: every recurring workflow has an automation path and an explicit answer to "when does a human stop doing this." Reporting that drafts itself. Forecasts that update continuously, not monthly by hand. Data hygiene enforced at the point of entry by validation logic, not by someone checking fields after the fact. The human's job is to set the models, own what's true, handle the exceptions the system can't, and defend the numbers under scrutiny.
If your instinct on arrival is to rebuild the proven RevOps playbook, this isn't the role. If your instinct is to ask which parts of that playbook AI just made obsolete, it is.
 Why this Role Matters 
This role is the senior commercial voice in the room. The board, the exec, and the leaders running Marketing, Sales and CS rely on it for the analytical truth decisions get made on
Revenue Operations at ScreenCloud has to move from reactive ticket-handling to strategic intelligence and challenge. This role architects that shift — pushing the right conversations into the room and bringing the questions and the depth to answer them, not waiting to be tasked
Forecasting needs to be board-grade — defensible, weighted, well-modelled across new ARR. Retention and expansion analytics need to match it — cohort-led, segmented and predictive across GRR, NRR and product mix. This role builds both. The AI and automation roadmap for the commercial motion, building the data foundation for intelligence and agents across Marketing, Sales and CS, in partnership with Data Engineering and AI Transformation
The AI-first operating model, with an explicit automation roadmap: for each recurring task, what AI owns, what the human owns, and the exit criterion that retires the manual version
Done well, RevOps becomes the engine the rest of the GTM motion runs on. This role co-owns the revenue section of the board pack — waterfall analysis, funnel analysis, retention cohorts and the narrative layer that ties them together — and provides the credibility layer for incentive design and investment cases.
 What you Own 
Strategic Intelligence and Executive Partnership
The revenue thinking partner to the CMO, CRO, CCO and CFO — bringing the questions and the depth to answer them, not waiting to be tasked
The commercial intelligence layer the exec & board rely on — a defined metrics framework across the full funnel (not ad-hoc reporting), how each metric is modelled, and what it says about where we're heading
The architecture of where AI and data leverage land in the commercial motion, in partnership with the Director, Data Engineering and the Director, AI Transformation
The customer health and journey lens with CS leadership — multi-dimensional, predictive; following a customer from top-of-funnel through expansion or churn. This means integrating product usage data into the customer health view — currently a meaningful gap — so we can see what usage profiles predict expansion vs churn, and direct CS effort to where it pays back
Operating Rhythm
The standing forecasting rhythm — new business, expansion, contraction, churn — with a monthly weighted forward view two quarters out, board-grade
GRR, NRR, cohort retention and expansion white-space analytics — segmented by tier, ICP, CSM and sector
The operating cadence across Marketing → Sales → CS — one joined-up funnel view, not three siloed dashboards
Active input into annual and mid-year planning for each motion — stress-testing assumptions on capacity, quotas, channel mix, expansion targets
Building the Function
Building the integrated lead-to-cash view and the GTM data architecture beneath it — one revenue picture across all motions, trusted by exec and board, with consistent definitions, source-of-truth, and a single dashboard truth
Tech stack discipline — rationalising the GTM stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Chargebee, Vitally, Hook, Gong, etc.) toward fewer tools and fewer failure modes, while retaining the functionality the business needs
The operating model — escalation matrix, triage discipline, standing reporting cadence, and CRM hygiene monitored continuously
The team — four direct reports, with people development, calibration and growth paths
 What We're Looking For: 
8+ years in Revenue Operations leadership at a SaaS business at $30M–$150M ARR, ideally with hybrid PLG / Enterprise motion experience, and depth across Sales, CS and Marketing operations
Has built or run forecasting at board-grade — multi-cohort, multi-segment, weighted, defensible under scrutiny
Operates as a strategic peer to senior commercial leaders — challenges back, asks the harder questions, doesn't wait to be tasked
Strong analytical instincts — knows what good cohort, retention and expansion analysis looks like, and what bad analysis dressed up as good looks like. Storyteller as well as data person — translates analytics into narrative, narrative into decisions execs can act on
AI-first — uses AI tooling in your own workflow and has a clear view on where it belongs in the RevOps motion
Strong people leader — has built and developed a small ops team. Builder mindset — wants to transform the function, not run it as-is. Player-coach disposition: comfortable designing the system and comfortable rolling up sleeves early
Direct, calm, decisive — willing to say no to wrong requests; willing to push back on senior stakeholders when discipline is at risk
 Bonus Skills 
Familiarity with our stack — Salesforce, Chargebee/Stripe, HubSpot, Vitally, Hook, Gong, Redshift, PowerBI, Intercom Fin, Qualified
Has led a billing platform migration (Chargebee → Stripe or similar)
Experience consolidating GTM tech stacks
Experience operating in a business where Marketing, Sales and CS ops sat in different orgs and had to be brought into one motion
 Interview Process and Experience 
Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScreenCloud, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles! If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let our friendly recruitment team know.
 Key Info 
 Typical Process: Intro to ScreenCloud - Meet the Hiring Manager - Challenge - Final
 Hybrid Friendly Working: 2-3 days in Office
 Flexi-Hours: We don’t follow the strict 9-5 here, we trust you to execute your role to the highest standard whilst being able to make time for the things you love!
 Benefits 
 Take the Time You Need – Unlimited paid time off to rest, recharge, or explore.
 AI As Standard - You'll have access to the AI tools you need to work the way we're describing. We don't ask you to work with AI and then make you fight for a license.

 Work From Anywhere – Up to one month a year to work remotely from any location in the world
 Home Office Boost – Stipend to set up your ideal remote workspace.

title: Sales Enablement Manager
location: United States or New York or London or San Mateo
description:
About Us: 
Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.
 The Role 
We're looking for a hands-on Sales Enablement Manager to help build GTM Enablement as Fireworks scales its go-to-market motion. The role sits in the Revenue Operations organization and reports to the Head of GTM Enablement.
This is a builder's seat with a real delivery mandate. Upon arrival, you'll take immediate ownership of two flagship initiatives that define how Fireworks captures and serves its GTM knowledge: organizing our knowledge as a data product and industrializing our internal GTM Tutor App. But you won't live only in content and tooling. You're also expected to deliver traditional enablement, facilitating live and virtual sessions, supporting role-based ramp, and running cross-functional GTM programs that keep the field ahead of a fast-moving product.
To do it well, you'll pair the fundamentals of great enablement (facilitation, content development, and program management) with genuine AI fluency, building the tools you teach rather than just briefing them. You'll own processes end to end and drive outcomes across Product, Marketing, and Sales without waiting to be told how.
 What You'll Own 
 Own our knowledge as a data product : 
Take immediate ownership of our "knowledge as a data product" vision by structuring, governing, and maintaining GTM knowledge so it's accessible for both human and agent consumption. Complete a full audit of our existing knowledge and content, then define and roll out the taxonomy, standards, and governance for how we create, maintain, and retire content going forward, turning a scattered corpus into a trusted, queryable source of truth that stays healthy and current as it grows.
 Industrialize the GTM Tutor App: 
Harden and scale our "GTM Tutor App," the internal AI application that trains and coaches sellers on GTM topics. Build the framework to add new topics quickly, improve the user experience, and strengthen the backend so the app is reliable, extensible, and ready for broad field adoption.
 Build the cross-functional content engine: 
Establish the recurring processes and working relationships with Product, Marketing, Field Engineering, and Sales that ensure the field and our customers always have the sales and marketing assets they need. Create the intake, prioritization, and hand-off model that turns new product primitives, launches, and campaigns into field-ready and customer-facing collateral on a predictable cadence, and hold cross-functional partners accountable to it.
 Deliver core enablement programs: 
Design and deliver enablement content and facilitate high-impact live and virtual sessions across product knowledge, sales skills, competitive positioning, and internal process. Support role-based ramp for new Account Executives, AI Field Engineers, and BDRs, and help run critical GTM programs alongside partners in Sales, Field Engineering, Marketing, and Product. As we grow, you'll expand our capacity to meet the field's enablement needs.
 Codify field best practices: 
 Synthesize what's working from real customer engagements and enablement outcomes, codify it into repeatable plays and content, and deliver it back to the field, feeding insight upstream to help shape the evolving GTM motion.
 Help define the future of agentic enablement: 
Shape what agentic enablement looks like at Fireworks, designing and shipping AI agents that lift Account Executive efficiency and surface Revenue Operations insight, building on the foundations laid by our GTM Engineering team.
 Minimum Qualifications 
Several years (5+) of experience in GTM enablement, sales, or a related solutions/RevOps role, with demonstrated ownership of enablement programs end to end
Strong at both content development and live facilitation for audiences from new hires to experienced sellers
Has personally built AI agents or apps, through prompting, no-code, low-code, or code, to drive seller or operational productivity (engineering degree not required)
Excellent program and process management: you can stand up structure, standards, and repeatable workflows from scratch
Skilled at eliciting knowledge from busy subject-matter experts and turning it into structured, reusable content
Comfortable working with knowledge, content, and data as structured systems (taxonomy, governance, quality standards)
Proven ability to enable technical sellers to sell credibly to technical buyers
A trusted cross-functional partner who can work independently across Product, Marketing, and Sales
Thrives in ambiguity, high ownership, and the pace of a high-growth startup
Willing and able to travel ~15–20% for onboarding weeks, offsites, and kickoffs
 Preferred Qualifications 
Prior experience as a quota-carrying field IC (Account Executive, AI Field Engineer, or similar)
Background in AI/ML infrastructure, developer tools, or API-first and consumption-based businesses, with literacy in usage-based pricing models
Experience with modern enablement tooling and systems (LMS, CMS, CRM, and enablement platforms)
Experience designing knowledge bases or content for retrieval by AI/LLM systems (RAG, agents)
 Why Fireworks? 
Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.
Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.
Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.
Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.
 Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Senior Associate, Sales Strategy & Operations - Groups
description:
About Engine
Engine is the all-in-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K+ businesses and groups representing 1.8M+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar. 
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
 About the Role 
We are seeking a Supply Sales Operations Manager to join our team. This role sits at the center of strategy and day-to-day execution — you’ll work closely with sales leadership to build the processes, tools, and reporting that keep our team focused on what matters most.This is a hands-on role. You’ll spend time in the details cleaning up data, building reports, fixing broken workflows and also zoom out to help leadership make smarter decisions about how the team is structured and where to invest. This position requires strong business partnering skills, financial and business reporting, planning, and process design and implementation. If you love making things work better and can move between big-picture thinking and tactical execution, this role is for you.
 What You'll Do 
Build and improve how our sales team operates
Map out how deals get done today, find what’s slowing the team down, and fix it
Create clear, repeatable processes so the team isn’t reinventing the wheel every quarter
Partner with sales leadership to make sure new processes actually get adopted and stick
Own forecasting and performance reportingOwn forecasting and performance reporting
Run the weekly and monthly rhythm of pipeline reviews and forecasting so leadership always has a clear picture of where we stand
Build dashboards and reports that show how accounts and reps are performing against targets
Spot trends in the data early — opportunities the team should go after, or risks that need attention
Manage how we divide up accounts and pay our team
Help decide which reps own which accounts and markets, making sure the workload is balanced and the right people are focused on the right opportunities
Support the design and maintenance of sales compensation plans that motivate the team and reward the right behaviors
Keep our tools and data accurate
Own the health of our Salesforce CRM — making sure account ownership, record types, and data are clean and up to date
Work with our data team to make sure what’s in our reporting systems actually reflects what’s happening in the business
Be the go-to person when something looks off in our tools or data — find it, flag it, and fix it
Lead projects that move the business forwardLead projects that move the business forward
Take on special initiatives — from new market analysis to building a business case for a strategic change — and see them through from idea to impact
Help with planning cycles like goal-setting and headcount modeling
Connect the dots between sales, finance, data, and product teams so everyone is working from the same playbook
 What We're Looking For 
3+ years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar role where you owned real processes and outcomes — not just supported them
Strong working knowledge of Salesforce — you know how to build reports, manage records, and set up workflows without needing a lot of hand-holding
You’re comfortable with data and can tell a clear story from a spreadsheet or dashboard — experience with tools like Looker or Snowflake is a plus
Great communicator who can work across teams and explain complex things simply — to a sales rep or to a VP
You don’t wait to be told what to do — you spot the problem, figure out the solution, and get it done
Comfortable in a fast-moving company where priorities shift and the job description doesn’t cover everything you’ll end up doing
 Nice to Haves 
Experience writing SQL or working hands-on with data visualization tools
You’ve led cross-functional projects end to end and have the scars to prove it
You’ve worked at a startup or fast-growing company before
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related field
 Why This Role 
Real ownership — the work you do directly affects how productive and successful our sales team is
A seat at the table — you’ll be a trusted partner to supply sales leadership, not just a support function
Variety — no two weeks look the same; you’ll work across strategy, systems, data, and people
Room to grow — strong performance here opens doors to broader scope and leadership over time
Applications for this role will be accepted through October 15th, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.
 Compensation 
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
Base Pay Range
 $108,400 — $150,000 USD 
 The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation 
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
 Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
 Benefits: Check out our full list at engine.com/culture  
 Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.
 Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

title: CS Operations & Onboarding Specialist
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
We are on the search for a CS Operations & Onboarding Specialist! We are seeking someone ready to roll up their sleeves to support our Revenue Operations team. Reporting to our Sales Operations Manager, you will be responsible for driving process improvement and automation across the customer lifecycle, project-managing customer onboarding from kickoff through go-live, owning renewals and CSM responsibilities for our smaller accounts, and serving as the first line of support for our Renewals and Customer Success inbox and ticketing queue. 
 What you'll do: 
 Process Improvement & Automation 
Serve as the RevOps planner for the Customer Success team — own automation initiatives and drive continuous process improvements and workflow optimization across the customer lifecycle. 
Lead process improvement and administration projects with our regional Business Partners, ensuring our processes scale cleanly as the partner network grows. 
Act as a trusted point of contact for our EMEA Business Partner network, providing guidance on tools, process, and account questions to help them succeed with their customers. 
 Onboarding Program Management 
Act as project manager for new customer onboarding, partnering with Professional Services to build and roll out onboarding processes and documentation for key accounts. 
Coordinate end-to-end onboarding for new customers, from initial contact through go-live and beyond. 
Act as the primary point of contact for customers during onboarding, resolving questions and concerns promptly. 
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Customer Support, and Business Partners to ensure cross-functional alignment and resolve onboarding issues. 
Build and maintain onboarding plans, timelines, and documentation to keep every project on schedule. 
Track project progress and provide regular status updates to customers and internal stakeholders, including recurring syncs with Business Partners and Professional Services. 
 Renewals & Customer Success 
Serve as CSM for a portfolio of smaller accounts (under $10K ARR), managing product requests, demos, upsell opportunities, and churn prevention. 
Act as the focal point for data-related requests — backups, selective data restoration, and account splits — from quoting through fulfillment and customer communication. 
Ensure data integrity and reliable information flow across our billing and CRM systems. 
 Support Operations 
Serve as the first point of contact for the Renewals/Customer Success inbox and support ticketing queue. 
Monitor, triage, and assign incoming tickets across the team. 
Own SOP approvals and documentation for the team. 
 What you'll bring: 
3+ years of relevant experience in customer success, onboarding, renewals, or revenue operations within a SaaS/CRM or related industry. 
Proven project management skills, with experience building and managing onboarding plans, timelines, and cross-functional stakeholders. 
A track record of managing multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. 
Accuracy, analytical skills, and attention to detail, especially when handling account and billing data. 
Strong communication and relationship-management skills, comfortable acting as a primary point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders alike. 
Experience triaging and resolving tickets in a helpdesk/ticketing tool (e.g., Zendesk) is an asset. 
Familiarity with CRM, billing, and quoting systems, and comfort learning new internal tools quickly. 
 Why you should apply:

???? Generous paid vacay and sick days 
???? A powerful Laptop 
???? Budget for courses, books, and personal development 
❤️ Peer to peer recognition and rewards 
???? Team building events, happy hours and more 
???????? Flexible & hybrid work 
 About Maximizer 
Maximizer was launched in a garage on Vancouver Island in 1987, evolving through the development of early contact management systems (CMS), through sales force automation (SFA) technologies, right to today's sophisticated customer relationship management (CRM) systems. Along the way, we have pioneered many of today's technologies. Over this 30-year history we have attracted over 100,000 customers from around the world, and 1 million users. 
Today, we are one of the few CRM providers in the world who can deploy our software in all three environments of on-premise, private or shared cloud, while providing access via a desktop/laptop, via a mobile device, or using the Maximizer app. 
Ultimately, however, we are successful because for over three decades we have proven we know how to help customers do three things: secure new customers; retain them for the long term; and maximize the repeat business from them. 
 Equal Opportunity Employer 
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, faith, colour, cultural background, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. 
 Salary Range $65,000—$75,000 CAD

title: Sr Mgr, Go To Market - ROE, PSC
description:
The Company
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

title: Revenue Operations and Sales Enablement Project Manager
description:
Qima is seeking a Revenue Operations & Sales Enablement Project Manager to guide our Sales & Marketing transformation. This role blends rigorous project management with hands-on sales enablement: you'll lead a critical initiative to consolidate disparate systems and processes across our customer value funnel, turning a patchwork of acquired technologies into a unified, high-performing revenue engine, and you'll equip our Sales and Marketing teams around the world to actually use it.
This is a hands-on role requiring knowledge of processes, technology, and people. You'll work directly with Sales and Marketing teams across multiple divisions to streamline workflows, eliminate friction, and create systems that drive both new customer acquisition and cross-sell revenue expansion. Beyond design, you own adoption: building training content and delivering hands-on training to Sales and Marketing users across multiple regions and time zones, so that every change lands in practical, everyday use. Your success will be measured not just in project delivery, but in adoption, efficiency gains, and revenue impact.
This is a high-visibility role where you'll partner closely with our RevOps Program & Change Manager and leadership team to shape how we scale our commercial operations.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Revenue Operations Transformation: Own end-to-end project management for consolidating CRM and related systems following multiple acquisitions; Develop and execute a phased roadmap that minimizes disruption while delivering quick wins; Balance speed with structure to move fast while establishing scalable processes
 Project Execution & Performance Tracking: Develop and maintain project plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and timelines; Run daily team stand-ups to track development progress, surface risks and blockers, and follow up closely to ensure deadlines are met; Define and monitor KPIs for project success and business impact; Keep Asana continuously up to date as the single source of truth for tasks, decisions, and documentation, so the whole team stays aligned; Generate weekly status updates and monthly executive reports with clear metrics and next steps
 Sales Enablement & Training: Own sales enablement for RevOps initiatives: build clear, user-friendly playbooks, battle cards, process guides, and training materials; Design and deliver live and self-serve training sessions for Sales and Marketing users across multiple regions and time zones; Support users through transitions with patience and practical, hands-on coaching.
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership: Build strong relationships with Sales & Marketing leaders across divisions; Hold regular conversations with stakeholders to gather requirements and drive business alignment; Secure buy-in through inclusive discovery, transparent communication, and demonstrated results; Manage change resistance with empathy, clarity, and compelling business cases
 Process Design & Documentation: Monitor efforts to document current-state processes and design future-state workflows that embody "Make it Simple" value; Navigate the complexity of integrating processes and data from acquisitions; Establish governance frameworks that provide structure without bureaucracy; Implement feedback loops to continuously improve systems and processes
 Systems Optimisation: Support the teams assessing current CRM configurations and integrations to optimise lead management, pipeline tracking, and forecasting accuracy; Help maintain focus on system simplicity and consistency across the organisation

Required Experience 
 7+ years project management experience, preferably in RevOps or Sales/Marketing Operations
 5+ years working on projects with Sales/Marketing stakeholders across multiple divisions/business units, with track record of successful user adoption and change management initiatives
Experience creating training materials and delivering live training to distributed teams across multiple time zones
 3+ years of hands-on experience on CRM tools with solid understanding of CRM platforms, data architecture, marketing automation tools, and sales enablement systems
Hands-on experience using Asana or a similar tool to run team cadences and keep documentation up to date
Experience with system integrations, data migration, and process automation, ideally in M&A-driven consolidation or post-merger integration
Proven track record delivering complex, multi-stakeholder projects on time and within scope
Exceptional English-language communication skills with ability to influence without authority
Bonus: Certification in project management (PMP, Prince2, Agile/Scrum)
Bonus: Experience in technical B2B services or the TIC sector
 Desired Characteristics 
 Embrace Change: You thrive in dynamic environments and help others navigate transitions
 Make it Simple: You cut through complexity to create elegant, user-friendly solutions
 Beauty Everywhere: You believe systems and processes should be intuitive and even delightful
 Scale-Up Mindset: You've implemented best practices at mid-size or large companies and know how to bring structure without killing speed
 Results-Oriented: You focus on business outcomes, not just project completion
 Diplomatic & Resilient : You navigate politics gracefully and persist through obstacles
 Salary range: between 65K USD and 75K USD package.

description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.
 Why us?
 🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.
🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.
🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.
🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.
💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.
 Role Mission
 We're looking for an experienced Sales Operations Analyst to join our global RevOps team. Reporting to our Senior Sales Operations Analyst, you'll take meaningful ownership of the systems, data, and processes that underpin CUBE's go-to-market engine. This is a role for someone who can hit the ground running — comfortable working independently, managing stakeholder relationships, and driving operational improvements without needing to be hand-held. You'll work closely with colleagues across London and New York, and have direct exposure to senior commercial leadership.
 Role Responsibilities
 Own day-to-day Salesforce CRM administration — including pipeline hygiene, data quality, object and field management, workflow automation, and user support (in conjunction with Salesforce Developers).
 Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and reports that give commercial leadership clear visibility into pipeline, forecast, and revenue KPIs
 Assist the business in sales operations, including quote configuration, contract data management, and approval process governance
 Help administer and optimise the wider RevOps tool stack, including Gong, Spiff, DocuSign CLM, ZoomInfo, Cognism, DemandFarm, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, among other tools.
 Identify process gaps and work with the wider team to design and implement scalable operational improvements across the sales cycle
 Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Cusromer Success on strategic operational projects
 Contribute to onboarding and enablement of new sales hires on tools and processes
 Document processes and maintain operational playbooks to ensure continuity and consistency
 Required Experience
 3–5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a similar commercial operations role within a B2B SaaS environment
 Solid, hands-on Salesforce CRM experience — confident managing data, building reports and dashboards, and administering workflows with minimal oversight
 Proven ability to independently own and deliver operational projects from scoping through to execution
 Experience designing or improving sales processes, with a track record of identifying inefficiencies and implementing scalable solutions
 Strong analytical mindset with high attention to detail and a low tolerance for bad data
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — comfortable working across time zones and engaging directly with senior commercial stakeholders
 Familiarity with tools such as Gong, Spiff, DocuSign CLM, or similar RevOps platforms is a strong advantage
 Experience in RegTech, FinTech, or a regulated industry is advantageous but not required
 Interested?
 If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.
