title: Founding Senior Revenue Operations Manager
location: San Francisco or New York City or London or United States
description:
About Pallet 
Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.
Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.
As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.
Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.
 $180,000 - $210,000 
 Full-time / Onsite (5 days/week)  
 You could be a Senior Revenue Operations Manager anywhere. Why Pallet? 
Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on the path to IPO ($50M raised, 700% revenue growth in 2 years, targeting a $6T market)
Build the operating system behind our revenue organization from day zero, not polish one that already exists.
Be our first dedicated Revenue Operations leader and turn messy, fast-growing data into clear, actionable direction.
Help transform a massive industry and scale us toward a $10 B+ business
 About the opportunity: 
We’re looking for our first Founding Senior Revenue Operations leader to build the operating system behind our go-to-market organization.
Pallet has reached the point where founder-led selling is evolving into a repeatable revenue engine. We have strong product-market fit, enterprise customers, and a rapidly growing sales team. Now we need someone who can create the infrastructure, rigor, and operating cadence that allows the organization to scale without slowing down.
You’ll partner directly with Sales Leadership to improve execution across the entire funnel. You’ll define what great looks like, build repeatable processes, drive accountability, and make sure every rep has the systems and enablement needed to perform at a high level.
 Why this role is different: 
Founding RevOps seat: first dedicated Revenue Operations leader defining how Sales operates as Pallet scales.
Zero-to-one build: create the reporting, inspection cadence, and operating processes leadership uses to run the business.
Full-funnel ownership: partner with Sales and Marketing leadership to improve execution, forecasting accuracy, and operational discipline.
Data as a product: turn raw, messy data into simple, trusted views that drive real decisions.
Direct line to growth: the systems and processes built in this role will shape how we generate predictable revenue.
 How you will make an impact: 
Design and improve the operational processes that enable Sales to scale predictably.
Build reporting, dashboards, and operating cadences that support executive decision-making.
Develop metrics that provide visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, and team performance.
Own pipeline hygiene, opportunity inspection, and forecasting accuracy.
Create repeatable pipeline review processes and establish clear expectations for CRM discipline.
Partner with Sales Leadership to improve SDR and AE accountability through reporting, metrics, and operational rigor.
Design lead routing, territory management, and account allocation frameworks.
Own commission administration and support operational planning across the sales organization.
Partner cross-functionally with Marketing and Finance to improve reporting, attribution, and data quality as the business scales.
 Preferred experience: 
5+ years of Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations experience in a high-growth B2B SaaS company
Experience scaling sales organizations from founder-led selling into a structured, repeatable revenue engine
Deep expertise with Salesforce and modern GTM tools such as Gong, Outreach, Apollo, Clari, HubSpot, or similar platforms
Proven ability to build operational processes from scratch while influencing cross-functional stakeholders
Strong analytical mindset with a bias toward action and a track record of solving ambiguous business problems through systems and process design
 Compensation: 
The estimated salary range for this role is $180,000-$210,000 , depending on experience and skill set. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and opportunities for growth. Final compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors, including experience, qualifications, and location.
 Pallet is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 
 Our Benefits  
We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.
🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 
🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation
➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 
❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage
💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff
🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future
🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families
📚 Yearly learning and development stipend
🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees
🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 
🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space
🍔 Daily catered lunches provided 
✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely
🥤 Monthly happy hours
🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴
 Workplace Policy 
We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.
Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 
Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.
 Equal Opportunity 
Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.
 Candidate Privacy Notice 
Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here .
 Accommodations 
Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.
If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please contact us at recruiting@pallet.com .

title: GTM Strategy & Operations Lead, Reseller Programs (EMEA)
description:
About The Team
 OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the ChatGPT Ads team is building advertising products that help businesses reach customers in useful, trusted, and responsible ways.
The Ads Strategy, Planning, and Operations team is responsible for building the operating foundation for OpenAI’s advertising business: GTM systems, segmentation, coverage, planning, forecasting, business rhythms, sales programs, incentives, and scalable execution across advertisers, agencies, partners, resellers, and internal teams. This team sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Policy, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success.
 About The Role
 We’re looking for a Reseller & Ecosystem Programs Lead to build the ChatGPT Ads reseller program from the ground up and design ecosystem programs that accelerate advertiser adoption, partner productivity, and revenue growth.
This role will define how OpenAI works with resellers and ecosystem partners across the Ads business: who we partner with, what motions they own, how they are enabled, how performance is measured, and how incentives should work. The ideal candidate has built reseller, channel, partner, or ecosystem programs in digital advertising, media, adtech, marketplace, or platform businesses and knows how to balance growth, control, customer experience, and platform integrity.
 In This Role, You’ll
Design and build the ChatGPT Ads reseller program, including partner segmentation, eligibility criteria, commercial model, operating model, onboarding, governance, and performance management.
Define the role of resellers and ecosystem partners across customer acquisition, activation, spend growth, market expansion, support, and scaled coverage.
Develop partner coverage and engagement models across advertisers, agencies, resellers, outsourced sellers, and other ecosystem participants.
Partner with Sales, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, Policy, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Ads Ops to launch reseller motions that are commercially effective and operationally sound.
Design ecosystem acceleration programs that drive advertiser adoption, partner-sourced growth, activation, retention, and incremental spend.
Build partner enablement, certification, launch readiness, and operating review mechanisms.
Develop reseller and partner incentive structures with clear eligibility, measurement, controls, ROI tracking, and guardrails.
Create program playbooks, partner scorecards, reporting cadences, escalation paths, and governance mechanisms.
Monitor program performance and recommend whether to scale, refine, or sunset specific reseller and ecosystem motions.
Ensure reseller and ecosystem programs reinforce user trust, platform integrity, financial discipline, and long-term advertiser value.
 You Might Thrive In This Role If You
Have 10+ years of experience in partner strategy, channel programs, reseller programs, sales strategy, revenue operations, business operations, or GTM program management.
Have meaningful experience in digital advertising, media, adtech, agency, marketplace, or platform businesses.
Have built or scaled reseller, channel, agency, partner, or ecosystem programs from early design through execution.
Understand ads GTM complexity, including advertiser needs, agency dynamics, partner incentives, billing, measurement, support, and sales coverage.
Can design commercial programs that balance revenue growth, partner productivity, customer experience, operational complexity, and risk.
Are strong at program design: goals, partner criteria, economics, enablement, governance, reporting, launch planning, and post-launch readouts.
Can work across Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Legal, Product, Marketing, Policy, and Operations to move complex programs from concept to execution.
Are analytically rigorous and comfortable evaluating program performance, incrementality, ROI, partner quality, and operational health.
Thrive in early-stage environments where playbooks need to be built, tested, and improved quickly.
 About OpenAI
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

description:

Why join Mintel? We are the world's leading market intelligence agency and technology underpins our success. We help our clients understand consumers and consumer markets and aspire to provide the market intelligence behind every great business decision.

Design and facilitate structured onboarding programmes and certification paths across sales segments.
Define and track key ramp metrics — including time-to-first-deal and time-to-productivity and continuously optimise onboarding based on performance data and feedback. 
 Ongoing learning & capability development
Design and deliver ongoing learning that reinforces commercial skills, product knowledge, and sales methodologies, through workshops, webinars, and certification activities focused on consultative selling and commercial best practice.

Act as a central coordination point for enablement activity, sharing best practice across commercial teams and regions.

title: Head of Data & Revenue Operations
description:

Entrepreneurial - Dare, do, and persist. At Yuki, we continuously encourage innovation, self-development, and initiative.

As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.
We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
 Job Description
 The GTM Lead - Net Zero & Sustainability is responsible for driving the global go-to-market (GTM) success of the IFS Sustainability portfolio. Acting as the commercial champion for the product, this role owns the execution of global GTM campaigns, develops compelling sales plays, and works across Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Partner teams to accelerate pipeline growth and strategic deal execution.
This is a highly commercial role with global responsibility, focused on creating repeatable revenue motions while directly supporting the largest Sustainability opportunities worldwide. The GTM Sustainability Manager will ensure Sustainability is positioned both as a standalone offering and as a strategic extension of IFS Cloud, helping customers realize greater business value while driving profitable growth.
Success in this role is measured through pipeline generation, strategic deal influence, GTM adoption, and overall commercial performance of the Sustainability portfolio.
 Key Responsibilities
 Global Go-to-Market Leadership
Own and execute the global GTM strategy for the Sustainability portfolio, ensuring alignment across Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Success, and Partners. 
Act as the commercial owner and global sales champion for Sustainability, driving awareness, adoption, and consistent execution across all regions. 
Develop and continuously refine repeatable GTM motions that accelerate market penetration and revenue growth. 
Ensure regional teams are equipped with the messaging, positioning, and sales assets required to successfully sell Sustainability solutions. 
 Sales Plays & Commercial Strategy
Define, launch, and optimize high-impact sales plays for Sustainability. 
Build commercial motions that enable both standalone Sustainability opportunities and attach opportunities alongside IFS Cloud. 
Identify market opportunities, competitive positioning, and customer use cases to strengthen commercial execution. 
Continuously evaluate sales performance and refine GTM approaches based on market feedback and commercial outcomes. 
 Strategic Deal Leadership
Personally support and influence the company's largest global Sustainability opportunities, including the top strategic standalone deals. 
Partner with regional sales leaders throughout complex sales cycles to improve deal quality, competitive positioning, and win rates. 
Facilitate executive engagement and cross-functional collaboration for strategic pursuits. 
Capture and share best practices from major opportunities to improve repeatability across the organization. 
 Pipeline Growth & Revenue Enablement
Drive a sustainable pipeline strategy targeting a minimum four-times pipeline coverage against revenue objectives. 
Partner with Marketing to develop and execute demand generation campaigns that create qualified pipeline. 
Monitor pipeline health, campaign effectiveness, and conversion metrics, recommending corrective actions where required. 
Identify opportunities to improve pipeline quality, sales velocity, and forecast accuracy. 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with Product Management to ensure market feedback influences product direction and roadmap priorities. 
Partner with Marketing to create compelling messaging, customer stories, thought leadership, and campaign content. 
Collaborate with Sales Enablement to develop training, playbooks, and sales resources that increase field effectiveness. 
Support Partner teams with GTM strategies that expand market reach through the ecosystem. 
 Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
Define and monitor key commercial performance metrics across pipeline generation, win rates, deal progression, and GTM effectiveness. 
Provide regular updates and recommendations to senior leadership on market performance, strategic opportunities, and execution priorities. 
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve execution, and increase commercial impact. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be demonstrated through:
Delivery of global GTM campaigns that generate measurable pipeline growth across PSO, MSO, and WISE. 
Achievement of at least a 4x pipeline multiple against commercial targets. 
Growth in standalone Optimisation revenue alongside increased IFS Cloud attachment rates. 
Establishment of a single, coherent Optimisation portfolio narrative and proposition across PSO, MSO, and WISE. 
Successful support and influence of the company's top strategic Optimisation opportunities globally. 
Increased adoption of Optimisation sales plays across global sales teams. 
Improved win rates, pipeline conversion, and commercial predictability. 
Strong cross-functional alignment that accelerates market execution and customer adoption. 
 Qualifications
7+ years of experience in enterprise software, SaaS, or technology organisations within Go-to-Market, Product Marketing, Sales Strategy, Business Development, or related commercial roles. 
Demonstrated success developing and executing global GTM strategies for enterprise software products, ideally spanning multiple products or a portfolio. 
Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and influencing strategic customer opportunities. 
Strong understanding of enterprise software sales motions, including pipeline generation, solution selling, and partner ecosystems. 
Experience working across multiple business functions including Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership. 
Domain knowledge of optimisation, scheduling, or planning technologies is highly advantageous — for example, field service planning and scheduling optimisation (PSO), manufacturing scheduling and digital-twin-based planning (MSO), or scenario modeling and predictive analytics (WISE / what-if analysis). 
Familiarity with the full spectrum of AI capabilities, from machine learning through to agentic and frontier AI approaches, and the ability to translate technical AI capability into a clear commercial proposition. 
Knowledge of Field Service Management, Enterprise Asset Management, Manufacturing, ERP, Industrial AI, or enterprise business applications is advantageous. 
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline. MBA is beneficial. 
 Skills & Competencies
Commercial mindset with strong business and revenue acumen. 
Strategic thinking combined with hands-on execution. 
Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership skills. 
Ability to influence senior executives and global sales organisations without direct authority. 
Ability to translate complex AI, optimisation, and scheduling concepts into clear, customer-facing propositions. 
Strong presentation, communication, and storytelling skills. 
Data-driven decision making with the ability to translate insights into commercial action. 
Strong project and program management capabilities. 
Ability to thrive in fast-paced, global, and matrixed environments. 
Passion for building repeatable GTM motions that drive measurable business outcomes. 
 Additional Information
 We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

title: Senior GTM Insights Analyst
description:
About Gusto
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy.
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About The Role
 The Senior GTM Insights Analyst is the strategic and analytical backbone of Gusto's GTM organization. You will partner directly with GTM leadership to shape business strategy, own the analytics infrastructure and serve as the connective tissue between Finance, GTM Operations, GTM leadership, and Product/Growth. You'll build and defend the end-to-end view of how our GTM organization is designed, how our sales processes perform, and how changes to the business (new products, pricing, org design, market shifts) ripple through the organization and revenue outcomes.
Where other RevOps leaders own the operational engine & execution you own the strategic and analytical through-line that cuts across all of them, translating what's happening across every motion into a single, coherent narrative leadership can act on, and translating, positioning, and reporting business decisions directly to the Head of GTM for the entirety of the org.
This is a high-visibility leadership role embedded in Revenue Operations, partnering directly with the Head of GTM, Finance, Product, Growth, and every GTM route-to-market leader.
 About The Team
 You'll join the Revenue Operations organization at Gusto. RevOps at Gusto owns the machine: the infrastructure, systems, and operational execution that make our GTM motions possible.
You'll be a peer to the RevOps leaders aligned to each route to market along with Sales Compensation, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems & Tooling, but your remit cuts horizontally across all of them rather than sitting inside one. The best version of this role is fluent in the mechanics of every motion without being married to any one of them, and leans into those partnerships to build one shared picture of the business rather than several competing ones.
 Here's What You'll Do Day-to-day
 Strategy & Business Partnership
Partner directly with the Head of GTM, Head of Revenue Ops, GTM leadership & I&O to shape business strategy, translating ambiguous strategic questions into structured analysis leadership can act on.
Serve as the primary conduit between Finance, GTM Operations, and GTM leadership, translating financial targets into operational plans, and operational reality back into financial forecasts.
Build the end-to-end view of the sales process across every route to market so leadership always has one coherent picture of how the business functions & performs
Represent GTM in cross-functional conversations with Product and Growth, ensuring changes to product, pricing, or packaging are understood in terms of their downstream impact on pipeline, quota, and rep behavior before they ship. Partnering directly with your RevOps peers to execute new sales motions or change existing sales processes & behaviors.
 Analytics & Reporting Infrastructure
Partner with Revenue Analytics to build the core analytics and reporting infrastructure the GTM org relies on, defining the metrics, definitions, and data sources that leadership trusts as the single source of truth.
Design and maintain the recurring reporting cadence (weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews) that keeps the Head of GTM and their leadership team decision-ready.
Partner with Revenue Analytics, GTM Systems & Tooling, and Finance to ensure the analytics layer scales as new routes to market, products, and motions are added.
Build forward-looking models (scenario planning, what-if analysis) that quantify how a proposed business decision would change outcomes and expectations before it's made.
 Translation & Executive Communication
Translate business decisions (org changes, comp plan updates, territory redesigns, product launches) into clear positioning and narrative for the Head of GTM and the broader GTM org.
Own executive-level reporting directly to the Head of GTM, distilling complex, cross-functional inputs into a small number of decisions and recommendations.
Partner with Finance to act as the trusted second read on any major GTM decision, pressure-testing assumptions and identifying where a proposed change will create winners, losers, or unintended consequences across routes to market.
 Cross-Functional Alignment
Build and maintain trusted relationships with Finance, Product, Growth, and every GTM lead, so GTM strategy reflects input from, and stays aligned with, the rest of the business.
Identify where routes to market should operate consistently and where they genuinely need to diverge, and make that judgment visible to leadership rather than letting it get decided ad hoc, motion by motion.
 Here's What We're Looking For
8+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Operations, Sales Operations, Strategy, or a strategy/analytics function within a SaaS or subscription business, with direct exposure to senior sales or GTM leadership.
Proven experience acting as a strategic partner to senior GTM leadership, not just an analyst producing reports on request, but someone who shapes the questions being asked.
Deep fluency in building and owning analytics and reporting infrastructure end-to-end, including defining metrics and data sources that become the org's source of truth.
Track record of translating complex, cross-functional inputs (Finance, Product, Ops) into clear executive narrative and recommendations.
Experience partnering across Finance, Product, and GTM Ops, with the credibility to influence decisions in each.
Strong analytical foundation: comfortable building financial/operational models, auditing assumptions, and explaining them in plain English to senior leaders.
AI fluency is required: you actively use AI tools to automate workflows, accelerate analysis, and prototype operational solutions.
Clear, credible communication style: you can influence without authority, hold the line in escalations, and present confidently to senior GTM leaders.
Familiarity with multi-segment or multi-motion GTM orgs (Direct, Indirect, or similar) strongly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 Compensation
 Our cash compensation amount for this role is targeted at $130,000 - $160,000/yr in Denver, Atlanta, and Scottsdale, $155,000 - $185,000/yr in San Francisco and New York, and $150,000 - $180,000 CAD/yr for Toronto. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience and expertise and may vary from the amounts listed above.

 insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com. 
 Job Description: 
 The Director of Retention Operations for the Reporting business unit is a strategic operations leader responsible for gross retention rate (GRR) and net retention rate (NRR) across a high-volume customer base. Reporting to the General Manager, this role consolidates customer success signal at scale, identifies churn risk and expansion opportunities across cohorts, and ensures execution of programmatic retention and growth strategies. 
 This is an internal, cross-functional operations role that brings discipline and scalability to retention by maintaining visibility into cohort and segment health trends, analyzing churn patterns and root causes, and ensuring that retention and expansion strategies are being executed with consistency and rigor. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Consolidate customer health signals (usage trends, engagement, support incidents, expansion opportunity) from customer success teams to provide the GM with weekly visibility into account and cohort health 
 Track gross retention rate (GRR) and net retention rate (NRR) by product, segment, and cohort; conduct variance analysis to identify deterioration trends and positive momentum 
 Identify at-risk account cohorts and customers; work with customer success to develop targeted interventions and track remediation progress 
 Conduct root-cause analysis on churn trends; identify systemic issues (product, onboarding, support, pricing) and recommend operational or product improvements 
 Partner with customer success, product, and marketing to design and implement retention and expansion plays (e.g., programmatic outreach, upgrade campaigns, engagement initiatives) 
 Maintain dashboards that track GRR, NRR, churn cohorts, expansion opportunity, and other key retention metrics; provide predictive forecasts of end-of-period performance 
 Work with customer success to develop and implement escalation and resolution protocols for at-risk accounts 
 Provide regular reporting to the GM on retention performance, key drivers, and recommended actions 
 Deep understanding of the at risk accounts and the plan of attack to maintain each customer and grow GRR. 
 Identify and work to resolve issues impacting customer retention through process improvement challenges with renewal management and other CS ops related patterns. 
 What Success Looks Like 
 The Director has real-time visibility into GRR and NRR performance by segment and cohort, with clear understanding of primary churn drivers 
 At-risk cohorts are identified early (at least one quarter in advance), with documented interventions tracked to completion 
 Churn analysis is conducted systematically for all at-risk accounts; patterns are identified and communicated to product and operations 
 Retention and expansion plays are tracked against execution and adoption targets 
 GRR and NRR meet or exceed target, with measurable improvement in efficiency and speed of intervention 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 Seven to ten years of experience in customer success operations, retention analytics, or similar role in a high-volume B2B SaaS environment 
 Deep understanding of SaaS metrics (GRR, NRR, CAC payback, churn drivers, cohort analysis) and ability to identify and investigate performance variances 
 Demonstrable experience working with programmatic or high-volume customer bases (100 plus accounts or more) 
 Strong analytical and data visualization skills; comfort with SQL, BI tools, and statistical analysis 
 Experience designing and tracking retention initiatives or campaigns at scale 
 Excellent communication skills and ability to distill complex analyses into actionable insights for leadership 
 Project management mindset: ability to manage multiple retention and expansion initiatives in parallel 
 Core Attributes 
 Systematic: Brings structure and process to high-volume environments; thinks in terms of cohorts and patterns, not just individual accounts. 
 Analytical: Comfortable working with large datasets; good at identifying signal in noise. 
 Collaborative: Partners well with customer success, product, and marketing; sees retention as a shared responsibility. 
 Execution-oriented: Focuses on results and impact; isn't satisfied until strategies are tested, tracked, and optimized . 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 Base salary: Competitive, based on experience. Bonus structure: 8 0 percent base, 2 0 percent bonus tied to GRR and NRR targets for the Reporting cohort. 
 Benefits package includes health insurance, 401(k), professional development support, and flexible work arrangements. 
The salary range in United States of America for this position is 160,000.00 to 201,000.00 USD Annual.
 For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply. 
 Your specific offer within this range will be determined by your skills, experience, and qualifications. 
 We are committed to pay transparency and fair compensation practices. If you have questions about our compensation approach, please don't hesitate to ask during the interview process. 
 Additional Information 
 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 
 Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us 
 insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team 
 Background checks are required for employment with insightsoftware, where permitted by country, state/province. 
 At insightsoftware, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: Sales Operations Junior Analyst
description:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.
From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.
10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.
But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.
If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.
Find us on Instagram: @optimizely
 Introduction 
 Optimizely is seeking a Sales Operations Analyst, Conversation Intelligence to join our GTM Operations team.
Every day, Optimizely generates thousands of recorded customer conversations — discovery and negotiation calls, onboarding and implementation sessions, QBRs and renewal discussions, support interactions, and AI-agent exchanges. Individually they are anecdotes. Systematically captured, tagged and routed, they are the most honest signal we have about why we win, why we lose, why customers churn, and what the market actually wants from us.
This role exists to build that system. You will own how conversation data is captured, structured and turned into decisions across the revenue organization — starting with seller performance and deal health, and extending across the full customer lifecycle.
This is a build role, not a reporting role. You will be the connective tissue between Sales, Customer Success, Onboarding & Services, Enablement, Marketing, Product and our Operations, Technology, Data & Analytics team.
 Job Responsibilities
 What You’ll Own
 The conversation data foundation
⚬ CI Strategy & Roadmap: Execute Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA) strategy across Sales, CS, and Onboarding.
⚬ Signal Taxonomy & Routing: Build a cross-functional signal taxonomy and routing logic to direct insights to owners.
⚬ Data Quality & Capture Strategy: Track recording coverage, establish quality thresholds, and manage tooling capture strategies.
 Sales execution and performance
⚬ Workflow Transformation & Auditing: Integrate transcript insights into key deal milestones and use Salesforce data to audit deal stages and forecast accuracy.
⚬ Methodology Adherence & Performance: Build scorecards to measure sales methodology on live calls and surface coaching insights.
⚬ Productivity & Win/Loss Program: Scale top-performing rep behaviors and run a win/loss program to identify cycle friction.
 Retention, onboarding and expansion
⚬ CS & Onboarding Workflows: Operationalize CI across adoption, onboarding, risk identification, and renewals.
⚬ Risk & Health Signals: Define early risk indicators to feed health scores and alert CSMs early.
⚬ Expansion Detection: Surface cross-sell opportunities for Optimizely One and route qualified signals to CSMs/sellers.
 Cross-functional intelligence
⚬ Competitive & Pricing Insights: Provide evidence on competitors, objections, and discount triggers to PMM, Deal Desk, and Finance.
⚬ Product & Messaging Feedback: Extract feature requests for Product and deliver ICP/messaging evidence to Marketing.
⚬ Enablement & Risk Flagging: Measure post-enablement behavior, flag off-script commitment risks, and create process docs.
 Platform and AI operations
⚬ Platform & Prompt Management: Build, test, and maintain AI prompt frameworks (e.g., ZRA, LLMs) and optimize the CI tech stack.
⚬ Product Fluency: Maintain functional knowledge of our Opal platform and apply internal AI capabilities to GTM ops.
 What Success Looks Like
 Within the first 12 months, you will demonstrate:
⚬ Expanded Coverage: Measurable conversation coverage across Revenue with shrinking blind spots.
⚬ Methodology Impact: Documented methodology adherence that correlates with higher win rates.
⚬ Forecast Accuracy: Improved forecast accuracy via conversation-validated deal stages.
⚬ Proactive CS Signals: Early risk and expansion signals delivered to CS and Onboarding.
⚬ Cross-Functional Trust: A recurring intelligence readout consumed outside Revenue.
 Behavioral Expectations
 ⚬ Process-First Mindset: Strong project management background to build scalable AI workflows in a fast-paced environment.
⚬ Outcome-Oriented: Prioritize work aligning with company objectives and business outcomes.
⚬ Cross-Functional Influence: Operate comfortably across boundaries to align non-direct-report teams.
⚬ Accountability & Problem-Solving: Blameless mindset focused on transparency and preventative solutions.
⚬ Self-Driven Innovation: Continuously experiment, research, and self-teach emerging AI/CI tools.
⚬ Curious & Transparent: Curious about GTM AI tech, maintaining clear communication and healthy work/life balance.
 Knowledge And Experience
2+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or GTM Process Strategy, ideally at a SaaS company 
Conversation intelligence and AI tool fluency: hands-on experience with conversation intelligence platforms (e.g. Zoom Revenue Accelerator, Gong, Clari, Chorus) and modern GTM AI tools, including large language models and prompt engineering 
Analytical acumen: comfortable turning qualitative conversational data and AI outputs into clear, actionable metrics for leadership 
Taxonomy and data structuring instinct: able to impose consistent structure on unstructured, messy conversational data 
Cross-functional delivery: experience running programs that span Sales, CS and other functions 
Experience with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise CRM 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree or related educational degree or certificates

title: Associate Director, Sales Planning Strategy and Operations
description:
The Associate Director, Sales Planning Strategy and Operations is responsible for leading the operational strategy, governance, and execution of key initiatives that enable the Global Compensation Center of Excellence (COE). This role will partner with key stakeholders across business units and within the Comp COE. As the operational backbone of the COE, the Associate Director develops scalable processes, knowledge management resources, communications that enhance stakeholder experience and improve operational efficiencies.
 Key Responsibilities:
Lead the global Annual Sales Planning program, overseeing the strategy, governance, and execution of planning activities across regions, divisions and business units, including segmentation, territory design, quota planning, capacity planning, compensation planning, and deployment readiness.
Establish and continuously enhance scalable planning frameworks, governance models, processes, and best practices that drive consistency, operational excellence, and alignment across global planning teams and stakeholders.
Serve as a strategic advisor and business partner to Revenue Operations, Sales, Service, Finance, HR, Compensation, Technology, and executive leadership, translating complex business requirements into actionable plans, aligning priorities, and ensuring successful execution of critical initiatives.
Drive cross-functional program leadership and stakeholder alignment by coordinating Annual Planning workstreams, elevating dependencies and risks, facilitating governance forums, and ensuring accountability for key milestones, decisions, and deliverables.
Provide executive-level program management and decision support, developing leadership communications, strategic updates, business reviews, and governance reporting that enable informed decision-making and visibility into planning progress, risks, and outcomes.
Advance planning effectiveness through data-driven insights, automation, and continuous improvement, identifying opportunities across people, process, technology, data, and governance while leveraging AI-enabled solutions to accelerate Annual Planning cycles, improve reporting, and strengthen operational maturity.
Act as a strategic extension of Sales Planning and Revenue Operations leadership, driving organizational planning, operating cadences, governance activities, executive communications, and special initiatives that improve alignment, execution, and achievement of global planning priorities.
 Ideal Candidate Profile:
Extensive experience in Sales Planning, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Planning, or related strategic operating functions within a complex global technology or B2B organization.
Demonstrated expertise leading large-scale annual planning cycles, including segmentation, territory planning, quota setting, capacity planning, compensation planning, and go-to-market operational readiness.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs and enterprise initiatives, driving alignment across geographically dispersed teams and stakeholders with competing priorities.
Strong executive presence with experience supporting senior leadership, including preparation of executive communications, business reviews, presentations, and strategic recommendations for C-level and senior executives.
Exceptional program management, organizational, and operational leadership skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives, navigate ambiguity, and deliver results in fast-paced environments.
Experience developing governance frameworks, operating models, KPIs, and performance measurements that improve strategic planning effectiveness, execution quality, and organizational accountability.
Strong relationship-building, communication, and influence skills, with a proven track record of partnering across Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, Compensation, Technology, and regional business leadership.
Strategic and analytical mindset with the ability to identify risks, anticipate challenges, uncover opportunities, and translate business objectives into scalable operational solutions.
Working knowledge of sales planning and revenue operations ecosystems, including CRM, ERP, SPM/ICM, HRM, and planning platforms such as Xactly Plan, Anaplan, or similar solutions.
Experience leveraging automation, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, decision-making, and planning outcomes.
Global business experience supporting teams across EMEA, AMER, APAC, and/or LATAM, with a strong understanding of regional go-to-market and organizational dynamics within highly matrixed environments.
 Preferred Qualifications:
Experience implementing process automation, AI-enabled workflows, or digital transformation initiatives supporting planning, operations, or business execution.
Our Interview Practices
 To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

title: Head of Revenue Operations | IFS Copperleaf
description:
About IFS Copperleaf 
IFS Copperleaf builds decision analytics and capital planning software for the organisations that run critical infrastructure: electric, gas and water utilities, transportation and rail, oil and gas, mining, and the public sector. Our software helps asset-intensive companies decide where and when to invest, balancing cost, risk, performance and sustainability, and it is used today to manage more than $2.9 trillion of assets worldwide.
These are high-stakes, evidence-led sales. Our buyers, CFOs, VPs of Asset Management, chief engineers and capital planning leaders, answer to regulators, boards and rate cases. Winning new logos and growing ARR depends on a sales engine that runs on clean data, sharp forecasting and a deal process that makes it easy for our customers to buy.
 The Role 
We are hiring a Head of Revenue Operations to be the operational backbone of the Copperleaf go-to-market team. Reporting to the COO, you will own forecasting, pipeline management, the deal desk, CRM, sales analytics, territory planning, and sales compensation. You will turn a complex, enterprise sales motion into a predictable one.
This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between the boardroom and the spreadsheet. One day you are presenting the quarterly forecast and its risks to leadership; the next you are rebuilding a stage definition in Salesforce because the data is not telling us the truth. Help us sign more new logos and grow ARR, by making the sales team faster, sharper and easier to buy from.
 What You Will Own 
 Forecasting, pipeline and demand generation. Run the forecast and demand generation cadence end to end.
 Deal desk and deal support. Own the contracting workflow and deal review for complex, multi-year enterprise deals. Make it easy to buy.
 CRM and systems. Own Salesforce and the wider sales tech stack as the single source of truth. Set data standards and make sure the tooling serves the seller rather than the other way round.
 Sales analytics and reporting. Build reporting: pipeline bridges, conversion by stage, win/loss patterns, ARR movement, quota attainment and productivity.
 AI in the go-to-market motion . Put AI to work across RevOps: forecasting and scoring, deal and win/loss analysis, and automating the manual work. Set the standards for how the GTM team uses AI well, and lead by example.
 Planning and territory. Support annual planning: quota setting, territory and account coverage, capacity modelling and headcount planning, working closely with sales leadership and finance.
 Sales compensation. Own the sales compensation plan, including quota letters, commission structures, crediting rules and payout administration, ensuring the plan is clear, enforceable and aligned to business priorities.

Substantial experience in sales operations, revenue operations or a closely related function within enterprise B2B software or SaaS, including time leading or effectively running the function.
A strong grasp of complex, long-cycle enterprise deals with seven figure ACVs, multiple stakeholders, and procurement and legal scrutiny.
Deep Salesforce fluency and comfort across the sales tech stack: you can design the process, not just administer it.
Strong practical fluency with AI: you use it daily in your own work and stay at the forefront of innovation in the AI and RevOps space.
Genuine analytical horsepower.
A track record of improving forecast accuracy, conversion or sales productivity in a measurable way.
Excellent communication.
 Why This Role Matters 
Copperleaf sells a product that helps the world’s infrastructure operators make better decisions with scarce capital. We making it easier to for our customers to buy this software.
 Location and How We Work 
This is a London-based role (Staines) with a hybrid pattern, combining time in our UK office with remote work. Some travel should be expected for team, customer and company events.
IFS is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.
At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.
We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.
We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
 We embrace flexibility and hybrid work opportunities to support diverse needs and lifestyles, while also valuing inclusive workplace experiences. By fostering a sense of community, we drive innovation, strengthen connections, and nurture belonging. Our commitment ensures you can work in a way that suits you best, while also engaging with colleagues to share ideas and build meaningful relationships.

We believe that coming together as a community, in person, is important for innovation, connection and fostering a sense of belonging. Our roles have the right balance of remote and in-office working to enable flexibility for managing your life along with ensuring a real connection with your colleagues and the broader IFS community.

title: Product Sales Operations & Enablement Specialist (12 month FTC)
description:
We’re reinventing payments.
 In less than four years, Dojo disrupted the market to become the largest and most loved acquirer in the UK. Our payments infrastructure, purpose-built for in-person commerce, is game changing.
Now, over 150,000 customers across four countries choose to transact billions with us every year.
But we’re just getting started.

title: Customer Success Operations Specialist
description:
Ready to accelerate your career? 
Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.
Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.
Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.
Cardata is looking for a Customer Success Operations Specialist to strengthen how we equip our customer-facing teams and educate our customers. You’ll connect Customer Success, Product, Support, Implementation and Product Marketing, making sure product changes are understood, customer questions are heard, and the right training and communications reach the right people. This is an operations and enablement role. Your focus will be building repeatable processes, resources and communications that help the whole CS team succeed. 
 What you’ll do 
Meet with Product at the end of each sprint to understand what has been completed, when it will be released and which customers will benefit
Translate release notes into practical training for CS and Support, including feature demonstrations, customer use cases, talking points and answers to likely questions
Help CSMs explain the value of new features and identify opportunities to introduce them to existing customers
Monitor questions from CSMs and customer admins to spot knowledge gaps, then develop group training, individual coaching or resources to address them
Regularly review and verify internal documentation in Guru so customer-facing teams can rely on it
Plan and manage communications to drivers, admins and customer contacts, using Mailchimp to reach the right audiences with clear, timely information
Demonstrate new features to existing customers through webinars or other training sessions, and answer questions about how to use them
Partner with Product Marketing to create customer enablement materials, including emails, webinars, guides and certifications
Share customer insights with Product Marketing to help shape customer campaigns, then brief the CS team on upcoming campaigns and how they can use them in customer conversations
Work with the Implementation Specialist to develop live and self-serve training, using tools such as Loom and Navattic where appropriate
Work with Support to identify ticket trends by program type, customer segment and account, and translate those trends into useful insights for CS and Product
Bring recurring customer questions, feedback and adoption barriers to Product as a trusted voice of the customer
Turn repeated questions into practical resources, such as videos, guides and one-pagers, and improve those resources based on how teams and customers use them
 What you bring 
3-5 years of experience in Customer Success Operations, customer enablement, customer education or a related role 
The ability to learn a product in depth and explain complex features in clear, useful language for internal teams and customers
Experience developing and delivering training, product demonstrations and written enablement materials
Hands-on experience with Mailchimp or a similar platform for building, segmenting and sending customer communications
Strong writing, facilitation and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate work across several teams
Comfort using customer feedback, support trends and recurring questions to decide where training or documentation is needed
Experience with knowledge and training tools such as Guru, Loom or Navattic is an asset
Hands-on experience with Customer Success and Support tools such as Gainsight, Zendesk, and Hubspot is an asset
 Compensation: 
In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the expected base compensation for this role is $75,000–$90,000 CAD annually (dependent on experience and competency). This is a vacant position , and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

title: Head of Sales Operations & Enablement
description:
Head of Sales Operations & Enablement 
 London (Hybrid - 2/3 days per week) 
 We're looking for someone who gets things done. 
Someone who can walk into a growing business, quickly spot where things aren't working, cut through the noise and actually do something about it.
You'll be working with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Pre-Sales and the wider organisation, identifying the gaps between strategy and execution and turning them into action.
You'll challenge people when things aren't working. You'll hold senior stakeholders accountable.
You'll bring different functions together when they're pulling in different directions. And you'll help create the kind of accountability, ownership and culture that allows a high-growth business to scale.
This isn't a role for someone who wants to sit behind a dashboard, build another process or spend six months analysing the problem.
 It's for an operator. 
Someone who sees an issue, understands what's really going on, gets the right people around the table and drives it through to a better outcome.
Our client is a rapidly growing global cybersecurity business helping organisations identify, prioritise and mitigate digital risk across their external attack surface.
They're now looking for a Head of Sales Operations & Enablement to help shape the next stage of their growth.
Reporting directly to the COO , you'll operate at a senior level across the commercial organisation, working closely with the C-suite and senior leaders across Sales, Marketing and Pre-Sales.
For the right person, this is much bigger than a traditional Sales Operations role. It's an opportunity to influence how the organisation operates, drive meaningful cultural and commercial change, and potentially grow into a broader COO-level position over time. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Spotting Gaps & Driving Change 
You'll get close to the business and quickly understand where things are working, where they're not and what's getting in the way of growth.
You'll identify the gaps between strategy and execution and take ownership of fixing them.
That could mean addressing issues between Sales and Marketing, improving how opportunities are progressed, strengthening accountability across teams or identifying where a lack of ownership is slowing the business down.
You'll be expected to identify quick wins, take action and deliver visible improvements. 
 Holding Senior Leaders Accountable 
You'll work with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Pre-Sales and other functions.
You'll need to be comfortable asking difficult questions, challenging assumptions and holding people accountable for agreed actions.
Where different functions aren't aligned, you'll bring the right people together, get to the root of the issue and drive towards a resolution.
You won't necessarily have direct authority over everyone you work with, so influence, credibility and emotional intelligence will be critical.
 Building a More Effective Commercial Organisation 
The business has a successful commercial organisation and people who know how to win business.
The opportunity is to build greater consistency around that success.
You'll help create the programmes, operating rhythms and ways of working that allow teams to execute more effectively and scale.
You'll work with sales leaders and sellers to improve areas such as pipeline quality, opportunity progression, deal execution, follow-up and sales effectiveness.
The focus isn't on adding bureaucracy.
It's on making the organisation better at executing. 
 Creating Cultural Change 
This role goes beyond process.
You'll help build a culture where people take ownership, commitments are followed through and teams work together towards shared commercial objectives.
You'll need to understand the dynamics within different functions and know when to challenge, when to coach and when to bring people together.
The goal is to create lasting changes in behaviour, accountability and execution , not simply introduce another process.
 Working at C-Suite Level 
You'll report directly to the COO and have significant exposure to the senior leadership team.
You'll be working across the organisation rather than operating within a single functional silo.
You'll need to understand the broader business strategy, identify what it means for the commercial organisation and translate that into practical action.
You'll also have the opportunity to bring your own experience and ideas to the table.
The business is looking for someone who has seen this before and can share what they've learned from scaling businesses, including what worked, what didn't and what they would do differently.
 Building for the Next Stage of Growth 
You'll help shape how the commercial organisation operates over the next 6-12 months .
That means balancing immediate priorities and quick wins with the longer-term changes needed to support continued growth.
You'll help turn successful individual behaviours into repeatable programmes, strengthen collaboration between functions and create greater visibility and accountability across the commercial organisation.
For the right person, the remit could develop significantly over time, with the potential to grow into a broader COO-level leadership position. 
 What You Should Have: 
 A Sales & Commercial Background 
We're looking for someone who has come from a strong sales or commercial environment and genuinely understands how revenue is generated.
You should understand the realities of sales teams, customers, pipeline, deal execution and commercial performance.
You don't need to have followed a traditional Sales Operations career path.
In fact, experience across different commercial environments could be particularly valuable.
 Action Orientation 
 This is one of the most important characteristics we're looking for. 
You need to be someone who gets things done.
You don't wait for perfect information, endless meetings or someone else to give you permission to solve a problem.
You see something that isn't working, understand the issue, get the right people involved and drive it through to a better outcome.
 Senior Presence & Influence 
You'll be operating with senior stakeholders across the organisation, so you'll need the credibility and confidence to hold your own at C-suite level.
You should be comfortable challenging senior people when necessary and having difficult conversations without creating unnecessary conflict.
We're looking for someone who can command respect without relying on hierarchy. 
 Emotional Intelligence 
Being able to identify a problem is one thing.
Knowing how to fix it within a complex organisation is another.
You'll need to understand different personalities, motivations and functional priorities, and know how to bring people with you when change is required.
You should be direct and challenging, but also collaborative and politically aware.
 Scale-Up Experience 
Ideally, you'll have worked in a Series B, Series C or similarly scaled technology business .
You'll understand the challenges that come with growth and will have experienced the inevitable mistakes, changes and challenges that happen along the way.
We're particularly interested in people who have developed genuine battle scars and can bring those lessons into the business.
 Ownership 
We're interested in what you personally did .
If you've helped grow revenue, improved sales performance or changed how a commercial organisation operates, we'll want to understand your specific contribution.
You'll need to be comfortable moving beyond "we" and explaining:
 What did you do? 
What did you identify?
What did you change?
Who did you influence?
What resistance did you encounter?
What was the outcome?
We're looking for someone with a clear track record of personal impact and ownership. 
 Strategic Thinking 
You'll need to be able to zoom out as well as get into the detail.
While you'll be expected to identify quick wins and make an immediate impact, you'll also need to think about what the business needs from its commercial organisation over the next 6-12 months.
You'll help translate that thinking into practical programmes and actions that the organisation can actually execute.
 What You'll Get 
Six Figure + base salary, Variable Bonus, Share Options + others usuals.
Senior leadership position reporting directly to the COO
Significant exposure to the C-suite and wider leadership team
Opportunity to influence how a growing global cybersecurity business operates
London-based hybrid working, with 2-3 days per week in the office
Significant autonomy and ownership
Opportunity to work across Sales, Marketing, Pre-Sales and the wider commercial organisation
Opportunity to bring your own experience, ideas and lessons from previous scale-ups into the business
Potential for the role to develop into a broader COO-level position
Opportunity to make visible and measurable changes to the way the organisation operates
A key role in shaping the next stage of the company's growth

title: Manager, Customer Success Architects (AI) in EMEA
description:
Working at Atlassian 
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
What you'll do
In this role, you'll lead a team of Customer Success Architects (AI) within the Customer Success Architecture organization, focusing on the adoption of Atlassian's AI platform, Rovo. As a Manager, you'll own the operational health and performance of your pod — ensuring your team delivers time-boxed, co-built technical engagements that take customers from "Rovo is turned on" to real, measurable business value in production.
You'll hire, coach, and develop Customer Success Architects (AI) who partner directly with enterprise teams to discover high-impact AI use cases, design and build custom Rovo agents, configure third-party connectors, and deploy working solutions into production workflows. You're accountable for engagement quality, team capacity planning, adoption metrics, and your direct reports' professional growth.
We're hiring a Manager, Customer Success Architects (AI) to join our Customer Success Architects team, reporting to a regional Senior Manager, Customer Success Architecture. You lead through people management, operational excellence, and domain expertise. You partner with Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure your team delivers solutions and technical guidance that help customers achieve their desired outcomes and goals.
You'll help your team's strongest customer promoters showcase their successes to peers, and ensure your pod serves as the tip of the spear in expanding the reach of AI and the Atlassian System of Work into new use cases and markets.
On your first day, we'll expect you to have:
 Lead & Develop. Hire, coach, and grow a team of Customer Success Architects (AI). Set clear expectations, run regular 1:1s, and create development plans that build deep technical expertise across the Atlassian platform.
 Operate. Own pod-level capacity planning, engagement assignments, and delivery quality. Monitor key operational metrics (e.g., TTFA, Cycle Times, Capacity) and broader business outcomes like product adoption and engagement completion rates, taking proactive action when engagements are at risk.
 Enable. Ensure your team has current playbooks, enablement materials, and access to product changes. Partner with Senior Customer Success Architects on methodology iteration and onboarding of new hires.
 Collaborate. Work with Account Teams, Customer Success Managers, and Sales leadership to prioritize customer engagements. Align pod capacity with pipeline demand and strategic account needs.
 Bridge Product & Field. Partner with Rovo Product and Engineering to surface systemic product friction your team encounters. Synthesize field patterns into structured feedback that influences roadmap priorities.
 Advocate. Represent TAS in cross-functional forums. Ensure your team's customer successes are visible internally and externally, contributing to case studies, events, and community engagement.
Familiarity with EMEA-specific regulatory frameworks, including GDPR and the EU AI Act, as they relate to enterprise AI adoption and data residency.
Travel up to 15% domestically and internationally for team events, customer meetings, and offsites.
*This position is UK based. 
 Experience: 8+ years in professional services, consulting, or SaaS implementation, with at least 2 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, billable services portfolios and teams.
 Project Management: Knowledge of project management frameworks (PMP, Agile, ITIL); experience with custom Statement of Work (SOW) scoping and delivery.
 Customer Success Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams; experience managing P&L and driving financial KPIs.
 Customer Focus: Strong background in building and maintaining executive-level customer relationships, driving customer satisfaction, and delivering outcome-based solutions.
 Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels and present complex information clearly.

P&L ownership and financial KPI management
Professional services/consulting or SaaS implementation background
SOW scoping and PMP/Agile/ITIL project frameworks
Technical delivery: AI agent build, connector configuration

title: Senior Sales Strategy & Analytics Manager
description:
Who We Are 
Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!
 Why This Role is Exciting: 
Our team believes great decisions start with great data. We're Sales Strategy & Analytics — you'll also hear us called Moneyball — and we turn pipeline, revenue, and customer signals into the insights that shape how the business grows. We're looking for someone who wants to help lead that work.
As our Senior Sales Planning & Analytics Manager, you'll own core pieces of our go-to-market planning and performance measurement system: annual ARR and pipeline generation targets, sales quotas, headcount and capacity models, and the dashboards and frameworks that keep leaders aligned. You'll work closely with GTM and Finance leadership, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and turning complex data into calls people can actually act on.
You'll report directly to our Director of Sales Strategy & Analytics, on a small, dedicated team focused on one thing: helping commercial leadership make the data-backed calls that drive our revenue growth.
This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who's just as comfortable building a model from scratch as they are sitting at the table with senior leadership, helping shape commercial strategy.
 Key Responsibilities: 
Own planning fundamentals
Build company-wide annual ARR and pipeline generation targets, translating growth goals into structured assumptions and scenarios
Own sales quota setting, headcount and capacity models, and rep productivity analysis
Support territory design so coverage matches where the growth opportunity actually is
Bring consistency to planning cycles by defining clear inputs, timelines, and outputs across workstreams
 Turn data into decisions 
Build and maintain the dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reports that give sales, SE, and xDR teams real visibility into what's working
Define leading indicators that flag risk and opportunity early — before they show up in the topline numbers
Standardize metrics across regions, channels, and product lines into a single source of truth
Use AI to build tools and efficiencies that scale the team's work — not one-off experiments, but things GTM teams actually rely on day to day
 Be a strategic partner 
Partner with GTM and Finance leaders to shape how performance gets measured and how decisions get made
Compress complex analysis into a clear, defensible recommendation
Align stakeholders around a shared narrative, cutting through fragmented views of the same numbers
Raise the bar
Set the standard for analytical rigor and QA across the analytics team
Mentor peers and junior analysts on modeling, scenario planning, and executive communication
Push reporting automation and data quality forward as the business scales
 Attributes for a Successful Candidate 
5+ years in GTM analytics, sales operations, or a related function supporting an enterprise, multi-product GTM motion (B2B SaaS strongly preferred)
Deep understanding of GTM motions, sales planning (territories, quota setting), and forecasting for sales, SE, and xDR functions
Hands-on SQL — you can pull, join, and validate data independently, without waiting on another team
Fluency with the modern B2B commercial stack (Salesforce, Gong, Clari, etc.) and a BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar)
Practical experience using AI to build GTM tools and workflow efficiencies that scale — you've shipped things people actually keep using, not just experimented
Strong executive communication: you can turn a complex analysis into one clear recommendation your CGO can act on
The judgment to structure ambiguous problems, and the courage to push back on convention when the data says so
 Nice to Have 
Experience with dbt, Python or R, and a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
Experience building with LLM APIs or AI-assisted analytics tooling — natural-language querying, automated narrative reporting, and the like
 Compensation Range 
$129,600 – $178,200

Your relevant skills, experience, and certifications
Where you are physically located (based on our regional tier system)

 *perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.
Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.
Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.
