title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
Job DescriptionJob DescriptionCompany Overview 
Mortgage Automator is on a mission to revolutionize the lending industry by providing a comprehensive, end-to-end platform that eliminates the manual bottlenecks of private lending. Our innovative software empowers lenders to streamline their entire pipeline from origination and underwriting to automated servicing and investor reporting, so they can focus on scaling their business with confidence.
As one of the fastest-growing FinTech companies in North America, Mortgage Automator is customer-centric, ambitious, and deeply rooted in the lending community. We are building the "operating system" for private lenders, fostering a culture of ownership, high-speed execution, and decentralized decision-making.
Job Summary 
This role is the strategic thought leader for Revenue Operations at Mortgage Automator. It goes beyond configuring HubSpot: the mandate is to proactively surface where the funnel is leaking, build the systems that make revenue predictable and repeatable, and bring a strong, data-backed point of view to how we grow.
You'll build a consolidated view of the business, rooted in our history and tested against forward-looking hypotheses, and use it to align Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing around one version of the truth. You'll also be expected to use AI tools to push both the customer experience and the team's own productivity forward, not just automate what already exists.
This is a builder's role. There's no fixed playbook. You'll set the frameworks, the operating rhythms, and the reporting cadence, and you'll be the person leadership and the board turn to for a clear read on where revenue is headed and why.
What Success Looks Like 
A single, trusted view of funnel health that Sales, Marketing, and CS all operate from.
Forecast accuracy improves and board reporting requires less last-minute scrambling.
Funnel leaks get caught and addressed before they show up in missed targets.
The RevOps function is seen as a strategic partner by every revenue-facing team, not a ticketing queue.
You think about how the whole funnel connects, not just the piece in front of you.
You bring a point of view and defend it, but you update it when the data changes your mind.
You're comfortable being the person who tells Sales, Marketing, or CS leadership something they don't want to hear, backed by data.
You build for scale, not just for the next fire.
You use AI as a first instinct, not an afterthought.
 Requirements 
Required Education & Experience 
4+ years leading a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations function in a B2B SaaS environment.
A track record as a fluent builder: someone who has built forecasting models, funnel reporting, and operational processes from scratch, not just maintained someone else's system.
Maniacal prioritization. You know how to protect your focus and your team's, even when every department wants a piece of you.
Strong cross-functional stakeholder management across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance.
Experience presenting to and partnering with a board or executive leadership team on revenue performance and forecasting.
Deep comfort with CRM systems (HubSpot preferred) and the data architecture behind them, but you think in systems and outcomes, not just fields and workflows.
A genuinely opinionated approach to data: you don't just report what happened, you tell people what it means and what to do about it.
Essential Functions 
Own the Funnel;
Take end-to-end ownership of the revenue funnel across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, from lead creation through renewal and expansion.
Proactively identify where the funnel is leaking (conversion drop-offs, stalled deals, churn signals) before they show up as missed targets.
Build and maintain a consolidated, opinionated view of the business that blends historical performance with forward-looking hypotheses.
Build Forecasting and Reporting Systems;
Own forecasting, pipeline management, and revenue performance reporting across the full funnel.
Establish the operating rhythms and governance (weekly, monthly, quarterly reporting cadences) that give leadership and the board a predictable read on the business.
Partner directly with the Revenue Leadership Team and executive team on board reporting, re-forecasts, and business reviews.
Drive Data Strategy and Governance;
Set the standards for what data matters, how it's defined, and who owns keeping it clean across HubSpot and other systems.
Resolve conflicts between systems of record (e.g., CRM vs. Finance) and establish a single source of truth for key metrics.
Push for proactive, not reactive, data quality: fewer dashboards nobody trusts, more definitions everyone agrees on.
Use AI to Improve the Customer and Team Experience;
Identify where AI can improve the customer experience, deal execution, or team productivity, and build or oversee those tools.
Bring a point of view on where automation should replace manual work versus where it should augment human judgment.
Lead Cross-Functional Alignment;
Surface insights and recommendations directly to Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing leadership, not just report numbers back to them.
Build and develop a small, high-leverage Revenue Operations team.
Act as a trusted partner to the executive team and board on revenue strategy, planning, and performance.
Other duties as assigned.
 Benefits 
Work Environment 
60% Office, 40% Work From Home.
Time-Off & Work Life Balance 
Comprehensive Time Off: Competitive paid vacation to unplug and recharge throughout the year.
Holistic Wellness Leave: Dedicated personal leave supporting total well-being, including physical recovery or mental health.
Commuter-Friendly Hybrid: Flexible schedule blending collaborative office time with remote work.
Team Culture & Perks 
Catered Lunches: Monthly team lunches to celebrate wins and connect with colleagues.
Growth & Learning: Continuous professional development with internal training and learning opportunities.
Modern Workspace: Professional, supportive environment with tools and technology needed to succeed.
Comprehensive Health Benefits.

Built forecasting models and funnel reporting from scratch
Board/exec presentation on revenue forecasting
Experience building and managing a RevOps team

no pay stated in the ad or the feed, verify vs floor

Hybrid 60% office means relocation to Canada before the citizenship certificate is proven.

The role combines hands-on analysis with team leadership. It owns the quality and consistency of revenue reporting, supports forecasting and planning, develops scalable dashboards and data products, and ensures stakeholders understand the commercial story behind the numbers.  Team Leadership & Delivery Management

 Revenue Analytics & Commercial Insight

Design scalable, user-friendly data products that reduce manual reporting and enable appropriate self-service analysis.
Establish documentation, refresh schedules, ownership, and service expectations for critical reports and dashboards.
Drive adoption by training users on definitions, interpretation, and effective use of revenue insight.
 Data Governance, Quality & Transformation
Define and govern commercial metrics, dimensions, business rules, and reporting hierarchies in partnership with Finance, Data, and RevOps stakeholders.
Identify material data-quality issues, quantify their business impact, assign ownership, and track remediation to closure.
Support CRM, BI, and data-platform transformation by translating commercial requirements into clear analytical and reporting specifications.
Help harmonize data and reporting across legacy systems, products, regions, and acquired businesses.
Promote appropriate controls for data access, privacy, confidentiality, and responsible handling of commercial information.

Act as the primary analytics partner for senior Revenue and RevOps stakeholders, constructively challenging assumptions and clarifying decision requirements.
Partner with Process, Tooling, Order & Contract Operations, Finance, Marketing, Product, and enterprise Data teams to align insight with operational workflows and strategic priorities.
Communicate analytical limitations, assumptions, and confidence levels clearly, avoiding false precision and ensuring decisions are evidence based.

title: Head of GTM Strategy and Planning
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
 The Team:
 The Global Lead, GTM Strategy and Planning will work as part of the Revenue Operations leadership team, reporting to the SVP Revenue Operations. This role is the strategic architect of Celonis' annual and multi-year GTM planning processes, coordinating across Sales, Marketing, Value Engineering, Services, Finance, and the broader business to ensure aligned, balanced, and executable go-to-market strategy. This person is responsible for ensuring our GTM investments, resource allocation, and organizational structure are optimized to drive sustainable growth and performance.
 The Role:
 This role owns the design and execution of our integrated GTM planning processes. You will lead comprehensive territory planning, segmentation strategy, role definition, and resource allocation exercises that balance growth objectives with sustainable unit economics. You will be the custodian of our GTM ratios and thought leader on how we structure our go-to-market. You will design and maintain the planning systems and frameworks we use to make decisions, while also being comfortable working offline and with custom modeling to stress-test plans and guide strategic decisions. You will coordinate senior stakeholders across the business to build consensus around the plan and drive alignment on priorities, resource allocation, and GTM strategy. Beyond planning, you will run critical programs and projects throughout the year that ladder up to the plan—such as Global Accounts management, New Logo strategy, and organizational design initiatives.
 The work you’ll do:
Lead the annual GTM planning process; coordinate across all business functions to build an integrated, bottom-up and top-down plan that balances growth with profitability
Develop and maintain territory and segment strategy; design territory structures that optimize for pipeline generation, ACV/ARR growth, and team productivity
Define and refine GTM ratios (AE to SDR, territories to manager, etc.); analyze performance and recommend adjustments to optimize resource allocation
Conduct role and organizational design analysis; think through optimal coverage models, account assignments, and team structures to drive business outcomes
Build and maintain planning systems and frameworks; ensure consistency and rigor in how we approach planning, modeling, and decision-making
Develop and test custom models and scenarios to stress-test plans; guide leadership through trade-offs and help them understand implications of different strategic choices
Coordinate cross-functional stakeholder alignment on the plan; facilitate discussions with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance to build buy-in and ensure feasibility
Communicate the plan cascading priorities, resource allocation, and expected outcomes to the broader organization
Lead GTM strategy initiatives and programs throughout the year, such as: Global Accounts strategy and operations, New Logo go-to-market approach, market expansion planning, channel and partner strategy
Develop and maintain critical business reporting and dashboards; track plan versus actual, highlight variances, and provide insights to guide course corrections
Conduct periodic reviews of plan performance; identify what's working, what isn't, and inform next iteration of planning
Serve as a strategic advisor to Revenue Operations and business leadership on GTM strategy, resource allocation, and organizational design decisions
Drive process improvements and modernization in how we approach planning, using data, technology, and best practices to increase effectiveness
 The qualifications you need:
Significant experience in SaaS and/or AI-oriented tech companies, in roles focused on GTM strategy, sales planning, revenue operations, or sales strategy
Deep expertise in territory planning, segmentation strategy, and account assignment; demonstrated success designing and implementing planning processes
Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS go-to-market models, sales structures, and the factors that drive ACV, ARR, win rates, and team productivity
Hands-on experience defining and optimizing GTM ratios (AE to SDR, territories to manager, etc.); ability to articulate why ratios matter and how they impact performance
Demonstrated ability to think through organizational design; experience designing roles, coverage models, and team structures that drive results
Comfort with planning and modeling tools (Excel, Tableau, Looker, etc.); ability to build custom models, run scenarios, and communicate findings to leadership
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work with complex data, identify patterns, and translate insights into actionable recommendations
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; proven ability to coordinate across senior leaders, build consensus, and drive alignment
Strategic thinking with ability to see the big picture and understand interconnections between GTM strategy, resource allocation, and business outcomes
Project and program management expertise; ability to run multiple initiatives in parallel while keeping organization aligned to core strategy
 What Celonis can offer you:
Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
 About Us:
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: Strategy & Operations Manager - Partnerships
description:
**The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.**
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no\-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500\+ builder\-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 \- working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
* Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
* Earned 190K\+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
* Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment \- bringing us to a $5\.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what *you* can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out \- whether you’re technical or not \- and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
**Partnerships is still a young motion at n8n, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.** Despite strong inbound interest, we're early in building this out, with ambitious growth targets and strong executive backing. The team is scaling quickly, new leadership is joining soon, and there's real momentum from recent strategic partnership wins. You'd be shaping strategy and operations across a genuinely broad ecosystem, spanning GSIs, affiliates, agencies, resellers, tech partners, education partners, and hyperscalers, with real room to define how it's structured and run rather than inheriting someone else's playbook.
**Your main goal will be to become n8n's dedicated architect of Partner Ecosystem strategy and operations, building the systems, data, and processes that let this fast\-growing partner network scale alongside n8n's growth.**
To do so, here are your responsibilities:
### **Channel Program Operations**
* Own the operational infrastructure powering n8n's global partner ecosystem across reseller and referral segments.
* Design and maintain partner\-attributed pipeline tracking, keeping sourced, influenced, and co\-sell deals accurately categorized in Salesforce.
* Build and maintain channel reporting frameworks covering partner\-sourced MRR, activation rates, deal registration, and tier performance.
### **Partner Performance \& Pipeline**
* Support partner pipeline inspection and forecast roll\-ups alongside Channel Sales leadership.
* Develop reporting and insights that drive partner growth and sharpen program performance.
* Build channel\-specific territory and routing logic so partner\-sourced leads and registered deals are prioritized and attributed correctly.
### **Program \& Systems Administration**
* Own configuration and adoption of partner\-facing tools, including the partner portal and Salesforce's channel\-specific objects.
* Maintain documentation and training materials covering channel processes, rules of engagement, and partner program policies.
* Manage partner tier qualification, tracking certifications and activity thresholds, while using AI\-enabled tools to streamline and scale the work.
### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner with Channel Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, Legal, and Finance to operationalize GTM motions like co\-marketing campaigns and partner enablement launches.
* Serve as the channel operations subject matter expert across cross\-functional planning cycles, from annual planning to QBRs and GTM launches.
* Triage and support ad hoc requests, partner escalations, and troubleshooting as they come up.
**REQUIREMENTS**
----------------
### **Must\-haves**
* **Channel/Partner Ops experience:** You bring 5\+ years in Sales Operations or Channel/Partner Operations at a technology company, ideally supporting partner or indirect revenue programs in a high\-growth SaaS environment.
* **Channel program know\-how:** You understand channel mechanics like deal registration, partner tiering, co\-sell motions, referral fee structures, and margin/discount governance.
* **Salesforce \& channel tech stack:** You're proficient in Salesforce objects, relationships, and reporting \- including channel\-specific objects \- and you've worked with tools like PartnerStack, Crossbeam, or partner portals.
* **Data \& analytics chops:** You're highly proficient in Google Sheets or Excel and comfortable with BI tools, turning partner data into clear insights on contribution and pipeline attribution.
* **Precision \& attention to detail:** You bring meticulous organization and hold your own work to a high standard of accuracy.
* **Change management:** You've led org\-wide change before, especially when operationalizing new program structures.
* **Problem\-solving mindset:** You spot operational gaps quickly and build scalable solutions that move the needle on efficiency and outcomes.
### **Nice\-to\-haves**
* **Salesforce Admin certification:** You hold a Salesforce Admin certification, or you're close to earning one.
* **SQL proficiency:** You're comfortable writing SQL queries to dig into partner and pipeline data yourself.
**Why join us?**
At n8n, you'll be a founding voice in how we scale our partner motion \- shaping the systems, data, and processes behind a channel strategy that's still being built from the ground up. You'll work closely with Partner leadership and the broader RevOps team, with the autonomy to drive initiatives end\-to\-end and the visibility that comes with being a first dedicated hire in this space. You'll join a supportive, remote\-first team that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, inside one of Europe's fastest\-growing startups.
Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?
Apply now \- and help us build the future of automation.
*n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*
*We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.*
***Our company language is English.***
*You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our* *Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n* *(**https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity\-inclusion\-and\-belonging\-n8n\-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35**).*
***Location disclaimer:*** *If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.*
**Benefits**
------------
* **Competitive compensation** – We offer fair and attractive pay.
* **Ownership** – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
* **Work/life balance** – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:
 + **Europe:** 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.
 + **US:** 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.
* **Health \& wellness** –
 + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
 + **US**: Multiple low\-premium, low\-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no\-cost premium HDHP option with a pre\-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
* **Future planning** –
 + **Europe:** We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.\*
 + **US:** 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
* **Financial security** –
 + **Europe:** We provide benefits according to local country norms.\*
 + **US:** Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
* **Career growth** – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
* **A passionate team** – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!
* **Remote\-first** – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off\-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.
* **Giving back** – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.
* **Transparency** – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.
* *Country\-specific details are provided in your contract.*

 As Senior Business Operations Manager for Core Platforms, you will help the Core Platforms leadership team run the organisation effectively and make better, faster decisions. You will design and improve the operating model, lead key planning and governance processes, create visibility of performance and risks, and coordinate execution across teams and departments.
This is an individual-contributor role with broad cross-functional influence. You will work closely with the Core Platforms Leadership Team, Central Tech leadership, Business Operations peers and partners across Product, Engineering, Finance, People and other departments.
 Key Job Responsibilities and Duties: 
 Operating model and governance
Design, implement and continuously improve the Core Platforms operating model, including decision forums, governance, meeting rhythms, action tracking and escalation routes.
Improve processes, tools and ways of working to make operations simpler, more reliable and more effective for internal partners.
 Planning and performance
Lead the adoption of Booking.com and Central Tech planning processes across the area, including annual planning, quarterly planning, budget and resource discussions, and cross-department dependency planning.
Act as the central point of contact for business planning activities and ensure that decisions and commitments made during planning are translated into clear follow-through.
Own the preparation and facilitation of business reviews and leadership updates, bringing together progress, performance, risks, dependencies, trade-offs and forward-looking actions.
Establish clear OKR, KPI and portfolio tracking, using quantitative and qualitative insights to identify trends, surface risks and recommend action to the Core Platforms Leadership Team.
 Portfolio oversight and reporting
Provide oversight of complex initiatives and portfolios, maintaining a clear view of scope, milestones, ownership, dependencies, risks and decisions.
Consolidate progress and performance reporting for the Core Platforms Leadership Team, highlighting risks, trade-offs, dependencies and actions that require attention.
Establish governance and follow-through so that initiative owners are clear on their commitments, with blockers and risks escalated early.
Translate priorities into clear planning inputs, roadmaps, success measures and execution choices without owning day-to-day initiative delivery.
 Cross-functional collaboration and change
Build effective engagement models across Core Platforms, Central Tech and partner departments so that shared objectives are prioritised, responsibilities are understood and handshakes happen early.
Support change adoption by making the case for change clear, explaining what it means for different audiences, and helping teams move from agreement to implementation.
Develop trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, Finance, People and other functions, adapting your approach to different stakeholders and levels of seniority.
 Strategic problem-solving and direction
Partner with the Core Platforms Leadership Team to shape the strategic narrative, priorities and medium-term direction of the area.
Structure complex and ambiguous problems, connect insights across teams and departments, and turn analysis into practical recommendations.
Identify opportunities to improve the effectiveness, scalability and impact of Core Platforms, supported by clear options, trade-offs and business cases where appropriate.
Help align Core Platforms priorities with Central Tech and wider Booking.com objectives, making implications for other teams visible and actionable.
 Role Qualifications and Requirements:
Substantial experience, typically 8+ years, in business operations, strategy and operations, transformation, planning, governance or a related field.
A proven track record of designing and running operating models, planning processes, governance routines or business cadences for a complex organisation.
Experience leading annual or quarterly planning for a sizable organisation or function, including aligning priorities, resources, milestones, dependencies and trade-offs across teams.
Strong performance-management skills, including experience with OKRs, KPIs, business reviews, reporting and turning data into clear insights and recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate and oversee complex cross-functional initiatives, with disciplined management of risks, dependencies, decisions, reporting and follow-up.
Strong process-management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify highly complex operational issues into practical actions.
Experience driving change and adoption of new processes, ways of working or company-wide initiatives in a way that is clear, structured and inclusive.
Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills. You can work with imperfect information, identify what matters, and tell a concise story that supports a decision.
Excellent stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the credibility to challenge constructively, build alignment and drive accountability across teams.
Experience working with senior leaders, including influencing at VP level and partnering effectively with SVP-level stakeholders.
Clear, compelling written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your message to technical, business and executive audiences.
A collaborative, customer-focused mindset and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, disciplines, levels of seniority and cultures.
Demonstrated curiosity about AI and emerging technology, supported by experience applying AI-enabled tools or approaches to improve productivity, decision-making or other business operations
Comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-moving environment where priorities, stakeholders and information may change.
 Nice-to-Have Skills:
Experience working in an enterprise technology, platform, cloud or infrastructure environment. An engineering background is not required.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Data, Finance, People or other corporate functions.
Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, business development or another role involving structured problem-solving and business-case development.
Experience with financial planning, workforce planning, headcount management or resource-allocation processes.
Experience with transformation governance, cross-functional change or large-scale organisational change.
Experience designing tools, dashboards or automated reporting that improve operational visibility and decision-making.
Familiarity with Booking.com, the travel industry or a similarly complex, global, technology-led business.
 Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance:
 Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include:
Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave
Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country)
Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit 
 Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) at Booking.com:
 Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations.
Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.”

title: Senior Business Operations & Strategy Manager
description:
About us:
 BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.
We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.
Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.
Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.
By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.
We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.
We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:
CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)
 About this role in the team:
 At BVNK, we are building the global operating system for money movement. To power our next era of hyper-growth, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Business Operations & Strategy to act as a strategic force multiplier across the company. The BizOps & Strategy team is the central execution engine that turns enterprise-wide complexity into strategic and operational clarity with long-term business outcomes.
Partnering closely with our Exec team, you will architect and own strategic initiatives related to three core pillars: Strategic Planning, Cross-Functional Delivery, and AI Enablement & Scale. You will solve the business's hardest unstructured problems, challenge assumptions, and scale our operating cadence across our entire organization.
 Key Areas of Responsibilities:
 Strategic Planning & Executive Ownership: Architect, govern, and own the company-wide strategic planning process and OKR engine, partnering directly with C-suite stakeholders to drive alignment, evaluate strategic trade-offs, and refresh corporate priorities
 Growth Strategy Creation & Implementation: Bridge product, engineering, and commercial teams to align product roadmaps with go-to-market strategies, including leading on building expansion and vertical strategies where necessary 
 Revenue Sizing & Business Case Modeling: Conduct rigorous quantitative analysis, market sizing, and financial modeling to evaluate new growth vectors, strategic bets, pricing strategies, and resource allocation
 Large-Scale Program Management & Delivery: Mobilize and lead complex, mission-critical cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, establishing accountability frameworks to turn enterprise-level strategies into measurable business outcomes
 AI Enablement, Scale, and Implementation: Champion organizational efficiency by deploying AI tools, automation workflows, and scalable operational playbooks to optimize cross-departmental productivity and eliminate operational friction
 What we need from you:
 8 - 12 years experience in a fast-paced Tech environment, with a track record of high performance in strategy & operations (S&O) / business operations (BizOps) roles
 Proven Executive presence : Deep experience directly influencing and advising C-level executives, presenting complex trade-offs, and driving alignment across conflicting priorities
 Experience in leading complex, company-critical strategic initiatives end-to-end, with a solid track record of ownership and exceeding expectations

 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
 Job Title

 Head of Customer Success

This role is accountable for driving customer satisfaction, portfolio growth, revenue retention, and customer lifetime value through proactive account management, upselling, and cross-selling of products and services.
The successful candidate will define and deliver the Customer Success strategy, ensuring customers realise strong value from the partnership while identifying opportunities to expand revenue and strengthen long-term relationships.

Customer retention and success

Strong commercial acumen with responsibility for customer revenue performance

title: Staff Analyst, GTM Analytics
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
Our Data Analytics and AI org (DAA) is actively seeking a Staff Analyst, GTM Analytics to contribute to building our framework to monitor health of business through metrics analysis. Examples of deliverables include building new assets, QBR, performance and ROI analysis and deep dive.
You'll be part of a global team transforming GTM data into actionable intelligence, driving real-time ROI optimization across international markets. This role combines technical expertise with strategic leadership to deliver impactful insights that directly influence our go-to-market strategy and business growth. Working with stakeholders in EMEA, you'll champion data-driven decision making and advance our mission of revolutionizing B2B GTM analytics practices.
 IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:
Be a Strategic Partner to Leadership: Partner with GTM executives to align analytics initiatives with global business objectives — driving QBRs, shaping investment decisions, and proactively surfacing insights that move the business, not just inform it.
Turn Data into Business Outcomes: Go beyond reporting to influence pipeline generation, conversion optimization, and campaign ROI — presenting complex analytical findings to executive stakeholders with clarity and impact. You measure success by decisions changed, not dashboards shipped.
Bridge Business and Technical Worlds: Collaborate across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Strategy teams to translate complex business questions into scalable analytical solutions — and communicate findings back in ways that drive alignment and action.
Master the Analytical Foundation: Maintain deep fluency in the data models, metrics, and pipelines (SQL, dbt, Snowflake) that power GTM reporting. Partner closely with Analytics Engineering and BI teams to ensure insights are accurately surfaced — and step in hands-on-keys when needed to build, debug, or extend models.
Amplify Reach with AI & Automation: Drive AI Self-Service & Productivity by enabling stakeholders to query complex marketing and pipeline data using natural-language, AI-driven interfaces (semantic models, text-to-SQL, Cortex Analyst) — reducing reliance on manual ad-hoc reporting and letting leadership get answers faster without sacrificing rigor.
Champion Data Quality & Governance: Ensure data integrity across source systems (Salesforce, Marketo, Snowflake) through automated testing and reconciliation. Spearhead data infrastructure improvements and best practices the team can trust at scale.
Establish Thought Leadership: Represent the company in the business intelligence space at industry events and champion innovation across the analytics org.
 OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:
Relevant Experience: at least 6 years of experience in tech, management consulting, or investment banking, in an analytical role working with data sets, deriving insights, and making strategic recommendations
Business Acumen & Strategic Partnership: a track record of partnering directly with leadership to drive strategic decisions
Executive Presence: Comfortable presenting to, advising, and pushing back on VP+ stakeholders — with the ability to work across different cultures and time zones
AI & Innovation Literacy: Experience building and working with AI-driven workflows
 PREFERRED:
GTM Domain Expertise: Prior experience in sales strategy, sales / business operations, or FP&A. Knowledge of SaaS business models and B2B channel structures
Technical Mastery: A background in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science (SQL, Python, AI-driven development, dbt, Airflow)
Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

description:
Description
 We are seeking a talented Sales Compensation Analyst to join the Business Unit Operations team supporting AGS EMEA Sales Teams. Reporting into the AGS EMEA Sales Compensation Manager, you will partner with the AGS EMEA sales and operational leaders to ensure the accurate, timely and equitable delivery of sales compensation plans as well as providing analytical insights to assist in evaluating the effectiveness of our sales compensation models. You will be the subject matter expert for sales compensation within AGS EMEA, resolving queries from the field and delivering impactful training and enablement to our rapidly expanding commercial & operations teams.
The successful candidate will be a motivated fast learner with high attention to detail and structured in their approach. They will be able to manage multiple assignments and requests/processes concurrently, prioritizing accordingly, and delivering timely results. They will be able to collaborate effectively with internal end-users and cross-functional teams to ideate and implement simple, scalable solutions to complex problems at a high standard. They are passionate about data, developing and owning standardized process improvements, automation and optimizing scalable central processes. Deep operational, analytical and interpersonal skills will make them a critical partner to business and operations leaders, identifying gaps in process and removing barriers to execution.

 Ensure the accurate, timely and equitable delivery of sales compensation plans and payments.
 Develop a deep understanding of sales compensation policy, systems and reporting tools in order to effectively drive resolution of issues, meet sales compensation SLAs and provide actionable insights for your business and operations partners.
 Forge strong cross-functional relationships to influence change, accelerate adoption and grow our capacity faster than the growth of the business.
 Partner with leadership to set objective targets aligned to positive business and customer outcomes.
 Provide ongoing sales compensation training and enablement to business users and operations.
 Proactively identify and implement operational processes and/or reporting that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence.
 Manage and execute SPIF programs to drive performance on immediate business priorities.
 Present OTE and performance analysis to sales leadership on a quarterly basis.

description:
We’re reinventing payments. In less than four years, Dojo disrupted the market to become the largest and most loved acquirer in the UK. Our payments infrastructure, purpose-built for in-person commerce, is game changing.

Our people are the driving force behind our success. They are our greatest investment and our ultimate competitive advantage. We hire exceptional people and give them the autonomy, trust, and ownership to thrive. The results take care of themselves.
 The role
 As Global Enablement Content & Learning Lead, you'll architect the content and learning engine behind Dojo's commercial growth. You'll build the methodology, onboarding, and playbooks that empower sellers and ensure new ways of selling land across our network. In this role, you'll embed a consistent sales methodology, a best-in-class induction experience, and high-impact GTM launches across all channels, roles, and markets.  What You Will Do...
Build GTM playbooks and standards: Create templates and messaging for new initiatives, collaborating with teams to land GTMs consistently.
Own our learning platform: Make Thrive the place sellers reach for first—a trusted source of truth with instant findability and zero clutter.
Embed the Dojo Way of selling: Standardize our sales approach so every seller across all channels, roles, and markets sells to one high standard.
Set the onboarding standard: Define what great onboarding looks like across the journey and scale a best-practice experience globally.
Innovate how we enable: Bring modern approaches—from AI roleplay to change management—so what we roll out actually changes behavior.
Measure and improve: Track behavior change, ramp times, and win rates to continuously sharpen our content and onboarding.
 What You Will Bring...
Proven background in enablement: Experience in Sales Enablement, L&D, GTM, or PMM roles within high-growth B2B businesses, designing onboarding across multiple channels and markets.

 Dojo home and away
 We believe our best work happens when we collaborate in-person. These “together days” foster communication, drive innovation and spark our brightest ideas.

Our drive to improve diversity, equity, and inclusion is closely linked to helping employees thrive and innovating for better customer experiences.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
Who We Are: 
SOCi is the leader in AI-powered marketing solutions for multi-location businesses. With its proprietary Genius AI™ and suite of Genius Agents™, SOCi provides a first-of-its-kind, AI-powered digital workforce capable of handling the workload of 1,000 local marketers™, empowering brands to achieve unmatched digital visibility, strengthen customer engagement, and scale faster than ever before.
SOCi is recognized by Fast Company as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies, and is trusted by nearly 1,000 top brands—including Ford, Ace Hardware, Kumon, Liberty Tax, and more—to automate and optimize local marketing tasks across all locations. Founded in 2012 and backed by leading strategic investors, SOCi is transforming how multi-location brands manage and scale their marketing efforts. You can view our Awards and Accolades here!
 About the Role 
We are seeking a highly organized, analytical, and process-oriented Revenue Operations Analyst to support our Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing organizations. This role will serve as a key operational partner across the customer lifecycle, helping teams operate efficiently through strong queue management, Salesforce administration and reporting, Customer Success operations, and cross-functional process management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across multiple teams, can translate business needs into operational solutions, and has advanced Salesforce reporting skills. This person should be equally comfortable investigating an operational issue, building an executive-ready dashboard, coordinating a cancellation across multiple departments, and identifying opportunities to improve the underlying process.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Revenue Operations Queue Management 
Own the day-to-day management of the Revenue Operations request queue.
Review and triage incoming cases, determine priority and appropriate ownership, and route requests to the correct Revenue Operations team member or functional owner.
Manage assigned cases from intake through resolution, ensuring timely communication and appropriate follow-up with stakeholders.
Monitor queue health, aging, volume, and resolution times to ensure requests are addressed within established service-level expectations.
Identify recurring requests and issues that may indicate opportunities for process improvement, automation, documentation, or enablement.
Maintain clear documentation of case resolutions and operational changes.
 Customer Success Operations 
Serve as a primary Revenue Operations point of contact and operational partner for the Customer Success organization.
Partner with Customer Success leaders and team members to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable processes, reporting, and system improvements.
Support changes and enhancements to Salesforce and other Revenue Operations tools used by Customer Success.
Partner closely with Customer Success Enablement to ensure alignment and understanding of processes, tools, documentation, and enablement assets impacted by operational changes.
Help document and standardize Customer Success operational processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scalability.
Support testing and quality assurance for system, workflow, and process changes before deployment.
 Cancellation & Offboarding Operations 
Manage and oversee the end-to-end customer cancellation process.
Coordinate across Customer Success, Implementation/Offboarding, Billing, Finance, and other stakeholders to ensure cancellations are processed accurately and on time.
Perform quality assurance throughout the cancellation process to ensure required information is complete, systems are updated appropriately, and downstream teams receive the information they need.
Identify and resolve discrepancies or process gaps that could impact customer offboarding, billing, reporting, or revenue data.
Maintain documentation and controls to ensure a consistent and auditable cancellation process.
Analyze cancellation trends and surface insights or recurring operational issues to Revenue Operations and Customer Success leadership.
 Reporting & Analytics 
Develop and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards supporting Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Revenue Operations .
Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and translate them into accurate, actionable reporting.
Provide Clari and CAP reporting to Customer Success leadership as needed.
Build recurring and ad hoc reporting to support leadership decision-making and operational reviews.
Perform quality assurance and validation of reporting to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Investigate discrepancies across Salesforce and other revenue systems and partner with appropriate teams to resolve data issues.
Help establish consistent definitions and reporting methodologies for key revenue and customer metrics.
 Salesforce & Data Management 
Serve as a Salesforce reporting subject matter expert within Revenue Operations.
Build and maintain advanced Salesforce reports, dashboards, report types, filters, formulas, and related reporting solutions.
Support data quality initiatives by identifying incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate CRM data.
Partner with Revenue Operations and system administrators to recommend improvements to Salesforce fields, workflows, processes, and reporting structures.
Assist with user acceptance testing and quality assurance for Salesforce enhancements.
Help maintain documentation related to Salesforce processes, reporting definitions, and operational workflows.
 Process Improvement & Operational Excellence 
Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and improve operational efficiency.
Document current-state and future-state processes, requirements, and standard operating procedures.
Partner cross-functionally to implement process improvements and measure their effectiveness.
Look for opportunities to reduce repetitive requests through automation, self-service reporting, documentation, and enablement.

Experience working with CRM data and translating business requirements into reporting or operational solutions.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate data, identify trends, and communicate findings clearly.
Strong project and process management skills with the ability to manage work from intake through completion.
Excellent attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and quality assurance.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple departments.
Ability to prioritize competing requests and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Comfortable identifying problems, recommending solutions, and taking ownership through resolution.

Experience supporting Customer Success operations and customer lifecycle processes.
Experience with Clari or similar revenue intelligence/forecasting platforms.
Experience with ticketing or case-management workflows.
Experience working with customer cancellation, offboarding, billing, or renewal processes.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
description:
About Kalepa:
Insurance is a $7T global industry built on professional labor: underwriting, claims, pricing, operations, and distribution. Kalepa is building AI that can perform that work.
We create professional-grade AI systems for insurers: software that can read, reason, decide, and act inside real workflows and operate over long-time horizons. Kalepa begins by augmenting professionals with the tools to succeed at their jobs. That earns us the right to learn from real decisions, capture decision traces, and automate what can be automated successfully over time.
Our products are already in production with leading insurers, driving measurable outcomes and expanding across functions. The opportunity is far broader than any single workflow: to build the AI operating system for decision-making across insurance. For people who want to work on AI that matters, in a sector where correctness, trust, and real-world impact count, Kalepa is just getting started.
Kalepa is backed by leading investors such as IA Ventures and Inspired Capital, and our team brings experience from Facebook, Palantir, Google, Amazon, McKinsey, Mastercard, and Uber.
Our Values (This is important):
Many organizations have a dusty list of corporate values that no one ever follows. Kalepa is not one of those companies. Our values are designed to unlock the potential of our employees. 
Success at Kalepa is bred from five core principles:
 Hustle and Determination - We hire people who take full ownership of their craft and relentlessly pursue excellence with speed and determination. We choose the hard problems and do not give up. This is the foundation of how we work and how we win.
 Deliver Customer Impact - We're obsessed with customer impact. Every feature, every line of code, every decision is measured against one question: does this help insurers make better decisions? If it doesn't drive speed, accuracy, or profitability for our customers, we don't build it.
 Meritocracy - We're building something exceptional, and that requires exceptional people and ideas. We have a high bar but we reward excellence with rapid growth. If you're the best at what you do, you'll thrive here.
 Transparency - We value honest, transparent communication over politics. We challenge ideas, not people. We say what needs to be said, even when it's hard. This is how we solve problems fast and find the truth.
 Experiment Relentlessly - Many of the problems we face have never been solved before. We tackle them by testing quickly, measuring rigorously, and iterating until we find the path forward. Speed of learning is our advantage.
In addition to our NY office, we have remote employees speaking 10+ languages across the globe. But we invest in bringing our people together both for regional meetups and global offsites (2021 - Playa Del Carmen | 2022 - Rome | 2023 - Buenos Aires | 2024 - Lisbon | 2025 - Cartagena).
Kalepa’s culture isn’t for everyone, and that’s ok. But for the people who are a fit, they can’t imagine working elsewhere.

 Cash Compensation: $190-250K
 Location: USA (Remote)
Kalepa is bringing on our first dedicated Revenue Operations hire to build and scale the operating system behind our go-to-market team and drive Kalepa’s rapid growth. You’ll report to the Vice President of Operations, partner closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, and work daily with Sales, Marketing, Client Success, and the founding team. 
Key Responsibilities:
 Forecasting and pipeline management : Develop Kalepa’s forecasting methodology, run the regular pipeline/forecast cadence with leadership, and surface risks early.
 Own a GTM tech stack for the AI era: Oversee the entire tech stack, including but not limited to our CRM (HubSpot), data enrichment tools, and AI-powered automation. You’ll evaluate and implement new tools to accelerate growth and productivity of our GTM teams.
 Compensation : Work closely with our CRO and finance to design compensation plans that align with Kalepa’s goals.

 Analytics and Reporting : Be the source of truth for GTM metrics and reporting - including for Kalepa’s executive team and board meetings.

7+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Strategy & Operations at a high-growth, VC-backed AI/SaaS startup
Experience as the first or an early RevOps hire, building the function from scratch and owning it all (or significant pieces of it).
A track record of working with GTM and finance leadership to design GTM compensation plans and running them.
Experience building forecasts for enterprise sales motions with long, multi-stakeholder cycles.
Comfort presenting to executives with a clear recommendation, and the judgment to deliver data-driven insights.
Experience owning and implementing a modern, AI-powered GTM tech stack

Significant equity options package.

 Soutenir l’analyse de la performance commerciale : mener des analyses approfondies des données relatives aux revenus, aux clients et à la performance des ventes afin de dégager les tendances, de diagnostiquer les problèmes et de générer des informations stratégiques pour appuyer la prise de décision de la direction. 
 Élaborer des documents et des analyses de rentabilité qui soutiennent les initiatives de croissance stratégique afin d’accélérer la croissance des revenus et d’augmenter le nombre de clients actifs dans les principaux segments et marchés. 
 Élaborer des présentations et des documents destinés à la haute direction afin de communiquer efficacement les initiatives de l’équipe. 
 Analyse du marché et de la concurrence : surveiller et présenter des rapports sur l’écosystème des technologies financières, en suivant les stratégies tarifaires des concurrents, les tendances du marché ainsi que les évolutions des coûts des réseaux de cartes (Visa/Mastercard, etc.) et des modes de paiement alternatifs. 
 Soutenir l’analyse des données relatives aux transactions des commerçants, de la performance des réseaux de cartes (Visa/Mastercard) et des indicateurs de risque. Générer des informations exploitables afin d’améliorer les taux d’approbation, de réduire les pertes liées à la fraude et de stimuler la croissance commerciale des clients de la région Asie-Pacifique travaillant avec Nuvei dans plusieurs régions. 
 Diriger l’analyse de l’économie des paiements (commissions d’interchange, frais des réseaux de cartes, coûts de traitement) afin d’identifier les fuites de marge et de recommander des ajustements tarifaires ou des optimisations du routage des transactions. 
 Collaborer avec l’équipe mondiale de tarification pour concevoir, mettre en œuvre et faire évoluer les stratégies tarifaires pour notre passerelle de paiement principale, nos services d’acquisition de paiements et nos produits SaaS. Analyser l’économie des paiements, élaborer des modèles de tarification personnalisés pour les grandes entreprises et mettre en place des cadres tarifaires évolutifs (Interchange++, tarification mixte et tarification forfaitaire) sur les marchés nouveaux et existants. 
 Exigences : 
 Plus de 2 ans d’expérience et une expérience avérée de réussite en stratégie de revenus, tarification ou dans un domaine connexe au sein des secteurs des technologies financières ou des paiements. 
 Solides compétences analytiques et expérience en modélisation financière, analyse de données et études de marché. 
 Excellentes aptitudes à la communication orale et écrite, notamment la capacité de traduire des informations complexes en messages clairs et adaptés au public visé. 
 Solides compétences en gestion des parties prenantes et en relations interpersonnelles, avec la capacité d’établir des relations de travail efficaces entre les différentes équipes. 
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément, à s’adapter à l’évolution des priorités, à faire preuve de rigueur et à respecter les échéances. 
 Capacité à travailler de façon autonome dans des délais serrés tout en collaborant efficacement avec une équipe diversifiée de professionnels. 
 Une expérience dans un environnement mondial ou multirégional est un atout. 
 Maîtrise professionnelle de l’anglais requise.
Benefits
Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. title: Head of Customer Success
description:
About us
Corlytics provides smart regulatory compliance and risk solutions to the Financial Services industry to help them track, monitor, and manage complex risks related to regulatory activities worldwide. The tools and underlying platform are built by multi-disciplinary teams including legal, banking, and technology specialists. The Company is growing rapidly and is undertaking enterprise deployments at global scale.
About the role
We are seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Customer Success to lead our global Customer Success function and drive client retention, value realisation, and growth for Corlytics.
Reporting to the COO and working closely with the senior leadership team, you will own the end-to-end Customer Success strategy across our global client base. You will lead a team responsible for managing large, complex accounts and ensuring clients achieve measurable outcomes from their investment in Corlytics solutions.
As Head of Customer Success, you will be accountable for retention, renewals, and adoption, while acting as a senior voice of the customer internally. You will bring strong leadership, commercial acumen, and a client-first mindset, with the ability to influence across Product, Sales, Professional Services, and Support teams.
This role requires extensive cross-functional collaboration, strong influencing skills, and a strategic mindset. You will play a key role in scaling the Customer Success function and embedding a consistent, high-quality client experience globally
 Responsibilities: 
 Customer Success Strategy & Leadership 
Define and execute the global Customer Success strategy aligned to company growth and retention objectives
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing distributed Customer Success team
Embed a structured coaching model and performance management discipline to continuously elevate team capability, client engagement quality, through systematic capability development aligned to best practices.
Establish clear KPIs (e.g. GRR, client health, adoption) and drive performance against targets
Provide leadership and direction to ensure consistent, scalable delivery of Customer Success across all client segments
 Client Value Realisation & Retention 
Own end-to-end client outcomes, ensuring successful adoption and ongoing utilisation of the Corlytics platform
Lead the global retention and renewal strategy for key accounts
Support and lead complex renewal and commercial negotiations
Develop and oversee execution of strategic account plans
Build senior stakeholder relationships and act as executive sponsor for key clients
 Cross-Functional Leadership 
Act as the voice of the customer internally, ensuring client needs and feedback are reflected across the organisation
Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and Support teams to deliver a seamless client experience
Influence product roadmap and innovation through structured client insights
Drive alignment across teams to ensure delivery against client expectations
Develop a structured customer advocacy programme, converting satisfied clients into referenceable advocates (e.g., case studies, testimonials) to strengthen brand credibility and support sales and expansion efforts
 Customer Experience & Operational Excellence 
Define and implement scalable Customer Success processes, playbooks, and lifecycle management approaches
Oversee client health tracking, reporting, and CRM accuracy
Ensure consistent, high-quality client engagement across all touchpoints
Drive continuous improvement through data-led insights and operational discipline
Leverage AI and automation to enhance customer insights, predict risk and opportunity, and enable more proactive, personalised, and scalable client engagement
Track and report advocacy impact (e.g., reference usage in deals, contribution to pipeline/NRR, brand amplification), linking customer experience directly to commercial outcomes
 Requirements: 
Bachelor's degree.
10+ years of experience in financial services and technology, with significant leadership experience in Customer Success or account management
Proven track record in owning retention, renewals, and expansion revenue in enterprise environments
Strong understanding of cloud computing technologies, and enterprise SaaS delivery models.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing teams, with a focus on driving employee engagement and retention (e.g. improving eNPS)
Strong commercial acumen with experience managing large, complex client relationships
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver measurable outcomes
 About you: 
A strategic, client-first leader who champions customer outcomes and embeds long-term value realisation across the full customer lifecycle
A strong people leader with a track record of building, scaling, and developing high-performing Customer Success teams, with a focus on engagement and retention (e.g. improving eNPS)
Highly collaborative, with the ability to align cross-functional teams (Product, Professional Services, Support) around a unified customer strategy and measurable outcomes
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment, bringing structure, prioritisation, and clarity amidst change
Commercially astute and results-driven, with a proven focus on driving retention and expansion (NRR), while improving customer satisfaction (CSAT) through consistent, high-quality engagement
Data-driven in decision-making, using leading and lagging indicators (eNPS, CSAT, NRR) to continuously optimise performance and customer outcomes
Forward-looking, with experience embedding AI and automation into Customer Success workflows to improve scalability, insight generation, and proactive customer engagement
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies.
Chance to make a significant impact on the company's growth.

Professional development opportunities.

title: Senior Manager, Marketing & Revenue Operations
description:
About ChartHop 
 Our Team: Remote-first team of builders, connected to a vision to make people teams and companies more successful through connected data, transparency, and AI.
 Our Values: fast, inclusive, transparent, optimistic, all-in
 Our Product: ChartHop is the AI-first people platform. Our roots are in Analytics and Planning — helping people teams model org structures, manage compensation, and plan for growth. We've expanded into a full people operations suite covering HRIS, performance management, engagement, and real-time org analytics. Our newest frontier is ChartHop AI — an agentic AI layer that lets HR teams ask questions, surface insights, and take actions across their people data in natural language. We're at an inflection point: AI is reshaping what HR software can do, and we intend to lead that category.
 Our Clients: Span nearly every industry from 10 employees to 30k. Some notable ones include 1Password, Sweetgreen, and Headspace.
 How We Work 
 AI-First Marketing 
At ChartHop, we believe AI is transforming how modern marketing teams operate. We don't see AI as a separate initiative—we see it as a fundamental capability that enhances how we research, create, execute, analyze, and make decisions.
Every member of the marketing team is expected to actively leverage AI to improve the quality, speed, and impact of their work. We encourage continuous experimentation with emerging AI technologies, thoughtful sharing of best practices, and a mindset of ongoing learning and innovation.
We believe the best marketers combine creativity, strategic thinking, customer empathy, and sound judgment with AI-powered tools and workflows to achieve outcomes that would not otherwise be possible.
 About the role 
We’re looking for a strategic, hands-on operator to own how ChartHop’s go-to-market engine runs. As we consolidate onto HubSpot as our combined sales and marketing CRM, this person will build the systems, data foundation, and reporting that let marketing and sales operate from a single source of truth, and turn that data into insight leaders can act on.
This is a rare blend of marketing operations depth and revenue operations acumen. You’ll be equally comfortable architecting a lead lifecycle, cleaning up messy data, and building the funnel analytics that tell a sales leader exactly where the pipeline is converting and why. You’ll do the tactical work when it’s needed, but you’ll bring a strategic, analytical lens to everything you touch. Above all, you’re proactive: when you see something broken, you roll up your sleeves and fix it.
 What you’ll own 
 Marketing Operations 
Own the marketing technology stack (HubSpot and its integrations), ensuring tools are configured, connected, and delivering value.
Lead data quality, enrichment, segmentation, and governance so the team can trust and act on its data.
Architect the lead lifecycle, routing, and SLAs.
Run campaign operations and QA, and build workflow automation and nurture execution.
Own attribution and full-funnel reporting as the marketing single source of truth.
Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting.
Serve as the GTM engineering and AI-automation champion across marketing, identifying where automation and AI can drive efficiency.
 Revenue Operations 
Build sales reporting and dashboards in HubSpot, expanding the single source of truth across the full go-to-market funnel.
Deliver full-funnel conversion analytics, from SAL to SQL through each pipeline stage (stage 1, 2, 3 and beyond).
Provide visibility at both the aggregate and individual rep level, so leadership can distinguish lead-quality issues from qualification and execution gaps.
Surface trends by persona and industry to inform outbound strategy (where to double down) and identify coaching opportunities for individual reps.
Lend expertise on account book creation and similar sales-ops projects; larger technical builds can be supported by additional technical resources.
Partner closely with sales leadership to define the metrics and insights they need to drive efficiency and growth.
 Note: sales compensation, commissions, deal desk, and related finance/regulatory work sit with Finance and are outside the scope of this role. 
 Cross-functional & strategic mandate 
Act as the connective tissue between marketing and sales, aligning both around shared definitions, data, and reporting.
Play a lead role in project managing the Salesforce-to-HubSpot migration and the operating model that follows.
Proactively identify process and system gaps across the funnel and drive them to resolution.
Bring a business-level perspective, not just a functional one, to how we plan, measure, and grow.
 How you’ll be measured 
Data accuracy and completeness; database health (duplicates, bounce rate, enrichment coverage).
SAL → SQL conversion rate / conversion efficiency
Speed-to-lead and routing SLA adherence.
Funnel-stage velocity and conversion rates across the full funnel.
Attribution and pipeline reporting accuracy (trusted single source of truth).
Marketing automation adoption and operational efficiency.
Quality and usage of sales and marketing dashboards by leadership and reps.
 What we’re looking for 
Deep hands-on expertise with HubSpot; experience operating it as a combined sales and marketing CRM is a strong plus. Familiarity with Salesforce is helpful given the migration.
A genuinely analytical mindset. You’re fluent in funnel and conversion data and can build the reporting that answers a leader’s real questions, not just surface-level metrics.
A track record spanning marketing operations and revenue/sales operations, with the judgment to see problems from multiple sides of the business.
Comfort moving fluidly between strategy and tactical execution. You’ll design the system and build it.
Proactivity and ownership. You spot what’s broken and fix it without waiting to be asked, and you push initiatives forward cross-functionally.
Strong, direct communication. You can challenge assumptions constructively and bring a clear point of view.
Curiosity and a bias toward learning; you’ll go figure out what you don’t yet know.
Ability to maintain reliable overlap with US working hours to stay closely connected to the team.
 How this role can grow 
This role is scoped to meet ChartHop where it is today: one strong operator who can span marketing and revenue operations at our current scale. As the company grows, there’s room for the role to expand, take on additional scope, and build and lead a team over time.
