title: Senior Manager, Incentives Strategy and Operations
description:
Senior Manager, Incentives Strategy and Operations | Viator
 About Tripadvisor
 The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.
We are looking for an analytically rigorous, commercially minded, and execution-oriented leader to help shape and scale Tripadvisor’s incentives and loyalty portfolio.
This role will own the strategic and operational governance for how we evaluate, prioritize, and scale incentives across the business. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to turn complex program economics into clear recommendations, scalable processes, and better business decisions.
You will play a critical role in helping the business answer some of its most important growth and profitability questions: Which incentives are truly incremental? Which audiences should we invest in? How do we balance conversion, customer value, margin, and cost discipline? And how do we build the operating model required to scale incentives responsibly across markets, channels, and customer segments?
This is a high-impact role for someone who can build structure from ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and translate analysis into strategy, governance, and action. While execution teams will support campaign delivery, this role will be responsible for setting the strategic direction, operating cadence, measurement standards, and investment discipline that enable the incentives portfolio to scale effectively.
Job Location: Hybrid
This role is a hybrid position that requires 2-3 days per week in our London office.
 What You’ll Do
 Shape the strategy and governance model for incentives and loyalty:
Develop the strategic framework for how Tripadvisor evaluates, prioritizes, and scales incentive and loyalty initiatives across the business.
Define the principles and guardrails for when, where, and how incentives should be used, balancing growth, profitability, customer experience, and operational complexity.
Partner with CRM, Product, Regional, Marketing, Data, and Finance teams to ensure incentive initiatives are aligned to broader business priorities.
Help move the business from isolated campaigns and tests toward a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined incentives portfolio.
Establish clear operating rhythms for reviewing performance, making investment decisions, and prioritizing future opportunities.
 Build The Financial And Analytical Backbone For Incentives Performance
Own the framework for evaluating incentive and loyalty program performance, including redemption, incremental bookings, revenue impact, margin impact, customer lifetime value, cost-to-serve, and ROI.
Partner closely with Finance to build and maintain reliable P&L reporting infrastructure for incentives and loyalty, including spend tracking, forecasting, cost visibility, and program-level economics.
Support the department lead and Finance partners with the inputs needed for budget planning, investment trade-off discussions, and performance reviews.
Establish reporting cadences, approval processes, and investment guardrails so incentive spend remains transparent, disciplined, and aligned to business objectives.
Ensure leadership has a clear, trusted, and consistent view of incentive performance across programs, markets, channels, and customer segments.
 Turn Insights Into Roadmap And Investment Decisions
Lead recurring and ad hoc deep dives into program performance, customer segments, test results, cost drivers, and behavioral trends to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should invest next.
Translate complex analysis into clear strategic recommendations, business cases, and executive-ready narratives.
Partner with Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams to shape the incentives roadmap, ensuring initiatives are prioritized based on expected impact, cost, feasibility, and strategic fit.
Identify opportunities to improve incentive effectiveness through better targeting, program design, customer segmentation, channel coordination, and measurement.
Help leadership understand trade-offs across short-term conversion, long-term customer value, margin impact, operational complexity, and strategic growth.
 Build Scalable Operating Processes For Cross-functional Execution
Design and improve the operating processes required to propose, approve, launch, measure, and review incentive initiatives.
Create clear standards for how incentive programs are evaluated before launch and assessed after execution.
Partner with execution teams to ensure campaign delivery is supported by strong strategic rationale, clear measurement plans, and appropriate financial guardrails.
Help build a scalable test-and-learn discipline for incentives, enabling the business to move quickly while maintaining measurement rigor and financial accountability.
Identify operational gaps, process inefficiencies, and areas of ambiguity that could limit the business’s ability to scale incentives effectively.
 Champion Incentive Economics Across The Business
Serve as a key thought partner to Finance, Product, Data, CRM, Regional, and Marketing teams on how incentive investment translates into customer and business value.
Own the metrics, narrative, and recommendations that feed into recurring business reviews and leadership updates on incentives and loyalty.
Bring a structured, analytical perspective to strategic discussions, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than intuition or isolated campaign results.
Act as a connective tissue across teams, ensuring incentives are managed as a disciplined business portfolio rather than a set of disconnected campaigns.
 What Success Looks Like
 A successful candidate will help the business build a more structured, scalable, and financially disciplined approach to incentives and loyalty.
 In This Role, Success Means
Leadership has a clear and trusted view of incentive performance, spend, ROI, and business impact.
Finance and business teams are aligned on how incentive economics are measured, reported, and forecasted.
Incentive investment decisions are grounded in clear evidence, consistent measurement, and well-defined business trade-offs.
Cross-functional teams have a repeatable operating model for proposing, launching, measuring, and scaling incentives.
The incentives roadmap reflects the highest-value opportunities across customer segments, channels, markets, and product surfaces.
Execution teams are supported by clear strategic direction, operating processes, and measurement standards.
The business can scale incentives with greater speed, confidence, and financial control.
Incentives become a more disciplined growth lever that supports both customer acquisition and long-term customer value.
 Required Skills & Experience
Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making in day-to-day work.
Proven ability to operate effectively with a global-first mindset 
7+ years of experience in growth strategy, business operations, commercial strategy, go-to-market strategy, incentives, loyalty, pricing, performance marketing, financial planning and analysis, or management consulting.
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience building or interpreting P&L models, ROI frameworks, forecasts, business cases, or investment recommendations.
Excellent analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, interpret complex data, and translate insights into clear business decisions.
Experience partnering with Finance, Data/Analytics, Product, Marketing, CRM, Regional, or Operations teams to build shared infrastructure and drive cross-functional alignment.
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to build crisp strategy documents, business reviews, and decision-ready presentations.
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive progress across teams with different priorities, incentives, and levels of context.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
A structured problem-solving approach, with a bias toward action and a high bar for analytical rigor.
 Nice To Have Skills
Experience in management consulting, business operations, growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, or commercial strategy roles.
Experience working on loyalty, promotions, incentives, pricing, marketplace growth, customer lifecycle, or monetization programs.
Experience with experimentation, incrementality measurement, customer segmentation, or lifetime value analysis.
Familiarity with BI tools, SQL, dashboards, or analytics workflows.
Experience building operating rhythms, governance processes, or scalable cross-functional planning mechanisms.
Experience working in travel, marketplaces, e-commerce, consumer technology, or membership-based businesses.
 What We Offer
Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
“Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.
 Our Cultural Pillars
 Traveler first
 We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.
 Execution is our edge
 We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.
 We succeed together
 The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.
If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

title: Senior Technical Customer Success Manager - Enterprise, East
description:
Summary: 
 The Customer Success team at Anaconda is the primary relationship layer between our platform and the enterprise organizations that depend on it — from data scientists and ML engineers to IT architects and security teams managing open-source risk at scale. We help customers get real, measurable value from Anaconda's product suite by building trust, showing up prepared, and staying curious about what each customer is actually trying to solve. 
 As a Senior Technical Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts and operate as the voice of the customer across the organization. You bring deep technical fluency (across Python packaging, environment management, and enterprise security and governance) and you use it to close the gap between what customers deploy and the value they actually realize. You're not here to just manage relationships. You're here to set the standard for how we engage technically and commercially, and to leave the function stronger than you found it. This role will cover an East Coast territory, so you will ideally be located in the EST time zone. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Build deep relationships across complex organizations (from data scientists and platform engineers to IT architects, security leads, and C-suite stakeholders) well beyond the initial point of contact 
 Accelerate onboarding and initial adoption. Guide customers through first-use milestones: environment setup, CVE policy configuration, private repo and channel tokenization, and initial workflow adoption, coding assistant & quick start processes. Identify and resolve technical blockers before they threaten time-to-value 
 Drive ongoing usage health and consumption. Monitor seat utilization, package and channel usage, and admin portal signals to identify underused licenses, stalled users, or shadow IT risk. Proactively engage the AE when usage patterns suggest expansion opportunity or churn risk 
 Arrive at every customer interaction with a prepared point of view. Draw on product usage data, health scores, and technical signals to drive conversations forward and deliver clear value at each touchpoint 
 Own the technical inputs to account health scoring. Surface risk early (unresolved CVE exposure, blocked package access, unmanaged environments) and coordinate mitigation plans with the RM, Support, and FDE 
 Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering. Channel technical requirements, competitive intelligence, and enhancement requests. Partner with Solutions Engineering on where Anaconda complements or competes with adjacent platforms in the customer's stack 
 Build the technical narrative for QBRs and executive engagement. Partner with the account team to document use cases, quantify value delivered (time saved, risk reduced, packages secured), and make the business case stick at the executive level 
 Support renewal and expansion. Bring technical proof points into renewal conversations (usage data, security posture improvements, workshop outcomes), advise the RM on churn forecast based on adoption and usage signals, and flag technical expansion whitespace; new teams, new use cases, adjacent workloads; to the AE for commercial pursuit 
 Use AI as a force multiplier. Build AI-enabled success approaches the team actually adopts. Know where AI belongs in the customer motion and where human judgment stays central. Your standard becomes the team's standard 
 Contribute to playbook development and team infrastructure. Senior TSMs are expected to leave the function stronger than they found it through documentation, engagement templates, peer coaching, and process improvements that raise overall team performance 
 Mentor and coach less experienced team members through account reviews, technical strategy sessions, and informal guidance. Translate personal experience into repeatable, teachable approaches 
 Operate within a Go-To-Market pod. Sit alongside the Account Executive, Renewal Manager, Solutions Engineer, and other pod roles (FDE, BDR, TAM where applicable) under a shared pod leader. Attend weekly pod and pipeline meetings and collaborate closely with the AE on account plans, customer relationships, and QBRs 
 What Success Looks Like: 
 Net revenue retention (NRR) across your enterprise portfolio 
 Customer health score trends and reduction in at-risk accounts 
 Time-to-value and adoption depth across your book of business 
 Quality and completeness of success plans, technical documentation, and account records 
 Expansion pipeline sourced from within existing accounts 
 AI-enabled workflows or playbook contributions adopted by peers 
 What You’ll Need: 
 6+ years in a technical customer-facing role. Customer success, technical account management, solutions engineering, or similar; with demonstrated ownership of a $6M+ book of business and accountability for retention and growth outcomes at large enterprise accounts (10,000+ employees) 
 Understanding of enterprise security and governance concepts relevant to Anaconda: CVE exposure, package provenance, air-gapped and private repo deployment, SSO, and gated registration 
 Experience with data science, ML, or developer tooling platforms. Databricks, Domino, Dataiku, SageMaker, or similar, and familiarity with how Anaconda fits into or alongside these environments 
 Ability to read logs and error output to triage technical issues before escalating to Support or Professional Services. You know the difference between self-resolving, routing to Support, and escalating to Product 
 Proven ability to build relationships across complex organizations, from practitioners to VP and C-suite stakeholders, and translate technical risk and product capability into executive-level business impact 
 Familiarity with adjacent and competitive tooling: SageMaker, Databricks, Snowflake, Vertex AI; sufficient to position Anaconda's complement-vs.-compete story credibly 
 Project management skills to coordinate multi-stakeholder technical engagements: onboarding, workshops, proofs of concept 
 Strong verbal and written communication across all levels of an organization, including executive audiences 
 AI fluency in daily work; comfortable using AI tools to research, document, prepare, and draft; rigorous about reviewing what you produce under your name before it reaches a customer 
 Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience 
 What Will Make You Stand Out: 
 Experience at a high-growth or early-stage company where the playbook wasn't written yet — you've helped build structure from scratch, operated with autonomy, and stayed effective when priorities shifted underneath you 
 Working fluency in Python packaging and environment management; conda, pip, pixi, and the tradeoffs between them — and the ability to hold a substantive technical conversation without SE support in routine scenarios 
 Deep familiarity with open-source ecosystems; software supply chain security, dependency management, license compliance exposure, and vulnerability workflows — and the ability to speak credibly to a CISO or VP Engineering about why it matters 
 A history of contributing to team infrastructure; playbooks, engagement templates, peer coaching, or process improvements that raised overall team performance, not just your own numbers 
 Experience in a high-growth, open-source, or data science-oriented company where customer needs evolve quickly and the product is still maturing 
 AI-enabled workflow contributions; you've built something others use, not just used AI for yourself; you've made a judgment call about where AI doesn't belong and explained why 
 You embody our values: Curious by Default, Build Together, Own It, and Lead with Guts and Heart — and our behaviors: Clarity, Care, and Candor 
 You care deeply about building environments where people of all backgrounds can do their best work 
 Why You'll Like Working Here: 
 You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded 
 Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise. 
 You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor. 
 You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth. 
 The application deadline for this role is 11/24/2026; applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled. 
 The US base salary range for this role is $96,000 - $139,000 + variable commission structure based on sales performance + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. 
 In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: 
 Flexible Vacation Policy 
 Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 
 Short Term and Long Term Disability 
 Paid Parental Leave 
 Monthly Wellness Stipend 
 Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources 
 An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. 
 Anaconda, Inc. (“We”, “Us”) are committed to protecting and respecting your privacy. This Privacy Notice sets out the basis on which the personal data collected from you, or that you provide to Us, will be processed by Us in connection with Our recruitment processes. 
 By clicking “Submit Application”, you acknowledge you have read our Privacy Policy and that Anaconda can retain your application data for up to 1-year, unless otherwise stated. For the purpose of the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) ”) and the version of the GDPR retained in UK law (the “UK GDPR”) the Data Controller is Vanessa Macilwaine. 
 Anaconda is an EEO/AA employer M/F/V/D. 
 About Anaconda 
 Be at the center of AI 
 Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at https://www.anaconda.com .
hard_gaps: Deep technical fluency in Python packaging and environment management
Enterprise security and governance expertise (CVE policy, repo tokenization)
flags: band 96000-139000 USD starts below your 130000 USD floor -- only the top half clears it
CSM in US-Remote at a non-standout company
Technical CSM role; hands-on Python packaging and CVE configuration exceeds his account-level, non-technical CS background.
Band midpoint sits below the USD 130K floor; only the top of range clears it.
Commission tied to sales performance suggests partial quota exposure in a CS role.
verdict: US runway-only technical CSM needing deep Python/security fluency he lacks; lateral, low-preference market, pay marginal against his floor.

title: Head of Customer Success, EMEA & APAC
description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box? 
At the end of this thrilling journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to help cybersecurity professionals and organizations enhance their cyber-attack readiness. Get ready for an exciting adventure into the world of cybersecurity! 
✨The core mission of the Head of CS, AMEA & APAC
As the Head of CS, EMEA and APAC, your mission is to lead and empower a team of Customer Success Associates and Managers in the EMEA and APAC regions, fostering excellence in customer experiences that drive retention, adoption, expansion, and growth. You aim to take full ownership of key CS operating model initiatives, collaborate cross-functionally, and leverage data to continuously improve client experiences, while building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders. Your active participation in the Customer Success leadership team contributes to the vision, strategy, planning, and execution, ensuring strategic growth and the success of your customers.
 Location & Work Mode:
Full-time employment
2 options for direct employment: UK (fully remote) or Athens, Greece (hybrid OR fully remote if located outside Athens)
We're open to exploring any country within the European time zone
 ✈️ Relocation 
We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your relocation to Athens, Greece. In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction as part of the relocation (if you comply with the gov criteria). We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks.
 The fellowship you’ll be joining:
As the Head of CS, you will be working closely with a diverse range of stakeholders, including your team of Customer Success Associates and Managers, as well as leaders in Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps, Finance, and Marketing. You are required to partner with EMEA and APAC Sales Leadership on managing those regions, on brainstorming and executing strategic growth initiatives, and building trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.
 The adventures that await you after becoming the Head of CS at Hack The Box:
Own and drive the regional Gross Retention Rate (GRR) and Net Retention Rate (NRR) metrics
Recruit, manage & coach a team of Customer Success Associates and Customer Success Managers in the EMEA and APAC regions, and empower them to deliver excellent customer experiences that drive retention & adoption, as well as expansion & growth.
Have tremendous direct impact on growing our EMEA and APAC CS teams, building our culture, evolving the way we make our customers successful, and helping HTB grow.
Active participation in the Customer Success leadership team, contributing vision & strategy, planning and execution.
Full ownership of strategy and rollout of important Revenue and CS-specific operating model initiatives, such as updated HTB messaging, new pricing, Tiered Customer Engagement Framework, career leveling framework, account health scoring, digital success motions, etc.
Work with leaders in other functions (Sales, Product, Engineering, RevOps, Finance, Marketing, etc) to execute cross-functional and CS operating model initiatives.
Closely partner with the EMEA and APAC Sales Leadership team on managing the business and on executing strategic growth initiatives.
Use data and analytics to identify usage & engagement patterns, and continuously improve the client experience for the accounts that your CS team manages.
As a customer-facing leader, build trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders.
 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Head of CS at Hack The Box:
You’ll have 5+ of experience leading enterprise customer success teams in a B2B SaaS company
You have a mentoring and growth mindset, coaching your CS team to lead value-based client conversations, empowering them to succeed, and providing feedback for their development.
You’ll have an entrepreneurial spirit with a high tolerance for ambiguity and complexity. Ability to be efficient with limited resources, and identify internal process gaps that you can help evolve and fix as HTB scales.
Strong track record of partnering with Sales, Marketing, Product, and other cross-functional leaders and stakeholders to deliver results.
You’re adept at being the senior voice in meaningful, data-informed Quarterly Business Review sessions with our clients.
You’re technically savvy, with experience using the tech-stack and tool-kit of a modern SaaS Customer Success leader. You’re also keen to develop a strong knowledge of cybersecurity concepts, the HTB platform and solutions.
️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:
You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.
 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.
 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, leveling up as our organization grows.
 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!
We also have other benefits that will keep you happy (Athens, Greece):
Private health care
Paid parental leave (4 weeks) 
25 annual leave days
Free lunch & snacks at the office
120€ Ticket Restaurant by Edenred
Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences
Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 
State-of-the-art equipment (mac, iPhone, and mobile plan)
Flexible WFH (Hybrid Model) - Fully Remote is also an option if you're not an Attica resident 
Annual childcare allowance to support daycare expenses for parents
Access to on-site gym and a variety of group activities, including Cross Training, Pilates, Boxing, and Climbing
[ Important Note: Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract)]
️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Head of CS:
Level 1 — Apply: Submit your application. Tell us why this role excites you and what you’d bring.
Level 2 — Talent Screen: A conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to explore your background and ambitions. Please note that an online assessment must be completed before your conversation with our Talent Acquisition team.
Level 3 — Chat with Petros: A relaxed conversation with your future manager. Think of it as a mutual vibe check.
Level 4 — Complete a job-specific challenge and have a meaningful conversation with the wider team. 
Level 5 — Congratulations! Not many reach this level . Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB. 
Level 6 — You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer. 
Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

You will lead three customer-facing functions through their supervisors, focusing on strategy, performance, and scalable team structures rather than day-to-day ticket management. The role combines people leadership, customer lifecycle strategy, data analysis, and operational execution in a fast-growing digital healthcare environment. You will identify the drivers behind churn and refunds, build programs to improve customer loyalty, and measure their impact on lifetime value. You will also oversee the systems, processes, and quality standards that support customer care and retention. Lead the Support, Retention, and Winback teams through their respective supervisors, setting clear objectives, performance standards, and operating structures.
Build scalable workforce-management processes covering staffing, scheduling, coverage, and headcount planning as the customer base grows.
Own retention and churn performance end to end, monitoring churn rate, retention by cohort and product, save rate, and customer lifetime value.
Analyze why customers leave and develop targeted retention strategies, lifecycle programs, and save plays designed to reduce avoidable churn.
Own refund performance and identify the underlying drivers, distinguishing between healthy cancellations and refunds caused by poor customer fit or experience.
Develop and manage the winback strategy, including offers, communication cadence, product-level performance, and return-on-investment analysis.

Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, loyalty strategies, referrals, and retention programs.

Strong people-management, coaching, and performance-management skills, with the ability to lead through supervisors rather than managing frontline tickets directly.

Strong commercial and operational judgment, with the ability to balance customer experience, retention, profitability, and compliance.
A highly data-driven, structured, and hands-on approach to identifying problems, testing solutions, and measuring results.

Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote environment where priorities and customer needs evolve quickly.

company: DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH
title: Team Lead Customer Success (all genders)
description:
About the role
Are you passionate about building high-performing teams, deepening client trust, and turning complex software into a tool people rely on every day?
As Team Lead Customer Success, you'll take ownership of our Customer Success function for D3 and OMS clients — banks, traders and technical teams who depend on our systems to price, manage and distribute FX Forward and Swap prices around the clock. You'll lead a team of four responsible for day-to-day client support, build the processes and product expertise that are shared across the team, and shape a more proactive way of working with clients.
This is not a role where you inherit a finished machine. You'll inherit a strong product, demanding expert users, a good team, and a function that needs clear ownership, deep product expertise, strong tooling, and a proactive way of working. Working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering, you'll help define what a modern, efficient Customer Success function looks like for our market.
This is a hands-on builder role for someone comfortable with ambiguity, who enjoys getting close to the product and the client as much as leading a team.
Your Responsibilities
Lead and grow the Customer Success team responsible for D3 and OMS clients, taking on full people-management responsibility.
Own the quality of day-to-day client support, making sure questions are answered quickly, clearly, and to a consistently high standard.
Own support escalation, ensuring complex, urgent, or sensitive cases move through the organisation in a structured way instead of bouncing between people.
Build the team's product expertise so that a growing share of D3 and OMS questions can be answered directly, without relying on Product, Engineering, or long-standing individual experts.
Own onboarding from a Customer Success perspective, so new clients and users understand the product and are set up for success from day one.
Develop a more proactive way of working with clients — anticipating issues before clients raise them, and identifying where they are not using D3 or OMS to its full potential, reaching out with suggestions rather than only reacting to requests.
Make client knowledge visible internally by documenting client setup, usage, stakeholders, infrastructure, and recurring issues, rather than letting it live in emails or individual heads.
Create a structured feedback loop into Product, surfacing patterns, friction, and recurring issues from client interactions, not just direct feature requests.
Help define and improve the tools, processes, and reporting used by Customer Success, including systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, and Jira.
Contribute to a clear, shared view of client health, including key users, setup, risks, and commercial opportunities, working closely with Sales.
Speak directly and frequently with traders, desk heads, application owners, and technical stakeholders at client banks.
Preferred qualifications 
Several years of experience leading a Customer Success, Support, or Client Services team, ideally in enterprise software or fintech.
A proven ability to build structure, process, and ownership in a function that is still evolving, rather than only maintaining an existing setup.
Strong technical aptitude and the ability to develop deep expertise in a complex software product like D3. This is not an engineering role, but you need to be comfortable with technical detail and credible with sophisticated users.
Enough financial-market understanding to grasp why D3 exists, what problem it solves, and what our traders need from it.
Comfortable engaging directly with senior, demanding stakeholders such as traders and desk heads, as well as technical and operations teams at banks.
Strong track record of managing escalations and keeping complex cases moving through an organisation without losing ownership.
Experience building or improving tooling, automation, AI-assisted workflows, reporting, and documentation practices within a support or Customer Success function.
Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working closely with Product, Sales, and Engineering.
Fluency in English is required.
 Nice to have 
Experience with one or more of the following would be an advantage:
FX, Capital Markets, FICC, Treasury, or electronic trading environments.
Previous exposure to OMS or similar trading systems.
Enterprise SaaS support or Customer Success in a technically complex product.
Experience building a Customer Success function in a small, expert team, with a hands-on approach to clients, product, and day-to-day operations.
Familiarity with SaaS environments and technical operations — infrastructure, connectivity, system monitoring — even though this role does not own technical operations.
CRM or ticketing systems such as Dynamics, Confluence, Jira, or Teams.
What we offer as an employer 
Join an Innovative Leader: Be part of a pioneering SaaS tech company recognised as the global standard in its category, experiencing impressive double-digit annual growth.
Transform a Major Market: Contribute to our mission of revolutionising the FX Swaps market with cutting-edge solutions and technologies.
Be part of an international workforce: Work within a truly multi-national team, collaborating with colleagues from across the globe, located in London, Hamburg, and Singapore.
Make an Impact: Hone your skills in small teams where your ideas matter, actively shaping your role and driving your personal growth.
Enjoy Competitive Benefits: Benefit from a competitive compensation and benefits package, including 30 days of annual paid leave.
Invest in Your Development: Access a €1,000 (or equivalent in local currency) yearly budget dedicated to further education and professional development.
About us
DIGITEC Financial Technologies and Services GmbH stands at the forefront of the financial technology sector, renowned for developing cutting-edge software solutions. Our innovative products encompass a wide spectrum, from pricing and settlement solutions for FX/MM businesses to FX market data services. With over 40 prominent banks worldwide, spanning Europe, America, Asia, and Australia, among our esteemed clientele, we have solidified our position as a global leader.
At the heart of our success is our exceptional team, comprised of approximately 75 dedicated professionals boasting expertise in software development, financial mathematics, sales, IT systems, and more. Operating from three key locations—Hamburg (headquarters), London, and Singapore—we champion equal opportunities and foster a culture of respect and collaboration, ensuring a welcoming and supportive work environment for all.
Join us as we continue to redefine the landscape of financial technology with DIGITEC.

description:
YOUR MISSION 
The Director, Revenue Operations and Administration, will lead the systems, processes, data, and commercial administration that enable CADSI's revenue-generating activities to operate effectively and scale.
Reporting to the V.P., Business Development, the Director will provide the operational backbone supporting CADSI's commercial activities across membership, events, exhibitions, sponsorship, advertising, international programming, and other revenue-generating products and services.
Working closely with Business Development, Membership Care, Marketing, Finance, Event Operations, International Programs, and IT, the Director will ensure commercial opportunities move efficiently from prospect through contracting, invoicing coordination, fulfillment, and renewal.
The Director will lead the Manager, Partnership, and Sales Coordinator and will be responsible for building a disciplined, data-driven Revenue Operations function that allows CADSI's commercial teams to spend more time growing relationships and revenue while providing leadership with accurate and actionable commercial information.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Revenue Operations & Commercial Intelligence 
Develop and maintain the operational framework, processes, and controls supporting CADSI's revenue-generating activities.
Maintain accurate visibility into sales pipeline, contracted revenue, renewals, customer activity, commercial inventory, and other key commercial commitments.
Develop dashboards, reporting, and key performance indicators that provide leadership with clear and timely visibility into commercial performance.
Provide Finance with accurate commercial pipeline, sales, renewal, and inventory information to support organizational budgeting and financial forecasting.
Analyze commercial performance to identify trends, bottlenecks, capacity constraints, and opportunities to improve efficiency and commercial outcomes.
Provide the Vice President, Business Development, and Director, Business Development, with actionable commercial intelligence to support sales strategy and decision-making.
Lead the contracting and administration of third-party commercial service providers and sales partners supporting the Business Development function, in collaboration with the Vice President, Business Development, and appropriate functional leads.
Ensure third-party commercial agreements clearly define scope, responsibilities, commercial terms, performance expectations, reporting requirements, and renewal provisions.
 Sales Operations & Commercial Administration 
Establish consistent processes for opportunity management, pipeline documentation, proposals, contracts, amendments, approvals, and commercial administration.
Ensure commercial opportunities and customer activity are accurately maintained within CADSI's systems.
Oversee the administrative lifecycle of commercial activities from opportunity through contracting, invoicing coordination, fulfillment, and renewal.
Ensure commercial agreements accurately reflect approved pricing, inventory, deliverables, and customer commitments.
Establish effective hand-offs between business development and the teams responsible for delivering sold products and services.
 Commercial Product & Inventory Management 
Maintain a centralized and accurate view of CADSI's commercial products and inventory, including exhibit space, sponsorship, advertising, meeting suites, registrations, and other commercial assets.
Provide timely visibility into available, reserved, and sold inventory.
Establish controls to prevent overselling, inventory conflicts, and inconsistent commercial commitments.
Analyze demand and utilization to support pricing, packaging, and commercial product decisions.
 Systems, Data & Commercial Process Management 
Define the business requirements and workflows required to support sales, commercial administration, contracts, inventory management, partnership management, and reporting.
Work closely with the Membership Data Administrator to ensure CADSI's MMS effectively supports commercial processes, reporting requirements, and customer information needs.
Work closely with the Director, IT/IM, on technology requirements, system integrations, automation, and improvements supporting CADSI's commercial operations.
Identify opportunities to streamline commercial processes, reduce duplicate data entry, and improve the flow of information across systems.
Establish business standards for the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of commercial data entered and maintained by the Revenue Operations team.
Ensure commercial teams follow established processes and appropriately use CADSI's systems to maintain accurate customer, opportunity, contract, and commercial information.
 Partnership & Commercial Coordination 
Lead and provide direction to the manager, Partnership.
Ensure commercial partnership commitments, contractual benefits, and organizational obligations are accurately documented and communicated to the appropriate delivery teams.
Establish effective processes for tracking partnership commitments, deadlines, and outstanding obligations.
Coordinate commercial information across business development, marketing, events, membership, and international programs.
 Process Improvement & Organizational Scalability 
Continuously assess commercial and administrative processes for opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service.
Establish clear roles, responsibilities, workflows, and service standards across CADSI's commercial lifecycle.
Champion the effective use of technology and automation.
 Team Leadership 
Lead, coach, and develop the manager, partnership, and sales coordinator.
Establish clear responsibilities, priorities, performance expectations, and service standards.
Build a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented revenue operations team.
 QUALIFICATIONS 
University degree or college diploma in business, commerce, operations, data/analytics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in revenue operations, sales operations, commercial operations, business operations, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading employees and developing high-performing teams.
Strong experience with CRM, membership management, ERP, or comparable enterprise business systems.
Experience with sales operations, pipeline reporting, commercial administration, and performance analytics.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing cross-functional business processes.
Experience working with contracts, commercial inventory, sponsorship, or partnership administration is an asset.
Experience within an association, event, exhibition, membership, or B2B environment is considered an asset.
Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
 KEY COMPETENCIES 
 Commercial Acumen: Understands how sales, products, inventory, customers, and commercial processes work together to generate revenue.
 Systems & Process Thinking: Ability to design practical, scalable processes that improve efficiency and accountability.
 Data & Analytics: Ability to translate commercial information into clear and actionable insights.
 Technology Enablement: Comfortable using CRM/MMS platforms, automation, and integrated systems to simplify work and improve productivity.
 Operational Leadership: Ability to create structure and discipline within a complex and rapidly growing environment. 
 Problem Solving: Anticipates operational challenges and develops practical solutions.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across business development, finance, marketing, membership, events, International Programs, and IT.
 People Leadership: Sets clear expectations, develops employees, and creates a culture of accountability and service.
 Attention to Detail: Maintains a high degree of accuracy across contracts, commercial data, inventory, and customer commitments.
 Continuous Improvement: Challenges inefficient processes and actively seeks better ways of working.
 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS 
This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes:
Annual salary of $90,000–$125,000, commensurate with experience
9%–12% discretionary annual performance bonus
Comprehensive health and dental benefits
Health and wellness credit
RRSP matching program
Competitive vacation and paid time off
Professional development opportunities
Flexible hybrid work environment
Seasonal remote-work opportunities
 YOUR WORKING ENVIRONMENT 
CADSI offers a flexible, collaborative working environment that combines in-office and remote work. Employees are provided with ergonomic workstations and the tools required to succeed in their roles.
Our culture values collaboration, accountability, professional growth, and the opportunity for employees to make a meaningful contribution to an organization experiencing significant growth and transformation.
 COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION 
CADSI is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and accessible workplace. We welcome applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds.
CADSI is committed to providing an accessible recruitment process. Accommodation is available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the selection process.
‍
 HOW TO APPLY 
To be considered for this position, please submit your resume and a cover letter of no more than two pages addressing the following:
Why you are interested in joining CADSI.
How your experience, skills, and background prepare you to succeed in this position.
Examples that demonstrate your results-oriented approach and ability to deliver meaningful outcomes.
Your compensation expectations.
Applications should be submitted by email to applications@defenceandsecurity.ca no later than October 2, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET .
We thank all applicants for their interest. Only candidates selected to participate in the interview process will be contacted.

title: Director, Head of Sales Operations
description:
Shape the Future of Sales Operations at Phreesia
 Title: Director, Head of Sales Operations
 Team: Phreesia Network Solutions
 Location: Remote EST or CST in Canada or the U.S., with occasional travel required for client meetings, industry events, conferences, and team collaboration.
 Why This Role Exists
 Phreesia Network Solutions partners with pharmaceutical manufacturers, biotech companies, media agencies, and other life sciences organizations to activate patients and engage providers with personalized, privacy-safe communications at the moments that matter most in care. Our media programs are sold — and re-sold — every year, which means our commercial engine has to run with precision: accurate forecasts, clean pipeline data, well-designed territories and quotas, and sellers who spend their time selling.
As Director, Head of Sales Operations, you will own that engine — and modernize it. You will be the connective tissue between Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, Client Experience, and Client Solutions — turning strategy into operating cadence, data into decisions, and friction into process.
You will scale the commercial operation with AI at its backbone, embedding AI-driven forecasting, insights, and automation across the sales workflow so the team can grow revenue faster than headcount. Reporting to the SVP, Finance & Commercial Operations, you will lead an established Sales Operations team and own the systems, analytics, and planning disciplines that allow the PNS sales organization to scale efficiently as we grow across PatientConnect, ProviderConnect, MediFind, and our expanding solution portfolio.
 What You’ll Spend Your Time Doing
Lead sales planning and go-to-market design. You’ll lead annual and quarterly sales planning across territory, capacity, quota, and compensation planning — designing balanced territories and account segmentation, modeling headcount needs, setting quotas tied to forecast targets, and partnering with Finance and People teams on compensation plans that incentivize the right behaviors across new business, renewals, and upsell. You’ll also support go-to-market planning for new offerings, ensuring rules of engagement, coverage, and targets are in place at launch.
Own forecasting and pipeline management. You’ll own the forecasting process and cadence, delivering accurate, defensible revenue forecasts across new business, renewals, and expansion for a business built on annually re-sold media programs. You’ll establish pipeline hygiene standards, stage definitions, and inspection rhythms; run weekly pipeline and forecast reviews with Sales leadership; and partner with Finance on bookings-to-revenue reconciliation, campaign delivery pacing, and quarterly business reviews.
Turn commercial data into actionable insights. You’ll build and maintain the reporting suite for the business, including pipeline, win/loss, retention and renewal rates, upsell, rep productivity, and brand- and agency-level performance. You’ll deliver insights that shape strategy — identifying where we’re winning, where deals stall, and which therapeutic areas and agency relationships are growing — and present those insights to senior leadership. You’ll also define and govern a single source of truth for commercial data across systems.
Scale systems, tools, and AI capabilities. You’ll own the sales technology stack — with Salesforce as the backbone, alongside forecasting, enablement, data enrichment, and workflow tools — including administration, roadmap, integrations, and vendor management. You’ll define and execute an AI roadmap for the commercial organization, deploying AI agents, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation to improve forecast accuracy, surface deal risk and next-best actions, automate non-selling work, and increase seller productivity. You’ll drive CRM adoption and data quality, design workflows that reduce manual effort for sellers and account teams, and ensure the clean, governed data foundation that AI-driven insights depend on. You’ll also evaluate emerging AI tooling with a practical eye — piloting quickly, measuring impact, and scaling what works.
Improve deal support and commercial processes. You’ll run deal desk functions, including pricing governance, approval workflows, proposal support, and order processing in partnership with Legal, Finance, and Client Experience. You’ll continuously identify and remove friction across the quote-to-cash process and own rules of engagement across Sales, Client Experience, and Market Development.
Scale sales best practices. You’ll identify what’s working across outreach cadences, deal motions, and renewal plays and scale those practices across the team to shorten sales cycles and maximize selling time. You’ll partner closely with Sales Enablement and Training, which is owned separately, to ensure process changes, tooling, and best practices are embedded in onboarding and ongoing coaching.
Lead and develop the Sales Operations team. You’ll lead, develop, and mentor an established Sales Operations team spanning analytics, systems administration, and deal support, shaping the function’s structure as the business grows. You’ll serve as a trusted operating partner to the SVP, Finance & Commercial Operations, Client Experience, and Sales leadership, taking meaningful non-selling work off the plates of the sales team so they can focus on clients and revenue.
 What Makes You a Great Fit
 You will be a great fit if you are:
Bring deep, hands-on expertise with Salesforce, including administration, reporting, and process design, and ideally have experience owning a broader revenue technology stack
Have demonstrated ownership of forecasting, territory and quota planning, and sales compensation design within a quota-carrying sales organization
Bring experience in media, advertising, point-of-care marketing, life sciences, or healthcare technology; familiarity with annually renewing or re-sold revenue models is a plus
Have a strong analytical toolkit, including hands-on use of AI tools for analysis, forecasting, and workflow automation, such as Salesforce Einstein/Agentforce, generative AI assistants, or similar
Are highly proficient with Excel or Google Sheets; experience with SQL and Power BI or similar BI tools is preferred
Know how to turn complex data into a clear, compelling narrative for executives
Have a demonstrated track record of scaling a commercial function with AI and automation — identifying use cases, driving adoption, and measuring productivity impact
Bring excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills and are comfortable operating at both strategic and hands-on levels in a fast-growing business
 We Do Have A Few Requirements To Check
Bachelor’s degree required
10+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or commercial strategy, including 3+ years leading the function or a significant portion of it
Prior people management experience
 Where You’ll Work
 This is a remote role, with the expectation that you’re based in EST or CST in Canada or the U.S. Occasional travel is required for client meetings, industry events, conferences, and team collaboration.
 Compensation & Rewards
Base Salary: $240,000-260,000 USD or $200,000-230,000 CAD (depending on experience) inclusive of base salary and variable incentive.
A comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support your whole life — not just your work
 Who We Are
 At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience. We’re committed to helping healthcare organizations succeed in an ever-evolving landscape by transforming the way healthcare is delivered. Our SaaS platform digitizes appointment check-in and offers tools to engage patients, improve efficiency, optimize staffing, and enhance clinical care.
Phreesia cares about our employees by providing a diverse and dynamic work environment. We’re a five-time winner of Modern Healthcare Magazine’s Best Places to Work in Healthcare award and we’ve been recognized on the Bloomberg Gender Equality Index. We are dedicated to continuously improving our employee experience by launching new programs and initiatives. If you thrive in a culture of recognition, value inclusivity, professional development, and growth opportunities, Phreesia could be a great fit!
 Top-rated Employee Benefits

title: Sales Compensation Manager
description:
Founded in 2018 with co-headquarters in Dublin and Boston, Tines powers some of the world's most important workflows. Our intelligent workflow platform applies AI, automation, and integration with human ingenuity to drive real business results. 
Tines serves a diverse range of customers, from startups to public companies, including Canva, Databricks, Elastic, Kayak, Intercom, and McKesson. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. And because Tines is secure and private by design, it’s popular with security, IT, engineering, finance, and other security-focused teams.
At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.
We're looking for a sales compensation leader to own how we pay our go-to-market organisation, and how that changes as our commercial model changes. You will run the engine that pays roughly 350 GTM people accurately and on time, own the design of the plans, quotas and incentives behind it, and lead a small team of analysts.
The timing is the interesting part. Tines is moving from subscription and seat-based pricing to a consumption model, which means designing and running two comp worlds in parallel while we transition. At the same time we are rebuilding the quote-to-cash stack on Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, which resets crediting and the data that feeds it. You will be central to both.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage and coach a small team, and you will also be in the model, in CaptivateIQ, and in the plan documents yourself.
 What you'll do: 
 Run the compensation engine 
Own the monthly and quarterly compensation cycle end to end: crediting, calculation, review, approval and payout, delivered accurately and on time
Own CaptivateIQ as our system of record for incentive compensation, including plan build, rule logic, testing and release
Own crediting and comp data integrity across Salesforce and downstream systems, and work with Systems and Deal Desk to fix problems at source rather than in spreadsheets
Oversee inquiry management ensuring clear SLAs and report on trends to improve overall processes
Document and keep policies and process up to date for stakeholders and your team
 Design the plans, quotas and incentives 
Own annual plan design in partnership with your Senior compensation analyst, GTM leadership, FP&A and People for all commissioned roles
Collaborate with Revops business partners on the quota setting process for each function to ensure it aligns with broader compensation strategy and benchmarks
Model attainment distribution, benchmarks and support finance in ad-hoc cost reporting
Own and build SPIFFs and non-cash incentive programmes, including President's Club,
Own plan communication and enablement, so reps and managers understand what they are paid for and can self-serve where needed
 Evolve the compensation strategy as we grow 
Build the compensation approach for an evolving pricing model and mulit-product business in partnership with the Head of Revenue Operations and VP of Finance
Represent compensation requirements during larger CPQ and CRM enhancements or changes
Enhance our approach based compensation reporting: attainment by role and segment, payout curves, quota coverage and programme effectiveness
 Lead and grow the team 
Manage, coach and develop a small team of compensation analysts, and set the standard and what good looks like
Prioritise the team's work, capacity and quarterly OKRs to ensure a balance of reactiveness and impactful projects
Stay hands-on. This is a doing and leading role, not a management-only role
 What you'll bring with you: 
 Required experience 
6+ years in sales compensation, revenue operations, sales finance or a closely related field, with experience managing or formally mentoring analysts
2-3 years direct management experience
Proven ownership of a full incentive compensation cycle for a distributed GTM team, including crediting, calculation, payout and dispute resolution
Hands-on administration of an ICM platform, ideally CaptivateIQ, including building and testing plan logic yourself
Demonstrated plan design experience: pay mix, leverage, accelerators and quota setting, with the modelling to back the recommendation
Strong Salesforce data fluency, and the ability to translate commercial requirements into system and crediting logic
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets modelling, including capacity, attainment and cost of sale models
Excellent stakeholder management, with the credibility to hold a position with Sales leaders and the judgement to know when to flex
You can communicate simply, clearly, and directly, especially with senior leaders, and your written work is polished enough to go straight to an executive audience
 Bonus points 
Experience with consumption, usage-based or hybrid pricing models and their compensation implications
Experience through a CPQ or quote-to-cash migration, ideally Salesforce CPQ or Dealhub
Experience in cybersecurity, IT or AI markets
Familiarity with ASC 606 commission capitalisation and audit requirements
Experience compensating post-sales and partner roles, not just AEs

title: Revenue Enablement Lead
description:
The Company 
Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want. 
As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment. 
Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives!
 Build the Sales Team Everyone Else Benchmarks Against 
The best revenue organizations don't leave great selling to chance. They understand what separates their best performers, turn those behaviors into a repeatable advantage, and build a culture where getting better is part of how the team operates.
 That's what we want to build at Medely - and you'll have the opportunity to shape it. 
We're entering a stage where our next level of growth isn't simply about adding more sellers. It's about raising the level of performance across the revenue organization.
As our Revenue Enablement Lead, you'll partner closely with Revenue Leadership to define what great selling looks like at Medely and build the coaching and development strategy that brings it to life. You'll uncover what's helping our best sellers win, identify where performance is breaking down, and turn those insights into better coaching, stronger onboarding, sharper messaging, and more consistent execution across both new business and expansion. This is an opportunity to have real influence over how an entire revenue organization develops and performs.
 If you've ever looked at an enablement function and thought, “I know how I'd build this better,” this is your chance to do it. 
 What You'll Own 
 Raise the bar for seller performance 
Build a coaching culture that helps good sellers become great and great sellers continue getting better.
Partner with sales and account management leaders to identify performance gaps, develop their teams, and improve execution across the customer journey.
Understand what our strongest performers do differently and turn those insights into repeatable behaviors that raise the performance of the broader organization.
Become a trusted thought partner to sellers and leaders on how we can sell better.
 Build an enablement engine that scales 
Own and evolve our approach to onboarding, ongoing development, certification, messaging, and sales methodology.
Turn what you're learning from the field into programs and resources that sellers actually use.
Use AI, conversation intelligence, and modern enablement technology to scale what works without losing the human element that makes great coaching effective.
 Make enablement measurable 
Partner with Revenue Leadership and RevOps to identify the highest-impact opportunities across the organization.
Connect enablement initiatives to changes in seller behavior, ramp, execution, and business performance.
Use those insights to continually challenge what we're doing, double down on what works, and evolve what doesn't.
 What You'll Bring 
 You've carried a quota before. The best enablement leaders earn credibility because they have sat in the seat themselves. You know tough discovery calls, lost deals, hard quarters, and the pressure of carrying a number.
You likely bring experience across sales, enablement, coaching, or front-line sales leadership in a growing B2B technology company, including:
2+ years of experience carrying a quota in a B2B SaaS sales or account management
A track record of developing sellers and improving performance
Experience building or evolving enablement programs in a growing organization
Strong understanding of modern B2B sales methodologies and complex sales cycles
The ability to identify performance patterns, get to the root of what's happening, and turn insights into action
The credibility and communication skills to influence both sellers and senior revenue leaders
Experience supporting both new business and expansion, scaling SaaS sales teams, building onboarding or certification programs, or working with AI-powered enablement and conversation intelligence tools is a plus.
 Why Now? 
Medely is building a world where healthcare professionals have the freedom to work the way they want and healthcare facilities can access the talent they need.
As we grow, the sophistication of our revenue organization needs to grow with us.
You'll join at a moment where there's a strong foundation to build from - but still meaningful whitespace to shape what comes next.
You won't be maintaining someone else's enablement machine. You'll help build the one that takes Medely into its next stage of growth. 
 Why Medely: Benefits & Perks 
Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance
Long-term Incentives: 401k
Healthcare Benefits: Full suite of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Flexibility: We believe that work/life balance is important, so we offer flexible and unlimited PTO
Paid parental leave
Purpose: Join a growing mission-oriented startup that is modernizing the healthcare industry nationally!
Ownership: Drive meaningful business impact on a team you’ll help build and define!
Remote: Work in a digital environment with all the tools to achieve your work as though you were in the office!
 We're an equal opportunity employer to all. We interview and hire applicants of all backgrounds, orientations, expressions, and identities. 
 Work location is flexible if approved by Medely. 
 Medely does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We consider any resume (CV) or biography received from an agency or outside recruiter without prior approval from a member of the Medely Human Resources or Recruiting team to be unsolicited and gratuitous, and such submissions will not be recognized by Medely for purposes of “ownership” of the candidate. 
 We are an E-Verify company.

description:

 Introduction to the Team & Role
 What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.
 Key Responsibility Areas
Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.
What You'll Do
 Within 1 Month, You Will:
Know the team, the stack, and the cross-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.
 Within 3 Months, You Will:
Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
 Within 6 Months, You Will:
Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
Have a 12-18 month roadmap, setting the high-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio
 Within 12 Months, You Will:
Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI-native operations
The Skill Set
5+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate. 
Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead-to-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
Run vendor evaluations end to end
Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).

Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠

Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝

 360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth.
