 26WD100752, Senior Principal Program Manager, GTM PMO 
 Position Overview 
Autodesk is on a journey of significant growth and transformation. To maintain and accelerate our trajectory, we need exceptional transformation leaders who can help drive our most important organizational initiatives across the go-to-market organization.
We are seeking an experienced Sr. Principal Program Manager to join Autodesk’s Go-to-Market Program Management Office (GTM PMO). In this role, you will lead complex, highly visible transformation programs that span multiple functions and business priorities. You will partner with senior leaders to translate strategy into execution, align stakeholders, establish effective governance, and drive measurable business outcomes.
This role combines strong program leadership with a consulting mindset. You will step into complex and often ambiguous environments, quickly identify what matters, connect dependencies across workstreams, frame decisions, and help teams move forward with clarity and urgency.
 Responsibilities 
Drive transformation program strategy and cross-functional execution end-to-end, partnering across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Product, and Technology to deliver key organizational initiatives and business outcomes
Quickly assess existing programs and execution challenges to establish clarity, alignment, and momentum
Establish and maintain integrated program plans and governance, including milestones, risks, dependencies, operating cadences, and executive reporting
Own cross-program integration, proactively managing interdependencies and driving resolution of blockers
Partner with senior leaders to translate strategic priorities into executable roadmaps, surface tradeoffs, and drive timely decision-making
Proactively identify risks and opportunities and develop actionable mitigation plans and recommendations
Develop and refine PMO standards, methodologies, tools, and best practices that strengthen transformation execution
Coach and mentor program managers supporting key strategic initiatives
 Minimum Qualifications 
10+ years of experience in management consulting, strategic program management, transformation leadership, strategy and operations, PMO leadership, or go-to-market transformation
Proven track record managing complex, enterprise-scale programs from strategy through execution across multiple business domains
Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across senior executives and cross-functional teams
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including experience working with VP and executive-level leaders
Strong ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance strategic thinking with detailed execution
 The Ideal Candidate 
Operates effectively as both a strategic consultant and hands-on program leader
Brings the judgment to balance rigorous program management with the flexibility needed to navigate ambiguity and evolving business priorities
Low ego and high impact; energized by solving complex problems and bringing diverse stakeholders together around shared outcomes
Asks incisive questions that surface assumptions, clarify priorities, and accelerate decision-making
Sees programs and transformations as interconnected systems, connecting dots across workstreams and anticipating downstream impacts
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 26WD100752, Chef de projet principal senior, GTM PMO 
 Aperçu du Poste 
Autodesk connaît actuellement une phase de croissance et de transformation majeures. Pour maintenir et accélérer notre dynamique, nous avons besoin de leaders de la transformation exceptionnels, capables de mener à bien nos initiatives organisationnelles les plus importantes au sein de la structure de commercialisation.
Nous recherchons un chef de projet principal senior expérimenté pour rejoindre le Bureau de gestion des programmes de commercialisation (GTM PMO) d’Autodesk. À ce poste, vous dirigerez des programmes de transformation complexes et très visibles, couvrant plusieurs fonctions et priorités métier. Vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les dirigeants pour traduire la stratégie en actions concrètes, aligner les parties prenantes, mettre en place une gouvernance efficace et générer des résultats commerciaux mesurables.
Ce poste allie un leadership fort en matière de programmes à un esprit de conseil. Vous évoluerez dans des environnements complexes et souvent ambigus, identifierez rapidement l’essentiel, établirez les liens de dépendance entre les axes de travail, cadrerez les décisions et aiderez les équipes à aller de l’avant avec clarté et rapidité.
 Responsabilités 
Piloter la stratégie des programmes de transformation et leur exécution transversale de bout en bout, en collaborant avec les équipes Marketing, Ventes, Réussite client, Opérations, Produit et Technologie pour mener à bien les initiatives organisationnelles clés et générer des résultats commerciaux
Évaluer rapidement les programmes existants et les défis liés à leur mise en œuvre afin d’assurer la clarté, l’alignement et la dynamique
Mettre en place et maintenir des plans de programme intégrés ainsi qu’une gouvernance, incluant les jalons, les risques, les interdépendances, les cadences opérationnelles et le reporting à la direction
Assurer l’intégration entre les programmes, en gérant de manière proactive les interdépendances et en favorisant la résolution des obstacles
Collaborer avec les cadres dirigeants pour traduire les priorités stratégiques en feuilles de route réalisables, mettre en évidence les compromis et favoriser une prise de décision en temps opportun
Identifier de manière proactive les risques et les opportunités, et élaborer des plans d’atténuation et des recommandations concrets
Développer et affiner les normes, méthodologies, outils et bonnes pratiques du PMO qui renforcent la mise en œuvre de la transformation
Accompagner et encadrer les responsables de programmes soutenant les initiatives stratégiques clés
 Qualifications Minimales 
Plus de 10 ans d’expérience dans le conseil en gestion, la gestion de programmes stratégiques, le leadership de transformation, la stratégie et les opérations, la direction d’un PMO ou la transformation de la mise sur le marché
Expérience avérée dans la gestion de programmes complexes à l’échelle de l’entreprise, de la stratégie à la mise en œuvre, dans plusieurs domaines d’activité
Capacité avérée à exercer une influence sans autorité hiérarchique et à favoriser l’alignement entre les cadres supérieurs et les équipes transversales
Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants, en animation, en négociation et en gestion des parties prenantes, y compris une expérience de collaboration avec des vice-présidents et des dirigeants de haut niveau
Grande capacité à gérer l’ambiguïté, à établir efficacement des priorités et à trouver l’équilibre entre réflexion stratégique et exécution minutieuse
 Le Candidat Idéal 
Opère efficacement à la fois en tant que consultant stratégique et en tant que responsable de programme impliqué sur le terrain
Fait preuve du discernement nécessaire pour concilier une gestion rigoureuse des programmes avec la flexibilité requise pour naviguer dans l’ambiguïté et s’adapter à l’évolution des priorités métier
Faible ego et fort impact ; motivé par la résolution de problèmes complexes et la capacité à rassembler des parties prenantes diverses autour d’objectifs communs

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Operations Manager based in Ireland.
 As Sales Operations Manager, you will own the systems, data, tooling, and technical infrastructure that enable a high-performing sales organization to operate efficiently. You will ensure calls and messages reach prospects, leads are routed correctly, and sales reporting remains accurate and actionable. This is a hands-on operational role where you will configure platforms, troubleshoot deliverability issues, build routing logic, and improve integrations. You will work closely with sales leadership to turn commercial strategies into reliable systems and processes. The role combines sales operations, revenue operations, data, compliance, and technical problem-solving. Your work will directly influence sales productivity, lead conversion, customer reach, and the reliability of business decisions.
Accountabilities
Own phone and text deliverability by monitoring spam-flag rates, maintaining healthy numbers, managing local presence and branded calling, and overseeing A2P 10DLC registration and related requirements.
Troubleshoot call blocking, text delivery issues, number reputation, and other communication-channel problems, working directly with telecommunications and messaging vendors when needed.
Manage and configure sales systems and tooling, including dialers, power lists, CRM integrations, tracking systems, link structures, and UTM configurations.
Build and maintain lead-routing and distribution workflows, including speed-to-lead rules, follow-up cadences, no-answer logic, and automated lead assignment.
Own tracking and attribution across calls, links, subscriptions, and purchases, ensuring that conversion, pickup, connection, and revenue data can be measured reliably.
Maintain the underlying data and definitions behind sales dashboards, ensuring that pipeline reporting is accurate, consistent, and accessible to sales leadership.
Build and maintain testing infrastructure that allows commercial teams to run structured experiments with clean setup, controlled variables, reliable measurement, and documented results.
Implement technical compliance requirements across sales communication channels, including consent tracking, compliant opt-in flows, A2P registration, and subscription disclosures.
Identify operational gaps proactively, investigate issues at their root cause, and continuously improve the reliability and effectiveness of the sales technology stack.
Partner closely with sales leadership and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical systems, integrations, workflows, and reporting solutions.
 Requirements

title: Head of Customer Success & Onboarding
description:
Purpose of role: The Head of Customer Onboarding & Success will lead the onboarding of new customers onto the Ezora financial control and analytics solution and to ensure that existing customers continue to receive the full benefits of the Ezora service. This is a remote working role, based in Ireland, with occasional travel to company events or meetings.
 Please note applications must apply via this link: https://ezora.hirehive.com/head-of-customer-onboarding-success-dublin-ezekma
 About Ezora 
Ezora is a scaling Irish SaaS company that has built an innovative financial control and analytics platform. As part of our solution, we integrate with a number of systems from some of the largest brands in the Food & Beverage and Retail sectors, including McDonald's, Burger King, KFC, Starbucks, Costa, and M&S.
The Ezora platform ingests, validates, and reconciles operational and financial data into a single verified source of truth, automating up to 95% of customers' monthly accounting entries. Coupled with that, our analytics layer provides bespoke metrics, visualisations and reports that key decision-makers in these brands use to run their companies on a daily basis.
On top of this verified data, Ezora also enables AI-powered analysis, letting customers connect their own data securely to a leading AI model and interrogate their numbers in plain language, with the model reasoning only over data that has already been validated and reconciled.
 Why this role exists 
Ezora is growing its customer base of QSR and retail franchise operators, and our ability to deliver new implementations and manage existing client relationships needs to scale with it. As we grow, we need a dedicated owner for client communication and project coordination, someone who can give every project a single, consistent owner from kickoff through to go-live and beyond.
You'll become the day-to-day owner of every customer implementation and project at Ezora - the person who knows what's happening, when, and why, across every live engagement. You'll be the connective tissue between our customers, our CEO, our delivery teams, and any third parties involved, making sure nothing falls through the cracks and every customer feels looked after.
This is a foundational hire for Ezora. Done well, it directly improves how fast we get paid for the work we've sold, how happy our customers are, and how much founder time is freed up for growth.
 What you'll do In your first 6 months, the priority is delivery and communication
Own the project plan for every new customer implementation: timelines, milestones, deliverables, resourcing, and dependencies.
Be the primary point of contact for customers during implementation and ongoing delivery.
Track every open project in the business at any given time, and be able to answer "what's the status of X" without needing to ask anyone else.
Coordinate everyone involved in getting a project over the line - the customer, third parties, our internal business teams, and our tech team.
Work closely with the leads of our data, analytics, and finance functions to plan and sequence delivery work realistically.
Identify and flag risk early: projects stalling, unclear scope, missing information, or customers going quiet.
Build and maintain a simple, reliable way for the leadership team to see project status across the whole book at a glance.
As you settle into the role, this expands into customer success
Take ownership of customer success for key accounts: proactively checking in, understanding how customers are using Ezora, and spotting risk or opportunity before it becomes urgent.
Build relationships with customer stakeholders beyond the implementation team, so Ezora has more than one point of contact within each account.
Represent the voice of the customer internally - feeding insight back into product, delivery process, and how we sell.
Help define what "customer success" looks like at Ezora as we grow: what we measure, how we check in, and how we catch problems before they become churn.
 What we're looking for 
Industry background. You've worked in or closely with QSR, hospitality, retail, or franchise operations - you understand the operational and financial pressures our customers face, and you can speak their language from day one.
Empathy and customer instinct. You can genuinely see things from the customer's point of view, even when it's inconvenient for us. You advocate for the customer and ensure they get what they need.
Excellent communication. You can talk to a franchise operator, a finance team, and a developer in the same week and be clearly understood by all three. You write clearly, you don't let things go unsaid, and you're comfortable delivering difficult updates as well as good news.
Highly organised. You naturally track multiple moving parts without dropping any of them. You bring structure and visibility to things that are currently informal.
Financial literacy, financial systems & data systems. You have a strong understanding of financial systems, restaurant or retail systems and strong reporting and analytical skills.
A track record of delivery. You've run projects that involved coordinating multiple groups - internal teams, customers, third parties - to hit a deadline or outcome. You know how to build a realistic plan and hold people (including yourself) to it.
Seniority and scope. You've operated at a senior level before - leading a delivery, project management, or client services function, not just contributing to one. You're comfortable owning outcomes across a whole portfolio of projects and pushing back when priorities or resourcing don't add up.
Comfortable with ambiguity early on. This role doesn't have a well-worn playbook at Ezora yet. You'll help build the process as well as run it.
No specific qualifications are required. We care much more about relevant experience and evidence of the traits above than about formal credentials. Project management certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum) are a plus but not a requirement.
 What success looks like 
Every open project has a clear plan, owner, and status that anyone on the leadership team can check at any time.
Closed contracts move to live/billing faster and more predictably, with far fewer projects stalling for reasons within our control.
Customers feel they have a consistent, reliable relationship with Ezora - someone who knows their context and follows through.
Over time, you own a clear view of customer health across our key accounts, and can speak confidently to how happy each of them is with Ezora.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (London Hybrid or US Remote)
description:
About Us
 Climate Impact Partners is the trusted partner for organizations taking ambitious climate action. Since 1997, we’ve helped leading businesses reduce or remove more than 151 million tonnes of CO₂e, turning climate ambition into measurable results.
We deliver high-quality carbon market solutions: developing and financing impactful projects, managing carbon credit and energy attribute certificate portfolios, and helping companies put a price on carbon to drive change.
By connecting corporates, governments, innovators, and project partners, we accelerate investment in climate solutions that deliver verified impact and advance progress toward net-zero goals.
 What Sets Us Apart
 Boundless, urgent ambition. We are accountable, relentless, resilient.
 Courage to innovate. We are courageous, creative, curious.
 Integrity without compromise. We are trustworthy, credible, committed.
 Empowered to serve. We are respectful, inclusive, collaborative.
 THE ROLE
 We are seeking a Revenue Operations Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team.
In this role, you will support the analysis and improvement of our sales and marketing funnel—bringing structure, visibility, and insights to our GTM reporting. You’ll collaborate closely with sales, finance, digital, and leadership teams to understand performance drivers, help spot where performance is slipping, and make sure revenue-generating teams have accurate data to operate effectively.
We are looking for a strong analyst first. You will bring the technical craft; we will teach you the commercial context of the carbon markets we operate in.
You will work closely with the Revenue Operations Associate Director, who sets direction for the function and will coach you through the work. This is a role built for someone early in their revenue operations career, with clear scope to take on broader ownership as you grow.
 Responsibilities
 Sales Funnel Analytics
Analyze performance across the full GTM funnel—from lead generation through deal close and revenue recognition—to surface insights and conversion trends.
Track and optimize key metrics (e.g., lead-to-opportunity rate, opportunity-to-close rate, sales cycle length, pipeline velocity).
Build and maintain dashboards and reports (e.g., in Salesforce, Excel, Power BI, web-based reports) to support visibility and decision-making.
Provide weekly/monthly reporting on KPIs, pipeline health, sales productivity, and attainment against targets.
Segment performance by rep, region, and product to uncover opportunities for coaching or reallocation.
Support sales leadership in pipeline hygiene efforts to ensure accuracy and forecasting confidence.
Track new business vs. expansion funnels so the team can see where to focus effort.
 Process & System Optimization
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or inefficiencies in data and work cross-functionally to resolve them.
Partner with sales leadership to streamline processes for lead handoffs, opportunity stages, and pipeline tracking.
Support implementation of sales methodologies and keep CRM workflows aligned to agreed sales processes.
Partner with Enablement to identify performance gaps and inform training priorities using data.
Participate in GTM retrospectives to assess what’s working and where pivots are needed.
Collaborate with RevOps, Finance and Digital to ensure data cleanliness, CRM alignment, and accurate forecasting inputs.
Suggest automation that reduces manual data entry and saves the sales team time.
Use AI tools (including Claude and Claude Code) to accelerate analysis, reporting, and documentation — partnering with the Digital team, who own our AI tooling and core platforms (Salesforce, D365, Business Central), and following agreed governance and workflows.
 Strategic Planning & Forecasting Support
Prepare the data and analysis that feeds quarterly business reviews and go-to-market planning.
Analyze historical trends to inform future revenue and funnel performance projections.
Work with sales leadership to understand rep performance drivers, ramp timelines, and capacity planning needs.
Pull and prepare the historical conversion data used in territory planning and quota setting.
Flag early when pipeline coverage, conversion trends or sales velocity drift from plan.
Work with FP&A on the inputs behind revenue forecasts and financial reporting cadences.
 What We Are Looking For
 Experience and Skills
1–3 years in a GTM analytics, sales/marketing operations, or RevOps role — or a strong analytical grounding in another field and the appetite to move into RevOps
Strong in Excel or Google Sheets — able to clean messy data and build an analysis from scratch, not just maintain someone else’s
A builder: you have built reports or dashboards yourself in a BI tool such as Power BI, Looker or Tableau
Hands-on with a CRM (Salesforce or similar) and with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to speed up analysis and build
Digs for the root cause rather than reporting the symptom, and brings a proposed solution alongside the problem
Able to write up what you found clearly enough for a non-technical reader to act on it
 What We’ll Coach You On
Judgment on which questions matter most commercially, and where your time is best spent
Presenting to senior leaders in the terms they care about — leading with the decision, not the method
Working in the open with sales, finance and digital — testing your thinking with them rather than analyzing in a bubble
How our B2B funnel, KPIs and carbon-market commercial model actually work
 Personal Attributes
Organized and self-directed — able to juggle several priorities and hit deadlines without being chased.
Keen to learn, with an appetite for feedback — you will get direct coaching from the Revenue Operations Associate Director and broad exposure to how a commercial team runs.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager
description:
About Us 
NALA is building Payments for the Next Billion. Faster, smarter, and fairer transfers for everyone. Since 2022, we've grown our business 120x, grown the team from 9 to 150+, raised $50M+ from top-tier investors, and were named to the Forbes Fintech 50 in 2025.
We operate two core products:
 NALA , our consumer app making cross-border payments cheaper, faster and more reliable for the global diaspora. Allowing users to send money from the UK, US and EU to Africa and Asia.
 Rafiki , our B2B payments infrastructure, is powering global payments.
Our team includes alumni from Wise, Stripe, Monzo, Revolut, and CashApp — operators who’ve scaled world-class products. We act with urgency, think deeply, and put our customers first always.
At NALA, this isn’t just a job. It’s ownership, impact, and the chance to change global payments forever.
Join us in building Payments for the Next Billion
 Your Mission
Global Ops is where NALA's ambitions meet reality. Every new market we open, every licence we win, every account we go live with — someone has to actually land it, across a dozen teams, on a deadline that doesn't move.
That's this role. You'll be the person we hand NALA's hardest cross-functional bets to: getting our EU licence over the line, taking Rafiki virtual accounts live across the UK and EU, and rebuilding how cash moves through the business. You'll sit in London, work across Product, Compliance, Finance, Treasury and our entity ops teams in Nairobi and India, and you'll be measured on whether the thing shipped — not on how good the deck was.
This is a special-projects seat, not a project-management seat. If the interesting part of a project for you is the slide pack rather than the unblocking, this isn't your role.
 Your Responsibilities in this Role
 Own NALA's highest-stakes cross-functional programmes end to end: EU licensing, Rafiki virtual accounts going live in the UK and EU, stablecoin rails, from problem definition through to the thing actually being live.
 Drive the EU licence application to completion, coordinating Compliance, Legal, Finance and our EU entity, and holding the timeline when a dozen other priorities pull at it.
 Rebuild how we manage cash across entities and corridors, diagnose where money is trapped, design a better structure, and get Finance and Treasury to adopt it.
 Tighten the entity ops structure: Across Nairobi and India, clearer ownership, fewer handoffs, processes that survive the next 2x of volume.
 Decide what we work on next, pressure-test the portfolio of ops projects, force-rank by impact, and kill the ones that aren't earning their place.
 Get to root cause: Use data (you'll be writing your own SQL) to find why a process is breaking rather than papering over the symptom.
 Make senior stakeholders move: Most of your stakeholders are in London and senior; a large part of the job is landing alignment without authority.
 Leave the process behind you: Every project should end with an owner, a runbook and a metric, not with you still holding it.
 What this role is not
 It isn't a strategy seat. You will build the plan, and then you will be the one chasing the last five things that stop it shipping. Roughly 70% execution, 30% strategy and the 70% is the point.
 It isn't a PMO seat either. We're not looking for someone to move cards across a board and chase status. You're expected to have a view, argue it, and own the outcome.
 It's ambiguous by design. You'll be handed problems that nobody has scoped yet, in a business that changes shape every quarter. If you need a clean brief to start, you'll find this hard.
 Alignment is part of the job, not a blocker to it. Getting Compliance, Finance and Product to a shared answer is the work. "They wouldn't move" isn't an outcome.
 Must-have requirementsExperience
 2–3+ years in a high-calibre, fast-paced problem-solving environment, top-tier strategy consulting (MBB), top-tier IB, or a founder's-associate / strategy & ops seat at a high-growth startup.
 Crucially, time inside an operating company, not just advising one. We're looking for consultant-grade structure paired with a genuine bias to execution. Pure advisory backgrounds with no in-house delivery experience will struggle here.
A track record of owning complex projects end to end, with outcomes you can point to shipped, live, measurably better.
Knowledge
Strong commercial and operational judgement in a regulated or otherwise complex environment, financial services, payments, compliance-heavy industries, or similar. You understand why the constraints exist.
Working understanding of how a cross-border payments or financial operation actually runs: flows, counterparties, reconciliation, risk.
Skills
 SQL — this is a must. You pull your own data, build your own view of the problem, and don't wait on an analyst to tell you what's happening.
 Structured problem-solving. You can take something vague and large ("our cash management is inefficient") and break it into a sequence of answerable questions with owners and dates.
 Cross-functional programme leadership. You can run a programme spanning Compliance, Product, Finance and an offshore ops team, and keep all of them moving without formal authority over any of them.
 Root-cause thinking. You're the person who asks "why" a fourth time when everyone else has settled for the first answer.
 Clear written communication. Short docs that make a decision easy, not decks that defer one.
 Nice to have requirements
Python or R alongside SQL — useful, not essential.
Direct exposure to licensing or regulatory applications (EMI, PI, or equivalent) in the UK or EU.
Experience with crypto or stablecoin rails, or an informed view on where they fit in cross-border payments.
Treasury, cash management or FX operations exposure.
Experience working with teams across multiple geographies and time zones — particularly Africa or Asia.
✅ Success in the role looks like3-Month Metrics
 Owning the EU licence programme end to end — you've taken the plan off your manager's plate, know every open item and blocker, and the application is measurably closer to submission than the day you joined.
 A credible read on the ops portfolio — you've mapped what's live, force-ranked it, and can defend what we should stop doing.
 Trusted by senior stakeholders — Compliance, Finance and Product come to you with problems rather than waiting to be chased.
6-Month Metrics
 Rafiki virtual accounts live in the UK and EU, with you having led the cross-functional path to get there.
 The EU licence secured or in final-stage review , with a clear, owned path to the finish line.
 Cash management materially improved — a documented, adopted structure with named owners, and a measurable reduction in trapped or idle cash.
 The entity ops structure clarified across Nairobi and India, running without you needing to be in the middle of it.
➡️ Interview Process
You will need to first submit your application through our ATS, Workable. There is no need to submit a cover letter.
If successful, you'll be invited into our interview process:
 [45 mins] Talent Screen — Talent Team 
We'll get to know you, your motivations and your track record, and cover the practical basics of the role. Best preparation: know why you applied, and be ready to talk through what you've actually owned.
 [45 mins] Hiring Manager Interview — Head of Global Ops 
A deep dive on your project experience: the impact you've had, how you've solved problems across functions, and how you operate in busy, resource-constrained environments. Best preparation: know your own CV cold, and bring specifics.
 [Case Study] Live problem-solve + discussion 
A realistic NALA operations problem, worked through live with the hiring team. We're assessing structure, judgement and how you handle being pushed — not whether you memorised a framework.
 [45 mins] Bar Raiser — Benjamin Fernandes, CEO 
Track record, ambition and cultural fit — and your chance to hear the NALA story from the top and ask anything you like.
We'll then take references and come back to you with a decision.

title: Sales Compensation Design Lead

Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About The Team
 The Sales Compensation team at Stripe is responsible for the overall compensation strategy, design, and payment administration for the global sales organization. We ensure that our objectives align with the compensation program and that our sales teams are paid accurately and on time. We provide thought leadership for the go-to-market initiatives so that performance and compensation are effectively correlated. The Sales Compensation team partners closely with the revenue-generating and support functions across Stripe to support the success of our sales efforts.
What you'll do
You're a key contributor to the sales compensation program design, implementation, and performance assessment of the sales organization. You'll have high visibility across multiple channels, owning the performance-to-compensation structure for specific sales teams and serving as the subject matter expert for strategic advice and implementation of any compensation programs (including SPIFFs and MBOs) that further align the sales focus with our OKRs.
You're passionate about sales compensation and comfortable working in ambiguous situations to identify optimal solutions for our sales teams to succeed. You have experience working across all levels and functions of an organization (preferably in a high-growth environment) to align our priorities with our sales team's motivation. You bring resilience and the ability to both partner and lead in cross-functional situations. You use analytics and quantitative data to support and evaluate decisions.
 Responsibilities
Lead the annual sales compensation plan design cycle for specific sales teams, including obtaining input and stakeholder approval for the proposed compensation structures
Implement metrics for the plans that are specific, measurable, and align with company priorities
Own the rollout and enablement of the compensation plans

Propose, evaluate, design, and measure the effectiveness of SPIFFs
Be the main contact for sales leadership to correlate objectives and compensation
Own, update, and lead the enablement of the sales compensation resources for the sales organization
Own, update, and lead the enablement of the annual sales credit policies for the sales organization
Represent the sales compensation impacts in company strategy discussions (e.g., with Product)
Have an in-depth understanding of the sales function, product priorities, and individual sales team characteristics
Support the commission calculation close process as needed
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum Requirements
BS or BA in Business, Finance, Economics, Math, or Statistics
At least five years of experience in a sales compensation role
At least two years as a key point of contact with senior Sales, Finance, and HR leadership
At least three years leading the sales compensation design process
Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) (e.g., Salesforce) and Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) (e.g., Captivate IQ, Varicent, Xactly) tools
Experience with reporting tools and Tableau
Strong logic, problem-solving, and Excel modeling skills
Very organized and attentive to detail, with excellent prioritization skills that allow you to consistently deliver quality results on time
Experience working in high-growth, performance-focused environments and administering complex programs
Ability to forge strong bonds, work collaboratively with, and influence internal partners such as other Sales channels, Finance, and Business Applications
 Preferred Qualifications
Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance impact and productivity
Experience in Sales or Sales Operations roles
SQL programming experience

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €96,500 - €144,700. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. description:
Revenue Operations Analyst - Americas
 Hiring Manager: Matt Leman
 Location: Hybrid working model out of Montreal, Canada. 2 days a week in office.
Reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations for the Americas, you will support the development of and drive the implementation of regional revenue growth and go-to-market initiatives, as well as long-range strategic plans for our Enterprise business.
 Key Responsibilities
Support the analysis of Commercial Performance: Lead deep-dive analysis of revenue, customer, and sales performance data to uncover trends, diagnose issues, and generate strategic insights for leadership decision-making
Develop materials and business cases that drive Strategic Growth Initiatives to accelerate revenue growth and increase transacting customers across key segments and markets
Develop presentations and materials for senior leadership to effectively convey the team's initiatives
Market & Competitor Analysis: monitor and report on the FinTech ecosystem, tracking competitor pricing motions, market trends, and shifts in card network (Visa/Mastercard etc) and alternative payment method (APM) costs

Partner with global Pricing team to design, implement, and iterate on pricing strategies for our core payment gateway, acquiring services, and SaaS products. Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to translate complex information into clear, audience-appropriate messages
Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across teams

Ability to work independently to strict timelines while collaborating effectively with a diverse team of professionals
Experience working in a global or multi-regional environment is preferred
Professional fluency in English required

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Channel Programs (Hybrid)
description:
About Us:
 A global SaaS leader for seamless digital document workflows, Nitro offers a suite of solutions for PDF, eSigning, identity verification and analytics supported by a best-in-class customer success and change management team. With more than 3 million licensed users and 13,000+ business customers across 157 countries, we serve 67% of the Fortune 500.
 How We Work:
 We aim to create an environment where talented individuals are empowered to excel. How we collaborate, innovate, and engage with one another is important to us. Our work is driven by 5 key principles:
One team, One mission Our collective dedication to Nitro's mission defines us. Together, we are building an environment where everyone feels like a valued part of something bigger than themselves.
Own it We take full ownership of our actions and decisions. We empower one another to lead with confidence, creativity, and a solutions-focused mindset.
Accountable to our customers We are dedicated to our customers and take our commitments seriously. We do what we say we are going to do.
Excellence in execution Driven by passion and precision, we exemplify excellence in our delivery with innovative, top-quality results.
Be bold, fail fast, learn faster We learn as we grow, dare to try, and bravely question. We are not chasing perfection but forever iterating towards it.
These guiding values shape our approach to work, fostering a culture where everyone is inspired to contribute their best.
 The Role
 Nitro is investing in its Revenue Operations function and needs a technically strong systems builder to own the Salesforce infrastructure that powers our go-to-market motion. This role sits inside RevOps and is primarily responsible for the configuration, automation, and integrity of our Salesforce instance with an immediate focus on the systems and workflows that support our channel and partner business.
You will personally build and maintain flows, automations, and reporting across the GTM stack. While the partnerships motion is the primary domain you will support day-to-day, this role is a RevOps systems role first and will naturally extend into broader areas of the GTM system as the function grows. This is a hands-on build role. You will be in Salesforce every day building, not directing others to do it.
 What You Will Do
 Salesforce Build & Administration
Own and personally execute Salesforce configuration across the GTM stack: flows, automations, assignment rules, approval processes, page layouts, record types, and dynamic layouts
Design and build scalable workflows, maintaining clean system architecture and clear documentation throughout
Manage data quality across the instance; deduplication, enrichment standards, validation rules, and field governance
Maintain CPQ configuration as it relates to deal structures, pricing rules, and quote generation
Own Salesforce documentation: build guides, flow documentation, change logs, and admin playbooks
Support governance, release management, health checks, and security reviews for the Salesforce instance
Serve as the primary Salesforce subject matter expert for RevOps and the internal teams that depend on it
 Partnerships & Channel Systems
Apply your Salesforce expertise to the channel and partner motion, building and maintaining deal registration workflows, partner tiering logic, opportunity routing, partner attribution logic, and partner-facing CRM processes
Own day-to-day administration of the partner tech stack, Salesforce, Allbound (partner portal), and Pax8-related workflows
Operationalise partner programme components inside Salesforce: deal registration, onboarding workflows, partner tiering, incumbency protection, and partner lifecycle tracking
Build and maintain dashboards covering partner pipeline, partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, deal registration activity, and programme performance
Identify and resolve system friction that slows partner activity, causes misrouting, or reduces adoption
Use AI and automation tools to reduce manual effort across partner operations: intake, enrichment, routing, reporting, and field notifications
 What We Are Looking For
5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a closely related function in B2B SaaS
Deep, hands-on Salesforce Administration experience is required. You must be able to personally build flows, configure automations, manage data, and own the system architecture
Salesforce Admin Certification strongly preferred; CPQ experience a plus
Familiarity with how SaaS partnerships work in practice. Channel motions, partner-led pipeline, and deal registration is useful context for this role, though not a hard requirement
Experience with partner portals, channel systems, or partner programme operations a plus
Familiarity with tools such as Allbound, Pax8, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Groove, or Clari is a plus
Analytical, process-oriented, and documentation-driven. Comfortable operating across both tactical build work and cross-functional programme coordination
AI-fluent and automation-minded in practice, not just in principle
 Success in This Role Looks Like
At 30 days: Clear picture of the current Salesforce configuration, highest-priority gaps identified, hands-on remediation underway
At 90 days: Deal registration workflows, partner account management, and attribution logic are cleaner and better documented. Partnerships team has a reliable system resource.
At 6 months: Leadership has trusted reporting on channel performance. Partner onboarding is faster. Routing and attribution are reliable. Manual workarounds have been replaced with documented, automated processes.
 Why Nitro? 
 Along With Our Regular Benefits And Programs (including Health, Dental, Vision, And Retirement As Standard), We Are Also Very Proud To Offer a Few Additional Initiatives To Future Nitronauts:
 Flex Time Off
 Work-life balance is important at Nitro, and we understand that there are events that we cannot plan for. We are proud to offer Flex Time Off to be used for holidays, spending days with your family, or appointments.
 Hybrid Work
 Our team embraces the hybrid work model, appreciating its blend of flexibility and structure. We combine three days of in-person collaboration at our global offices in Toronto, Dublin, Antwerp, Porto, and Melbourne with the convenience of two days of remote work each week.
 Benefits:
 Nitro provides all employees with a comprehensive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, and wellness perks. We also offer pension/401k matching, along with many other country-specific benefits.
 Nitro strongly encourages applications from everyone regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. We provide an accessible candidate experience and invite you to request any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond.
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Nitro will process your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.
 Expected Salary Range:
 Circa 140k - 170k CAD
 AI Disclosure:
 Artificial intelligence is not used in Nitro’s recruitment process to screen CVs, assess candidates, or make selection decisions.
 Real Vacancy:
 This role is a current, active vacancy.

title: Head of Revenue & Commercial Operations
description:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 200 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology.
 The Opportunity
 As our Head of Revenue & Commercial Operations , you will build the commercial operating engine that enables ANYbotics to scale.
Working directly with our CRO and closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance and Operations, you will create the processes, insights and operating rhythms that help us make better commercial decisions and execute consistently across regions.
This is a broad and highly hands-on role. You will own areas including forecasting, pipeline management, sales process, CRM governance, commercial reporting and sales effectiveness, while helping translate our go-to-market strategy into practical execution.
You will join at an important point in our growth. Our commercial organisation is becoming larger, more international and more sophisticated, and we need to build the infrastructure around it accordingly. You will have the opportunity to shape that model rather than inherit a finished function, establishing strong foundations and building the Revenue & Commercial Operations capability around you over time.
This is not a pure strategy role. We are looking for someone who enjoys identifying what needs to improve, designing a practical solution and then getting close enough to the detail to make it happen.
 The Market & Our Technology
 ANYbotics transforms industrial environments in the energy, process, and utility sectors by introducing robotics to applications previously beyond reach. Our mobile robot, ANYmal, uses legs for extreme mobility in complex environments, camera- and LIDAR-based sensing for full autonomy, and AI for high-quality inspection results.
Our customers are some of the world’s largest asset operators and industrial companies. Their buying journeys are complex, often involving technical validation, business-value assessment, deployment planning and multiple stakeholders before expanding from an initial installation to larger fleets across sites and regions.
That creates a particularly interesting commercial operations challenge. Scaling ANYbotics requires connecting the traditional disciplines of Revenue Operations with the operational realities of selling, deploying and supporting a physical technology platform.
 About Us
 ANYbotics is a leading robotics company developing autonomous mobile robots for industrial inspection. Our technology enables customers to automate routine inspection work in environments that are complex, hazardous or difficult for people to access.
Headquartered in Zurich and with a growing international presence, we bring together more than 200 people from across the world spanning robotics, software, hardware, product, operations and commercial functions.
We are scaling quickly as industrial customers move from initial deployments towards broader adoption of autonomous inspection across their operations.
 Your Contributions
Build a trusted commercial forecast: Own and continuously improve sales and revenue forecasting, pipeline governance and visibility of risk, giving Sales leadership, Finance and the executive team a reliable view of performance. 
Create a scalable commercial operating model: Define and improve sales stages, opportunity standards, customer engagement processes and CRM discipline so teams operate consistently across regions. 
Establish a strong operating cadence: Build effective forecast and pipeline reviews, QBRs and commercial reporting for the CRO, leadership team and Board. 
Improve sales effectiveness: Partner with Sales leadership and Business Value Consulting to strengthen enterprise and value-based selling, enable new processes and improve commercial productivity. 
Turn GTM strategy into execution: Work with the CRO and regional leaders to translate commercial priorities into clear plans and measurable actions, connecting Sales closely with Marketing, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. 
Build the function: Initially operate as a hands-on owner of Revenue & Commercial Operations, then help shape and develop the capability around you, including Deal Desk / Commercial Sales Support. 
 Your Profile
Significant hands-on experience in Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, Sales Operations or GTM Strategy & Operations within a scaling B2B organisation. 
Strong experience owning forecasting, pipeline governance, CRM discipline and commercial reporting. 
A track record of building or materially improving commercial processes, with the project and change-management capability to take problems from diagnosis through to implementation. 
Strong commercial judgement and credibility as a partner to senior Sales leadership, with experience working across Marketing, Customer Success, Finance and Operations. 
Highly analytical and comfortable working across data and commercial systems. Our current environment includes HubSpot, Apollo and Clay, with SAP across Finance and Operations; exact platform experience is less important than strong systems fluency. 
Comfortable remaining highly hands-on, moving between strategic questions, stakeholder discussions, data, systems and detailed process work as needed. 
 Bonus Points
Experience supporting long, complex, high-value enterprise sales cycles. 
Experience in a hardware + software business where deployment, services, field operations or other physical-world complexity form part of the customer journey. 
Background in robotics, industrial automation, industrial AI, IoT, connected products or another technical B2B environment. 
Experience connecting commercial forecasts and booked business with production, delivery, revenue recognition or operational capacity. 
We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich.
 Agency Policy: We are not currently partnering with external search firms or recruitment agencies. Any profiles or resumes submitted to ANYbotics employees without a prior written agreement will be considered public disclosure and the property of ANYbotics, involving no liability or fee for subsequent hiring.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product
description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge.
At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.
We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.
By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.
We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference.
If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.
 Job Description
The GTM Lead - AI Optimization Product is responsible for driving the global go-to-market (GTM) success of IFS's Optimisation portfolio — Planning & Scheduling Optimization (PSO), Manufacturing Scheduling & Optimization (MSO), and the What-If Scenario Explorer (WISE). Acting as the commercial and proposition owner across these offerings, this role works across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to define the GTM strategy, build the proposition, and accelerate pipeline growth and strategic deal execution. 
This is a cross-portfolio role rather than a single-product sales role. AI is a collection of capabilities spanning machine learning through to agentic and frontier large language models, and the Optimisation portfolio completes that stack: PSO, MSO, and WISE apply machine learning to autonomous scheduling, planning, and predictive decisioning, increasingly integrated with agentic and frontier AI approaches to extend what customers can do with them. The AI Optimisation GTM Lead is responsible for defining the strategy and narrative that connects PSO, MSO, and WISE within this broader AI stack: how optimisation, scheduling, and predictive modeling combine to help customers make better decisions, faster, with less manual effort. The role owns the offering GTM plan, faces off directly to the product teams, and carries a number for the portfolio. 
Success in this role is measured through pipeline generation, proposition and GTM adoption, strategic deal influence, and overall commercial performance of the Optimisation portfolio. 
Key Responsibilities 
Portfolio Strategy & Proposition 
Own and execute the global GTM strategy for the Optimisation portfolio (PSO, MSO, WISE), ensuring alignment across Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partners.

title: Go-to-Market Operations Manager
description:
Job Title : Go-to-Market Operations Manager
 Department : Marketing
 Reporting to : Director of Go-to-Market Operations & Analytics
 Location: Remote
 Vacancy Status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.
Greenfield Global is looking for a Go-to-Market (G2M) Operations Manager to lead connected marketing and sales operations. This role will be a trusted partner to commercial leadership and a key decision maker in how Greenfield Global goes to market. The G2M Manager owns the technology, processes, and playbooks that make marketers and sellers successful in delivering results that help our customers meet their goals.
This role will help build a new function within a 35 year old company rich with history, culture and deep values. This role requires an individual who is comfortable in a startup environment, who is comfortable and excited about growing and driving change while playing a critical role in an exciting digital transformation.
 Who We Are
 Greenfield Global is a leading producer and supplier of high-value, mission-critical raw materials, ingredients, and additives that are vital to businesses and integral to a lower-carbon economy. From start-ups to the largest brands in the world, customers trust Greenfield’s extensive portfolio of premium products, regulatory expertise, and industry-leading service to improve people’s lives and the health of the planet.
We own and operate five distilleries, four specialty chemical manufacturing and packaging plants, and three next-generation biofuel and renewable energy R&D centers. This integrated model enhances supply chain transparency, quality control, custom formulation development, and ultimately customer satisfaction.
 Why Join Greenfield? 
 We innovate, collaborate, and work with purpose. By unlocking the potential of people, partnerships, and nature to accelerate sustainable solutions for the health of the planet, our work has a positive impact on the environment around the world. We’re always looking for people who can bring new talents and experience to our team.
 Who You Are
A credible partner to sales leadership: brings a clear point of view and the operating experience in D365 CE to back it, earning a seat in planning conversations rather than waiting for requests. 
Proactive by default: spots funnel and process problems early and brings solutions before they escalate.
A process builder at heart: brings discipline to documentation and enablement, leaving behind playbooks and standards clear enough that both new and tenured sellers rely on them.
Intellectually curious: understands business context before building, enjoys cross-functional partnership, and gains consensus.
A natural educator: leads with empathy, bringing clarity to complex analytics across technical and non-technical audiences.
 Your Experience Should Include
 Funnel Ownership
Experience designing pipeline stages, funnel definitions, and lead scoring directly with sellers, including ownership of a marketing-to-sales handoff (routing, scoring logic, and follow-up standards).
Campaign & Commercial Tooling
3-5 years in a sales/revenue operations role on a team running D365 Customer Engagement (CE) Sales, with working knowledge of its back-end architecture and customization capabilities
Experience with modern GTM and selling tools such as Salesloft, ZoomInfo, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and authoring sales process documentation that sellers actually use
Hands-on experience with the Power Platform (Dataverse, Power Automate, Power BI) and familiarity with Microsoft/D365 agentic AI capabilities for sales
Commercial Analytics Partnership
Experience defining pipeline and funnel metrics with finance and analytics teams, and understanding of how CRM stage data supports forecasting
Commercial Leadership Partnership
Experience translating company strategy and sales growth goals directly into operational execution across process, systems & fields, and definitions
Experience operating in dynamic or start-up environments, driving cross-department collaboration and change management across teams in transition
Proven experience partnering with and presenting to senior sales and marketing leadership
 Job Responsibilities
 Funnel Ownership
Own a single taxonomy connecting marketing campaigns to sales plays, so one naming and category structure carries from GTM strategy through to seller execution
Own lead scoring and routing models, including thresholds, criteria, assignment logic, and the follow-up standard sellers are held to
Own the sales funnel: work directly with sellers to define and maintain stage definitions, entry and exit criteria, and the conversion measures that describe how leads become orders
Campaign & Commercial Tooling
Design sales cadences and sequences that carry a connected campaign strategy from marketing through sales to revenue, so every GTM launch has a seller-ready play behind it
Partner with IT development and BSA teams to translate sales requirements into CRM process and field changes that drive growth and accuracy
Own sales process documentation and playbooks end-to-end, keeping them the current, usable reference for how sales operates
Continuously assess the marketing and sales tool stack for seller effectiveness; evaluate new tooling extending the foundational D365 toolset
Commercial Analytics Partnership
Partner with sales leadership, commercial analytics, finance, and data governance to define pipeline, funnel and sales activity metrics that measure realistically and accurately, and establish the always-on reporting sales leadership can rely on
Partner with finance leads to define pipeline confidence criteria and how stages map to forecast
Commercial Leadership Partnership
Act as a strategic, day-to-day partner to sales and marketing leadership on process, productivity, and go-to-market execution
Proactively surface funnel and process problems and keeping both teams aligned on active pipeline and initiatives
 Total Compensation & Care
Base salary dependent on experience and demonstrated performance - $120,000–$140,000
Formal and informal training opportunities 
Comprehensive health and dental benefits 
Income protection: short- and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, paid personal sick time 
Vacation time exceeding industry standards 
Company funded retirement savings program with individual contribution opportunities 
Meaningful and challenging work 
Curated intentional culture focused on growth and development, engagement, and communication 
 About Us
 We own and operate five distilleries, four specialty chemical manufacturing and packaging plants, and three next-generation biofuel and renewable energy R&D centers. This integrated model enhances supply chain transparency, quality control, custom formulation development, and ultimately customer satisfaction.
 Core Principles
Innovation: We are constantly seizing opportunities to develop new products, processes and methods to meet the diverse and demanding requirements of our customers. 
Collaboration: We are part catalyst, part collaborator. We work with partners to get the most out of our existing products, and to develop custom solutions for our customer requirements. 
Responsibility: Our commitment to give back to local communities in the US and Canada goes beyond the bottom line. We give back to the planet by processing renewable resources into low carbon fuels and chemicals. 
Agility: Our team is not only fast, we has the flexibility and creativity to pivot with customer needs to develop custom-made, on-time solutions. 
Discipline: At every plant, and for every customer, for every shipment, we put quality first. We operate a tight, transparent supply chain while meeting the highest regulatory standards. 
At Greenfield, people—not AI—make our hiring decisions. We use AI only for routine administrative support and never to screen candidates or determine outcomes. Every application is reviewed by our team, and if any step involves increased AI use, we’ll inform candidates in advance. We’re committed to responsible, transparent, and fair hiring practices.

title: Head of Sales Operations
description:

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
 WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US
 As Head of Sales Operations, you will play a pivotal role in enabling our global sales organization to operate efficiently, consistently, and with confidence. Supporting the full sales lifecycle, from lead management and deal execution to renewals and client administration, you will help create the operational foundation that allows our commercial teams to focus on delivering value to clients.
This is a highly visible leadership role within Commercial Operations, working across SimCorp, Axioma, Domos, and Sofia entities. Success in this role means creating scalable processes, improving data quality and transparency, and enabling better business decisions through reliable operational insights.
You will join a collaborative, international environment where your work directly contributes to predictable growth, client retention, and commercial excellence.
 WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
 In your daily work, you will collaborate with teams across Sales, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Commercial Operations to:
Lead and develop the global Sales Operations function, supporting the end-to-end sales process from lead qualification through contract renewal.
Establish and continuously improve scalable sales processes, ensuring data accuracy, operational excellence, and consistency across the organization.
Drive CRM governance and optimization, ensuring Salesforce remains a trusted source of truth for commercial activities and reporting.
Partner with commercial stakeholders to support efficient deal execution, contract administration, invoicing readiness, and renewal management.
Deliver reporting and operational insights that improve pipeline visibility, forecast reliability, and commercial decision-making.
Enable sales productivity through training, documentation, process guidance, and continuous operational support.

 Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:
10+ years of experience leading Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, or similar business support functions within a complex international organization.
Knowledge of CRM platforms, sales processes, and commercial data management, ideally including Salesforce.
Experience supporting contract management, deal administration, and collaboration across commercial, finance, and legal functions.
Ability to establish structure, improve processes, and maintain data quality across multiple stakeholders and business units.
Familiarity with client onboarding, commercial governance, or operational compliance activities.
Confidence working with senior stakeholders and translating operational insights into business improvements.

 Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, at SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. In addition to our traditional benefits package, we provide flexible working arrangements and a hybrid workplace model that supports work-life balance.
We are committed to supporting your professional growth through continuous learning opportunities, career development programs, and access to a global network of colleagues and experts. At SimCorp, there is never just one route for development, and we encourage our employees to shape careers that match their ambitions and interests.

 Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.  For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds. SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Sales Operations Manager
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Operations Manager based in Netherlands.
 As Sales Operations Manager, you will own the systems, data, tooling, and technical infrastructure that enable a high-performing sales organization to operate efficiently. You will ensure calls and messages reach prospects, leads are routed correctly, and sales reporting remains accurate and actionable. This is a hands-on operational role where you will configure platforms, troubleshoot deliverability issues, build routing logic, and improve integrations. You will work closely with sales leadership to turn commercial strategies into reliable systems and processes. The role combines sales operations, revenue operations, data, compliance, and technical problem-solving. Your work will directly influence sales productivity, lead conversion, customer reach, and the reliability of business decisions.
Accountabilities
Own phone and text deliverability by monitoring spam-flag rates, maintaining healthy numbers, managing local presence and branded calling, and overseeing A2P 10DLC registration and related requirements.
Troubleshoot call blocking, text delivery issues, number reputation, and other communication-channel problems, working directly with telecommunications and messaging vendors when needed.
Manage and configure sales systems and tooling, including dialers, power lists, CRM integrations, tracking systems, link structures, and UTM configurations.
Build and maintain lead-routing and distribution workflows, including speed-to-lead rules, follow-up cadences, no-answer logic, and automated lead assignment.
Own tracking and attribution across calls, links, subscriptions, and purchases, ensuring that conversion, pickup, connection, and revenue data can be measured reliably.
Maintain the underlying data and definitions behind sales dashboards, ensuring that pipeline reporting is accurate, consistent, and accessible to sales leadership.
Build and maintain testing infrastructure that allows commercial teams to run structured experiments with clean setup, controlled variables, reliable measurement, and documented results.
Implement technical compliance requirements across sales communication channels, including consent tracking, compliant opt-in flows, A2P registration, and subscription disclosures.
Identify operational gaps proactively, investigate issues at their root cause, and continuously improve the reliability and effectiveness of the sales technology stack.
Partner closely with sales leadership and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical systems, integrations, workflows, and reporting solutions.
 Requirements
You have 3+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, or a technical operations role supporting an inside sales or call-center environment.
You are comfortable configuring phone systems, dialers, CRMs, and sales technology directly rather than relying solely on technical support teams.
You have practical experience troubleshooting phone spam flagging, SMS blocking, deliverability problems, or similar communication-channel issues and can explain how you diagnosed and resolved them.
You are highly comfortable working with spreadsheets, operational data, reporting, and dashboards, with a strong focus on accuracy and trustworthy metrics.
You understand phone and messaging compliance concepts such as A2P 10DLC, consent management, deliverability, and branded calling, or can quickly develop expertise in these areas.
You have a strong attention to detail and naturally identify inconsistencies, incorrect data, broken workflows, or system issues before they create downstream problems.
You are analytical, hands-on, and comfortable investigating technical problems independently until you understand their underlying cause.
Experience in telehealth, supplements, weight management, subscription healthcare, or another subscription-based business is a plus.
Experience with dialer platforms such as Kixie, CallTools, or similar systems is valuable, as is experience with omnichannel tools such as Customer.io or SalesMSG.
Familiarity with CRMs such as Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, or similar platforms, as well as communications providers such as Twilio, First Orion, or Plivo, is beneficial.
Experience setting up A2P 10DLC registration or branded calling from the ground up is a strong advantage.
Basic scripting or SQL skills, along with comfort working with APIs and integrations, would be an additional advantage.
You communicate clearly, take ownership of operational problems, and are comfortable working independently in a fast-moving environment.
 Benefits
Full-time, remote working opportunity with flexibility around where you work.
High ownership over the systems, data, and technical infrastructure supporting a sales organization.
Hands-on exposure to sales technology, telecommunications, CRM platforms, automation, attribution, and deliverability.
Opportunity to directly improve sales productivity, lead conversion, communication reach, and data reliability.
Close collaboration with sales leadership and the ability to influence how commercial processes and systems are built.
Broad technical scope spanning dialers, messaging, integrations, tracking, reporting, compliance, and operational automation.
Opportunity to identify and solve high-impact operational problems with measurable business outcomes.
Potential to work with modern sales and communication platforms, APIs, and automation tools.
A role suited to someone who enjoys autonomy, technical problem-solving, and building reliable operational infrastructure.
