You will be the person reps come to when a quote is stuck, an opportunity needs fixing, or a deal has to close today.
This role suits someone who is genuinely hands-on, comfortable owning a region independently, and able to move quickly in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and deadlines are real.
What You'll Do
Field Sales Operations
Act as the primary sales operations contact for the EMEA field organization, fielding and resolving day-to-day requests from reps, managers, and regional leadership.
Own opportunity and pipeline hygiene for the region, ensuring data in Salesforce is accurate, complete, and current ahead of forecast calls and business reviews.
Support the weekly forecast process for EMEA, preparing reporting, flagging data gaps, and following up with reps and managers on inconsistencies.
Administer account and territory changes for the region, including ownership transfers, account moves, and territory assignment updates.

Build and maintain reporting and dashboards for EMEA sales leadership on pipeline, coverage, activity, and attainment.
Quoting & Deal Desk Support

Partner closely with Deal Desk on non-standard deal structures, discounting, multi-year terms, and approval requirements.
Manage deal approval workflows end to end, driving quotes through required approvals and unblocking stalled deals.
Support the reps through the full quote-to-order process, coordinating with Legal, Finance, and Order Management to keep deals moving to closure.
Serve as the first line of guidance for reps on pricing policy, discount thresholds, and deal structuring questions, escalating to Deal Desk where judgment is required.
Support end-of-quarter close, working extended and early hours as needed during peak periods to ensure deals are processed accurately and on time.
Process & Continuous Improvement
Identify recurring friction in the EMEA sales process and propose practical fixes, whether in process, enablement, or system configuration.
Document regional processes and maintain runbooks so support is consistent and not dependent on a single person.
Partner with the broader Revenue Operations, Systems, and Enablement teams on projects, testing, and rollout of new processes and tools to the EMEA field.
What You'll Bring
5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Field Operations, Deal Desk, or Revenue Operations at a B2B software or technology company.
Hands-on Salesforce experience, including opportunity management, reporting and dashboards, and comfort navigating and troubleshooting the sales process within the CRM.
Direct experience with quoting and the quote-to-cash process, including CPQ tooling and deal approval workflows.
Experience supporting a field sales organization directly, with a track record of being the go-to operational contact for sellers and sales managers.
Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for analysis, reporting, and ad hoc modeling.
Excellent written and verbal English communication, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders across geographies and seniority levels.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-paced environment with competing demands and tight, non-negotiable deadlines.
High attention to detail and strong ownership — you follow issues through to resolution rather than handing them off.
Willingness to work an early-start schedule that overlaps substantially with EMEA business hours, and to flex during quarter-end close.
Nice to Have
Experience supporting EMEA specifically, including familiarity with multi-currency deals, regional pricing, and EU contracting norms.
Exposure to SQL or BI tools (Sigma, Tableau, or Looker).
Practical fluency with AI assistants such as Claude to speed up analysis, reporting, and recurring operational work.
Experience with tools such as Xactly, Clari, LeanData, or DocuSign.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
Job DescriptionJob Description
In a multi-billion-dollar B2B distribution business, sales acceleration is more than a buzzword — it is a competitive advantage. The Sales Operations Specialist is a mission-critical role built for high-performing professionals who blend strategic thinking, operational precision, and commercial insight. You will operate across the entire sales ecosystem — from Outside Sales and Technical Specialists to Business Development and Own Brand teams — ensuring every seller is empowered to move faster, win more, and serve customers better.
This is not your typical behind-the-scenes support role. You will be an initiative-taking, data-informed force for growth — connecting the dots across Sales, Marketing, Category Management, Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, and Analytics. Whether it is untangling complex workflows, removing barriers, or bringing smart strategies to life, you will be the go-to execution partner for keeping the pipeline moving and the team on point.
At Bunzl, we thrive on digital execution, customer-first thinking, and operational excellence. If you are enthusiastic about sales enablement, obsessed with problem-solving, and excited to see the tangible impact of your work on revenue and customer success – this is your opportunity to lead from the center.
 Key Responsibilities 
As a Sales Acceleration Partner, you will function as the strategic operations backbone for the sales team — ensuring deals move faster, data is actionable, and sellers stay focused on customers. Your work spans five core areas:
 Sales Enablement & Deal Acceleration 
 You will fuel deal momentum through hands-on, tactical execution across the sales cycle 
Partner with selling teams to advance opportunities through the qualify to close selling process
Review CRM pipeline data to understand stage, deal size, and strategic fit
Join sales planning sessions to align on strategy, customer pain points, and key value drivers
Contribute insights from market research, competitive intel, and customer data
Request and manage product information, pricing exceptions, and vendor support
Build cost models and compile pricing packages for internal review and approval
Map customer journey touchpoints to spot friction, improve engagement, and drive conversion
Create polished, purpose-built sales materials for internal and external use
 Data Analysis & Customer Insights 
 You will turn raw data into actionable insights that support smarter selling: 
Analyze pipeline activity, and customer data to highlight risks and opportunities
Create and maintain customer organizational charts to support strategic account planning.
Develop dashboards, forecasts, and data summaries to provide stakeholders with clear, actionable data
Leverage reporting tools including Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms to support data-driven decision-making.
Connect insights across platforms to support personalized selling approaches
Submit new item usage and forecasts to the purchasing team
 Operational Support & Workflow Optimization 
 You will take charge of optimizing operational processes, ensuring deals stay on track and progress efficiently: 
Partner with Category and Supply Chain teams to source SKUs or initiate new item creation
Coordinate product sample requests and vendor bill-backs to manage costs and meet delivery timelines
Prepare pricing review packages and manage formal pricing submissions
Support Accounts Receivable by collecting missing customer information during New Customer setup and facilitating timely resolution of outstanding issues
Ensure part and price file accuracy to support quoting and order integrity
Track requests through completion and eliminate ambiguity in workflows
Identify inefficiencies and implement solutions to streamline execution
 Administrative & Commercial Support 
 You will ensure sales teams stay organized, compliant, and focused: 
Draft and review pricing agreements, contracts, and other commercial documents
Monitor open requests and deadlines, following up to ensure completion and accountability
Maintain organized, centralized records of customer interactions, agreements, and sales documentation
Establish customer rebate based on trade agreements in the system
Track and manage contract lifecycles — from initial request to execution and renewal
Ensure all documentation complies with internal policies, customer requirements, and audit standards
Prepare executive-ready summaries, approval decks, or sign-off packages to support deal closure
 Cross-Functional & Customer Collaboration 
 You will serve as a communication bridge and problem-solver across teams and with customers: 
Function as a key liaison between Sales, Marketing, Product, Customer Service, Accounts Receivable, Category Management, and Data teams.
Facilitate smooth internal handoffs and customer deliverables
Proactively step in to clarify requirements, resolve blockers, and preserve customer confidence
Escalate friction points and co-lead efforts to improve tools, processes, and execution
 Qualifications: 
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years in a sales operations, sales enablement, or business analysis role, preferably within a B2B environment. Experience in a distribution environment an asset.
Experience with Microsoft Office Applications: Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Power BI, CRM - Dynamics, and automation platforms are highly valued.
You see how tactical work connects to long-term business goals.
You are comfortable diving into data to uncover actionable insights.
Adapt your message to your audience — from field reps to senior leadership.
Approach complexity with curiosity and calm.
Ensure accuracy and follow-through in fast-paced, high-stakes work.
Prioritize value — for internal partners and external clients alike.
Build trust and make your teammates better through partnership
 Performance Metrics 
 Success in this role is measured by your ability to drive speed, clarity, and confidence across the sales process 
 Deal Velocity – Reducing time from opportunity creation to close
 Sales Support Effectiveness – Fast, accurate quote turnaround and internal stakeholder satisfaction
 Customer Impact – Positive feedback from customers and improved engagement outcomes
 Operational Excellence - Improved pipeline data quality, workflow efficiency, and process adoption

Een veiligere, slimmere wereld vormgeven door vertrouwen, samenwerking en gedurfde innovatie.

 Vacatureomschrijving
 IQSight B.V. is looking for an experienced and hands-on Sales Operations & Finance Manager EMEA to lead and further develop our Sales Operations organization across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
This is not a purely managerial position. The successful candidate will actively participate in daily operational activities while providing leadership, governance, and continuous improvement across the function. You will combine operational execution with team leadership, financial governance, process harmonization, and organizational development.
As Sales Operations & Finance Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for ensuring efficient order-to-cash processes, accounts receivable management, partner program administration, cost controlling, internal controls, and compliance activities across multiple countries. You will play a key role in harmonizing processes as we continue consolidating operations into our hubs in Eindhoven and Dubai.
The Sales Operations & Finance Manager reports directly to the Sales Controller based in Eindhoven.
 A Unique Opportunity to Build and Shape the Function
 This role offers a unique opportunity to build and further develop the Sales Operations organization at IQSight. Following a recent carve-out, IQSight now operates as an independent company, creating an exciting environment where processes, structures, and responsibilities are being redesigned to support future growth.
Historically, many operational activities were supported by a larger group structure with shared resources across multiple countries and functions. As part of the transition to an independent organization, a number of these resources are now becoming dedicated IQSight team members for the first time.
The Sales Operations team is still being formed. While team members are already in place across the region, responsibilities, processes, and ways of working differ significantly today. One of the key objectives of this role is to bring these activities together into a single, high-performing Sales Operations organization with clear ownership, standardized processes, strong controls, and a shared way of working.
As Sales Operations & Finance Manager EMEA, you will have the opportunity to shape the organization, define responsibilities, drive harmonization across countries, and build a scalable operating model that supports IQSight's future growth.
 Key Responsibilities
 Leadership & Continuous Improvement
Lead and develop the Sales Operations team across the EMEA region.
Define roles, responsibilities, and operating procedures as the team evolves.
Drive harmonization and standardization of processes, systems, pricing structures, and commercial conditions across countries.
Identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and operational excellence.
Support the ongoing integration and centralization of operations into the Eindhoven and Dubai hubs.
Foster collaboration between Sales, Finance, Shared Services, and regional stakeholders.
Act as a change leader during the transition from a shared-services model to a dedicated IQSight organization.
 Team Structure
 The Sales Operations organization currently consists of 7 team members (5.5 FTE) across the EMEA region. As part of IQSight's transformation into an independent company, these resources are being brought together into a dedicated Sales Operations organization under centralized leadership.
As Sales Operations & Finance Manager EMEA, you will be responsible for developing this organization into a cohesive, high-performing team with clear ownership, standardized processes, strong controls, and a shared way of working.
 Regional Finance & Business Support
Responsible for all Sales Operational tasks for the EMEA Region
Contact for our customers for any Finance related topics
Order release, credit limits
Maintain master data. Discounts, pricing, payment terms etc.
Serve as business partner for the EMEA region, supporting our sales teams with their daily operations and commercial activities within the region, in order to make them more efficient in the market.
Prepare and improve reporting to support the local team (e.g. Open orders, daily sales, customer performance, sell-out data) and act as business partner to utilize this data in the sales team.
Operational Excellence & Order-to-Cash
Support the shared service organization with analyses of blocked orders, particularly those related to customer credit limits.
Maintain customer credit limits and assess order releases based on customer payment behavior and outstanding receivables.
Monitor and follow up on overdue receivables and customer payment performance.
Track Accounts Receivable balances and collaborate with customers' finance departments to resolve payment issues.
Escalate collection matters when necessary and coordinate with Sales teams to support customer discussions.
Ensure the Sales Operations team serves as the first point of contact for customers on all finance-related operational matters, including payment inquiries, credit limits, account statements, invoice discrepancies, and other order-to-cash related topics.
Maintain master data, including pricing, discounts, payment terms, and customer conditions.
Ensure bonus accruals and rebate claimback provisions are accurately calculated and aligned with expected future payouts.
 Partner Program Management
Oversee the monthly partner claims process.
Review partner claims for accuracy and completeness before approval.
Ensure balance sheet accruals for partner incentives and rebates accurately reflect future payment obligations.
Maintain strong financial governance and control over all partner-related programs.
 Cost Controlling & Financial Governance
Review and validate incoming invoices across multiple countries.
Ensure costs are booked correctly and transferred appropriately to the Eindhoven hub through internal invoicing processes.
Monitor local entity cost allocations and verify accurate cost element assignments.
Review local bookings from HR and shared service functions and ensure necessary accruals are recorded where costs are incomplete.
Take final responsibility for VAT, tax filings, and related compliance activities, supported by the local Finance team.
Ensure financial records and operational reporting remain accurate and complete across the organization.
 Internal Controls & Compliance
Own the Sales Operations internal control framework.
Ensure controls are properly designed, executed, monitored, and continuously improved.
Provide oversight to team members responsible for day-to-day control execution.
Support audit activities and ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.

Several years of experience in Sales Operations, Finance Operations, Order-to-Cash, Business Operations, Controlling, or a similar function.
Previous experience leading and developing teams in an international environment.
Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable, credit management, accrual accounting, rebates, and financial controls.
Experience with VAT, tax compliance, and multi-country operational processes.
Experience leading organizational change, transformation projects, or shared-services transitions is highly desirable.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
A hands-on mentality and willingness to actively participate in operational activities.
Experience driving process improvement, standardization, and organizational development.
Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an advantage.

 Bij Keenfinity maak je deel uit van een wereldwijd team dat werkt aan betekenisvolle projecten die echt verschil maken. We bieden meer dan alleen een baan – we bieden een carrière met impact.

title: Regionaal Sales Operations Manager

• Je stuurt het Sales Operations / Customer Service team aan en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en opvolging.
• Je coacht medewerkers en ondersteunt hen bij complexe commerciële en operationele vraagstukken.
• Je optimaliseert commerciële processen, van aanvraag en offerte tot orderopvolging en levering.
• Je bewaakt marges, rendabiliteit en commerciële voorwaarden en grijpt in waar nodig.
• Je analyseert commerciële en operationele KPI's en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.
• Je stemt klantverwachtingen af op productiecapaciteit, planning en interne mogelijkheden.
• Je bewaakt een professionele dienstverlening voor internationale klanten en ondersteunt bij escalaties.
• Je werkt nauw samen met Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance en andere interne stakeholders.
• Je detecteert verbeterkansen en bouwt mee aan een schaalbare en efficiënte commerciële organisatie.
 Wie ben jij? 
• Je hebt ervaring binnen Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Customer Service Management of een gelijkaardige commerciële managementfunctie.
• Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring binnen een industriële of productieomgeving.
• Je begrijpt technische producten en productieprocessen en kan commerciële belangen verbinden met operationele realiteit.
• Je hebt een sterk analytisch inzicht en ervaring met margebeheer, rendabiliteit en KPI's .
• Ervaring binnen een internationale, exportgerichte organisatie is een belangrijke troef.
• Je bent een coachende leidinggevende die duidelijke beslissingen durft nemen.

✔ Een vaste functie binnen een stabiele en internationaal actieve onderneming.

title: Senior Manager, GTM Systems
description:
About Blue J
Blue J is the leading generative AI solution for tax professionals and one of Canada's fastest-growing AI companies. Headquartered in Toronto, we're a high-growth B2B SaaS company building industry-leading tax research software that helps accountants find accurate answers to complex tax questions with greater speed and confidence.
Backed by a $122M USD Series D funding round, we're scaling rapidly across North America and the UK while continuing to push the boundaries of what's possible with AI. By combining advanced technology with deep tax expertise, we empower tax professionals to work more efficiently, make better decisions, and deliver greater value to their clients.
A Note on Location
We’re excited to meet with qualified candidates and are grateful for everyone’s interest. This role is open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. While the position is remote, team members will be expected to travel to our Toronto office approximately once per quarter for in-person collaboration, planning, and team events. The role may also include occasional travel for industry events, trade shows, and conferences. Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States.
The Opportunity
As our Senior Manager, GTM Systems , you'll own the architecture, health, and roadmap of the systems that power Blue J's go-to-market engine across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success. You'll set the vision for our GTM technology stack, helping shape what we build, buy, or retire while ensuring the systems our teams rely on every day are stable, scalable, and well-configured.
You'll manage a small, growing team - a Senior GTM Systems Administrator and a contractor supporting ticketing and systems work - and partner closely with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Analytics, and GTM Enablement to prioritize the initiatives that will have the greatest impact.
This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on technical work. You'll define the long-term architecture and direction of our GTM systems while also contributing directly to system configuration and optimization as needed, particularly as the team and function continue to grow.
What You’ll be Doing
 Vision, Strategy & Architecture 
Own the long-term vision and architecture for Blue J's GTM technology stack, including Salesforce, CPQ, marketing automation, and adjacent systems.
Assess and evolve our GTM technology stack, identifying opportunities to optimize, modernize, or enhance our systems as the business grows.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate when to introduce new tools versus extending existing capabilities, balancing business needs, user experience, cost, complexity, and long-term sustainability.
 Systems & Tool Stack Ownership 
Ensure our GTM systems are reliable, well-configured, and seamlessly integrated with billing, the data warehouse, AI agents, and other business-critical systems.
Lead configuration management and the GTM systems project pipeline, partnering with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to prioritize initiatives based on business impact.
Oversee vendor relationships, renewals, and the GTM technology budget, helping ensure investments align with business priorities and long-term goals.
 Team Leadership & Ticket Operations 
Establish scalable processes and operating practices that enable the GTM Systems team to deliver high-quality support and strategic initiatives.
Ensure requests from Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success are triaged, prioritized, and resolved in alignment with agreed service levels.
Continuously improve the team's processes, tools, and operating model to support business growth and evolving organizational needs.
 AI Strategy for GTM 
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can enhance GTM workflows, surface actionable insights, and reduce manual systems work.
Collaborate with teams across the business to identify and implement AI capabilities within our GTM systems that improve the experience for prospects, customers, and internal users.
Monitor emerging trends and advancements in AI-enabled GTM technology, evaluate their potential impact, and provide recommendations that align with business priorities and long-term goals.
 Cross-Functional Partnership 
Partner closely with Revenue Operations and GTM stakeholders to understand business needs, gather feedback, and prioritize the GTM systems roadmap.
Provide guidance to GTM leaders on technology capabilities, implementation considerations, trade-offs, and investment decisions to support informed planning and execution.
What You Offer Blue J 
8+ years of experience in GTM Systems, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, or a related technical or systems-focused function.
3+ years of experience leading and developing a team within a systems, operations, technical, or related environment.
Experience working in a SaaS organization, with an understanding of how GTM systems interact with billing platforms, data warehouses, and AI-enabled technologies.
Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce; salesforce certification is considered an asset.
Experience with CPQ and marketing automation platforms, including integrating them with Salesforce and related GTM systems.
Experience evaluating and evolving an existing technology stack by identifying opportunities to optimize, modernize, or enhance systems in support of business goals.
Experience managing vendor relationships, renewals, and a SaaS technology budget.
Experience balancing strategic planning and systems architecture with hands-on configuration and implementation.
Strong collaboration, communication, and prioritization skills, with experience partnering across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Experience identifying opportunities to apply AI to improve internal GTM workflows and customer-facing experiences.
Comfortable leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to drive efficiency, improve workflows, and stay ahead of industry trends
 Nice to Have : 
Experience with Chargebee, Agency, DocuSign, Customer.io, Gong, Zendesk, or similar platforms.
What We Offer You 
A rare opportunity to shape the systems that power the revenue engine of a fast-growing, well-funded SaaS company.
A mission-driven culture where your work directly advances clarity, efficiency, and accessibility in tax research.
Competitive base salary, stock options, and benefits designed to support you and your family.
Flexibility in how you work: primarily remote, with occasional travel to our Toronto office as needed.
A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive team that values innovation, respect, and fun.
The excitement of a fast-growing, well-funded company with clear momentum, and the resources to back bold initiatives.
The Core Values that Define Our Culture
We are customer-focused
We put the team interest before self-interest
We are pleasant and playful
We are open to better ideas
We move fast and fix things
What to Expect in the Interview Process
We anticipate a high volume of applicants for this role and are excited to grow our team. A human will review each application and get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and look forward to connecting with you! 
 Interview Process 
Chat with Natalie, Sr. TA Manager
Meet Paul H. VP, GTM Strategy & Operations
45-minute deep dive with Paul 
Meet Justin, Director of Sales Operations 
Meet Jordan, Director of Marketing Operations 
Present your case study
Meet Ben, our CEO
We believe our strength is built on diversity of thought, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply. We value inclusiveness and are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
We strive to create an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know in your application. Our team is dedicated to providing the necessary support and making reasonable adjustments to ensure a smooth process for everyone.
How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process
To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Blue J uses AI-enabled tools within our applicant tracking system to help organize applications and highlight profiles that match the key requirements for each role.
 AI does not make hiring decisions. 
Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans.
We use these tools to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment and we’re committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.
Compensation
The base pay range for this role is $126,000 - $173,000 per year.
This is a Level 5 in Blue J’s career level framework. We use levels to define the expected scope, autonomy, impact, decision-making, and experience for each role. Final compensation will be set fairly and thoughtfully based on experience, expertise, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities. While all candidates are expected to bring directly relevant experience, the top of the range is typically reserved for individuals who demonstrate exceptional depth in the role’s core competencies, a strong track record of impact in similar environments, and the ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy from day one.

title: Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
About the Role 
Imagine this. You are the engine behind a Business Development team competing in one of the fastest-moving and most demanding industries in the world. As our Indoor Sales Coordinator, you will bring structure, preparation, and momentum to the Commercial team, keeping our sales funnel accurate, our Business Developers prepared, and our commercial activity moving forward.
You will own the coordination behind meetings, events, CRM activity, sales materials, and reporting. From making sure the right meetings happen at major industry events to giving our BDs the information they need before walking into a customer conversation, your work will directly influence how effectively we compete and win.
At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight systems designed for the demands of modern operations. We develop and deliver advanced interceptor and strike systems that combine speed, precision, autonomy, and efficiency. Working with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide, we are building next-generation technologies for mission-critical operations and redefining what is possible in defense aerospace.
 What You’ll Do 
 Sales Funnel & CRM Management 
Own the day-to-day management of our sales funnel in the CRM, keeping opportunities, stages, contacts, and next actions accurate and up to date
Keep CRM data clean and reliable, following up with BDs for updates, closing stale records, and making sure the funnel reflects commercial reality
Produce funnel and pipeline reports and proactively flag stalled, slipping, or at-risk opportunities
Maintain CRM views, pipelines, templates, and simple automations that make the sales process faster and more effective
 Event & Meeting Planning 
Plan and coordinate BD meetings around trade shows, conferences, customer visits, and industry events, creating efficient and well-organised itineraries
Maximise the impact of every event by pre-booking meetings with relevant contacts and making sure each engagement has a clear objective
Own the coordination behind invitations, confirmations, scheduling, calendars, and follow-ups so nothing gets lost along the way
Work ahead of the BD team, anticipating what needs to happen before, during, and after key commercial events
 BD Readiness & Sales Enablement 
Make sure our BDs arrive at every customer conversation fully prepared with current pitch decks, one-pagers, product information, and relevant commercial materials
Maintain a central and version-controlled library of sales materials and work with Marketing and Product to keep content accurate and current
Prepare concise briefing packs covering account background, key contacts, previous interactions, and meeting objectives
Help turn commercial information into practical tools that make our BD team more effective in the field
 Sales Data & Analytical Support 
Provide practical data and analytical support by pulling reports, creating simple dashboards, and tracking pipeline and activity metrics
Prepare account history, previous interactions, and relevant data before meetings and events to sharpen customer conversations
Support forecasting and management reporting with clean and reliable commercial data
Identify straightforward trends, gaps, and opportunities that help BDs understand where to focus their time
 Team Coordination & Administration 
Be the reliable internal point of contact for the BD team, keeping communication moving between field teams, the office, and supporting functions
Coordinate closely with Marketing, Product, and the wider Commercial organisation to keep sales activity connected
Take ownership of the commercial administration that keeps the sales engine running smoothly
Bring structure and follow-through to a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly
 Requirements 
 What You’ll Need 
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or a relevant vocational qualification combined with hands-on sales support experience
Around 2 to 4 years of experience in sales support, sales coordination, inside sales, commercial administration, or a comparable role
Experience working with CRM platforms and an interest in keeping commercial data accurate, structured, and useful
Strong organisational and coordination skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines
Confidence working with data, including a good working knowledge of Excel and basic reporting or BI tools
Strong communication skills and a proactive, service-minded approach to supporting a field-based sales team
Fluent English, with another European language considered an advantage
Eligibility to obtain or hold the required security clearance within an EU member state
 Who You Are 
You thrive when there are a lot of moving parts and you are the person bringing them together. You are organised, proactive, and dependable, and you take real satisfaction in helping others perform at their best.
You do not wait to be chased. You spot what is missing, follow through, and make sure the details are handled before they become problems. CRM data, schedules, briefing packs, sales materials, and event logistics are not just administration to you. They are what enable a commercial team to move faster and make better decisions.
You communicate clearly, enjoy working across different teams and cultures, and stay composed when priorities shift. Most importantly, you want your work to have an impact and you are excited by the challenge of helping Destinus compete and win in the global defense market.

title: Business Operations Senior Manager

Job Description
To take our mission to the next level, we are constantly applying for new licences and creating regulated subsidiary entities designed to serve international lives seamlessly. While our underlying operations and technology are delivered centrally via Wise Group, our regulated entities retain full entity-level responsibility and regulatory accountability for customer outcomes, operational resilience, and service quality. We are looking for a Business Operations Senior Manager to join a newly formed entity COO team. This is a critical, high-profile role responsible for supporting the establishment of our entity-level operational governance, operational resilience frameworks, and intra-group service oversight.
You will not be running daily execution or managing traditional hands-on delivery teams. Instead, your mission is to treat Wise Group as a material service provider, independently validating performance and data, and providing the structured, repeatable evidence that senior managers, our Board, and regulators require.
 Your Mission: 
 Intra-Group & Outsourcing Oversight: Implement and operationalise our intra-group outsourcing framework. Actively monitor, validate, and challenge the service levels (SLAs), KPIs, and customer outcomes delivered by Group functions (such as Customer Support, KYC, Financial Crime, and Payment Operations).
 Operational Resilience Framework: Support the design, mapping, and ongoing testing of Important Business Services (IBS) and impact tolerances, ensuring our regulated subsidiary meets regulatory expectations for end-to-end resilience.
 Incident Governance: Maintain a real-time, entity-level view of current major incidents and changes. Oversee severity classifications, look after customer impacts, and ensure the root causes are addressed via robust remediation tracking with Group providers.
 Regulatory & Board Readiness: Fulfill essential regulatory and governance requirements. Help draft clear, consistent, and audit-ready management information (MI), dashboard analytics, and evidence packs to support Board committees and senior executives.
 Change Oversight: Act as the operational gatekeeper and interface for change management when product launches, infrastructure developments, or process updates impact entity servicing, customer outcomes, or third-party risks.
 This Role Will Give You The Opportunity To: 
 Shape a U.K. Regulated Subsidiary: Play a critical role in a regulated entity's operating and oversight model.
 Choose Your Path to Impact: Work with radical levels of ownership and empowerment within an autonomous, collaborative FinTech environment.
 Gain Wide Exposure: Deal with the full breadth and depth of a global financial product, collaborating extensively across Product, Operations, Expansion, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Corporate Secretariat teams. This role would allow you to work across entities within the group and work closely with Senior Executives and the Board.
 What You'll Bring: 
 The Experience: You have a proven track record within financial services, banking, or scale-up fintech, specifically dealing with operating model design, risk frameworks, or supplier/service oversight.
 Control & Risk Mindset: You possess a strong analytical controls mindset. You look past surface-level narratives and use data to investigate root causes, track remediations, and validate data quality.
 Credible Challenger and Influencer: You are highly confident in your ability to constructively cross-examine and challenge large global delivery organisations to make sure entity commitments are honored. You are apt at managing stakeholders and building relationships to advocate for change.
 High Documentation Quality: You take pride in producing traceably accurate, clean, and professional documentation that is immediately ready for auditors and regulators.
 Get Stuff Done: You are an entrepreneurial self-starter. You are comfortable doing complex strategy design one day and rolling up your sleeves for manual validation or tracking tasks the next.
 Customer centricity: You’re passionate about helping customers. They are at the heart of what you do and that empathy drives your decisions.

Directive Consulting is the leading B2B performance marketing agency that delivers real revenue—not just leads.
We use Customer Generation (a marketing methodology developed by us) to cut through the noise. Forget MQLs—we’re here to drive pipeline, fuel SQLs, and scale brands that are serious about growth. From Paid Media and SEO to CRO, RevOps, and Go-To-Market Strategy, we build marketing engines that win in SaaS and across B2B industries.
We move fast. We think boldly. We are elite. We hire people who challenge the status quo and push campaigns past what’s expected - sparking demand for bold, innovative brands. If you live for performance, love solving hard problems, and want your work to actually mean something, you’ll fit right in.
But here’s the fun part—we don’t just deliver results; we’re shaping the future of marketing. Ready to build something that breaks the mold?
Internally this role is titled Associate Director, Revenue Operations*
 About The Role
 We’re looking for an Associate Director, Revenue Operations to help lead and scale Directive’s Revenue Operations practice. This is a senior, client-facing player-coach role for someone who combines strong people leadership with deep technical expertise across Salesforce, marketing automation, and HubSpot.
You’ll partner closely with the Director of Revenue Operations to lead a team of RevOps Strategists, oversee complex client engagements, and ensure we consistently deliver high-quality strategic and technical work. You’ll also remain hands-on, stepping into client environments to guide architecture, troubleshoot complex issues, conduct audits, and support implementations when deeper expertise is required.
The right person is equally comfortable leading a team, presenting recommendations to senior client stakeholders, and getting into the details of a Salesforce or marketing automation environment.
 What You’ll Do
Manage and mentor a team of Revenue Operations Solution Engineers, including workload management, prioritization, coaching, and performance support.
Serve as an escalation point for complex client and technical challenges.
Own or oversee strategic client relationships, ensuring strong communication, delivery quality, and client satisfaction.
Lead and support Salesforce, HubSpot, and marketing automation audits, implementations, integrations, and optimization projects.
Provide hands-on expertise across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Account Engagement/Pardot, and HubSpot Marketing Hub.
Design and advise on lifecycle architecture, lead management, routing, automation, CRM/MAP integrations, attribution, reporting, and data governance.
Translate complex technical findings into clear recommendations for executive and non-technical stakeholders.
Review strategist work for technical accuracy and strategic quality before client delivery.
Partner with Account Directors and internal leadership to identify expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Support scoping, solution design, and new business conversations for RevOps opportunities.
Help develop repeatable processes, documentation, playbooks, and technical standards as the Revenue Operations practice scales.
Maintain visibility into project health, capacity, utilization, and delivery risks across the team.
 What You’ll Bring
 Must Haves
5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, CRM consulting, Marketing Operations, Salesforce consulting, or a related discipline.
Meaningful experience working in an agency, consultancy, systems integrator, or professional services environment, supporting multiple client engagements.
1–2+ years of direct people management or formal team leadership experience, including coaching, prioritization, workload management, and quality oversight.
Active Salesforce Administrator Certification.
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, including administration, solution design, implementation, optimization, and troubleshooting.
Experience leading complex Salesforce or RevOps engagements such as implementations, audits, migrations, integrations, or optimization initiatives.
Hands-on experience with at least one marketing automation platform outside of Salesforce Sales Cloud, such as HubSpot Marketing Hub, Marketo, or Salesforce Account Engagement/Pardot. Formal certification in these platforms is not required.
Strong understanding of how CRM and marketing automation systems work together across lead lifecycle management, routing, automation, integrations, attribution, reporting, and data governance.
Demonstrated experience leading client discovery, diagnosing business and technical challenges, and translating findings into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Experience scoping consulting engagements, including defining deliverables, estimating effort, identifying assumptions and dependencies, and establishing clear scope boundaries.
Experience supporting new business, pitches, proposals, cross-sell, or account expansion opportunities.
Strong written and verbal communication with the executive presence to confidently manage client expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and make technical concepts understandable to non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to operate as a true player-coach, balancing team leadership with hands-on client and technical work.
 Preferred
Additional Salesforce certifications, particularly Sales Cloud Consultant or other relevant consulting credentials.
Salesforce Account Engagement/Pardot, HubSpot, or Marketo certifications.
Deeper hands-on experience across more than one marketing automation platform.
Experience working with B2B and SaaS organizations across Salesforce and marketing automation environments.
Experience managing multiple concurrent client engagements and competing priorities.
Experience owning or contributing to project economics, utilization, capacity planning, and delivery quality.
Experience helping build or scale a RevOps, Salesforce, or professional services practice.
 What We Offer
Compensation for this role includes a competitive base salary
🙏 Medical, dental, vision plans, disability, and life insurance coverage for you and your family that fit your lifestyle
Including a 100% employer-paid plan for you and a 50% employer contribution for your dependents (US, CAD, MX)
Benefits to Support the Whole Person:
🧠 Mental - Access to certified therapists through Spring Health, membership to Headspace
💪 Physical - Physical therapy through Omada, thousands of Aaptiv virtual workouts, complimentary One Medical membership for primary and virtual care
🛫 Time Off - Unlimited PTO (2-week minimum), Paid Company Holidays, Your Birthday Off, End of Year Recharge (Closed December 24 - January 1), Paid Parental Leave
💰 Financial - Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 3% company match
🌟 Bonus - Annual bonus based on tenure, which scales in total amount over time
🌴 Annual Company-wide Retreat 
 Work Environment Requirements
 As a remote-first company, you’ll have the ability to work from your home office. For some positions, as posted, we will accommodate global opportunities where we have established businesses, including Canada, Mexico, and the UK. For global locations, you must have established and current work authorization and permanently reside in that country.
This role has the opportunity to operate 100% virtually from your home office. We primarily collaborate with our colleagues through virtual meetings (Zoom), and Slack. In this role, you will be required to operate a laptop computer (PC or Mac available), computer software platforms, and other office productivity tools as necessary. Due to the nature of this role, you must be able to remain stationary for extended periods, must be able to observe and interpret written and/or verbal communication, must have reliable internet access, and a professional background.
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.
If you require reasonable accommodations in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, direct your inquiries to recruiting@directiveconsulting.com.
 Additional Information
 At Directive, one of our core values is People First. We’re committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture in the digital landscape. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Head of Customer Success
description:
🚀 Build the Customer Success Function Behind Our Next Stage of Growth 
 📍 London, Shoreditch | Hybrid 3 days per week in the office 
 👤 Reporting to our VP of Go-to-Market & Growth
 We have strong customer traction, proven value across some of the UK’s largest infrastructure organisations and a clear understanding of where we make the biggest impact.
Now, we want to go deeper.
 Our next stage of growth is focused on expanding the customers we already have. We’re seeing our largest accounts in the UK and US move towards enterprise-wide partnerships, and we want another 5–10 customers heading in the same direction over the next 12 months.
 That’s where you come in.
 We’re looking for a Head of Customer Success who can lead and develop our Customer Success function as we scale, raise the capability of the team and build the structure needed to make great enterprise customer management repeatable.
 You’ll still be close to our customers, owning a small number of strategic accounts and role-modelling what great looks like, but this is fundamentally a leadership role. You’ll be responsible for developing the team, improving performance and building a scalable Customer Success function that can support the next stage of Sensat’s growth.
 You will have commercial responsibility for the existing customer base, NRR and GRR.
🛠️ What you'll be doing
 Leading, Building and Developing the Function 
 Lead our Global Customer Success function, setting clear direction, expectations, creating accountability and r aising the standard of enterprise customer management across the team.
 Develop the capability of the function through regular coaching, feedback and clear performance expectations, helping people become stronger strategic and commercial customer partners.
 Coach the team through complex accounts, senior stakeholder relationships and commercial conversations, while role-modelling what great looks like through your own accounts.
 Build a scalable Customer Success ****function, putting the right structure, ways of working and operating rhythm in place to support Sensat as our customer base and ambitions grow in scale.
 Be the ‘voice of the customer’ and champion a Customer Centric culture within Sensat
 Growing our Enterprise Accounts 
 Own and grow a small portfolio of strategic customers, turning strong relationships into larger, enterprise-wide partnerships.
 Build trusted relationships with senior and C-level stakeholders, uncovering new use cases and expansion opportunities through strategic account planning and commercially meaningful QBRs.
 Help us focus on the right customers by tiering our portfolio and ensuring our highest-potential accounts receive the right level of partnership.
 Building How We Work 
 Build a clear understanding of the value Sensat is delivering within each strategic account and use that evidence to strengthen executive relationships, increase adoption and create credible expansion cases.
 Create practical playbooks and frameworks across account planning, QBRs, customer steering committees, adoption and expansion & introducing structure without unnecessary bureaucracy.
 Put the right metrics and visibility in place across customer value, account health, expansion pipeline and risk.
 Work closely with Product and the wider business to make sure customer insight is captured properly and used to inform decisions.
💭 You might be the kind of person we’re looking for if...
 You’ll probably bring: 
 Strong experience leading and developing a customer success or customer partnerships teams, improving performance, raising capability and creating accountability.
 Experience building or evolving a customer function, introducing the processes, frameworks and ways of working needed to support scale.
 A strong track record of managing, maintaining and growing complex, high-value enterprise B2B SaaS accounts, with evidence that you’ve expanded existing customers in ARR, not simply retained or supported them.
 Experience leading a customer-facing team, improving performance and holding people accountable while continuing to develop them.
 The ability to build useful processes and frameworks that people genuinely adopt.
 Confidence building C-level relationships and running strategic, commercially focused QBRs.
 A data-led approach, alongside the technical credibility to understand complex products and translate them into clear business value.
 Experience setting up, managing and using technologies such as Planhat, HubSpot or similar customer success and CRM platforms.
 It would be a bonus if you have experience: 
 Working within infrastructure, energy, utilities, construction or another complex industry.
 Supporting international growth, particularly within the US.
 Public speaking experience.
 🌱 You’ll thrive here if... 
 You’re a commercially minded functional leader who is comfortable building while doing. You can set the direction for a team, raise performance and create the structure needed to scale, while still staying close enough to customers to role-model what great looks like.
You’ll happily run the QBR when needed, coach someone through a difficult conversation and create the playbook that helps the whole team do it better next time. You’re direct, curious and focused on creating structure that improves performance, not process for the sake of it.
 🤝 Why Sensat? 
 We build technology that helps infrastructure organisations make better decisions across some of the world’s most important projects.
 You’ll have genuine ownership, direct access to senior leadership and the opportunity to shape and lead how Customer Success operates as Sensat enters its next phase of growth.
 If building something lasting excites you, we’d love to hear from you.
Benefits
 💷 Salary Information: £80,000 - £90,000 base salary as well as performance-related bonus scheme (20-25% based on team and account growth metrics)
📈 Share in Our Success: When Sensat succeeds, so will you, with significant equity share options giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success.
 🏝️ Time to Switch Off: Enjoy 30 days' annual leave, in addition to UK bank holidays, giving you plenty of time to properly switch off and recharge.
 🏡 Flexibility That Works: We offer a flexible working environment, giving you the freedom to balance time in the office with working remotely.
 🎓 Keep Learning: You'll receive a £500 annual personal development fund to invest in courses, books, conferences or anything else that supports your learning and growth.
 ❤️ We've Got Your Back: We care about making essential healthcare more accessible and affordable. Our BHSF health and wellbeing cash plan offers up to £1,700 cashback annually towards a range of everyday healthcare costs.
 🧠 Mental Health Matters: You'll have immediate access to mental health support through Spill, giving you confidential professional support whenever you need it.
 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Support for Every Stage of Life: We offer enhanced Family Leave to support you and your family during some of life's biggest moments.
 💻 Everything You Need: We'll set you up with a MacBook, mouse and keyboard, plus £250 towards your home-working setup, so you've got what you need to do your best work.
 🏢 Workspaces You'll Love: Our Fora office membership gives you access to brilliant workspaces, including gyms, fitness classes, events and dog-friendly offices.
 💰 Invest in Your Future: Our pension is provided through Penfold, with a 3% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution, with the option to increase your own contributions.
 🚴 Everyday Extras: You'll also have access to practical benefits including our Cycle to Work scheme, season ticket loans, eye-care vouchers and Payroll Giving.
 🎉 More Than Work: We make time to have fun together with regular team and social events. We've been to the theatre, gone go-karting, hosted movie nights, watched the London Symphony Orchestra, tried line dancing and even tackled a murder mystery.
At this time, we are only able to accept applications from those who have a right to work in the United Kingdom. Our office is in Old Street, London. 
Equality, Diversity and Inclusion 
 We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, disability, gender, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. All employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need, and our recruitment processes are conducted in accordance with the Equality Act 2010. If you require any adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
This is a fully remote position , open to candidates based in Canada.
 Pay: $50–$100/hr
 Role Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (SaaS) 
 Role Type: Contractor 
 Location: Remote 
We are engaging Revenue Operations Specialists (SaaS) to contribute to a customer's project focused on elevating operational effectiveness and data integrity in complex SaaS business environments. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is ideally suited for a professional with hands-on ownership of CRM systems and adjacent SaaS revenue tools, especially in regulated or multi-product contexts where operational judgment and clear communication are essential.
Scope of Work:
Assess and refine CRM data models to align with evolving sales, customer success, and revenue operations requirements.
Identify, arbitrate, and document resolutions for conflicting operational policies, explaining logical choices and tradeoffs.
Design and validate compliance-constrained workflows for SaaS revenue processes, ensuring adherence to vertical-specific regulations.
Diagnose and address gaps in revenue data integrity, supporting accurate, actionable reporting and analytics.
Deliver detailed process walk-throughs based on personal system configuration experience, highlighting decision points and lessons learned.
Contribute written and verbal insights for scenario-based operational training tasks in collaboration with project stakeholders.
Recommend system improvements with a focus on scalability, compliance, and cross-functional alignment.
Preferred Qualifications
4+ years of direct, hands-on experience in SaaS revenue, sales, customer success, or implementation operations (not adjacent or management-only exposure).
Proven CRM ownership (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) with configuration experience, plus at least two additional tools such as billing, CPQ, ticketing, or project tracking.
Demonstrated ability to resolve policy conflicts and explain operational tradeoffs in high-complexity, high-compliance environments (fintech, healthtech, insurtech, or similar fields strongly preferred).
Strong operational judgment: adept at making and justifying process decisions where rules, regulations, or business needs intersect.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of documenting logic and collaborating clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in process design for regulated industries or multi-product SaaS implementations, with a focus on compliance and reporting accuracy.
Comfort navigating ambiguity, prioritizing what to change versus what to leave stable, and articulating the rationale behind each decision.
 How to apply 
Apply here with your Indeed profile. We will then email you a link to complete your application on the hiring platform — your application is only considered once that final step is done.

title: GTM Manager / Head of GTM
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GTM Manager / Head of GTM based in Belgium.
 This is a hands-on commercial leadership opportunity at the intersection of AI, robotics, data, and model evaluation. You will own the development and execution of the go-to-market strategy, from defining target markets and customer profiles to building pipeline and closing revenue. Working directly with founders and closely with product, research, and engineering teams, you will translate complex technical capabilities into compelling commercial value. The role combines strategic GTM development with direct ownership of the full sales cycle. You will help turn early customer traction into repeatable acquisition, sales, and expansion processes. This is an early-stage environment offering significant autonomy, visibility, and influence over both commercial and product direction.
Accountabilities
Define and continuously refine the ideal customer profile, priority segments, buyer personas, target accounts, and market positioning across Physical AI and robotics. 
Build and execute the go-to-market strategy, covering positioning, customer acquisition, sales channels, partnerships, and commercial development. 
Generate qualified pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting, founder networks, strategic partnerships, industry events, and relevant inbound opportunities. 
Own the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal development, negotiation, and closing. 
Build relationships with technical decision-makers, budget owners, executive sponsors, and other stakeholders involved in complex purchasing decisions. 
Understand customer data-generation and model-evaluation challenges, purchasing criteria, budgets, timelines, and decision-making processes. 
Translate technical capabilities into clear business value, differentiated messaging, commercial materials, and compelling customer proposals. 
Partner with technical teams to structure commercially viable pilots and proof-of-concept engagements with measurable success criteria and defined paths to paid adoption. 
Support pricing and packaging decisions using customer feedback, willingness-to-pay signals, delivery economics, and market intelligence. 
Convert pilots and early engagements into paid contracts, renewals, and opportunities for account expansion. 
Identify and develop strategic partnerships that can create customer access and new revenue opportunities. 
Maintain accurate pipeline data and provide realistic forecasts covering deal progress, priorities, risks, buying signals, and next steps. 
Track key commercial metrics, including conversion rates, sales-cycle duration, deal value, and reasons for wins and losses. 
Bring customer and market insights back to product, research, and engineering teams to inform positioning, offerings, and product direction. 
Build repeatable sales processes, qualification frameworks, and commercial playbooks as the business scales. 
 Requirements
Demonstrated experience in B2B go-to-market, business development, or full-cycle sales for technical products or services. 
Proven track record of personally generating pipeline and closing revenue rather than solely managing a sales team. 
Experience selling to technical buyers and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes. 
Strong discovery and consultative selling skills, with the ability to connect customer challenges to compelling value propositions. 
Confidence leading commercial conversations, developing proposals, negotiating terms, and progressing opportunities toward decisions. 
Ability to understand and credibly communicate technical concepts while collaborating effectively with subject-matter experts. 
Experience defining target segments, developing market positioning, and testing customer-acquisition channels. 
Strong commercial judgment and disciplined approaches to qualification, prioritization, pipeline management, forecasting, and deal execution. 
High ownership, initiative, and comfort building processes from the ground up in an early-stage environment. 
Strong communication, relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills. 
Experience with AI, robotics, data platforms, infrastructure, developer tools, enterprise SaaS, or technical services is an asset. 
Existing relationships within robotics companies, AI labs, or enterprise AI teams are a plus. 
Experience transitioning founder-led sales into scalable and repeatable commercial processes is highly valued. 
Experience structuring technical pilots or proof-of-concept engagements and converting them into paid contracts is an advantage. 
Familiarity with pricing and packaging for software, data, or technical services is beneficial. 
Experience developing revenue-generating partnerships or helping a new offering enter a market is a plus. 
Genuine curiosity about AI, robotics, data, and emerging technologies, with the ability to engage credibly with technical stakeholders. 
 Benefits
Fully remote position. 
Significant autonomy and ownership over the commercial function and go-to-market strategy. 
Direct access to founders and close collaboration with product, research, and engineering leadership. 
Opportunity to build a commercial engine and sales processes from an early stage rather than inheriting an established playbook. 
Meaningful influence over revenue strategy, market positioning, customer development, and product direction. 
Opportunity to work at the intersection of AI, robotics, data generation, and model evaluation. 
High-impact environment with opportunities to shape repeatable acquisition, sales, partnership, and expansion processes. 
Exposure to technical customers, emerging AI applications, and complex enterprise buying environments. 
 How Jobgether Works

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether?
 Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: GTM Engineer
description:
About us 👇 
Workflows.io is an AI-native GTM services company specializing in helping B2B companies scale revenue through 4 service lines: LinkedIn Content, Outbound, RevOps, and ABM.
Combining AI workflows with human expertise to implement end-to-end growth systems.
Not another software.
Not another traditional agency.
Workflows is an AI-native GTM services company that delivers outcomes.
 Our growth trajectory: 
We’re already working with the world’s fastest-growing companies backed by YC, a16z, Insight Partners including: Cluely, Landbase, Freckle, Blacksmith, Hyperbolic, ExaCare and Fortune 500 companies like Alibaba to name a few.
Bootstrapped since day one, we’ve grown from 0 to $3M ARR in 12 months, without raising a single dollar.
 Our Mission: Become the #1 "service-as-software" for GTM.
 Our Values: 
 1. Ownership: Own your outcomes completely, good or bad.

 3. Hard Work: It’s cliche, but we’re looking for people who are comfortable with the intensity and pace that comes with high growth - and who see this as an opportunity to rapidly expand their skill set.
 The role: 
As a GTM Engineer , you'll work across outbound, RevOps, and ABM projects - helping B2B companies map their TAM, set up signal tracking, build CRM infrastructure, orchestrate inbound flows, and execute outbound plays.
You will work with multiple sales leaders of high-growth B2B SaaS companies.
 Your Responsibilities

 Project Management: Collaborate in Notion & Slack for project management and documentation.
 Internal Library of Plays: Contribute to our internal SOPs and knowledge-sharing

 What’s In It For You
