title: Global Head of Revenue Operations & Commercial Excellence
description:
Job Title: Global Head of Revenue Operations & Commercial Excellence 
 Location: Anywhere in Europe
 Working Model: Hybrid (flexible, depending on candidate location)
Reports to: Executive Committee (ExCo)
Department: Commercial/Sales
Seniority Level: Executive Leadership / Senior Leadership
Travel Requirements: Based on the business need (occasionally)
Global Head of Revenue Operations & Commercial Excellence
 Who Is Sa.global
 sa.global, a global Microsoft partner, specializes in delivering AI-powered, cloud-based solutions tailored for service-centric organizations such as architecture and engineering, legal, consulting, software services, accounting, and homebuilding. We help over 800,000 Microsoft Dynamics users across 80 countries to deliver operational excellence and financial performance for their organizations. An 13-time winner of the coveted Microsoft Dynamics Partner of the Year Award, sa.global is also a part of Microsoft’s elite Inner Circle. Established in 1990, we are now a 700+ member strong global organization with a presence in 22+ countries.
For more information about sa.global, please click www.saglobal.com.
ROLE PURPOSE
This is a newly created, high-visibility leadership role with the mandate to define and scale the future of our global commercial operating model. As Global Head of Revenue Operations & Commercial Excellence, you will bring together strategic ownership of CRM, sales operations, commercial governance, revenue forecasting, Microsoft partner compliance, and incentive management — creating a more connected, data-driven, and scalable approach to growth.
You will have the opportunity to shape how a transforming and ambitious organization goes to market, improve commercial discipline, and accelerate sustainable growth. Working closely with the Executive Leadership Team, CFO, and business leaders across the organization, you will establish the processes, insights, and capabilities that enable our commercial teams to perform at their best.
This is a unique opportunity to build the foundation of a world-class commercial engine — empowering teams to focus on customers, growth, and long-term success while ensuring the organization operates with clarity, consistency, and excellence.
 Who Thrives In This Role
 You are someone who finds satisfaction in making the machine work. You care about data integrity, process consistency, and operational reliability — not because you enjoy bureaucracy, but because you understand that disciplined commercial operations are what allow a sales organization to scale without breaking.
You are comfortable operating across multiple stakeholders and geographies without direct authority over most of them. You know how to influence through clarity, structure, and the quality of the data and processes you put in front of people. You do not need to own the strategy to have a significant impact on how it lands in market.
You have a strong bias toward automation and efficiency — you actively look for ways to replace manual reporting with system-driven insight and are energized, not threatened, by the opportunity to embed AI into revenue operations workflows.
You are pragmatic about change: you know that a new process only works if people adopt it, and you invest the time to make that happen.
If you want a role where operational excellence directly enables commercial growth — and where you build the infrastructure that an ambitious, transforming organization runs on — this is the right role for you.
 Key Accountabilities
 Sales Operations & CRM Governance: Own the end-to-end sales operations function, including CRM system integrity, pipeline governance, deal stage discipline, and process adherence. Ensure the commercial infrastructure provides a single, reliable source of truth for pipeline, forecasting, and revenue reporting across all entities and verticals.
 Revenue Forecasting & Commercial Reporting: Own the forecasting cadence, methodology, and accuracy standards. Deliver consolidated revenue forecasts to ExCo and the CFO, ensuring alignment between pipeline data, financial targets, and capacity planning. Surface risks, gaps, and trends early enough to enable intervention.
 Pricing, Discount Governance & Commercial Compliance: Own the group pricing framework, discount approval processes, and commercial contract review from an operational standpoint. Ensure deal pricing and margin modelling follow established guardrails and that intercompany pricing rules are applied consistently across multi-entity deals.
 Microsoft Partner Desk & Programme Compliance: Own the operational relationship with Microsoft’s partner programmes, including partner solutions designations (MPD), co-sell registration processes, incentive tracking, and certification maintenance. Ensure sa.global meets all programme requirements and captures available benefits.
 Incentive Calculation & Commission Administration: Own the end-to-end process for calculating, validating, and administering sales incentives and variable compensation. Ensure accuracy, transparency, and timely delivery in close collaboration with Finance and the CPO.
 Pursuit Management & Sales Process Governance: Own pursuit management standards, including stage entry and exit criteria, deal review cadences, go/no-go qualification, and readiness-to-sell approval processes. Drive adoption of consistent sales methodology across all markets.
 Technology Landscape & IT Liaison: Own the commercial technology stack in partnership with IT, including CRM configuration, sales tooling, reporting platforms, and data quality governance. Define business requirements, drive adoption, and ensure systems evolve to support AI-enabled and automated revenue workflows.
 GTM Enablement Coordination: Ensure GTM enablement materials, playbooks, and training produced by the Transformation Programme Lead are operationalized into the sales motion. Own readiness-to-selling processes and demand-to-pipeline alignment between Marketing and Sales.
 Win/Loss Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Lead structured win/loss analysis and embed learnings into repeatable sales plays. Scale what works by industrializing successful pursuits into standardized, replicable commercial motions.
 Key Outcomes — What Success Looks Like
 Forecast accuracy is consistently within agreed tolerance, and ExCo has a dependable forward view of revenue across verticals and geographies without needing to chase data.
 CRM is trusted as the single source of truth: pipeline data is clean, deal stages are meaningful, and reporting is automated rather than manually assembled.
 Microsoft partner programme requirements are met proactively, incentives are fully captured, and partner desk interactions are structured and timely.
 Incentive calculations are accurate, auditable, and delivered on schedule — removing a recurring source of friction between Sales, Finance, and HR.
 Commercial governance (pricing, discounting, contract review) operates as a reliable, scalable system rather than ad hoc escalation — with AI-assisted tooling progressively reducing manual effort in deal modelling and compliance checks.
 Core Skills
 Skills Level Definition
Revenue Operations & Sales Process Design - Ability to design, implement, and govern end-to-end sales operations processes across a multi-country, multi-vertical commercial organization.
CRM & Commercial Systems Management - Deep hands-on expertise in CRM platforms (Dynamics 365 preferred), reporting infrastructure, data quality governance, and sales tooling architecture.
Financial Acumen & Forecasting - Strong understanding of revenue forecasting, pipeline analytics, margin modelling, and the linkage between commercial activity and financial outcomes.
Commercial Governance & Compliance - Ability to design and enforce pricing frameworks, discount governance, and contract review processes with consistency and rigor.
Microsoft Partner Ecosystem - Working knowledge of Microsoft partner programmes, co-sell mechanics, MPD reporting, incentive structures, and certification requirements.
Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Coordination - Ability to operate across Finance, IT, Sales, HR, and Marketing without direct authority, aligning operational processes to strategic intent.
Data Analysis & Business Intelligence - Ability to translate commercial data into actionable insight through dashboards, win/loss analysis, and pipeline diagnostics.
AI-Enabled Process Design - Awareness of how AI and automation can improve revenue operations workflows — including forecasting, deal scoring, CRM hygiene, and incentive modelling — with willingness to adopt and champion new tooling.
 What We Offer
 Strategic leadership role with global impact – the opportunity to define and build sa.global’s Revenue Operations and Commercial Excellence function, shaping how a global Microsoft partner scales, operates, and grows.
 Executive-level exposure and influence – work closely with the Executive Committee, CFO, and senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, Finance, and Technology to drive commercial transformation and measurable business impact.
 Opportunity to build and transform – create scalable processes, governance frameworks, operating models, systems, and insights that become the foundation for predictable growth and commercial excellence.
 Key role in our AI-enabled transformation journey – help modernize commercial operations through automation, data-driven decision-making, advanced analytics, and innovative approaches to revenue management.
 Competitive executive compensation package – an attractive base salary, performance-based bonus, and benefits package aligned with the seniority, scope, and strategic impact of the role.
 Flexible hybrid working model – work from anywhere in Europe while collaborating with global teams across multiple countries and markets.
 Global and diverse environment – partner with talented colleagues across our international organization and contribute to a truly multicultural and collaborative workplace.
 High level of ownership and autonomy – the freedom to challenge existing ways of working, introduce improvements, and directly influence how sa.global scales for the future.
 Professional growth and continuous learning – access to opportunities to expand expertise in revenue operations, AI transformation, commercial excellence, and global leadership.
 Culture of innovation and accountability – join an environment where initiative is valued, impact is visible, and leaders are empowered to make meaningful change.
 Application, Data Privacy And Compensation
 At sa.global, we value the trust candidates place in us throughout the recruitment process. All information shared as part of your application will be treated with strict confidentiality and handled in accordance with applicable data protection regulations, including GDPR requirements.
Candidate information will only be used for the purpose of assessing suitability for this position and managing the recruitment process. Access to candidate data will be limited to the relevant stakeholders involved in the selection process.
sa.global is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. The compensation package for this position is determined based on objective criteria, including the scope and complexity of the role, required experience, skills, location, and relevant market benchmarks. The final compensation package will be discussed during the recruitment process and will reflect the candidate’s experience, expertise, and applicable employment market conditions.
Please note that this recruitment process is managed directly by sa.global. For this position, we are not working with external recruitment agencies or third-party suppliers. Unsolicited agency submissions will not be considered, and no agency fees will be applicable.
sa.global is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from talented individuals with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Good luck!

title: Strategy & Operations (1-3 YoE)
description:
Strategy & Operations (1-3 YoE) 
London, 4x days per week in-office
Vega is looking for multi-disciplinary A players who have what it takes to build a business from the ground up. We hire people who are already high-performers in MBB or finance/investing, but still have the itch to do more. This role will sit in the CEO Office, reporting to the Head of Strategy & Growth, working across the highest strategic priorities in the business.
 About Vega 
Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.
Vega built the industry’s first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done - from the start of an investor’s journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it’s also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.
 Who we are 
We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world’s leading technology and financial services firms - including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.
 How we do it 
Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:
 We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.
 We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.
 We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.
 We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.
 We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.
We know that this culture won’t be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.
 Who succeeds in this role 
We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.
In this role, you will:
Context-switch across strategy, go-to-market, operations, external comms, special projects, and investor relations
Be handed projects from Day 1, including representing Vega externally
Sit in the CEO Office, reporting directly to the Head of Strategy & Growth
Work closely with the Product & Growth and Engineering teams - strategy is not a silo at Vega
 What we look for: 
Required: 1-3 years of experience in MBB or finance/investing at a Tier 1 institution.
Whilst stellar training is essential, this is not all that we look for and not everyone with a background in MBB/investing will do well. This role is for people who have high standards of excellence for themselves, along with the risk tolerance and ambition to go beyond the comfort zone and structure of a larger institution.
Low ego, and a willingness to get stuck in; this role will allow you to do career-accelerating things that you might otherwise wait decades to do - but there will also be gruntwork. Everyone at Vega, including leadership, handles both.
Exceptional analytical and communication skills. You will need to think and explain complex concepts and communicate them internally and externally with different audiences.
 Why join us? 
Get a first-hand view, and real ownership of, everything that it takes to operate a fast-growing business
You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team
Competitive salary and equity package
Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

title: Director, Commercial Operations
description:
We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers.
From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go.
10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech.
But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together.
If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place.
Find us on Instagram: @optimizely
 Introduction
 The Director, Commercial Operations is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the operational backbone of Optimizely’s commercial engine. This individual will own and evolve the end-to-end commercial operations function — spanning pricing governance, SKU lifecycle management, CPQ platform integrity, Deals and Renewals Desk leadership, and partner channel operations. Reporting into the VP of Revenue Operations, the Director will serve as a critical integrator across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, Product, and IT, ensuring that commercial systems, processes, and people are aligned to deliver predictable, scalable revenue outcomes.
 Job Responsibilities
 Commercial Releases
Own and govern the Commercial Release Framework, setting release classification standards (where Pricing & Packaging impact) and ensuring appropriate runway timelines are defined, communicated, and adhered to across all commercial launches.
Serve as the primary integration point between Product, Finance, and Go-to-Market teams, translating commercial release plans into operational readiness requirements for CPQ, SKU governance, billing, and Deals Desk execution.
Guide and hold accountable downstream operational teams — including the Commercial Desk, Renewals Desk, and Reseller operations — on release-specific impacts, ensuring teams are enabled, systems are updated, and exceptions are managed ahead of go-live.
Drive cross-functional release governance, chairing or co-chairing commercial readiness reviews, maintaining the release planning framework, and escalating risks where runway, system integrity, or stakeholder alignment is at risk prior to launch.
Pricing Operations & Governance
Define and own the commercial pricing operations framework, ensuring pricing accuracy, consistency, and compliance across all systems and channels.
Partner with Finance and Sales leadership to develop, evolve, and govern pricing structures in support of go-to-market strategy.
Establish and maintain a pricing governance model, including exception management, escalation pathways, and audit cadences.
Drive continuous improvement in pricing data quality, monitoring for anomalies and systemic compliance risks.
CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) Ownership
Hold strategic and operational ownership of the CPQ platform, including architecture, configuration, quality assurance, and roadmap alignment.
Serve as the senior escalation point and commercial authority for CPQ-related issues raised by field sales, Deals Desk, and partner teams.
Govern UAT and change management processes for all CPQ enhancements, integrations, and releases.
Work cross-functionally with IT and system owners to drive CPQ continuous improvement, ensuring the platform scales with business growth.
SKU Governance & Catalogue Management
Lead and own the product SKU catalogue strategy, ensuring data integrity and synchronisation across CPQ, CRM, NetSuite, and downstream billing systems.
Govern the full SKU lifecycle — from creation and launch through active management, deprecation, and deactivation — with clear policies, documentation, and cross-functional communication.
Drive SKU rationalisation initiatives, reducing catalogue complexity while maintaining commercial flexibility and system stability.
Partner with Product, Finance, and IT to resolve systemic catalogue issues, including renewal logic, auto-provisioner alignment, and sync failures between platforms.
End-of-Life (EOL) Product Management
Lead the strategic and operational coordination of end-of-life product programmes for SKU Governance.
Define and enforce EOL governance standards for Pricing Operations, Desk and IT teams.
 Knowledge And Experience
8+ years of progressive experience in commercial operations, revenue operations, or a closely related function, with at least 3 years in a senior or people-management capacity.
Demonstrated experience owning CPQ platforms (e.g. Salesforce CPQ, Apttus/Conga) and CRM systems at an operational and strategic level.
Proven track record of leading SKU governance, pricing operations, or product lifecycle programmes in a SaaS or technology business.
Strong cross-functional leadership experience, working across Sales, Finance, Product, IT, and Customer Success at pace.
Experience managing or consolidating operational teams (Deals Desk, Renewals Desk, or equivalent).
Exceptional analytical and systems-thinking capability, able to diagnose root causes and drive durable solutions across complex, interconnected commercial infrastructure.
Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills; comfortable operating at Director and VP level across functions.
High commercial acumen — able to connect operational decisions to revenue outcomes, margin impact, and customer experience.
Clear, structured communicator with the ability to translate operational complexity into executive-ready narratives and documentation.
Process-oriented and quality-driven, with a track record of building scalable frameworks and governance structures.
 Education
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field. An MBA is a plus.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
An exciting Revenue Operations Manager opportunity with a high-growth SaaS business is looking for a commercially minded operations professional to help scale its customer and partner functions through better systems, reporting, automation and insight.
Based in Hybrid (Horsham / London)
1-2 days a week in the office

title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
description:
**The Opportunity:** **Zero\-to\-one category creation for AI\-Native Zero Trust Access**
**Cipherscale** is building an AI\-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.
The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.
**We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.**
**Mission:** discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale \- who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.
**What You Own**
* Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design\-partner recruitment.
* Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design\-partner conversion, and initial closing.
* Build an evidence\-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.
* Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.
* Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.
* Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs \- without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.
* Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.
**What This Role Is Not**
* It is **not** a traditional marketing leadership job.
* It is **not** an MQL, impressions, content\-calendar, or brand\-campaign role.
* It is **not** a decision to hire SDR, demand\-gen, content, and marketing\-ops teams **before** product\-market evidence exists.
* It is **not** ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established\-business growth mandate;
**This role is focused on Cipherscale zero\-to\-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.**
**Important:**
* This is a full\-time remote job, and it will be **a long\-term** **B2B contract.**
* This can be **a permanent employment** opportunity for candidates based in **Spain, Poland, and Germany.**
**Our philosophy is that we are a small, close\-knit team, and we care deeply about you:**
* Highly competitive salary \+ Bonus
* Fully remote work environments.
* Self\-managed time off.
 **Who We Want**
* You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI
product from near\-zero to repeatable initial revenue.
* You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI\-platform leader and earn credibility.
* You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,
enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.
* You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.
* You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.
* You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.
* You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.
**Strong Background Signals**
* Early\-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise\-security categories.
* Founder, first\-GTM, product\-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands\-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.
* Large\-company titles alone are not compelling.
**Anti\-Profile**
* Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."
* You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.
* You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.
* You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.
* You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.
* You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.
**First 90 Days:** Window Expected outcome
* **0\-30 days:** 10\-15 qualified ICP conversations; \~5 credible design\-partner candidates; evidence\-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.
* **31\-60 days:** Convert the strongest partners into real or production\-like deployments; measure time\-to\-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.
* **61\-90 days:** Target 5\+ production or production\-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.
**How Success Is Measured**
* **Business:** paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.
* **Customer:** time\-to\-first\-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,
retention and expansion.
* **Funnel:** qualified conversations \-\> design partners \-\> deployments \-\> production \-\> paid \-\> expansion.
* **Learning velocity:** experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.
**Operating Model and Reporting**
**This role works directly with the CEO during zero\-to\-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.**
Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth
organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes
repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.
**Security Expectations**
**You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially**
**technical environments.** Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,
deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer\-data boundaries, prompt\-injection
defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high\-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.
**Compensation Philosophy**
**We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder\-level operator**
**than assemble a large conventional GTM organization.** Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and
demonstrated ability to create zero\-to\-one enterprise value.
**The Test**
A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten
customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to
execute the work with minimal human headcount.

* **People Leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop a Revenue Operations team and culture aligned with Omada values. Serve as a member of the Commercial Operations senior leadership team.
**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field required; Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent preferred.

title: Sales Operations Analyst, Compensation
description:
Sales Ops Analyst, Compensation
AcuityMD is an AI platform that accelerates access to medical technologies. We help MedTech companies understand how their products are used, why customers vary, and identify opportunities for physicians to better serve their patients. Each year, the FDA approves ~6,000 new medical devices. Our solution helps MedTech companies get these products to physicians more effectively so they can improve patient care with the latest technology. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, and Ajax Health. We're a high-growth AI and Data company scaling rapidly.
This role, will design the compensation structure that translates our top-level strategy into how the commercial org actually operates — the mechanism that turns company goals into what the org is incentivized to do.
Team Mission
Revenue Operations exists to make AcuityMD's go-to-market motion predictable. We build the data, systems, and plans that tell the commercial organization where to aim and what they earn for getting there. Compensation is our sharpest tool: designed well, it drives the behavior the business needs, can be administered at scale, and is understood by every rep it touches.
Responsibilities
 Compensation Plan Design : Partner with Commercial leadership to design comp plans that drive our strategy, model payout outcomes for proposed plans and SPIFFs with the RevOps leader and CFO, pressure-test designs for administrability and rep comprehension, and support book of business and territory analytics
 Plan Administration: Configure and test plan builds in CaptivateIQ, keep plan documentation in Notion aligned to what is live, and administer quotas, plan issuance, acknowledgements, and new hire setup
 Commission Execution: Run the monthly cycle in CaptivateIQ. Reconcile deal, renewal, and roster data, calculate payouts across every plan, and deliver a validated file for Finance approval
 Attainment Reporting: Measure ramp and attainment across AE, AM, CSM, SDR, Solutions, and leader populations, and own the recurring reporting leadership uses to manage performance
 Commercial Partnership: Act as first responder on payout and data questions from the GTM organization, resolve discrepancies to root cause, administer exceptions such as deal transitions, and equip managers to own their team's review
 Territory design: Own ****for the commercial org, including modeling scenarios, recommending structural changes as the org grows, and updating segment definitions
 Your Profile 
3-6 years in sales compensation, commissions administration, or revenue operations at a high-growth SaaS company
Hands-on ownership of an incentive compensation platform; CaptivateIQ strongly preferred, with Xactly, Varicent, Spiff, or Everstage experience translating well
Fluency in plan mechanics: quotas, rates, tiers, accelerators, kickers, draws, splits, and clawbacks
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, and comfort reconciling imperfect data across CRM, CPQ, ERP, and HRIS systems. SQL is a plus
Highly organized and detail-driven, with the judgment to be the last check before money goes out the door
Excellent communication skills. You can explain a calculation to a frustrated rep and push back on a request that would compromise data integrity
Comfort with recurring hard deadlines, and with AI tools as part of your daily workflow
AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $110,000-140,000
 You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position. 
 We Offer: 
 Ground floor opportunity : Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
 Learning Budget:  Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
 Remote work : AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
 Flexible PTO : Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
 Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans:  We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
 Home Office Stipend:  $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
 Optional Team Retreats:  We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
 Parental Leave:  8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.
Who We Are:
 The Company:  We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.
We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.
 The Product:  AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.
How We Work:
AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.
We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.
In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

 We’re looking for an Associate Director, Revenue Operations to help lead and scale Directive’s Revenue Operations practice. This is a senior, client-facing player-coach role for someone who combines strong people leadership with deep technical expertise across Salesforce, marketing automation, and HubSpot.
You’ll partner closely with the Director of Revenue Operations to lead a team of RevOps Strategists, oversee complex client engagements, and ensure we consistently deliver high-quality strategic and technical work. Partner with Account Directors and internal leadership to identify expansion and cross-sell opportunities.
Support scoping, solution design, and new business conversations for RevOps opportunities.

 What You’ll Bring
 Must Haves
5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, CRM consulting, Marketing Operations, Salesforce consulting, or a related discipline.

Compensation for this role includes a competitive base salary

title: Associate Director, Sales Compensation Data Architecture and Strategy
description:
About the Role: 
 Grade Level (for internal use): 
12
 Role Overview: 
The Finance Associate Director, Sales Compensation (Data Architecture & Strategy) serves as the primary business partner for the S&P Global Market Intelligence division, focusing on data architecture, database building, and continuous systems maintenance. This position sits at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Technology. You will be responsible for gathering sales performance data from various source systems, evaluating and deploying optimal database tools, and constructing a centralized single source of truth for commission calculations and commercial reporting.
Operating as a key advisor to Sales leadership, Commissions, and Systems Analytics, you will translate complex commercial strategies into scalable data structures, troubleshoot systemic data errors, and ensure all commission operations run on a clean, validated, and SOX-compliant foundation.
 Responsibilities and Impact: 
This role is central to establishing a clean, scalable, and fully controlled data architecture for S&P Global Market Intelligence's sales compensation operations. By serving as both architect and governor of our single source of truth, the Finance Manager ensures reliable commission calculations, robust audit compliance, and trusted strategic reporting for leadership.
Manage, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of data and compensation analysts by defining goals, allocating resources, and fostering technical excellence and continuous improvement.
Own the full data platform lifecycle for extremely large, complex datasets: lead database build-out, schema design, tool selection, and ongoing maintenance to support commission calculations and sales reporting.
Design and implement automated reconciliation and standardized adjustment processes to ensure data integrity, accuracy, and audit-ready change management.
Partner with Business Intelligence and Systems Analytics teams to shape Data Warehouse architecture, ETL workflows, and scalable infrastructure that supports reliable downstream analytics.
Translate complex commercial contracts into structured, reusable data constructs that integrate cleanly into operational systems and reporting workflows.
Establish, document, and enforce enterprise data governance—covering data health, traceability, and operational consistency—across the organization.
Govern audit trails and automated validation models so every data change is fully traceable and SOX-compliant, and so calculations run on validated inputs.
Produce and communicate sales performance analytics and data-quality metrics for senior leadership, highlighting trends, risks, and root causes.
Communicate complex data and architecture in clear plain English for sales reps and leaders, resolving data-related questions and driving adoption of correct processes.
Serve as the first point of contact for sales leadership; proactively detect and resolve data anomalies (e.g., double-counted revenue, incorrect territory mapping) before they impact calculations.
Lead end-to-end pipeline and calculation troubleshooting with Commissions and Systems Analytics to ensure clean, validated data foundations.
Lead process design and standardization by converting ambiguous legacy workflows into documented SOPs and clear SLAs.
 Compensation/Benefits Information: (This section is only applicable to US candidates) 
S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is
$104,435 to $182,604. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.
In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.
 What We’re Looking For: 
 Basic Required Qualifications: 
10+ years of relevant experience in sales compensation, data architecture, data governance, financial systems, sales operations, or a related field, including experience leading and developing high-performing analytical teams.
 Database & Technical Mastery: Deep hands-on experience in database building, schema design, database maintenance, data warehousing, ETL processes, and advanced SQL querying across very large and complex data environments.

title: Director, Growth Strategy, Planning + Ops
description:
Before TuneCore, artists needed to be signed to a record label to sell their music online. In 2006, we democratized the industry by partnering directly with digital stores and streaming platforms to enable any musician to sell their songs worldwide while retaining 100% ownership of their music. Today, TuneCore is the leading independent development partner for self-releasing artists to build audiences and careers, with technology and services across distribution, publishing administration and a range of promotional services. TuneCore is headquartered in Brooklyn, NY, and owned by Paris-based Believe, one of the world’s leading digital music companies. The company is one of the fastest growing companies in the music industry and is actively investing in the continued growth of the business. 
We have made it our mission to best serve artists and labels at each stage of their development in the digital world. We are a company that cares deeply about our people and our creator community, advocating for diversity, equity, and inclusion across all of our platforms and throughout our business. The pursuit of innovation inspires us to work hard for our artists, while collaboration drives the way we work and approach our company’s social responsibility.
Join TuneCore as we embark on the next phase of innovation in the music industry. Be part of the team that bridges the unmet and evolving needs of creators by building the tools and services that make their lives better.
 Job Description
As we evolve our product, redefine our brand and accelerate global growth, we're creating a Growth organisation capable of operating with the discipline of a world-class technology business and the creativity of a culture-leading brand for independent artists.
Reporting to the the VP Brand Marketing this role will be responsible for building the engine that powers this transformation. Acting as a strategic partner to the Leadership Team, you will establish the planning and operating model that enables Brand and Growth to operate as one high-performing global organisation that finds, retains and empowers independent artists at scale.
This is an exceptional opportunity for a highly driven, entrepreneurial leader who enjoys building from the ground up. You will design and embed the frameworks, rhythms and governance that bring clarity, alignment and accountability to how Marketing works - transforming ambition into measurable execution at scale. From annual planning and integrated campaign operations to launch excellence and budget management, you will create the systems that enable the team to move faster, make better decisions and deliver greater commercial impact.
Working closely with Product, Finance, Data, Customer Experience, regional teams and colleagues across Believe, TuneCore’s parent company, you will operationalise the creation, communication and delivery of key strategic initiatives, ensuring they are scalable, measurable and aligned to business priorities. You will champion an insight-led approach to planning, helping the organisation develop a deeper understanding of artist needs, marketing effectiveness and opportunities for growth.
You are equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up your sleeves to make it happen. You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are naturally curious and data-driven, and bring the confidence to challenge thinking, influence senior stakeholders and continuously improve the way teams work together. Above all, you believe that operational excellence is not about process for process' sake - it exists to unlock creativity, accelerate innovation and ultimately help more independent artists succeed at scale.
 The tasks and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:
 Strategy + Planning
Partner with Leadership to define strategic priorities, resource allocation and investment decisions. 
Develop and own the annual planning process, translating company objectives into integrated marketing priorities and measurable outcomes. 
Establish quarterly and bi-annual planning rhythms that align Growth, Brand, Product and the business teams around shared objectives. 
Build and maintain the organisation’s roadmap, ensuring visibility across initiatives, launches and campaigns. 
 Operations
Design and implement scalable operating models, governance and ways of working. 
Introduce best practice planning processes, briefing frameworks, approval workflows and project management disciplines. 
Establish clear roles, responsibilities and decision-making frameworks across the organisation. 
Drive operational excellence through continuous process improvement and simplification. 
Lead cross-functional planning, ensuring Product, Growth, Brand, Creative, Regional and Finance teams are aligned from strategy through execution. 
Create consistent launch frameworks, timelines, playbooks and retrospectives to improve delivery over time. 
 Marketing Performance & Measurement
Build the measurement framework, defining success metrics across Brand, Growth and Int’l teams. 
Develop dashboards and reporting that provide real-time, actionable visibility of performance, campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution and business outcomes. 
Partner with Finance + Insights teams to establish attribution models, reporting standards and performance insights. 
Lead regular business reviews, identifying opportunities to optimise performance and improve return on investment. 
 Budget + Resource Management
Partner with Finance and Growth Leadership to manage annual marketing budgets and investment planning. 
Track spend across teams, markets and programmes, ensuring effective allocation of resources against strategic priorities. 
Build forecasting models and investment frameworks that support data-informed decision making. 
 Cross-functional Leadership
Act as the operational connector between Growth, Brand, Product, Finance, Data,Customer Experience and Business teams. 
Facilitate strategic planning sessions, leadership reviews and cross-functional governance meetings. 
Foster a culture of accountability, transparency and continuous improvement across the organisation. 
Some international travel (at least 10-25% of the time) is required
 Qualifications
10+ years experience in Marketing Strategy, Marketing Operations, Business Operations or Commercial Strategy within a high-growth technology, SaaS, marketplace or digital consumer business.
Demonstrated success building marketing planning processes, operating models and organisational rhythms from the ground up.
Experience leading annual planning, quarterly business reviews, integrated launch planning and cross-functional programme management.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes and financial performance.
Excellent analytical capability, including experience developing KPIs, dashboards, measurement frameworks and executive reporting.
Deep understanding of modern marketing organisations across Brand, Growth, Product Marketing and Creative functions.
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across complex global organisations.
Exceptional organisational and programme management skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic initiatives simultaneously.
Experience managing budgets, agency relationships and cross-functional investment planning.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building new capabilities within fast-changing environments.
Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate strategy into clear action.
Passion for music, creators and the independent artist ecosystem is highly desirable.
Experience supporting international or multi-market marketing organisations is preferred.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience; postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing or Strategy is advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred
Location: This role will be based out of the London, Believe office in Kings Cross. TuneCore operates on an in-office and remote hybrid model giving our teams flexibility and choice of how they work. Required in-office Tues, Weds, Thurs.
 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
 Additional Information
 Our Values
TuneCore is a team of creators, for creators. Our mission is to support our artists and labels at every stage of their careers. Our driving forces are fairness, expertise, respect and transparency. As global citizens, we believe that if we build more diverse, equitable and inclusive teams across our company, we will collectively create and offer more innovative solutions and better serve our artists, labels, partners, and employees. 
 We strive to build a company that reflects the communities we serve and embraces the diversity of the world we live in, where each person’s unique perspective is valued, and where everyone has the same opportunities and is supported in their personal and professional growth. From our hiring practices to the culture we create and nurture, we are committed to listening, learning and evolving. Our goal is to make TuneCore an inspirational place that feels comfortable and familiar no matter how you look, where you call home, who you love, what you believe, or what’s on your playlist. 
 CSR Strategy: Shaping Music for Good 
Our core values are put into action through Shaping Music for Good, Believe and TuneCore’s global corporate social responsibility strategy, integrated at all levels of the company and at the heart of our business model. 
 We strive to shape the music industry for good by building trusting relationships with artists and partners, investing in the growth and talent development of our local markets, and empowering our community to positively impact society. We work to achieve progress on our core priorities: gender equity, diversity, equity & inclusion, environmental sustainability, and wellness for our employees, artists, and industry partners. 
 Shapers Program 
Employees have the opportunity to join the Shapers Program, a resource group made up of teammates who want to dedicate their time and skills to Shaping Music For Good initiatives. Shapers develop action plans, educate teammates, support the implementation of programs, and inspire action within the organization on causes and issues that align with TuneCore and Believe’s SMFG priorities. 
 Inclusion in the Music Business Report
In 2025, Believe and TuneCore partnered with the Annenberg Inclusion Initiative, the world’s leading think tank studying diversity and inclusion in the entertainment industry, to produce the second Inclusion in the Music Business report which analyzes the gender, race, and ethnicity among executive leadership in the music industry.
 Recognition and Awards
Fast Company's 10 Most Innovative Companies in Music list (2023-2025)
Crain's Best Places to Work in NYC (2022-2024)
 Benefits & Perks
At TuneCore we’re committed to the well-being of our employees and aim to create a workplace that fosters both personal and professional growth. Our inclusive benefits include, but are not limited to:

Company wide events, outings and volunteer days – we have team spirit and know how to have fun! 
Hybrid Work 
Learning and development opportunities and career development training – we believe in promoting and growing our leadership from within the company and proactively invest in our people. 
Free distribution subscription for employees – so you can experience the magic of releasing music worldwide (and give us valuable feedback!)

Jouw prestaties worden beloond met een bonus of met leuke teamuitjes.

Mogelijkheid tot reiskostenvergoeding

title: Manager Sales Operations
description:
Leidinggeven, optimaliseren en groeien. In deze rol combineer je strategie met actie en bouw je aan sterke teams en betere resultaten.
 Goede beloning 
Jouw prestaties worden beloond met een bonus of met leuke teamuitjes. 
 Jouw ontwikkeling 
Met opleidingen en trainingen word jij een expert in het salesvak.
 Extra toeslagen 
In het weekend werken? Dat verdient lekker want dan krijg je extra toeslagen. 
 Leuk team 
Het salesteam bestaat uit een hechte club met enthousiaste collega’s.
 Wat ga je doen? 
Als Manager Sales Operations ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het aansturen en ontwikkelen van de commerciële binnendienst van meerdere shops. Je zorgt ervoor dat teams zelfstandig functioneren, doelstellingen behalen en zich continu ontwikkelen. Met jouw energie en betrokkenheid weet je mensen te motiveren en het beste uit hen naar boven te halen.
Je richt je op het realiseren van commerciële groei door salesprocessen te optimaliseren en projecten succesvol uit te voeren. Je schakelt moeiteloos tussen strategie en operatie en neemt beslissingen die bijdragen aan betere resultaten. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de Manager Sales en fungeer je als sparringpartner.
Binnen onze organisatie krijg je de ruimte om processen slimmer in te richten en nieuwe initiatieven op te zetten. Je werkt met data en dashboards om inzicht te creëren en prestaties te verbeteren. Zo draag jij direct bij aan onze ambitie om verder te groeien, ook internationaal.
 Een greep uit de werkzaamheden 
• Je stuurt en ontwikkelt meerdere commerciële teams binnen onze shops
• Je realiseert omzetgroei door processen te verbeteren en kansen te benutten
• Je leidt commerciële projecten van idee tot resultaat
• Je ontwikkelt en optimaliseert dashboards voor inzicht en sturing
• Je denkt actief mee met de Manager Sales en vertaalt ideeën naar concrete verbeteringen
 Dit krijg je van ons! 
Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie in een sterk groeiend bedrijf
Goed salaris en aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling
Toegang tot 100+ trainingen in onze Online Academy
Mogelijkheid tot reiskostenvergoeding
Iedere twee weken een massage
Personeelskorting op onze producten
Toegang tot het platform Corporate Benefits met aantrekkelijke kortingen op mode, elektronica, vakanties, dagjes uit en nog veel meer
Centrale locatie, binnen 30 minuten van Amsterdam en Utrecht
Gezonde lunches, avondeten en gratis fruit in onze gezellige bedrijfskantine
 Wat vragen wij? 
Je hebt hbo werk en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een commerciële, bedrijfskundige of economische richting.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar commerciële ervaring, bij voorkeur binnen een sales binnendienst of inside sales omgeving.
Je hebt minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar leidinggevende ervaring en weet teams succesvol aan te sturen en te ontwikkelen.
Je hebt ervaring met het leiden van commerciële projecten en het realiseren van aantoonbare omzetgroei.
Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands en Engels.
Je bent resultaatgericht, besluitvaardig en weet mensen te overtuigen en mee te nemen in jouw plannen.
Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en blijft continu zoeken naar verbeterkansen.
 Het salesteam 
Het salesteam bestaat uit een hechte club enthousiaste collega’s. We vieren samen feestjes en hebben leuke afdelingsuitjes. Natuurlijk gaan we ook mee met de uitjes en (sport) evenementen die door het bedrijf worden georganiseerd. Samen werken we hard om onze doelstellingen te behalen. Op de salesafdeling werken we met een diverse groep aan collega's: van studenten tot collega's die al jaren in het vak zitten. Zo blijven we van elkaar leren!
 Zo ziet de
sollicitatieprocedure eruit 
 Telefonische intake We nemen telefonisch contact met je op.
 Kennismaking We nodigen je uit voor een kennismaking bij ons op kantoor.

 Voorstel We willen graag dat je bij ons komt werken en sturen je een voorstel.
 We verwachten deze functie zelf in te kunnen vullen. Acquisitie vinden we zonde van jouw én onze tijd.

title: Renewals Manager - French Speaker
description:
MongoDB is looking for a driven, results-oriented, and experienced Renewal Manager (Senior IC) to join our Renewals Team in the EMEA region. In this role, you will play a key part in delivering a world-class renewal experience for our customers across the French markets, while driving strong retention outcomes for MongoDB’s business.
Success in this role requires exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, operational excellence, advanced deal formulation and negotiation experience, and the ability to build solid relationships with internal stakeholders. We are looking for a senior professional who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment and who is motivated by the opportunity to have a major impact on their team, customers, and MongoDB's business.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.
What You Will Be Doing
As a Renewal Manager at MongoDB, you will be responsible for managing the commercial renewal process for our Enterprise Growth customer base, ensuring the seamless continuation of their partnerships with MongoDB and maintaining strong customer relationships. You will work closely with our Sales and Customer Success teams to offer an outstanding customer experience, ultimately contributing to the growth and retention of our customer portfolio within your territory.
Renewal Management
Proactively manage the end-to-end renewal process for assigned customer accounts, owning timelines, coordination, and execution to drive high retention outcomes and maximize Renewal Rates
Work strategically on upcoming renewals, engaging with customers 120 days in advance to secure timely, predictable renewals
Prepare complex renewal quotes and contracts, ensuring accuracy and strict compliance with company policies
Customer Engagement & Services Attachment
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders to understand their consumption patterns, business needs, and challenges
Act as a trusted commercial advisor to customers, providing insights and solutions to maximize the value they receive from MongoDB, including the strategic integration of Professional Services
Data Analysis & Forecasting
Utilize data and reporting tools to track renewal performance, accurately forecast risk and revenue, and proactively identify at-risk accounts. Knowledge of Tableau and Salesforce are a plus!
Provide regular, detailed updates to the EMEA management team on renewal status, forecasts, and key performance metrics
Cross-functional Collaboration
Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Legal, and Finance to ensure a highly coordinated, frictionless approach to renewals and expansions
We're Looking for Someone With:
Experience: 5+ years of customer-facing sales, account management, or revenue-carrying experience within a fast-paced, competitive SaaS or technology environment
Track Record: A proven history of quota-carrying experience with a focus on closing renewals, managing commercial outcomes through to execution, and consistently exceeding targets. (Excellence clubs, awards!)
Negotiation Skills: Strong problem-solving, organization, and commercial negotiation skills, with experience handling complex contractual terms
Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills - French and English, with the ability to confidently present to a diverse, senior audience both internally and externally
Agility: The ability to effectively prioritize and manage a high volume of concurrent opportunities in a dynamic environment
Relationship Building: A natural talent for building solid, collaborative relationships with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders
Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to database, cloud, and infrastructure technology is highly preferred
Location requirement: Must be based in, or willing to relocate to, Dublin, Ireland
Why Join Now
A Proven Market Leader: Join a company at the absolute forefront of data innovation, recently named to the CRN Big Data 100 and experiencing massive EMEA growth (including a landmark €74M investment and expansion across Ireland)
Best-in-Class Sales Enablement: Benefit from industry-renowned sales training, onboarding bootcamps, and continuous career development programs widely praised across tech employer reviews
Highly Rated Workplace Culture: Work within a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performance environment that values diverse perspectives and offers competitive equity packages
Generous and Competitive Benefits: Enjoy robust mental health, fertility, parental leave, and flexible hybrid working models designed to support a sustainable work-life balance
 About MongoDB
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Assistant GTM Manager Gaming
description:
Role overview: 
 Assistant GTM Manager Gaming 
London
Currys London Campus at Waterloo
Fixed Term Contract 12 Months
Full Time
Grade 3
At Currys we’re united by one passion: to help everyone enjoy amazing technology. As the UK’s best-known retailer of tech, we’re proud of the service our customers receive – and it’s all down to our team of 25,000 caring and committed colleagues. Working as one team, we learn and grow together, celebrating the big and small moments that make every day amazing.
Join Currys and help bring the biggest names in gaming to life. As an Assistant Go-To-Market (GTM) Manager, you'll play a key role in supporting the planning and delivery of exciting product launches, supplier-funded campaigns, and multi-channel marketing activity across our Gaming category.
Working closely with senior stakeholders, suppliers, and brand partners, you'll help coordinate campaigns across digital and physical channels, identify new marketing opportunities, and ensure our customers enjoy engaging and seamless experiences.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a commercially minded, organised, and customer-focused individual looking to build a career in marketing, category management, and go-to-market strategy within a fast-paced retail environment.
 Role overview: 
As part of this role, you'll be responsible for:
Coordinating the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns, product launches, and business initiatives.
Working with cross-functional teams to execute impactful multi-channel marketing activity.
Aligning campaign plans with commercial objectives and customer growth opportunities.
Maintaining campaign briefs, timelines, workflows, and delivery updates.
Driving continuous improvements to campaign planning processes and ways of working.
Developing supplier-funded marketing proposals to unlock additional investment.
Managing campaign administration and performance reporting.
You will need:
Experience supporting the planning and delivery of marketing campaigns or commercial projects within a fast-paced environment.
Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to build effective relationships across teams and with external partners.
Commercial awareness, with the ability to understand business objectives and support campaigns that drive customer engagement and sales performance.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret data, track campaign performance, and manage campaign plans accurately.
To be customer-focused, with an understanding of how marketing activity drives engagement and customer experience.
We know our people are the secret to our success. That's why we're always looking for ways to reward great work. You'll find a host of benefits designed to work for you, including:
Performance related bonus.
Competitive pension scheme.
Product discounts on the latest tech.
A range of wellbeing initiatives.
Hybrid working; our primary Currys Campus is at Waterloo (WeWork) with an expectation to meet in person 2 times per month.
 Why join us: 
Join our team and we'll be with you every step of the way, helping you develop the career you want with new opportunities, on-going training and skills for life.
Not only can you shape your own future, but you can help take charge of ours too. As the biggest recycler and repairer of tech in the UK, we’re in a position to make a real impact on people and the planet. 
Every voice has a space at our table and we're committed to making inclusion and diversity part of everything we do, including how we strengthen our workforce. We want to make sure you have a fair opportunity to show us your talents during our application process, so if you need any additional assistance with your application please email careers@currys.co.uk and we'll do our best to help.

title: AI Architect - GTM Systems
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Architect - GTM Systems based in Canada. 
This senior individual contributor role will define the technical vision for AI-powered Go-To-Market systems and automation.
You will architect, prototype, and establish scalable patterns across low-code platforms, enterprise integrations, and custom AI agents.
The role combines hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, requiring the ability to move from strategic discussions to working prototypes.
You will partner with GTM engineering, Sales Operations, business technology, and executive stakeholders to turn business objectives into technical roadmaps.
The position will shape standards for agentic AI, LLM orchestration, integrations, governance, observability, and responsible AI.
You will influence how complex GTM workflows are designed, evaluated, automated, and operated at enterprise scale.
This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced technical leader who enjoys setting architectural direction while remaining deeply hands-on.
Accountabilities:
Define and own the technical vision and architecture strategy for AI-powered GTM systems, covering both low-code automation and custom agentic AI solutions.
Establish reference architectures, design patterns, and decision frameworks that guide technology choices across the GTM engineering organization.
Determine when to use low-code platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, and Salesforce Flow versus custom AI and software engineering solutions.
Lead the architecture of complex GTM systems involving multi-system integrations, agentic workflows, real-time event processing, and cross-platform data orchestration.
Design integration strategies across platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, Marketo, and custom data stores, including APIs, event contracts, and data models.
Evaluate, select, and drive adoption of emerging AI tools, frameworks, and platforms while balancing innovation, risk, operational requirements, and technical debt.
Serve as a technical authority on LLM orchestration, including prompt safety, retrieval-augmented generation, model context management, tool calling, multi-agent coordination, and responsible AI practices.
Establish governance, extensibility, and operational standards that enable safe and scalable low-code automation.
Partner with senior GTM stakeholders to translate strategic business objectives into architectural roadmaps with defined trade-offs, timelines, and success criteria.
Conduct architecture reviews, provide structured technical feedback, identify systemic risks, and promote continuous improvement in engineering practices.
Develop internal technical thought leadership through architecture decision records, white papers, engineering documentation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
Mentor engineers and contribute to raising the technical standards and architectural capabilities of the wider organization.
Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of software engineering experience with a proven record of building and deploying production-grade backend systems.
At least 3 years of experience in a Technical Lead or comparable technical leadership role.
Demonstrated hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents used by real end users, with the ability to explain the problem, architecture, implementation, and outcome of a specific agent.
Strong practical knowledge of LLM orchestration and agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing and implementing RAG systems, including vector databases, retrieval strategies, chunking approaches, and embedding pipelines.
Strong backend engineering fundamentals with Python and/or Node.js and experience with FastAPI or equivalent frameworks.
Experience with asynchronous and event-driven architecture patterns.
Experience with AWS and cloud-native services such as Bedrock, Lambda/serverless, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or equivalent technologies.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business objectives into technical solutions.
Strong architectural judgment and the ability to balance low-code, custom development, automation, governance, scalability, and maintainability.
Experience building evaluation and observability capabilities for LLM-powered systems, such as LangFuse, tracing solutions, benchmark suites, or custom evaluation frameworks, is desirable.
Familiarity with sales, deal desk, finance, or revenue operations workflows is desirable.
Experience with FastMCP, LiteLLM, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or production multi-agent systems is desirable.
Familiarity with Salesforce as a data source and understanding of where relevant GTM data resides is desirable.
Experience in an AI-for-GTM or RevOps environment, or experience transitioning from RevOps into AI engineering, is desirable.
Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to technical hiring is desirable.
Knowledge of prompt engineering and model behavior across different LLM providers, including OpenAI and Anthropic/Claude, is desirable.
Full-stack development experience involving custom applications, AWS Bedrock, Node.js, Python, and serverless technologies is desirable.
Benefits:
Fully remote position available across Canada.
Annual base salary range of $135,575–$175,450 USD , with actual compensation varying based on location, experience, skills, and job-related qualifications.
Eligibility for an initial Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) grant with no vesting cliff, subject to applicable plan terms.
Potential ongoing equity refresh opportunities based on performance and applicable plan conditions.
Performance-based bonus or variable compensation as part of the broader total rewards package.
Flexible, employee-led remote working model.
Professional development stipend.
Comprehensive health benefits.
Parental leave programs.
Opportunities for career development and technical growth.
Exposure to advanced AI, agentic systems, cloud infrastructure, enterprise integrations, and GTM technology.
Opportunity to work with multidisciplinary teams and senior business stakeholders on high-impact initiatives.
Inclusive and collaborative environment focused on innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.
 How Jobgether works:

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
 Why Apply Through Jobgether? 
 Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.
#LI-CL1We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
